english: Currently, it has six (6) check-in counters, up from the initial two (2) only.

english: There is also a newly developed ramp that can serve up to four (4) jet aircraft at the same time, which has increased the operational capacity of the airport.

english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Giovanni Lopez, Acting Secretary of the Department of Transportation, said that due to the increase in the length of the runway from 1,430 meters to 1,800 meters, it provides the opportunity to accommodate jet aircraft.

text: Apang padayon pa nga nagapakig-angot sa Local Government Unit (LGU) sang Antique bangud may ara sang mga panimalay kag imprastraktura sa puno kag punta sang runway.
english: However, the Local Government Unit (LGU) of Antique is still in contact because there are houses and infrastructure at the beginning and end of the runway.

english: Yesterday, President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

english: the inauguration of the Antique Airport Development Projects in Funda Dalipe, San Jose de Buenavista, Antique.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang development ang may balor nga Php1.576 billion, nga ginalakipan sang bag-o nga ginpatindog nga Passenger Terminal Building (PTB) nga mahimo nga makaakumodar sang tubtob 360 ka pasahero, kumpara sa una nga 64 lamang.
english: The development, worth Php1.576 billion, includes a newly constructed Passenger Terminal Building (PTB) that can accommodate up to 360 passengers, compared to the previous 64 only.

text: Milagro para sa ginikanan sa Canada nga masaksihan ang first birthday sang ila anak nga kapid nga amo ang ginakilala nga pinaka-premature nga kapid sa bilog nga kalibutan.
english: It was a miracle for a Canadian parent to witness the first birthday of their twin daughter, who is recognized as the most premature twin in the world.

text: Nabun-ag ang babies nga sanday Adiah kag Adrial Nadarajah sang Marso 4, 2022 sa edad lamang nga 22 weeks ukon 126 ka adlaw.
english: Babies Adiah and Adrial Nadarajah were born on March 4, 2022 at just 22 weeks or 126 days.

text: Nagabug-at lamang sila sang 330 gramos kag 420 gramos, kag sila man ang pinakamag-an nga babies suno sa Guinness World Records.
english: They weigh only 330 grams and 420 grams, and they are also the lightest babies according to Guinness World Records.

text: Sang ginbun-ag ang duha, may yara gid lamang sang zero percent chance of survival suno sa doktor.
english: When the twins were born, there was really only a zero percent chance of survival according to the doctor.

text: “When I went into labor, the babies were denied all life-sustaining measures at the hospital I was admitted to and almost left to die,” suno sa iloy nga si Shakina Rajendram.
english: “When I went into labor, the babies were denied all life-sustaining measures at the hospital I was admitted to and almost left to die,” said mother Shakina Rajendram.

text: Todo ang pasalamat sa iloy nga si Shakina Rajendram bangud sa dalayon, ginpadaku nila kag gintatap ang kapid tubtub nga nabatyagan niya nga alive and kicking na si baby boy kag si baby girl!
english: Thank you very much to the mother Shakina Rajendram for always, they raised and cared for the twins until she felt that baby boy and baby girl are alive and kicking!

text: Matapos ang anum ka bulan nga pagtinir sa ospital kun sa diin may mga kumplikasyon pa nga natabo kaangay sang brain bleeding kag sepsis, ginpapauli na gid man sa balay ang kapid.
english: After six months in the hospital with complications such as brain bleeding and sepsis, the twins were finally sent home.

text: Sang gintatap na sa balay, 18 ka beses ang gindaku ni Adiah halin sa iya nga birthweight!
english: When she was cared for at home, Adiah grew 18 times her birthweight!

text: “She’s an extremely happy and social baby, and smiles all day long,” pahayag sang iloy.
english: “She’s an extremely happy and social baby, and smiles all day long,” the mother said.

text:
“She is very chatty and has ‘conversations’ with us and her toys for hours.”

Sa subong suno sa mommy, may nagakatabo gihapon nga infections kag respiratory issues sa iya bata nga si Adrial apang masami man gina-check sa ospital, wala ginapabay-an, kag makit-an gid ang progress sa lawas.
english:
“She is very chatty and has ‘conversations’ with us and her toys for hours.”

Currently, according to the mommy, there are still infections and respiratory issues in her son Adrial but he is often checked in the hospital, not neglected, and the progress in the body can be seen.

text: “Observant, attentive, intelligent, kag music lover” ini suno sa iloy.
english: He is “observant, attentive, intelligent, and a music lover” according to the mother.

text: Masami ginahambal nga para lang sa tigulang ukon may edad ang gout, isa ka sahi sang balatian nga nagapalanakit ang kasukasuan, ilabi na sa tiil tuga sang tuman nga uric acid.
english: Often said to be for the elderly, gout is a type of disease that causes pain in the joints, especially in the feet, caused by excess uric acid.

text: Apang suno kay Jing Zamora, isa ka rheumatologist, mahimo man nga makaangkon sang gout ang mga kabataan nga naga edad 20 anyos pataas.
english: But according to Jing Zamora, a rheumatologist, children aged 20 years and older can also develop gout.

text: Pahayag niya, ang mga lalaki ang masami nga nagaka-angkon sang gout bangud mataas ang ila nga uricacid — isa ka kemikal nga kabangdanan agud mag-porma ang gout sa lawas.
english: He said men are more likely to develop gout because they have high levels of uricacid — a chemical that causes gout to form in the body.

text: Agud mabuhinan ang sakit nga nabatyagan, panugyan sang eksperto nga kun mahimo likawan ang mga pagkaon nga may uric acid.
english: To reduce the pain, experts recommend avoiding foods containing uric acid if possible.

text: Mas importante man nga mag pa check-up sa doktor agud makakuha sang pang-maintenance nga bulong.
english: It is also more important to check-up with a doctor to get maintenance medication.

text: Nag-isyu sang isa pa ka warrant of arrest nbatok kay Atong Ang kag sa iban pa nga akusado angot sa pila ka kaso sang kidnapping with homicide may kaangtanan sa missing sabungeros.
english: Another warrant of arrest was issued against Atong Ang and other accused in connection with several cases of kidnapping with homicide in connection with the missing sabungeros.

text: Ginsuguran sang Philippine National Police ang pagserbe sang warrant sang Miyerkules apang wala gid nadakpan si Ang.

text: Ipatuman na epektibo subong nga adlaw, Enero 20, ang maximum suggested retail price (MSRP) nga P58 sa imported rice.
english: The maximum suggested retail price (MSRP) of P58 for imported rice will be implemented effective today, January 20.

text: Suno sa Department of Agriculture (DA), sa Metro Manila anay ang inisyal nga implementasyon kag panilagan sa masunod nga sinemana para sa posible nga adjustments.
english: According to the Department of Agriculture (DA), the initial implementation will be in Metro Manila and will be monitored next week for possible adjustments.

text: Suno kay Agriculture Assistant Secretary kag spokesman Arnel de Mesa, maga-check ang personnel sang DA kag Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) sa mga merkado agud masiguro nga naga-comply sila sa pagsulundan.
english: According to Agriculture Assistant Secretary and spokesman Arnel de Mesa, personnel of the DA and Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) will check the markets to ensure that they comply with the rules.

text: Sa idalom sang Price Act, mahimo makapatong ang traders sang maximum nga 10% nga ginansya sa baligya nila, apang sa idalom sang maximum SRP, ang P58 amo dapat ang pinakamataas nga presyo.
english: Under the Price Act, traders can charge a maximum of 10% profit on their sales, but under the maximum SRP, P58 should be the highest price.

text: May pila ka rice varieties kaangay sang glutinous rice, black rice kag red rice nga indi covered sang maximum SRP.
english: There are some rice varieties like glutinous rice, black rice and red rice that are not covered by the maximum SRP.

text: Ginpahayag ni De Mesa nga kumpyansa sila nga maganubo na ang retail price sang bugas sa masunod nga inadlaw.
english: De Mesa said they are confident that the retail price of rice will decrease in the coming days.

text: Samtang, subong man nga semana natalana nga mag-istorya si DA Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr.
english: Meanwhile, this week, DA Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr. is scheduled to meet with the government.

english: to President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.

english: Remegio “Reming” Gumban.

english: So now, Reming has got the assurance of some business friends to start a business in their town.

text: Good luck Reming!

text:
***

Sa aton Demokrasya, ang gahum yara sa mga pumuluyo kag indi sa isa ukon pila lang ka tawo nga luyag maghimo sang bisan ano lang nga magustuhan nila.
english:
***

In our Democracy, the power lies with the people and not with one or a few people who want to do whatever they like.

text: Amo gani nga importante ang pagluntad sang mga partido pulitikal, nga ang isa nagaamlig kag ang isa nagabantay sa hulag sang yara sa pihak.
english: That is why the existence of political parties is important, with one protecting and the other monitoring the movement of the other.

text: Sa sini nga palaabuton nga mid-term elections sa Mayo 13, 2019, natural nga “on the defense” ang administrasyon sa pagpanguna sang partido PDP-Laban kag ka-koalisyon sini.
english: In the upcoming mid-term elections on May 13, 2019, the administration led by the PDP-Laban party and its coalition partners will naturally be on the defense.

text: Sa kampayahanay nga natalana sa Pebrero 12, sa bahin sang mga kandidato nasyonal, kag sa Marso 29 sang mga kandidato lokal, depensahan sini ang mga programa kag proyekto nga ginpangako kag ginapatigayon sini agud liwat makapungko sa poder.
english: In the campaign scheduled for February 12, on the part of national candidates, and on March 29 for local candidates, it will defend the programs and projects it has promised and is implementing to regain power.

text: “On the offense” naman ang partido kag ka-koalisyon sa oposisyon sa ila pagkritikar sang mga kakulangan kag kapaslawan sang administrasyon, nga ginapangunahan sang Liberal Party, para sa oportunidad nga makabulos man sa poder kag makapatigayon sang ila mga hingyo sa kaayuhan sang mga pumuluyo.
english: The party and its opposition coalition are “on the offensive” in their criticism of the shortcomings and failures of the administration, led by the Liberal Party, for the opportunity to take power and implement their demands for the benefit of the people.

text: Sa sining ila sambuwa sa pagkumbinsi sang mga pumuluyo sa kon ano gid ang mas maayo nga hingyo para sa mga pumuluyo magagamit ini sila sang nagakalain-lain nga mga isyu, metodo, kag palautwasan – radyo, TV, pahayagan, social media kag iban pa nga gimmick.
english: In their struggle to convince the people of what is the best demand for the people, they will use a variety of issues, methods, and means – radio, TV, newspapers, social media and other gimmicks.

text: Madamo sang istratehiya ang pwede mahimo.
english: There are many strategies that can be done.

text: Kon ano man ina, ang importante nga malab-ut ang mga pumuluyo sa paagi nga mahapos nila ma-intiendihan.
english: Whatever it is, the important thing is to reach the people in a way that they can easily understand.

text: In fact, wala ang mga kandidato sing kinalis sa mga negosyante nga nagabaligya sang ila produkto.
english: In fact, the candidates are no different from the entrepreneurs who sell their products.

text: May General Merchandising, sa diin madamo nga produkto ang mapilian sang mga manugbakal.
english: There is General Merchandising, where many products are available for shoppers to choose from.

text: May Niche Marketing man, sa diin ang focus yara lang sa isa ka produkto katulad sang sapatos nga Nike, Converse kag iban pa, kag delargo nga may isa lang ka tag ukon brand.
english: There is also Niche Marketing, where the focus is on one product such as Nike shoes, Converse and others, and delargo with only one tag or brand.

text: Sa pagkampanya sa eleksyon, may ginatawag man nga Micro-Targeting, nga daw pinasangkad nga Niche Marketing.
english: In election campaigning, there is also something called Micro-Targeting, which is like extended Niche Marketing.

text: Sa Micro-Targeting, ang mga botante gina-classify sa lain-lain nga grupo – dalagku nga negosyante, gamay nga negosyante, lain-lain nga propesyonal, informal settlers (squatters),  mangingisda, salespersons, kon ano nga radyo kag TV ang ginapamatian, kon ano nga peryodiko ang ginabasa, kon sin-o ang ila paborito nga artista kag celebrity, barkada, mga fraternity kag sorority, kag kon ano pa nga grupo sa ila partikular nga problema kag huyog.
english: In Micro-Targeting, voters are classified into different groups – big businessmen, small businessmen, various professionals, informal settlers (squatters), fishermen, salespersons, what radio and TV they listen to, what newspaper they read, their favorite friends, celebrities and celebrities fraternity and sorority, and whatever other group in their particular problem and inclination.

text: Ang ideya diri amo nga ma-identify ukon mahibal-an sing temprano pa kon sin-o ang naluyagan na nila botohon kag ang kon sin-o pa pwede ma-persuade ukon makumbinsi magboto sa kandidato.
english: The idea is to identify or know early who they like to vote for and who else can be persuaded or convinced to vote for the candidate.

text: Importante diri ang isa ka survey nga makagiya sa kandidato kon ano pa ang iya himuon agud magdaug.
english: Important here is a survey that can guide the candidate on what else he needs to do to win.

text: Mauti ugaling ining micro-targeting kag magasto kaayo.
english: However, this micro-targeting is bad and very expensive.

text: Sa mga may kulang sang badget, sa masami ginapili lang nila kon diin nga grupo may padaug sila, katulad sang pagkampanya lang sa mga lugar nga may madamo nga botante, ang pagpangamusta door-door, kag ang magdala sang ila panghuna-huna angot sa mga dalagku lang nga isyu.
english: For those who lack a budget, they often choose which group they have to win, such as campaigning only in areas with many voters, greeting door-to-door, and bringing their views on major issues.

text: Katulad ina sang ginhimo ni Duterte sadtong siya nangampanya, sa diin nagtutok lang  siya sa dalagku nga problema sa droga kag krimen, kag problema sang mga trabador.
english: That's similar to what Duterte did during his campaign, where he focused on the big problems of drugs and crime, and the problems of workers.

text:
***

In fact, pwede man gamiton sang oposisyon ang ining simple nga pangampanya – ang iguon lang ang mga mayor nga kapaslawan kag problema sang administrasyon kag ang mga isyu nga importante sa mga pumuluyo.
english:
***

In fact, the opposition can also use this simple campaign – just to hit the major failures and problems of the administration and the issues that are important to the people.

text: Lakip na diri ang problema sa presyo sang balaklon, ang aton relasyon sa Tsina kag Estados Unidos, kag ang personal nga pagtan-aw sang mga pumuluyo sa indibidwal nga kandidato.
english: These include the commodity price problem, our relationship with China and the United States, and citizens’ personal assessment of the individual candidate.

text: Ti, good luck na gid lang sa inyo nga mga kandidato!
english: Well, good luck to you candidates!

text: Tani, ang mga labing masaligan gid sa panghimanwa ang mapilian.
english: Hopefully, the most trustworthy in the community will be elected.

text: Nakapauli na kagab-i, Enero 19, ang bangkay sang Ilongga overseas Filipino worker (OFW) nga si Mary Jill Dela Cerna Muya, nga napatay sa Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates (UAE).
english: The body of Ilongga overseas Filipino worker (OFW) Mary Jill Dela Cerna Muya, who died in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates (UAE), returned home last night, January 19.

text: Tuman ang pagpasalamat sang pamilya Muya bangud, suno sa ila, wala gid sila maglaom nga mangin madali ang pagdala pauli sang bangkay sang ila himata.
english: The Muya family is very grateful because, according to them, they never expected that it would be easy to bring home the body of their relative.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo sa iya utod nga si Michelle Muya Santos, iya ginpahayag nga nasubuan sila sa natabo kay Mary Jill, apang nalipay man bangud “makapahuway na ini sang insakto” matapos nga na-repatriate pauli sa iya pamilya.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, her sister Michelle Muya Santos said they are saddened by what happened to Mary Jill, but also happy because she can “rest properly” after being repatriated back to her family.

text: Sandig sa impormasyon sang pamilya, ginapahayag nga gin-utas ni Muya ang iya kaugalingon nga kabuhi.
english: According to family information, Muya allegedly took his own life.

text: Nasapwan siya nga wala na sang kabuhi sa iya ginatiniran nga hulot sa Abu Dhabi, UAE.
english: He was found dead in his living room in Abu Dhabi, UAE.

text: Tumandok sang Jaro, Iloilo City si Muya kag ginabanta duha ka dekada na ini nga naga-trabaho sa luwas sang pungsod.
english: Muya is a native of Jaro, Iloilo City and has been working abroad for about two decades.

text: Pahayag sang pamilya, nag-umpisa sila nga matingala sa sitwasyon sini matapos nga wala ini nakapangamusta ukon nakapanamyaw sa iya anak sa tion sang Pasko.
english: The family said they began to wonder about his situation after he did not greet his son during Christmas.

text: Matandaan nga nagdangop ang pamilya sa Bombo Radyo kag nagpanawagan sang bulig agud madala na pauli ang bangkay ni Mary Jill.
english: The family turned to Bombo Radyo and asked for help to bring Mary Jill's body home.

text: Nagpasalamat nama ini sa Bombo, sa OWWA amo man kay Iloilo City Lone District Representative Julienne “Jamjam” Baronda nga natigayon madala pauli ang bangkay ni Mary Jill sa Iloilo.
english: He thanked Bombo, OWWA and Iloilo City Lone District Representative Julienne “Jamjam” Baronda for bringing Mary Jill's body back to Iloilo.

text: Nabatyagan mo man bala ang tuman ka init subong nga tyempo?
english: Do you feel the heat right now?

text: Apisar nga naga ulan-ulan sa Iloilo, indi sa gihapon manigar nga naga tagiti ang init.
english: Although it's raining in Iloilo, it's still hot.

text: Bangud sa mainit nga panahon subong, uso ang bungang balhas ilabi na sa mga bata ukon sa lapsag.
english: Due to the hot weather, fruit balhas is popular especially for children or babies.

text: Suno kay Dr. Karissa Platon, isa ka pediatrician, ang mga lapsag ukon kabataan nga naga edad 4 ka tuig panubo ang masami ginatubo-an sang bungang balhas bangud ang ila sweat glands ang padayon pa nga naga develop.
english: According to Dr. Karissa Platon, a pediatrician, said babies or children under the age of 4 are more likely to develop acne because their sweat glands are still developing.

text: Apang indi lang mga bata ang nagakatubo-an sang bungang balhas kundi amo man ang mga tigulang ukon may edad nga masami naga balhas.
english: But it is not only children who grow beards but also the elderly who often beard.

text: Masami magtubo ang bungang balhas sa tyura, liog, abaga, likod, tyan, dughan, sa idalom sang ilok kag iban pa.
english: Moles often grow on the face, neck, shoulders, back, abdomen, chest, under the nose and other areas.

text: Panugyan ni Dr. Platon, siguraduhon nga hydrated ukon mag inom sang madamo nga tubig, indi pagkaluton ang bahin sang lawas nga may bungang balhas, maggamit sang mild soap lamang, magtinir sa sulod balay kun udto, magsuksok sang presko nga bayo kag gilayon nga mag ilis kun basa na ang bayo sang balhas.
english: Advice of Dr. Platon, make sure you are hydrated or drink plenty of water, do not scratch the part of the body with the fruit of the balhas, use only mild soap, stay indoors at noon, wear fresh clothes and immediately change if the clothes are wet with balhas.

text: Ginalauman ang ekonomiya sang Pilipinas nga maka-post sang kapin sa anum ka porsyento nga pag-uswag subong nga tuig nga may mas manubo nga inflation kag interest rates agud suportahan ang consumption kag investments.
english: The Philippine economy is expected to post more than six percent growth this year with lower inflation and interest rates to support consumption and investments.

text: Samtang ang inflation amo ang major risk sa ekonomiya sang Pilipinas kag global economy sa sulod sang tatlo ka tuig.
english: Meanwhile, inflation has been the major risk to the Philippine economy and global economy for the past three years.

text: Ang average nga inflation sang pungsod nga 3.2 percent sang nagligad nga tuig ang yara sa sulod sang target nga range sang bangko sentral nga duha tubtob apat ka porsyento.
english: The country’s average inflation rate of 3.2 percent last year is well within the central bank’s target range of two to four percent.

text: Nahibaluan nga sang nagligad nga tuig, amo ang una nga tion nga ang average nga headline inflation yara sa sulod sang target sang bangko sentral, halin sang 2021.
english: Notably, last year, was the first time that average headline inflation was within the central bank’s target, since 2021.

text: NATUBLAG gid kita sa sining balita sa Kalibo, Aklan nga gindala sang Panay News sadtong Pebrero 19 sang sini nga tuig.
english: WE ARE deeply disturbed by this news in Kalibo, Aklan brought by Panay News on February 19 this year.

text: Sunu sa sining balita,  8 sa 10, ukon 80 ka porsyento, sang mga first-born (una nga mga anak) sa Aklan indi legitimo, ukon sang wala makasal nga mga partner.
english: According to this news, 8 out of 10, or 80 percent, of first-borns in Aklan are illegitimate, or of unmarried partners.

text: Ini nga datos kuha sa Philippine Statistics Authority.
english: This data is taken from the Philippine Statistics Authority.

text: Sobra kataas ini sa pang-kalibutan nga statistics sang mga indi legitimo nga mga kabataan nga yara lang sa 15 ka porsyento!
english: This is too high for the global statistics of illegitimate children which is only 15 percent!

text: Natabo ini, wala duha-duha, tungod madamo na nga mga young adults ang wala luyag magpakasal.
english: This happened, no doubt, because many young adults do not want to get married.

text: Okey lang sa ila ang mag-cohabit, ukon mag-live-in, kag magkaanak sa amo sina nga relasyon.
english: It’s okay for them to cohabit, or live-in, and have children in that relationship.

text: Isa ka daku nga rason diri ang diborsyo nga legal sa madamo nga nasyon sa Amerika kag Uropa.
english: A big factor here is divorce being legal in many American and European countries.

text: Tungod sining diborsyo, madamo matuod ang wala nagapakasal, ukon naga-cohabit (live-in) lang, sa ila kahadlok nga matabo man sa ila ang mga failed marriages sang ila mga ginikanan.
english: Because of this divorce, many people do not marry, or just cohabit (live-in), for fear that the failed marriages of their parents will happen to them.

text: Sunu sa McKinley Irvin Family Law statistics (updated sang 2018),  42-45% sang first marriages sa Estados Unidos nagtapos sa diborsyo; 60 porsyento sa 2nd marriages; kag 73% sa 3rd marriages.
english: According to McKinley Irvin Family Law statistics (updated in 2018),  42-45% of first marriages in the United States end in divorce; 60 percent in 2nd marriages; and 73% in 3rd marriages.

text: Tungod sini, para sa mga young adults, wala sing forever matuod, kag wala man pulos ining pag-upod bisan pa sa sinumpaan nga “til death do us part”.
english: Because of this, for young adults, there is no forever, and there is no point in being together even with the oath “til death do us part”.

text: Sa bahin sang mga Filipino, sa diin wala sing diborsyo, ang masami nga rason amo ang kapigaduhon.
english: On the Filipino side, where there is no divorce, the most common reason is poverty.

text: Ara sa karagto nga kultura sang mga Filipino ang magasto nga kasal nga indi masarangan sang mga pigado.
english: It is part of the Filipino culture to have expensive weddings that the poor cannot afford.

text: Tungod man sa sini nga rason, mahapos gani magsiling ang mga young Filipino adults nga wala sa papel ang maayo nga pag-upod kundi sa mahirup nga pag-tamdanay.
english: For this reason, it is easy for young Filipino adults to say that good relationships are not based on paper but on close relationships.

text: Gani, ngaa pa magpakasal sila?
english: So, why would they get married?

text: Matuod, indi talaksan ang casamiento, ukon marriage certificate, para sa maayo nga pag-upod sang mag-partner sa kabuhi.
english: True, a casamiento, or marriage certificate, is not a criterion for a good marriage.

text: Apang, kon maayo na ang mag-live-in para sa mag-partner indi naman ugaling manegar nga may indi maayo ini nga resulta sa mga kabataan, luas sa problema legal, nga dapat ta gid ulikdon bilang maayo nga ginikanan.
english: However, if it is good to live-in for the partner, there is no denying that it has bad consequences for the children, in addition to legal problems, which we must avoid as good parents.

text: Ang isa ka pagtuon nagpakita sang indi maayo nga madangtan sang mga kabataan sang indi kasado nga mga ginikanan – halin sa mataas nga mortality (kamatayon) sang mga lapsag, atrasado nga pagdaku (delayed development), poor achievement sa eskwelahan, kag mas problemado nga pagbinatasan.
english: One study showed the negative consequences for children of unmarried parents – from high infant mortality, delayed development, poor school achievement, and more problematic behavior.

text: Kalakip sining problema sa pagbinatasan amo nga madali sila ma-expose sa pagpanabako, sa makahulubog nga ilimnon kag sa ilegal nga droga, kag ang kakulangan sa pag-intiende kon ano ang maayo kag malain nga nagatulak sa madamo sa ila sa paghimo sing malain.
english: Among these behavioral problems is that they are easily exposed to smoking, alcohol and illegal drugs, and a lack of understanding of right and wrong that leads many of them to do wrong.

text: Samtang ang mga kabataan sang mga kasal nga mga ginikanan mas maayo ang ila panglawason ,  mas mataas ang achievement sa eskwelahan, kag may mataas nga pinanilagan kag ihibalo sang kon ano ang maayo kag malain.
english: Meanwhile, children of married parents are healthier , achieve higher in school, and have a higher sense of right and wrong.

text:
***

Sa karon, amat-amat na gid man seguro damo ang nagapakasal tungod sa mga mass marriage nga wala bayad nga ginapatigayon sang gobyerno kag mga non-government organizations (NGOs).
english:
***

Nowadays, more and more people are getting married because of the free mass marriages conducted by the government and non-government organizations (NGOs).

text: Kon may reklamo tungod sa mauti kag madamo nga requsitos sa pagpakasal, sala ina ugaling nga pagpati.
english: If there is a complaint about the mauti and many requirements for marriage, that is a wrong belief.

text: Indi man mabudlay ang magpakasal a. Sunu mismo sa Family Code, simple man lang ang requisitos agud makasal.
english: It's not hard to get married. According to the Family Code itself, the requirements for marriage are simple.

text: Sunu sa Art.
english: According to Art.

text:
2 sang Family Code, “No marriage shall be valid, unless these essential requisites are present:

“(1) Legal capacity of the contracting parties who must be a male and a female; and (2) Consent freely given in the presence of the solemnizing officer,” nga dugang ginaathag sa Art.
english:
2 of the Family Code, “No marriage shall be valid, unless these essential requisites are present:

“(1) Legal capacity of the contracting parties who must be a male and a female; and (2) Consent freely given in the presence of the solemnizing officer,” which is further clarified in Art.

text: Ang Art.
english: The Art.

text:
6 nagasiling: “This declaration shall be contained in the marriage certificate which shall be signed by the contracting parties and their witnesses and attested by the solemnizing officer.”

Amo gid lang ina ang “essential requirements” sang balido nga kasal.
english:
6 states: “This declaration shall be contained in the marriage certificate which shall be signed by the contracting parties and their witnesses and attested by the solemnizing officer.”

Those are the only “essential requirements” of a valid marriage.

text: Kag wala man nagasiling diri nga ma-invalido ang kasal kon wala pa mabaton ang dokumento sang Civil Registry kag NSO.
english: And it does not say that the marriage will be invalidated if the document has not been received by the Civil Registry and NSO.

text: Tungod sini, partikular sa kaso nanday Charlie kag Sheerlyn nga nag-viral sa internet, nagapati kita nga legal ang ila kasal bisan wala pa nabaton sang natungdan ang dokumento sang ila kasal halin sa pastor.
english: Because of this, particularly in the case of Charlie and Sheerlyn who went viral on the internet, we believe that their marriage is legal even though the person concerned has not received the document of their marriage from the pastor.

text: In other words, formalidad lang ang pagbaton sining dokumento nga indi maka-invalido sang ila kasal.
english: In other words, it is just a formality to receive this document that will not invalidate their marriage.

text: Nagsugtanay na ang Thailand kag ang Cambodia sa pagpatuman sang ceasefire matapos ang lima ka adlaw nga away sa border nga nagresulta sang masobra 30 ka mga patay kag nagpatal-as sang linibo ka mga residente.
english: Thailand and Cambodia have agreed to implement a ceasefire after five days of border fighting that resulted in more than 30 deaths and displaced thousands of residents.

text:
Santo sa anunsyo ni Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim, nag-umpisa ang “immediate and unconditional ceasefire” kaina sang tungang gab-i.

“This is a vital first step towards de-escalation and the restoration of peace and security,” pahayag sini sa press conference sa administrative capital nga Putrajaya.
english:
According to the announcement of Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim, the “immediate and unconditional ceasefire” began yesterday at midnight.

“This is a vital first step towards de-escalation and the restoration of peace and security,” he said at a press conference in the administrative capital Putrajaya.

text: Sa amo nga anunsyo, nagtambong man sanday Thai acting Prime Minister Phumtham Wechayachai kag si Cambodian Prime Minister Hun Manet.
english: The announcement was also attended by Thai acting Prime Minister Phumtham Wechayachai and Cambodian Prime Minister Hun Manet.

text: Suno kay Anwar, magakit-anay ang military commanders halin sa duha ka nasyon subong nga aga antes magsapol ang cross-border committee sang magtimbang nga bahin sa Cambodia sa Agusto 4.
english: Anwar said military commanders from the two countries will meet this morning before the cross-border committee of both sides meets in Cambodia on August 4.

text: Nahibaluan nga halos 300,000 ka mga pumuluyo halin sa border regions sang duha ka nasyon ang nag-evacuate bangud sang pagsinigabong sa area nga madugay na gina-awayan.
english: It is known that nearly 300,000 residents from the border regions of the two countries have been evacuated due to the fighting in the area that has long been disputed.

text: Ini ang pinakamakamamatay nga gamo sa magkaiping nga nasyon nga nag-ugat pa sang 2008-2011 bangud sa isyu sa teritoryo.
english: This is the deadliest conflict in the neighboring countries that took root in 2008-2011 over territorial issues.

text: Sa pag-ibwal sang tensyon subong nga tuig, kadam-an sa casualties sa Thailand suno sa militar amo ang mga sibilyan nga naigo sang rockets.
english: At the height of tensions this year, most of the casualties in Thailand, according to the military, were civilians hit by rockets.

text: Sa Cambodia naman, 13 ang patay lakip ang walo ka mga sibilyan.#
english: In Cambodia, 13 people were killed, including eight civilians.

text: Ginakonsiderar bilang “no.1 most wanted” sa Pilipinas ang negosyante nga si Atong Ang.
english: Businessman Atong Ang is considered the “no.1 most wanted” in the Philippines.

text: Suno ini kay Department of Interior and Local Government (DILG) Secretary Jonvic Remulla.

text:
Pahayag sang tiglikom, akusado si Ang sa pagpatay sa masobra 100 ka missing nga sabungeros kag makabig ini nga “armed and dangerous.”

“Kasama po si Atong Ang siguro maituturing natin na number one most wanted sa buong Pilipinas ngayon.
english:
The secretary said Ang is accused of killing more than 100 missing sabungeros and is considered “armed and dangerous.”

“Atong Ang is probably the number one most wanted in the Philippines right now.

text: He’s accused of killing over 100 missing sabungeros and he is considered armed and dangerous,” suno kay Remulla.
english: He’s accused of killing over 100 missing sabungeros and he is considered armed and dangerous,” Remulla said.

text: Pahayag pa sini, sandig sa intelligence reports, nagabyahe si Ang nga may (at least) 20 ka mga bodyguard apisar nga ginkanselar na ang lisensya sang iya armas.
english: He said that based on intelligence reports, Ang travels with (at least) 20 bodyguards despite the fact that his firearms license has been cancelled.

text: “Si Atong po ay bumibiyahe nang hindi kumukulang ng 20 ang bodyguard lagi.
english: “Atong travels with at least 20 bodyguards.

text: Sanay po ‘yan sa marahas na pagharap sa mga awtoridad.
english: He is used to violent confrontation with the authorities.

text: Sanay po ‘yan sa marahas na paraan para masolusyonan ang kanyang mga problema,” dugang pa niya.
english: He is used to violent means to solve his problems,” he added.

text: Bangud sini suno sa DILG chief, himuon sang law enforcers ang tanan nga legal nga pamaagi agud nga maaresto ang nasambit nga negosyante.
english: The DILG chief said law enforcers will take all legal measures to arrest the businessman.

text: Pahayag sini, 320,000 ka mga myembro sang PNP ang magapangita sa bilog nga Pilipinas.
english: He said 320,000 PNP members will search the entire Philippines.

text: Ginpasalig man sini nga wala sang matabo nga extrajudicial killings.
english: He also assured that there will be no extrajudicial killings.

text: “Ang buong 320,000 members ng PNP ay hahanapin siya sa buong Pilipinas.
english: “The entire 320,000 members of the PNP will be looking for him all over the Philippines.

text: At lahat ng paraan na kailangan gawin para kunin siya ay gagawin namin.
english: And we will do whatever it takes to get him.

text: Pero, may garantiya kami na walang EJK,” suno sa iya.
english: However, we have a guarantee that there will be no EJK,” he said.

text:
“Mag-iingat lang ang ating mga kawal na hindi sila masaktan sa pagkuha kay Atong Ang.”

Nagtanyag man ang ahensya sang P10-million nga padya para nga madakpan si Ang.
english:
“Our soldiers will be careful not to get hurt by taking Atong Ang.”

The agency also offered a P10-million reward for Ang's arrest.

text: Ini nga kuwarta magahalin sa intelligence fund sang ahensya kag ihatag sa “no questions asked” basis.
english: This money will come from the agency’s intelligence fund and will be provided on a “no questions asked” basis.

text: “Basta ikaw ‘yung nagbigay ng impormasyon leading directly to the arrest ay P10 milyon ang reward para sa kanya,” suno sa tiglikom.
english: “As long as you are the one who gave information leading directly to the arrest, the reward for him is P10 million,” the secretary said.

text: Dugang niya: “Nandito pa siya [sa Pilipinas] kasi noong sabi nga ng abogado noong the day before ay kasama niya pa.
english: He added: “He was still here [in the Philippines] because he said that the lawyer the day before was still with him.

text: Pumipirma ng mga papel bago lumabas ‘yung mga warrant of arrest a few hours later.
english: Signing papers before the warrants of arrest are issued a few hours later.

text:
So ang tracking namin nandito pa rin siya.”

Lakip si Ang sa 18 ka mga tawo nga gindagdagan sang warrant of arrest nga may koneksyon sa pagkadula sang mga manugbulang.
english:
So we're tracking he's still here.”

Ang is among 18 people whose arrest warrants have been added in connection with the healers’ disappearance.

text: Nagapangatubang siya sang 15 counts sang kidnapping kag serious illegal detention kag four counts sang kidnapping with homicide.
english: He faces 15 counts of kidnapping and serious illegal detention and four counts of kidnapping with homicide.

text: Yara na sa kustodiya sang kapulisan ang 17 ka iban pa nga akusado.
english: Seventeen other accused are now in police custody.

text: Nagapati ka bala nga may siyam ka kabuhi ang mga kuring?
english: Do you believe cats have nine lives?

text: Lantawa ini nga video sang isa ka kuring sa Cebu City nga naglumpat halin sa 18th floor sang isa ka building sa Barangay Labangon.
english: Watch this video of a cat in Cebu City who jumped from the 18th floor of a building in Barangay Labangon.

text: Ginapahayag nga nagtawag ang mga residente sang rescuers agud ma-luwas ang isa ka kuring nga yara sa ledge sang isa ka condominium sa amo nga barangay.
english: Residents reportedly called rescuers to rescue a dog that was on the ledge of a condominium in the barangay.

text: Pag-abot sang City Animal Disaster Rescue Team, makit-an gid kun ano ang ila paghinay-hinay kag pag-halong agud nga mabutang sa net ang pobre nga kuring.
english: When the City Animal Disaster Rescue Team arrived, it was obvious how slow and careful they were to put the poor cat in the net.

text: Pero sa baylo nga mag-kooperar kag magsulod sa net, sa kakibot sang tanan, naglumpat ini halin sa iya ginapungkuan!
english: But instead of cooperating and going into the net, to everyone’s surprise, it jumped out of its perch!

text: Halin sa ika-18 nga panalgan, nagtupa ini sa atop sang second floor, kag mapati ka kag sa indi, buhi ini gihapon!
english: From the 18th floor, it landed on the roof of the second floor, and believe it or not, it is still alive!

text: Gilayon nga gindala ang kuring sa veterinarian agud nga ma-check.
english: The cat was immediately taken to the veterinarian to be checked out.

text: Safe na ini subong apang magapabilin anay sa doktor para sa dugang nga obserbasyon.##
english: He is safe now but will stay with the doctor for further observation.##

text: Extra nga confidence ang nahatag kay Miss Universe Philippines Chelsea Manalo matapos ang send-off ceremony para sa iya pagtiglawas sa Pilipinas sa global pageant.
english: Extra confidence was given to Miss Universe Philippines Chelsea Manalo after the send-off ceremony for her representation of the Philippines in the global pageant.

text: Pahayag sang Bulakenya beauty queen, mas daku ang pagsalig niya sa iya kaugalingon bangud sa mga mensahe sang kaabyanan, pamilya, team, kag organisasyon nga nagtipon gid antes ang iya pagpadulong sa Mexico para sa 73rd edition sang pageant.
english: The Bulakenya beauty queen said she has more confidence in herself because of the messages from friends, family, team, and organizations that gathered before her trip to Mexico for the 73rd edition of the pageant.

text: Yara sa send-off ang iloy sang 24-anyos nga titleholder amo man si former Miss Universe Philippines Shamcey Supsup.
english: The mother of the 24-year-old titleholder was also present at the send-off as was former Miss Universe Philippines Shamcey Supsup.

text: Suno kay Chelsea, 9/10 pa lang ang iya pagpanghanda subong bangud ang magakumpleto sini amo gid ang suporta sang mga Pilipino.
english: According to Chelsea, she is only 9/10 prepared now because what will complete it is the support of the Filipinos.

text: Balantayan ang koronasyon sa Nobyembre 16 kun sa diin tinguhaan sini nga makuha ang ika-lima nga MU crown para sa Pilipinas.
english: Watch the coronation on November 16 where he will try to win the fifth MU crown for the Philippines.

text: Indi lang si Chelsea ang Pinay sa amo nga pageant.
english: Chelsea is not the only Filipina in the pageant.

text: Makasumpong sini ang Filipina-British nga si Christina Dela Cruz Chalk sang Great Britain, Filipina-Kiwi nga si Victoria Velasquez Vincent sang New Zealand, kag Filipina-Bahraini nga si Shereen Ahmed nga magatiglawas sang Bahrain.
english: She will face Filipina-British Christina Dela Cruz Chalk of Great Britain, Filipina-Kiwi Victoria Velasquez Vincent of New Zealand, and Filipina-Bahraini Shereen Ahmed who will represent Bahrain.

text: Ginpadayon sang National Basketball Association (NBA) ang pagsunod sa tradisyon nga limpyuhon ang schedule subong nga adlaw kadungan sang Election Day sa Estados Unidos sang Amnerika.
english: The National Basketball Association (NBA) continued its tradition of clearing the schedule today in conjunction with Election Day in the United States of America.

text: Ini agud mahatagan sang ligwa ang mga empleyado sang liga, team workers, coaches, kag players nga gamiton ang ila nga kinamatarong nga magpili sang ila kandidato.
english: This is to give league employees, team workers, coaches, and players the opportunity to exercise their right to choose their candidate.

text: Madamo man nga prominente nga basketball coaches kaangay kanday Warriors head coach Steve Kerr kag Spurs head coach Gregg Popovich ang nagtulod kay Commissioner Adam Silver nga indi anay magpatigayon sang mga hampang subong nga adlaw.
english: Many prominent basketball coaches such as Warriors head coach Steve Kerr and Spurs head coach Gregg Popovich also urged Commissioner Adam Silver not to hold games today.

text: “The scheduling decision came out of the NBA family’s focus on promoting nonpartisan civic engagement and encouraging fans to make a plan to vote during midterm elections,” suno sa liga kaangot sa amo nga polisa nga nagsugod sang 2022.
english: “The scheduling decision came out of the NBA family’s focus on promoting nonpartisan civic engagement and encouraging fans to make a plan to vote during midterm elections,” the league said regarding the policy that began in 2022.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, si Bucks guard Damian Lillard ang nagpangabay man sa mga botante nga dapat tungdan ang ila responsibilidad bisan matapos na ang eleksyon.
english: Meanwhile, Bucks guard Damian Lillard also urged voters to take responsibility even after the election.

text: “Pay attention.
english: “Pay attention.

text: Get informed,” pahayag sini sa recorded interview nga gin-ere sang NBA sang nagligad nga semana.
english: Get informed,” he said in a recorded interview aired by the NBA last week.

text: Nagpasakop naman ang liga sa National Vote Early Day sang Oct.
english: The league participated in the National Vote Early Day on Oct.

text: Walo man ka NBA teams ang naggamit sang ila pasilidad bilang polling locations ukon ballot drop boxes.
english: Eight NBA teams also used their facilities as polling locations or ballot drop boxes.

text: Ang mga players kaangay kanday Celtics G Jaylen Brown, Bucks G Damian Lillard, Wizards F Kyle Kuzma kag Hawks F Larry Nance Jr.
english: Players like Celtics G Jaylen Brown, Bucks G Damian Lillard, Wizards F Kyle Kuzma and Hawks F Larry Nance Jr.

text: ang nagpakigbahin man sa public service announcements nga nagahaylo sa publiko nga magboto.
english: also participated in public service announcements persuading the public to vote.

text: Nahibaluan nga may mga espesyal nga okasyon lamang nga wala sang naka-schedule nga hampang sa liga.
english: It is known that there are only special occasions when there is no scheduled game in the league.

text: Lakip ang Thanksgiving kag Christmas Eve sa holiday-related days nga may break ang NBA apang gindugang diri ang Election Day sang 2022 kag ginpadayon man sang nagligad nga tuig.#
english: Thanksgiving and Christmas Eve are among the holiday-related days the NBA has a break but Election Day was added in 2022 and continued last year.#

text: Pilason ang Sangguniang Bayan Member sang Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) kag ang iya bana nga anay suldado matapos gin-ambush sa Midsayap, North Cotabato.
english: A Sangguniang Bayan Member of the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) and her husband, a former soldier, were injured after being ambushed in Midsayap, North Cotabato.

text: Duwa naman ang patay matapos nadalahig lang kag naigo sang bala.
english: Two others were killed after being involved and hit by a bullet.

text: Ang mga napatay amo sanday Udin Dalgan, 31-anyos, residente sang Sultan Kudarat, Maguindanao del Norte, kag Rahib Wahab, 35-anyos, tricycle driver kag residente sang Barangay Sambulawan, Kadayangan.
english: The dead were identified as Udin Dalgan, 31, resident of Sultan Kudarat, Maguindanao del Norte, and Rahib Wahab, 35, tricycle driver and resident of Barangay Sambulawan, Kadayangan.

text: Ang mga pilason amo sanday Kadayangan Municipal Councilor Saida Endaila kag bana nga si Madron Endaila Jr., 48, kag isa pa ka biktima nga si Lani Yusop, 20.
english: The injured were identified as Kadayangan Municipal Councilor Saida Endaila and husband Madron Endaila Jr., 48, and another victim, Lani Yusop, 20.

text: Base sa imbestigasyon, sakay ang mga biktima sa isa ka Toyota Fortuner nga ginamaneho ni Yusop sang ginpaarakan luthang sa national highway sa Barangay Salunayan, Midsayap.
english: According to the investigation, the victims were riding in a Toyota Fortuner driven by Yusop when they were shot on the national highway in Barangay Salunayan, Midsayap.

text: Dead on arrival sa ospital si Dalgan.
english: Dalgan was dead on arrival at the hospital.

text: Natabuan naman nga yara sa lugar sakay sa iya tricycle si Wahab kag naigo sang nagtalang nga bala.
english: Wahab happened to be at the scene on his tricycle and was hit by a stray bullet.

text: Ginpahayag nga away sa pamilya ang posible nga motibo sa pag-ambush.
english: Family quarrels were reportedly the possible motive behind the ambush.

text: Madasig nga nalagyo ang mga gunmen.
english: The gunmen quickly fled.

text: Padayon pa ang imbestigasyon kag pag-ayam sa mga suspek.
english: The investigation and hunt for the suspects is ongoing.

text: YARI kita sa Demokrasya, kag kinamatarong sang kada isa sa aton ang magpahayag sang aton panghuna-huna kag tindug sa ano man nga bagay nga may kahilabtan sa aton kabuhi.
english: WE ARE in a democracy, and it is the right of each of us to express our thoughts and positions on any matter that affects our lives.

text: Angot diri, luyag ko ipabutyag ang akon tindug sa kaso sang babaye nga Chinese student nga si Zhang Jiale, 23 anyos, sa natabo nga insidente sa Metro Rail Transit Line 3 sadtong Sabado, Pebrero 9.
english: In this regard, I would like to express my position on the case of female Chinese student Zhang Jiale, 23, in the incident that occurred on Metro Rail Transit Line 3 on Saturday, February 9.

text: Sa sina nga hitabo, ginbasyahan niya ang gwardya nga pulis sang malamig nga taho (isa ka lokal nga gelatin-like nga delicacy) sa baso nga iya ginauyatan sang manugsakay siya sa metro rail transit.
english: In that incident, he sprayed the police guard with cold taho (a local gelatin-like delicacy) from the glass he was holding as he boarded the metro rail transit.

text: Ambot kon ano ang sa ulo ni Zhang sa sadtong ginhimo niya.
english: I don't know what was in Zhang's head when he did that.

text: Naaburido seguro sa bag-o nga regulasyon nga wala sing magpasulod sang pagkaon sa metro rail transit.
english: I guess I'm worried about the new regulation that no food is allowed in metro rail transit.

text: Ukon may mabug-at lang siya nga problema sa iya pagtuon.
english: Or he just has a serious problem with his studies.

text: Apang nangayo man siya sing pasensya sa iya nagalumaw-lumaw nga mga mata.
english: But he also apologized with his teary eyes.

text: Bahala na kon madamo ang maga-kontra sa akon, nga ginalakipan pa sang mga dalagku nga mga opisyales sa gobyerno.
english: It doesn't matter if there are many who will oppose me, which includes senior government officials.

text: Apang ini gid ang akon tindug.
english: But this is exactly where I stand.

text: Indi ako kumpormi nga ma-deport si Zhang sa amo lang kanabaw nga kasaypanan.
english: I don't agree that Zhang should be deported for such a superficial mistake.

text: Pwede na seguro ang isa ka formal nga censure, ukon pagpakamalaut, kag pabayaron lang siya sing multa kag warningan nga indi magliwat.
english: I guess a formal censure, or condemnation, could be done, and he would just be fined and warned not to do it again.

text: Kanugon nga indi na basi niya matuman ang iya handom sa pagtuon, nga daan yara pa lang siya sa first year sa School of Fashion and Arts Design Institute in Makati City, kon ma-deport.
english: It is a pity that she may not be able to fulfill her dream of studying, which is already in her first year at the School of Fashion and Arts Design Institute in Makati City, if she is deported.

text: Kon ma-deport siya, ina gid bala ang nagakabagay nga silot sa iya sa idalom sang aton kasuguan, katulad sang pagpati sang Bureau of Immgiration, ukon sang isa ka senador kag iban pa?
english: If he is deported, is that really the appropriate punishment for him under our law, as the Bureau of Immigration believes, or a senator and others?

text: Pagpati lang ina ya nila.
english: They just believe she's their mother.

text: Ang nahibal-an ko nga ang pagpa-deport sang “undesirable alien” isahanon ini nga poder pulitikal sang Presidente, kag wala pa kita subong kahibalo sang tindug sang Presidente.
english: What I know is that the deportation of “undesirable aliens” is the sole political power of the President, and we do not yet know the President's position.

text: Kabay lang nga upod ang Presidente sining aton pagpati nga indi gid daku ang atong kasaypanan ni Zhang agud ipa-deport siya.
english: I hope the President shares our belief that Zhang's fault is not big enough to deport him.

text:
***

Gapati ako sa pagka-mapatawaron sang Filipino.
english:
***

I believe in the forgiveness of the Filipino.

text: Amo na atong kapintas ang naagyan naton sa mga Espanyol, Amerikano kag mga Hapon, pero madali gani naton nalipatan ato.
english: That's the cruelty we went through with the Spaniards, Americans and Japanese, but we easily forget that.

text: Ti, ngaa indi abe naton mapatawad ang ining gamay lang nga sayop sining Chinese student?
english: Well, why can't we forgive this little mistake of this Chinese student?

text: Tungod bala kay pangayaw siya nga Intsik halin sa Communist China, nga indi kaugyon sa aton ideolohiya nga Demokrasya?
english: Is it because he is a foreign Chinese from Communist China, which does not agree with our ideology of Democracy?

text: Wala man seguro sing problema ini basta naga-respetuhanay kita bisan pa katuhay ang aton pagpati.
english: I don't think it's a problem as long as we respect each other even if we have different beliefs.

text: In fact, wala pa man sing okasyon gani nga nakaaway sang Pilipinas ang Tsina.
english: In fact, China has never even fought the Philippines.

text: Tungod man bala kay nakasayop si Zhang sa isa ka pulis nga dapat naton tahaon?
english: Is it also because Zhang made a mistake with a police officer we should respect?

text: Of course, dapat tahaon naton ang aton mga maligdong nga mga pulis nga ginpakita man sang gwardya sa MRT paagi sa pagpaumod bisan gin-insultuhan na siya.
english: Of course, we should respect our police officers who were also shown by the MRT guard by being humble even after being insulted.

text: Ginpakita niya ini sa iya pagkilala nga bisan otoridad siya wala siya malipat nga siya “suluguon sang banwa” nga indi basta mag-asta nga daw hari siya, kay indi siya hari.
english: He showed this by recognizing that even though he was an authority, he did not forget that he was a “servant of the people” who did not just pretend to be a king, because he was not a king.

text: Idugang ta pa dira ang aton bantog nga “hospitality trait”, labi na gid sa mga bisita nga dapat naton tagaan sing ligwa sa ila pag-istar diri sa aton pungsod.
english: Let us add to this our famous “hospitality trait”, especially to the visitors whom we should give comfort in their stay here in our country.

text: Indi man kita seguro magsobra pa ka sensitibo sangsa mga Vietnamese nga aktwal nag-sufrir sing labi sa kamot sang mga Pranses kag mga Amerikano sadto.
english: We are probably no more sensitive than the Vietnamese who actually suffered more at the hands of the French and Americans back then.

text: In fact, nangin mapatawaron man sila kag nag-uliay na gani sing panimuot.
english: In fact, they became forgiving and even made peace.

text: Upod gani sila subong sang Estados Unidos sa ila kawsa sa South China Sea.
english: They are even now with the United States in their cause in the South China Sea.

text: Matudlo man naton diri ang kaso sang isa ka Amerikano – si Daniel Huer – nga isa ka manunudlo sa lenggwahe nga English sa Vietnam.
english: We can also point here to the case of an American – Daniel Huer – who was an English language teacher in Vietnam.

text: Gin-insultuhan niya sa Facebook ang well-respected nga heneral nga si Vo Nguyen Giap.
english: He insulted well-respected general Vo Nguyen Giap on Facebook.

text: Nagapanguna ini nga baganihan sang Vietnam, nga, obviously, ang kadungganan indi matupongan sang pulis nga gin-insultuhan ni Zhang.
english: It is leading Vietnamese hero, who, obviously, honor cannot be matched by the policeman Zhang insulted.

text: In other words, daku kaayo nga dungog ang ginapangapin sang mga Vietnamese sa pag-insulto kay Heneral Giap, apang nangin mapainubuson sila.
english: In other words, the Vietnamese were defending a lot of honor in insulting General Giap, but they were humble.

text: Ang penalidad lang nga ginhatag nila kay Hauer, amo ang VND70-100 million ($3,100-4,400) nga multa sa iya pang-insulto.
english: The only penalty they gave Hauer, was a VND70-100 million ($3,100-4,400) fine for his libel.

text: Ti, kinahanglan bala kita sobra pa ka pikon sa mga Vietnamese sa sining gamay lang gani nga sayop ni Zhang Jiale?
english: Well, do we need to be more angry with the Vietnamese for this small mistake by Zhang Jiale?

text: Ginbawi ni United States President Donald Trump ang pahayag sini nga hatagan niya sang 50 ka adlaw ang Russia agud nga tapuson na ang giyera sa Ukraine.
english: US President Donald Trump has withdrawn his statement that he will give Russia 50 days to end the war in Ukraine.

text: Sa latest statement sang American president, 10 tubtub 12 ka adlaw na lang ang ginhatag sini kay Russian President Vladimir Putin.
english: In the latest statement of the American president, he gave only 10 to 12 days to Russian President Vladimir Putin.

text: Ginalauman nga magahatag siya sang dugang nga detalye kaangot diri subong nga adlaw.
english: He is expected to provide more details in this regard today.

text: Duha ka semana na ang nagligad, matandaan nga nagpaandam si Trump sang tuman ka lala nga taripa sa mga trading partners sang Moscow kun wala sang matabo nga deal sa Russia-Ukraine war sa sulod sang una nga ginhatag sini nga plaso.
english: Two weeks ago, Trump warned of severe tariffs on Moscow's trading partners if no deal was reached on the Russia-Ukraine war within the initial deadline.

text: Apang sa iya pinakaulihi nga pahayag halin sa Scotland, na-mensyonar sini nga wala na sang rason nga maghulat pa, kag mahimo na siya makapatuman sang sanctions kag secondary tariffs.
english: But in his latest statement from Scotland, he mentioned that there is no reason to wait, and he can impose sanctions and secondary tariffs.

text: “No reason in waiting,” pahayag sini sa iya ginpanubo nga timeline.
english: “No reason in waiting,” he said in his reduced timeline.

text:
“We just don’t see any progress being made… Too many people are dying.”

Nagdugang man ini nga wala na siya sang gana nga makig-istorya kay Putin: “I’m not so interested in talking anymore.”

Sa inisyal nga statement sang Ukraine paagi kay Andrii Yermak, ang head sang presidential office sang Kyiv, nagpasalamat ini nga ginpanubo sang president ang deadline.#
english:
“We just don’t see any progress being made… Too many people are dying.”

He also added that he has lost interest in talking to Putin: “I’m not so interested in talking anymore.”

In Ukraine's initial statement through Andrii Yermak, the head of Kyiv's presidential office, it thanked the president for lowering the deadline.#

text: Nagasalalampaw nga gold medals ang nakuha sang Pinoy gymnast nga si Karl Eldrew Yulo sa 3rd JRC Artistic Gymnastics Stars Championships sa Bangkok, Thailand.
english: Pinoy gymnast Karl Eldrew Yulo won double gold medals at the 3rd JRC Artistic Gymnastics Stars Championships in Bangkok, Thailand.

text: Magluwas sa una sini nabulsa nga bulawan nga medalya sa individual all-around, nagkampyon man ang 16-anyos sa Men’s Artistic Gymnastics (MAG) Junior floor exercise, still rings, kag vault events.
english: In addition to pocketing his first gold medal in the individual all-around, the 16-year-old also won the Men’s Artistic Gymnastics (MAG) Junior floor exercise, still rings, and vault events.

text: Nadag-an man sini ang silver medal sa parallel bars.
english: She also won the silver medal in the parallel bars.

text: Nagdangat tanan sa anum ang iya natipon nga medalya lakip ang isa pa gid ka silver sa all-around team event.
english: He collected a total of six medals including another silver in the all-around team event.

text: Ang iban pa nga Pinoy gymnasts nga multi-gold medalists sa kumpetisyon amo sanday Jacob Alvarez, Andrei de Leon, Prince Sumabal, Chelsea Lynn Hong, kag Ma.
english: Other Pinoy gymnasts who were multi-gold medalists in the competition were Jacob Alvarez, Andrei de Leon, Prince Sumabal, Chelsea Lynn Hong, and Ma.

text: Elizabeth Medina.
english: Elizabeth Medina.

text: Si Karl Eldrew amo ang manghod sang two-time Olympic gold medalist nga si Carlos Edriel Yulo.
english: Karl Eldrew is the younger brother of two-time Olympic gold medalist Carlos Edriel Yulo.

text: Sang damlag lang, gin-anunsyo nga nagahanas na ini kaupod ang manghod nila nga si Elaiza sa idalom sang Japanese coach nga si Munehiro Kugimiya nga long-time coach ni Caloy.
english: Recently, it was announced that she is training with their younger sister Elaiza under Japanese coach Munehiro Kugimiya who is Caloy's long-time coach.

text: Una na nga ginkumpirma sang Gymnastics Association of the Philippines (GAP) nga isa man si Karl Eldrew sa ginalantaw nga updon sa 2028 Los Angeles Summer Games nga kun matabo makaupod sa iya magulang nga si Caloy nga magabalik naman para sa iya ikatatlo nga Olympiada.
english: Earlier, the Gymnastics Association of the Philippines (GAP) confirmed that Karl Eldrew is also one of the expected participants in the 2028 Los Angeles Summer Games, which will join his brother Caloy who will return for his third Olympiad.

text: ANG amon pari sa Mandurriao Church, sa iya sermon sang Domingo, nagpahanumdom sa aton mga ginikanan sa dugang nga pagtuytuy kag pag-amlig sang ila magagmay kag salawayon nga mga kabataan.
english: OUR priest at Mandurriao Church, in his sermon on Sunday, reminded our parents to further guide and protect their young and innocent children.

text: Ina tungod sa indi na seguro mapunggan nga pagpasar sang bag-o nga kasuguan nga nagapanubo sang “criminal liability” halin sa edad nga 15 tubtub 12 anyos.
english: This is due to the inevitable passage of a new law that reduces criminal liability from the age of 15 to 12 years old.

text: Aprubado na ang hagna sa Kamara kag basi maaprubahan man ini sa Senado sa palaabuton nga Mayo ukon Hunyo, sunu kay Senate President Tito Sotto.
english: The bill has already been approved in the House and may be approved in the Senate in May or June, according to Senate President Tito Sotto.

text: Sa sini nga bag-o nga kasuguan, ang mga kabataan nga may edad panubo sa 12 anyos “exempted” sa pag-panabat sang ila nahimo nga krimen, kag indi na sa edad nga 15 anyos panubo sa idalom sang karon nga kasuguan, ang R.A. 9344.
english: With this new law, children under the age of 12 are “exempted” from accountability for their crime, and no longer under the age of 15 under the current law, R.A. 9344.

text: Pwede sila, ugaling, manabat sa mga civil damages, ukon kabayaran sang mga naperhwisyo nila nga mga bagay ukon sang madulot nila nga kasamaran sa mga biktima, nga lulukduhon naman sang ila mga ginikanan.
english: They may, however, be liable for civil damages, or compensation for the damage they cause or for the injuries they cause to the victims, which will be borne by their parents.

text: Pasalamat kita ugaling kay ang may edad 12 tubtub 17 anyos indi kilalahon nga mga kriminal, kundi mga Children in Conflict with the Law (CWL) lang, luas lang kon gapakita sila sang husto na nga pamensaron (discernment) agud manabat katulad sang mga may legal na nga edad nga 18 anyos pataas.
english: Thankfully, however, those aged 12 to 17 are not recognized as criminals, but as Children in Conflict with the Law (CWL), unless they show discernment to be held accountable like those of legal age 18 and above.

text: Pwede lang sila ma-detener sing temporaryo sa mga rehabilitation kag training centers, katulad sang Bahay Pag-asa,  sa diin tudluan sila mangabuhi kag mag-usoy sang tadlong nga direksyon sa ila kabuhi.
english: They can only be temporarily detained in rehabilitation and training centers, such as Bahay Pag-asa, where they will be taught to live and find the right direction in their lives.

text: Sa sini nga kasuguan, may salabton man ang mga ginikanan sa ila pagpatumbaya sa ila mga kabataan kag ang mga tawo nga nagasugyot ukon naga-gamit sa sining mga kabataan agud maghimo  sing malain.
english: Under this law, parents are also liable for their neglect of their children and people who incite or use these children to do wrong.

Sa madamo nga beses nga napilitan sa pagsabat si Gob Art sa pamangkot kon sin-o ang ulo-ulo sang pag-delay sang 2019 Budget, ginasiling niya: Ang “boss” nila, nga ang ginatumod sang “nila” amo ang maka-Biron nga yara sa mayoriya sa Sangguniang Panlalawigan (SP).
english:
***

Many times when Gob Art was forced to answer the question of who is behind the delay of the 2019 Budget, he said: Their “boss”, who is referring to Biron who is in the majority in the Sangguniang Panlalawigan (SP).

text: Sang nagligad nga Huwebes sa iya semanal nga paghinun-anon sa media, wala na si Gob magpatumpik-tumpik pa.
english: Last Thursday in his weekly media briefing, Gob did not hesitate.

text: Ginmensyonar na niya si Cong.
english: He already mentioned Cong.

text: Ferjenel Biron nga amo gid ang promotor sang pagpa-delay sang 2019 nga budget paagi sa iya mga ka-partido sa SP.
english: Ferjenel Biron who is the promoter of the delay of the 2019 budget through his party colleagues in the SP.

text: Ina tungod si Congressman Biron gid man ang nagapamuno sang iya grupo diri sa probinsya sang Iloilo.
english: That's because Congressman Biron is the leader of his group here in Iloilo province.

text: Samtang dapat tani ma-aprubahan na ang badyet bag-o matapos ang Disyembre 2018, nagdugay pa ini kag ginahingyu gani sang maka-Biron nga tapuson pa sa Marso, kon san-o may “banning” na sa pagpatigayon sang mga proyekto kag mga programa para sa mga pumuluyo.
english: While the budget should have been approved before the end of December 2018, it has been delayed and Biron is even asking for it to be completed in March, when there is a ban on the implementation of projects and programs for the people.

text: Madamo sang mga kaundan sang ginproponer ni Gob nga executive budget sa 2019 nga nagadala sang kaayuhan sang mga pumuluyo nga segurado luyag likawan sang mga maka-Biron nga indi ma-implementar sing dali-dali.
english: Many of the contents of Gob's proposed executive budget for 2019 that bring the welfare of the people that the Biron supporters surely want to avoid will not be implemented quickly.

text: Ngaa man?
english: Why else?

text: Ina tungod nakita nila seguro nga ang kaayuhan nga madala sang 2019 Budget daku gid nga bulig sa kandidatura ni Toto Defensor sa pagka-gobernador kag sang iya ka-grupo kontra kay Congressman Biron kag sang iya man ka-grupo.
english: That's because they probably saw that the benefits that the 2019 Budget will bring will be a big help to the candidacy of Toto Defensor for governor and his group against Congressman Biron and his group.

text: Kag kon ginaduso gid nila ang pag-delay sang 2019 Budget, ina tungod man seguro kay wala sila sang daku nga isyu batok kay Toto Defensor luas nga punggan ang ano man nga kaayuhan nga mahatag sang 2019 budget sa naulihi.
english: And if they are pushing for the delay of the 2019 Budget, it is probably because they have no major issue against Toto Defensor except to prevent any benefits that the 2019 budget will bring to the latter.

text: Ugaling gulpyada nga may problema ang mga maka-Biron sa sining ila padihot.
english: But suddenly the Biron people had a problem with their trick.

text: Ang mga meyor, nga ang laban gani ka-partido ni Biron, nagpasar, sang sini lang, sang resolusyon nga nagahingyo nga padasigon na sang SP ang pag-aprubar sang 2019 Budget.
english: The mayors, most of whom are Biron's party members, recently passed a resolution calling on the SP to expedite the approval of the 2019 Budget.

text: Ang Liga ng mga Barangay gani sa banwa sang Cabatuan naghingyu man sang kasubong nga resolusyon.
english: The League of Barangays in Cabatuan town also requested a similar resolution.

text: Kag may magasunod pa nga mga resolusyon, segurado.
english: And more resolutions will follow, for sure.

text: No doubt, daku gid ang pagka-kinahanglan sining mga meyor kag mga kapitan sa barangay sa madamo nga proyekto nga ginapaabot man sang ila pumuluyo halin sa 2019 Budget.
english: No doubt, these mayors and barangay captains are in great need of the many projects that their people are also expecting from the 2019 Budget.

text: Ti, ano ang maayo sini, Congressman Biron kag sang mga ka-partido mo dira?
english: Well, what's the good of it, Congressman Biron and your party mates there?

Gasoline – P1.35 to P1.60 per literDiesel – P2.30 to P2.60 per literKerosene – P2.30 to P2.50

english: According to the wife, they were planning to have an eighth child but did not realize that it was a set of quintuplets — three baby girls and two baby boys!

english: The babies were delivered by caesarean section but required respiratory support as they were only 29 weeks old.

english: The babies were named Arianna Daisy, Charles Patrick, Elizabeth May, Evangeline Rose and Henry James.

text: “Miracle” ini para kay Dominika, kag suno pa sa iya, “As a mathematician, I like these kinds of statistics.

text:
We had a greater chance of winning the lottery than having this crowd.”

Ginapahayag “1 in 55,000,000 births” ang tyansa sa pag-angkon sang quintuplets.
english:

text:

Indi pirme ang tindug legal santu sa tindug moral.
english:
***

The legal position does not always correspond to the moral position.

text: Amo gani kon kis-a may mga bagay nga legal ang indi makumpormihan sang Simbahan kag mga moralista sa sosyedad.
english: That is why sometimes there are things that are legal that the Church and moralists in society cannot agree on.

text: Sa masami ugaling, may mga pagsulundan legal nga sunu man sa pagtudlo moral sang Simbahan Catolica, nga ang tumuluo nagalakip sang mga 80 ka porsyento sang aton populasyon.
english: Often, however, there are legal rules that are also in accordance with the moral teachings of the Catholic Church, whose believers make up about 80 percent of our population.

text: Lakip na diri ang pagsulundan kon ano ang paghusgar sa isa ka akusado.
english: This includes the rule of how to judge an accused.

text: Sa pagtudlo sang Simbahan, nga segurado upod diri ang aton man mga otoridad sa kasuguan, tatlo ka kondisyon ang balasehan sang dapat pagpamatbat sa isa ka akusado.
english: In the teaching of the Church, certainly including our legal authorities, three conditions are the basis for the justification of an accused.

text:
Ang ining tatlo ka kondisyon amo ang masunod:

(1) kon ano kabug-at ang pagpakasala

(2) kon ano kasanyog ang ihibalo sa nahimo nga sala, kag

(3) kon bala bug-os ukon indi man bug-os ang pag-kunsinte, ukon pagpasugot, sini sa ginhimo nga sala.
english:
These three conditions are as follows:

(1) how serious the sin is

(2) the extent of knowledge of the wrongdoing, and

(3) whether it fully or partially condoned, or acquiesced, in the wrongdoing.

text: Sa idalom sining mga kondisyon, ang sala pwede mamag-an ukon mabug-at, ukon wala gid sing sala ang akusado.
english: Under these conditions, the offense can be light or serious, or the defendant is completely innocent.

text: Gaproblema matuod ining mga meyor sa kon ano ang makuha nga bulig halin sa kapitolyo.
english: These mayors are really worried about what kind of help they can get from the capitol.

text: Bal-an ninyo, siling ni Mayor Kalay, wala gid man sing daku nga kwarta ang amon banwa, kag tungod sini masalig pa kami sa kapitolyo.
english: You know, said Mayor Kalay, our town doesn't have much money, and because of that we still rely on the capitol.

text: Ginpaathag ni Gob nga wala sing problema ang ginapangayo sining mga mayor kon may pondo lang.
english: Gob explained that there is no problem with the request of these mayors as long as there is funds.

text: Ara kita sa Reenacted Budget 2018, gani limitado ang aton mahimo nga bulig,  siling ni Gob, nga gin-ugyunan man ni  provincial administrator Mamon.
english: We are in the Reenacted Budget 2018, so we can do limited help, said Gob, which was also agreed by provincial administrator Mamon.

text: Tungod ang magamit lang nga pondo amo ang yara sa Reenacted 2018 Budget, nasiling ni Gob sa balita sang Panay News, sa lugar nga P20 milyones mga P14 milyones lang ang mahatag sa mga atleta.
english: Because the only fund available is in the Reenacted 2018 Budget, Gob told Panay News, instead of P20 million, only P14 million will be given to the athletes.

text: Kulang kaayo ini sa kinahanglan sang mga atleta, siling ni Gob.
english: This is far from what the athletes need, said Gob.

text: Ginkasubo gid ini ni Gob, kay nga daan defending champion ang Iloilo, kag tungod sa kakulangan sang kinahanglanon nga gamit kag training allowance basi indi na mangin kampyon ang Iloilo.
english: Gob regretted this, because Iloilo is already the defending champion, and due to the lack of necessary equipment and training allowance, Iloilo may not become the champion.

text: Ginkasubo man ni Gob nga indi ang Iloilo makahatag sang financial assistance sa isa ka daku nga football competition kag sa Batang Pinoy, luas lang sa pagtugyan sa ila ang paggamit sang facilidad sang Iloilo Sports Complex.
english: Gob also regretted that Iloilo cannot provide financial assistance to a major football competition and to the Batang Pinoy, except to entrust them with the use of the facilities of the Iloilo Sports Complex.

text: Ina tungod kinahanglan masulod pa ang probinsya sa isa ka MOA sa ila nga dapat aktuhan gid sang SP bag-o mahatag ining financial assistance.
english: That's because the province needs to enter into a MOA with them that the SP must act on before giving this financial assistance.

text: Indi man gani makahatag sang P500 ka milyon nga amot sa Dinagyang 2019 kay indi maka-akto si Gob sa request sang Dinagyang Foundation agud bayaran ini nga wala sing resolusyon sang SP.
english: He cannot even give P500 million contribution to Dinagyang 2019 because Gob cannot act on the request of the Dinagyang Foundation to pay it without a resolution of the SP.

text: Ang Local Govt Code nagasiling nga ang SP may obligasyon lang sa padayon nga pagtuon sa badyet tubtub ma-aprubahan ini kag wala na sing ano man maubra nga iban, lakip ang pagpasar sang mga ordinansya kag resolusyon.
english: The Local Govt Code states that the SP is only obliged to continue studying the budget until it is approved and can do nothing else, including passing ordinances and resolutions.

text: Naham-ot gani si Gob sa pagsiling nga indi gani seguro ang SP makapasar sang Resolution of Condolence kon siya mapatay nga indi pa ma-aprubahan ang 2019 Budget.
english: Gob even went so far as to say that the SP will not even be able to pass a Resolution of Condolence if he dies before the 2019 Budget is approved.

english: Susmariose!

text: Nagpatas na sa 2-2 ang serye sa best-of-seven finals sa PBA Season 49 Governors’ Cup matapos ang back-to-back wins sang Barangay Ginebra batok sa defending champions nga TNT Tropang Giga.
english: The series is tied 2-2 in the best-of-seven finals of the PBA Season 49 Governors' Cup after Barangay Ginebra's back-to-back wins against defending champions TNT Tropang Giga.

text:
Nakabalik na sa orihinal nga porma sa opensa si Justin Brownlee sa 106-92 win sang Gin Kings sa Game 4 sa Smart Araneta Coliseum sa Cubao subong nga gab-i.

Apisar may 34 points, six rebounds, four assists, kag one steal ang three-time Best Import, si Stephen Holt ang gin-deklarar nga Best Player of the Match matapos ang impresibo nga 18 points, three rebounds, two assists kag five steals lakip ang back-breaking shots sa hingapusan sang hampang.
english:
Justin Brownlee returned to his original offensive form in the Gin Kings' 106-92 win in Game 4 at the Smart Araneta Coliseum in Cubao tonight.

Although the three-time Best Import had 34 points, six rebounds, four assists, and one steal, Stephen Holt was declared the Best Player of the Match after an impressive 18 points, three rebounds, two assists and five steals including back-breaking shots at the end of the game.

text: Magluwas sa duha, sanday Maverick Ahanmisi kag Japeth Aguilar ang pareho nga may tag-18 puntos para sa Gin Kings.
english: In addition to the two, Maverick Ahanmisi and Japeth Aguilar each had 18 points for the Gin Kings.

text: Hulom naman sa hampang ang recently-crowned Best Import nga si Rondae Hollis-Jefferson nga amo man ang nagpanguna sa TNT nga may 28 points, nine rebounds, four assists, kag two steals.
english: Recently-crowned Best Import Rondae Hollis-Jefferson also led TNT with 28 points, nine rebounds, four assists, and two steals.

text: Daku naman ang nahimo ni Calvin Oftana para sa team nga may 26 points kun sa diin 20 ang nabubo sa first half antes nalimitahan sa sais puntos sa second half.
english: Calvin Oftana did a great job for the team with 26 points, 20 of which were poured in the first half before being limited to six points in the second half.

text: Natalana ang Game 5 sa Miyerkules, Nobyembre 6, sa pareho nga venue.
english: Game 5 is scheduled for Wednesday, Nov. 6, at the same venue.
