text: ANG pagtuon sang mga medical experts nagapakita nga kon may benepisyo (benefits) ang paggamit sang marijuana, ukon cannabis – “recreational” man ukon “medical” nga strain – may risgo (risks) nga dala ini.
english: A study by medical experts shows that if there are benefits to using marijuana, or cannabis – whether it is a “recreational” or “medical” strain – there are risks.

text: In fact, samtang may mga kasuguan nga nga-differentiate sang “recreational” marijuana sa “medical” marijuana, ang American Society of Addiction Medicine (ASAM) “(has) dismissed the concept of medical marijuana”, ukon nagapanginwala ini nga may medical marijuana.
english: In fact, while there are laws to differentiate “recreational” marijuana from “medical” marijuana, the American Society of Addiction Medicine (ASAM) “(has) dismissed the concept of medical marijuana”, or it denies that medical marijuana exists.

text: Ngaa man?
english: Why else?

text: Ina tungod wala sing “strain” sang marijuana – “rcreational” ukon “medical” man – nga “harmless”.
english: That’s because no “strain” of marijuana – whether “rcreational” or “medical” – is “harmless”.

text: In other words, bisan ang “medical” marijuana indi matuod-tuod nga bulong.
english: In other words, even “medical” marijuana isn’t really medicine.

text: Ang bulong dapat “effective and safe”.
english: The drug must be “effective and safe”.

text: Posible nga makapaayo ang “medical” marijuana, nga ginakilala nga “soft drug”, sang pila ka balatian, apang may risgo nga dala ang paggamit sini kag ma-classify lang nga “less hazardous” sa ikaayong lawas.
english: Medical marijuana, known as a soft drug, can cure some diseases, but its use carries risks and can only be classified as “less hazardous” to health.

text: Samtang ang “recreational” marijuana nga isa ka “hard drug”, kilala nga “more hazardous” sa ikaayong lawas kay amo gid ang ini ang nagapa-buang kag nagatulod sa paghimo sing krimen sang mga nagagamit sini.
english: Meanwhile, recreational marijuana, which is a hard drug, is known to be more hazardous to health because it drives users to commit crimes.

text: Ang ining pahayag sang American Society of Addiction Medicine SAM nga indi “harmless” ang “medical” marijuana gina-suporta gani sang isa ka survey sa mga United States adults (may legal nga edad).
english: This statement by the American Society of Addiction Medicine SAM that “medical” marijuana is not “harmless” is even supported by a survey of United States adults (of legal age).

text: Ining survey gin-conduct sang American College of Physicians (ACP) sadtong Setyembre 4, 2018.
english: This survey was conducted by the American College of Physicians (ACP) on September 4, 2018.

text: Sa mga respondent nga US adults nga nagadamo sing 9,003, mga 14.6 ka porsyento ang nagsiling nga nagagamit sila sang marijuana sadtong tuig 2017.
english: Of respondent US adults numbering 9,003, about 14.6 percent said they used marijuana in 2017.

text: Mga 81percent ang nagsiling nga ang paggamit sang marijuana may  “at least one benefit”, samtang 17 percent ang nagsiling nga wala ini sing bisan isa ka benepisyo.
english: About 81 percent said marijuana use had “at least one benefit”, while 17 percent said it had no benefit.

text: Mapuslan kuno ini sa pain management (66 percent ang nagsiling), sa pagbulong sang pila ka masakit katulad sang epilepsy kag multiple sclerosis (48 percent), relief from anxiety, stress kag depression (47 percent).
english: It is said to be useful in pain management (66 percent said), in the treatment of certain diseases such as epilepsy and multiple sclerosis (48 percent), relief from anxiety, stress and depression (47 percent).

text: Parti sa risgo sa paggamit sang marijuana, mga 91 percent sang mga respondent nagsiling nga may “at least one risk” ini, samtang nine percent nagsiling nga wala sing risgo ang paggamit sini.
english: As for the risk of using marijuana, about 91 percent of respondents said there was “at least one risk” to it, while nine percent said there was no risk to using it.

text: Ang risgo diri sunu sa mga respondent, amo ang parti sa problema legal nga ginasundan sang addiction (sunu sa 50 percent) kag impaired memory, sunu sa 42 percent sa ila.
english: The risk here, according to respondents, is about legal problems followed by addiction (according to 50 percent) and impaired memory, according to 42 percent of them.

text: In other words, ang pag-legalize sang paggamit sang “medical” marijuana isa ka pagpa-abenturar sang paggamit sini para sa ila ginabatyag.
english: In other words, legalizing the use of “medical” marijuana is an adventure of using it for what they feel.

text: Tungod man sini, indi ayhan ang paggamit sang “medical” marijuana katulad sang paglumpat “out of the frying pan into the fire” nga sa lugar nga mag-ayo kita, mas malala pa ang aton madangtan?
english: Because of this, isn't using medical marijuana like jumping out of the frying pan into the fire that instead of getting better, we get worse?

text: Sa karon, naaprubahan na sa second reading ang hagna nga naga-legalize sang paggamit sang “medical” marijuana.
english: The bill legalizing the use of medical marijuana has now been approved on second reading.

text: Meantime, ang aton mismo Department of Health, partikular sa bahin sang Food and Drug Administration, nagapanugyan nga tun-an anay sing maayo gid ang ining hagna kag padayunon pa ang mga clinical tests agud mapaseguro kon hasta gid diin ang kahalitan sini.
english: Meantime, our own Department of Health, particularly on the part of the Food and Drug Administration, recommends that this bill be studied very carefully and that clinical tests be continued to ensure the extent of its harm.

text: Kon indi man lang significante ang posible nga halit nga matuga sini, ti okay!
english: If the potential harm it causes isn’t significant, then okay!

text: Kon indi, ti dapat lang nga indi ini pagapadayunon, indi bala?
english: If not, then it should just not be continued, right?

text: Apang kon ipamilit gid naton ang pag-legalize sini, at least may laygay sa aton ang aton mga utod nga mga Muslim.
english: But if we insist on legalizing it, at least our Muslim brothers will give us advice.

text:
Sa bahin sang mga tumuluo sang Islam (Muslim), nagsiling si Muslim scholar nga si Sheikh Yusuf Al-Qaradawi, sa iya libro “The Lawful and Prohibited in Islam”, nga puede tugutan ang paggamit sang marijuana sa tatlo ka kondisyon:

Una, nga ang kabuhi sang pasyente mabutang sa peligro kon indi sini pagamiton ang marijuana bilang bulong;

Ikaduha, wala sing alternatibo ukon substitute nga bulong halin sa halal (lawul) nga source ang available; kag

Ikatlo, ang paggamit sang marijuana bilang bulong gina-prescribe sang isa ka competent Muslim physician nga mahadlukon kay Allah.
english:
As for Muslim believers, Muslim scholar Sheikh Yusuf Al-Qaradawi, in his book “The Lawful and Prohibited in Islam”, said that the use of marijuana is permissible under three conditions:

First, that the patient’s life would be endangered if he refused to use marijuana as medicine;

Secondly, no alternative or substitute medicine from halal (lawul) source is available; and

Third, the medicinal use of marijuana is prescribed by a competent Muslim physician who fears Allah.

text:
***

On second thought, indi ta lang anay seguro i-legalize ang “medical”marijuana.
english:
***

On second thought, let's not legalize medical marijuana.

text: Hinay-hinay lang, i-“decriminalize” lang anay ini, nga ang madakpan pabayron lang sang multa (monetary fine).
english: Gradually, decriminalize it, so that those caught will be fined.

text: Pareho lang bala sa naga-violate sang anti-littering law nga indi siya ma-priso apang mabayad lang sang multa tubtub mahibal-an ta gid ang lubos nga epekto sining “medical” marijuana.
english: It's like violating the anti-littering law that he can't go to jail but can only pay a fine until we know the full effects of this “medical” marijuana.

text: Indi ta luyag matabo ang saku-sako nga pagpatuman sini katulad sang Dengvaxia kontra dengue nga nagdulot sang indi lahg-lahog nga kahangawa sa aton mga pumuluyo, indi bala?/PN
english: We don't want the slow implementation of this like the Dengvaxia against dengue that has caused unrelenting anxiety to our people, right?/PN

text: Wala sagihapon nagauntat ang gyera sa tunga sang Cambodia kag Thailand.
english: The war between Cambodia and Thailand is still ongoing.

text: Ini kasunod sa pag-anunsyo ni US President Donald Trump nga naghigutanay ang duha ka pungsod sang ceasefire talks.
english: This follows US President Donald Trump's announcement that the two countries have signed ceasefire talks.

text: Naglab-ot na sa 35 ka mga tawo ang napatay samtang masobra 200 ka mga indibidwal ang nasamaran kag masobra man 200,000 ang ginpa-evacuate bangud sa gamo.
english: At least 35 people have been killed while more than 200 individuals have been injured and more than 200,000 have been evacuated due to the violence.

text: Pareho nga gin-akusaran ang kada panig nga nag-umpisa sila nag-atake rason nga naglala ang away sa border.
english: Both sides accused each side of launching an attack that escalated the fighting on the border.

text: Natalana naman nga magsapol ang lider sang duha ka pungsod sa Malaysia para sa estoryahan ang ceasefire.
english: The leaders of the two countries are scheduled to meet in Malaysia to discuss the ceasefire.

text: Apisar gin-anunsyo ni United States President Donald Trump nga nagsugot na ang Cambodia kag ang Thailand sa ceasefire, nagpadayon sa gihapon ang linukpanay nga naangot sa away sang duha ka mga nasyon sa ila nga border.
english: Despite US President Donald Trump's announcement that Cambodia and Thailand have agreed to a ceasefire, the conflict between the two countries on their border continues.

text: Suno kay Bombo Rinse Bancal Galupo, Bombo International Correspondent sa Thailand, alas kuatro pa lang sa kaagahon subong nga adlaw, may na-report na nga pagsinigabong kag nagpadayon tubtub alas syete kaina sang aga.
english: According to Bombo Rinse Bancal Galupo, Bombo International Correspondent in Thailand, the fire was reported as early as 4 am today and continued until 7 am yesterday.

text: Naga-guwa suno kay Galupo nga daw kaangay nga wala sang sinseridad sa ginpahayag nga ceasefire sa tunga sang duha ka mga pungsod.
english: Galupo said it appears that there is no sincerity in the announced ceasefire between the two countries.

text: Una na nga nagpasalamat ang magtimbang nga bahin kay Trump, kun sa diin ginbaton sang Cambodia ang request sini para sa ceasefire, samtang ginplastar naman sang Bangkok nga kinahanglan gid ang dayalogo.
english: Both sides have earlier thanked Trump, with Cambodia accepting his request for a ceasefire, while Bangkok has stressed the need for dialogue.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagdangat na sa 33 ka mga soldado kag mga sibilyan ang napatay samtang linibo naman nga Thai kag Cambodian nationals ang nagtal-as sa ila mga balay halin sang nagsaka ang tensyon sang Hulyo 24.
english: At least 33 soldiers and civilians have been killed while thousands of Thai and Cambodian nationals have fled their homes since tensions escalated on July 24.

text: Pareho nga gina-akusaran sang Thailand kag Cambodia ang isa kag isa nga amo ang una nga nag-umpisa sa pagpalupok sa ila nga border regions.
english: Both Thailand and Cambodia accuse each other of initiating the firing in their border regions.

text: Nagsaka na sa 5-0 ang matinlo nga record sang Oklahoma City Thunder sa NBA regular season subong nga tuig.
english: The Oklahoma City Thunder have a clean record in the NBA regular season this year.

text: Ini matapos ginlutos ang host nga Portland Trail Blazers, 137-114, sa pagpanguna ni Shai Gilgeous-Alexander nga may 30 points, seven rebounds kag six assists.
english: This after defeating the host Portland Trail Blazers, 137-114, led by Shai Gilgeous-Alexander with 30 points, seven rebounds and six assists.

text: Nagdugang si Jalen Williams sang 22 points, five rebounds, four assists kag four steals sa amo nga hampang nga amo ang ikalima nga sunod-sunod nga pagdaog sang Oklahoma City sa pagbukas sang season.
english: Jalen Williams added 22 points, five rebounds, four assists and four steals in that game, which was Oklahoma City’s fifth straight win in the season opener.

text: Wala sa starting line-up sanday Aaron Wiggins kag Cason Wallace apang pareho nga naka-13 points samtang si Isaiah Joe naman ang may 12 kag may 11 si Ousmane Dieng para sa Thunder.
english: Aaron Wiggins and Cason Wallace were not in the starting line-up but both had 13 points while Isaiah Joe had 12 and Ousmane Dieng had 11 for the Thunder.

text: Ini man ang pang-13 nga sunod-sunod nga hampang nga ginlutos sang Thunder ang Trail Blazers sa ila pagkit-anay sa NBA.
english: It was also the 13th consecutive game the Thunder defeated the Trail Blazers in an NBA meeting.

text: Sang nagligad nga season, isa sa ila hampang ang nagtakop sa 139-77.
english: Last season, one of their games ended 139-77.

text: Ang 62 puntos nga abanse ang nalakip sa ika-lima sa pinakadaku nga abanse sa hampang sa NBA history.
english: The 62-point lead ranks among the fifth-largest game leads in NBA history.

text: Nagpanguna naman sa Portland si Jerami Grant nga may 17 points kag Deandre Ayton kag Rayan Rupert nga may tag-14.
english: Portland was led by Jerami Grant with 17 points and Deandre Ayton and Rayan Rupert with 14 each.

text: Taklaron pa ang banas sang Trail Blazers nga nagsulod sa season nga may apat na ka kalutusan sa anum ka mga hampang.
english: The Trail Blazers have a long way to go, entering the season with four losses in six games.

text: Sunod nga atubangon sang Thunder 10:30 subong nga aga ang LA Clippers, samtang 10:00 sa aga man maga-atubang ang Trail Blazers sa Phoenix Suns.
english: The Thunder will next face the LA Clippers at 10:30 this morning, while the Trail Blazers will face the Phoenix Suns at 10:00 am.

text:
“Namayha ron ‘ko maghambal sa iban nga taho.”

“So gahipos ka na lang sa higad?
english:
“I'm tired of talking to other people.”

“So you’re just sitting on the sidelines?

text: Wala ka na naga-recite?
english: You don’t recite anymore?

text: Wala ka na naga-istorya?
english: You don’t talk anymore?

text:
Nabudlayan gid ikaw?”

“Yes, Tita.
english:
Are you having a hard time?”

“Yes, Tita.

text: As in, daw ano bala.
english: As in, what the hell.

text:
Daw sa…daw…gusto-gusto mo ron…gusto-gusto mo ron i-ano…imitlangon, tita, garing daw….daw ma-experience mo ang daw…daw block bala, tita.”

Ini ang pagpahayag ni Gemini 21, tagpalasakop sa Kahapon Lamang Program (KLP) sang Bombo Radyo Iloilo, Hunyo 13.
english:
It's like...it's like...you want to...you want to do something...say, tita, ivory....like you're going to experience what...like a block, tita.”

This was revealed by Gemini 21, a participant in the Kahapon Lamang Program (KLP) of Bombo Radyo Iloilo, June 13.

text: Madamo sang dead-air.
english: There’s a lot of dead-air.

text: Ginahapo.
english: Tired.

text: Kag daw nagakaubusan sang tinaga kun maghambal si Gemini 21.
english: And Gemini 21 seems to run out of words when he speaks.

text: “Ang problema, tita, ang problema…ang paghambal ko don.
english: “The problem, tita, the problem...I'm talking about it.

text: Daw nag-ano don da sa isipan ko Tita…nga amo na ang disorder ko,” pahayag ni Gemini kay Tita Regine, host sang nasambit nga programa.
english: I wonder what happened to my mind, Tita...that's my disorder,” Gemini told Tita Regine, host of the program.

text: Santo sa panaysayon sang natungdan, sang damlag lang niya nahibaluan nga ang iya kondisyon nga iya gintawag bilang “stammering” ukon”stuttering” ang isa ka disorder.
english: According to the victim, he recently learned that his condition, which he called “stammering” or “stuttering”, is a disorder.

text: Dugang pa sang natungdan, nagabatyag siya sang kahadlok, kahuya, kag kasubo sa tion nga siya ang maghambal bangud masami nga indi niya matapos ang iya luyag ipahayag kag nagasulit-sulit ang iya mga tinaga.
english: She added that she feels scared, embarrassed, and sad when she speaks because she often can't finish what she wants to say and repeats her words.

text: Nag-umpisa ang amo nga pagpanghangkat suno kay Gemini 21 sang tion nga ginasunlog siya nga “pitla” sang iya mga classmates sang elementary.
english: Gemini 21 said the challenge started when she was beaten as a “pitla” by her elementary classmates.

text: Ginpahayag sang natungdan nga umpisa sadto, nadula ang iya pagsalig sa kaugalingon, rason nga wala siya nagapakigbahin sa mga aktibidad nga may yara sang speech ukon ano man nga klase sang malawig nga pagpaathag.
english: He said that since then, he has lost his self-confidence, which is why he does not participate in activities that involve speeches or any kind of long explanations.

text: Apisar sang ginasuprer nga kondisyon, isa ka consistent honor student si Gemini 21 kag nag-graduate pa bilang Cum Laude sa degree nga Bachelor of Science in Agriculture.
english: Despite her condition, Gemini 21 is a consistent honor student and graduated Cum Laude with a degree of Bachelor of Science in Agriculture.

text: Apang aminado ang natungdan nga tubtob subong, ginaproblema man niya sa gihapon ang nasambit nga speech disorder kag nagalalain siya sa tion nga makit-an niya nga natak-an ang mga tawo sa paghulat sang iya luyag ihambal.
english: However, he admitted that until now, he still has problems with the said speech disorder and he gets worse when he sees that people are tired of waiting for what he wants to say.

text: Common apang daku ang epekto sang childhood-onset fluency disorder, isa ka communication disorder sang isa ka tawo nga nabudlayan magmitlang sang mga tinaga.
english: Common but significantly impacted by childhood-onset fluency disorder, a communication disorder of a person who has difficulty pronouncing words.

text: Ini ang suno sa in-house psychologist sang Bombo Radyo Iloilo nga si Professor Monique Muyargas.
english: This is according to in-house psychologist of Bombo Radyo Iloilo Professor Monique Muyargas.

text: Paathag ni Professor Muyargas, mas common ini nga kondisyon sa mga kalalakihan kag maathag nga naga-umpisa sa pagkabata apang may tsansa man nga ma-overcome sa edad nga 8 ukon 9 anyos.
english: Professor Muyargas explained that this condition is more common in men and clearly starts in childhood but there is a chance to overcome at the age of 8 or 9 years.

text: Apang kun indi ini matapna, mahimo ini magresulta sa sitwasyon kaangay sang ginabatyag ni Gemini 21.
english: But if left unchecked, it can lead to a situation like the one Gemini 21 is feeling.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Professor Muyargas nga wala sang bulong ang amo nga disorder.
english: Professor Muyargas also said that there is no cure for the disorder.

text: Sa mga bata pa, importante ang masami nga pag-practice sa paghambal kag ang pagkonsulta sa isa ka speech pathologist.
english: In younger children, frequent speech practice and consultation with a speech pathologist are important.

text: Kun may edad naman ang isa ka indibidwal kaangay ni Gemini 21, nagpanugyan si Professor Muyargas nga importante nga buligan nila ang ila kaugalingon paagi sa pag-istorya sa iban nga tawo, pagdaug sa kahuya, kag pagdugang sang pagsalig sa kaugalingon.
english: If an individual is older than Gemini 21, Professor Muyargas advised that it is important for them to help themselves by talking to other people, overcoming shyness, and increasing self-confidence.

text: Base naman sa Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders – Fifth Edition, dapat nga may yara sang cognitive therapy ang isa ka indibidwal nga nagasuprer sang amo nga disorder agud mabuligan ini nga ma-express ang kaugalingon.
english: According to the Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders – Fifth Edition, an individual suffering from the disorder should have cognitive therapy to help him express himself.

text: ANG pasalig sang oposisyon sa Sangguniang Panlalawigan kontra kay Iloilo Gob Art amo nga puede niya ipatuman ang mga “essential services” sa kapitolyo, samtang ginatun-an pa nila dugang kuno ang 2019 executive budget ni Gob.
english: THE assurance of the opposition in the Sangguniang Panlalawigan against Iloilo Gob Art is that he can implement the “essential services” in the capitol, while they are still studying the 2019 executive budget of Gob.

text: Ugaling pasalig lang gali ini nga wala sing ngipon.
english: But it's just a promise that there are no teeth.

text: Ina tungod indi gid masuelduhan ang mga contractual kag mga job hire mientras indi maaprubahan ang 2019 nga budget, sunu mismo kay Acting Chief Accountant Orwen Anuevo.
english: This is because the contractual and job hires will not be paid until the 2019 budget is approved, according to Acting Chief Accountant Orwen Anuevo.

text: Tungod man ina kay wala sing makuha nga pondo para sa ila sueldo sa re-enacted 2018 budget.
english: That is also because there will be no funding for their salaries in the re-enacted 2018 budget.

text: Indi sila permanente nga mga empleyado, sunu kay Anuevo, nga kinahanglan ma-rehire pa agud malakip sa 2019 budget ang ila mga sueldo.
english: They are not permanent employees, Anuevo said, who need to be rehired to include their salaries in the 2019 budget.

text: Ang daku gid nga maapektuhan sining problema amo ang mga 1,011 nga mga contractual nga mga doktor, nars, kag medical technician, lakip na ang ordinaryo nga mga job hire nga na-assign sa 12 ka district hospitals sang probinsya.
english: The most affected by this problem are about 1,011 contractual doctors, nurses, and medical technicians, including ordinary job hires assigned to the province's 12 district hospitals.

text: Ang siste pa dira amo nga daw indi gid tugtan sang oposisyon, sa pagpanguna niVice Governor Christine Garin, nga mapasar ang 2019 budget tubtub sa Marso kon san-o masugod na ang banning sa pag-rehire sang bag-o nga empleyado.
english: The joke is that the opposition, led by Vice Governor Christine Garin, will not allow the 2019 budget to be passed until March when the banning of the rehiring of new employees will begin.

text: Ina agud wala na sing panahon nga magamit ini ni Gob, sa ila pagpati, sa eleksyon sang Mayo 2019.
english: That is so that there will be no time for Gob to use it, they believe, in the May 2019 elections.

text: Ang banning, ukon pagdumili, sa pag-appoint kag pag-hire sang bag-o nga mga empleyado natalana sang Comelec sa Marso 29 tubtub Mayo 12.
english: The banning, or ban, on the appointment and hiring of new employees is scheduled by the Comelec from March 29 to May 12.

text: Ginasuspetsuhan man sang oposisyon ang “lumpsum” nga pondo nga bahin sang executive budget ni Gob.
english: The opposition also suspects the “lumpsum” fund that is part of Gob.

text: Basi kuno pilion lang ni Gob Art kon sin-o lang ang tagaan niya sang proyekto halin diri.
english: Maybe Gob Art will just choose who he will give the project from here.

text: Indi nila mabasol si Gob.
english: They can't blame Gob.

text: Kon ikaw man si Gob paano mo abe i-itemize sing ipihu ang mga proyekto sa mga barangay kay wala pa man mapihu sang mga kabarangayan ang ila luyag nga proyekto.
english: If you are Gob, how can you itemize the projects in the barangays because the barangays have not yet identified the projects they want.

text: Apang may solusyon dira, sunu mismo kay Gob.
english: But there is a solution, according to Gob.

text: Kag ina mahimo nila sa pagdula sining “lumpsum” nga pondo sa 2019 budget.
english: And that they can do with eliminating this “lumpsum” funding in the 2019 budget.

text: Kon luyag nila gani, puede man sila magdikta kon diin ihatag ining “lumpsum” nga pondo kay poder man ini sang Sanggunian Panlalawigan ang pag-review sang budget.
english: If they want, they can also dictate where to give this “lumpsum” fund because it is the power of the Sanggunian Panlalawigan to review the budget.

text: Pero, himuon ayhan nila ina?
english: But, will they do that?

text: Laban-laban nga indi, man ma-boomerang ini sa ila kay limitado lang ang ining pondo nga indi mahatag sa tanan, kag sila gid ang iguon sang mga barangay nga indi makabaton sing proyekto.
english: Most of the time, it will boomerang on them because the funds are limited and cannot be given to everyone, and they will be affected by the barangays that do not receive projects.

text: Ti, ang maayo seguro amo nga dulaon na gid lang ining bahin sang executive budget nga wala ma-itemize ni Gob kag hulaton nga ma-earn, ukon kitaon, lang halin sa padayon nga koleksyon sang probinsya.
english: Well, the best thing is to eliminate this part of the executive budget that Gob did not itemize and wait to earn, or see, only from the continuous collection of the province.

text: Puede man ina sa ulihi magamit bilang  supplemental budget sa mga proyekto nga i-rekomendar sang mga barangay nga puede gihapon kwestyunon sang oposisyon sa aprubado na nga 2019 budget.
english: It can also be used as a supplemental budget for projects recommended by the barangays that can still be questioned by the opposition in the approved 2019 budget.

text: Kon mahimo nila ina, tapos na ang problema sa 2019 budget nga indi na ma-delay sing madugay pa.
english: If they can do that, the problem with the 2019 budget is over which cannot be delayed much longer.

text: Kag puede na ma-suelduhan ang mga contractual kag mga job hire, kag mabayran ang iban pa nga obligasyon sang kapitolyo nga matigayon lang kon aprubado ang 2019 budget.
english: And the contractual and job hires can be paid, and other obligations of the capitol can be paid that will only be achieved if the 2019 budget is approved.

text: Indi bala?
english: Isn't it?

text:
***

MAAYO nga balita halin sa Bureau of Customs-Port of Iloilo sa idalom sang pagpanguna ni District 6 Collector Dr. Wivina B. Pumatong, CESE, kay nalapawan sini ang ila collection target sa tuig 2018.
english:
***

GOOD news from the Bureau of Customs-Port of Iloilo under the leadership of District 6 Collector Dr. Wivina B. Pumatong, CESE, because it exceeded their collection target in 2018.

text: Maayo gid nga balita, tungod sa lugar pulos corruption ang mabalitaan naton sa Bureau of Customs sa iban nga pwerto sa pungsod, ang aton mabalitaan amo lang ang maayo nga accomplishment sini sa District 6, nga nagalakip sang Port of Iloilo kag Sub-port of Pulupandan.
english: Very good news, because in the area all corruption we hear in the Bureau of Customs in other ports in the country, we hear only the good accomplishment of this in District 6, which includes the Port of Iloilo and Sub-port of Pulupandan.

text: Sa tuig 2018, ang collection revenue sang District 6 naglab-ut sa Php4,009,668,524.51 halin sa annual target nga Php3,487,000,000.00.
english: In 2018, the collection revenue of District 6 reached Php4,009,668,524.51 from the annual target of Php3,487,000,000.00.

text: Nagtaas ining collection sing mga 15 porsyento, ukon sing mga Php522,668,524.51.
english: This collection increased by about 15 percent, or about Php522,668,524.51.

text: Ang ining revenue nasukot sang District 6 mayormante halin sa importasyon sang lima ka produkto: Mogas kag Oil, Coal, Cement, LPG kag Auto Transformer, kag Power  Shunt Reactor with Accessories.
english: This revenue was collected by District 6 mainly from the importation of five products: Mogas and Oil, Coal, Cement, LPG and Auto Transformer, and Power Shunt Reactor with Accessories.

text: Sa sining lima lang ka produkto, nakolekta na ang Php3,893,402,074.00.
english: With these five products alone, Php3,893,402,074.00 has been collected.

text: Halin ini nga mga produkto sa padayon nga importasyon pasulod sa District 6 sang lima man ka kompaniya: ang Seaoil Philippines, Inc., Panay Energy Dev’t. Corp., Palm Concepcion Power Corp., Isla Petroleum and Gas Corp., kag Fortem Cement Corp./PN
english: These products are from the continuous importation into District 6 by five companies: Seaoil Philippines, Inc., Panay Energy Dev't. Corp., Palm Concepcion Power Corp., Isla Petroleum and Gas Corp., and Fortem Cement Corp./PN

text: Gintawag ni Senate President Pro Tempore Panfilo “Ping” Lacson nga indi makabulig kag nagapanggamo lamang ang gina-obra nga pag-akusar ni Sen.
english: Senate President Pro Tempore Panfilo “Ping” Lacson called Sen.

text: Imee Marcos sa Senate Blue Ribbon Committee.
english: Imee Marcos on the Senate Blue Ribbon Committee.

text: Ini kaangot sa ginapasuni nga pagbawal sini nga magpagwa sang sentimento kaangot sa pag-imbestigar kay anay House Speaker Martin Romualdez.
english: This is in connection with his alleged prohibition to express sentiments regarding the investigation of former House Speaker Martin Romualdez.

text: Suno kay Lacson, mas maayo nga magtambong si Marcos sa hearing kag ipresentar sini ang anuman nga ebidensya nga may ara ini para maduso ang pakaisa sini nga si Romualdez.
english: Lacson said it is better for Marcos to attend the hearing and present any evidence he has to push his cousin Romualdez.

text: Dugang pa ni Lacson nga wala sang magapugong kay Marcos kag wala man sang magapauntat sa senadora.
english: Lacson added that no one will stop Marcos and no one will stop the senator.

text: Napaslawan ang tiglawas sang Pilipinas nga si Ahtisa Manalo nga makuha ang labing-una nga korona sa Miss Cosmo 2024 pageant sa koronasyon nga ginpatigayon sa Saigon Riverside Park sa Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam.
english: Philippine representative Ahtisa Manalo failed to win the first crown in the Miss Cosmo 2024 pageant at the coronation held at Saigon Riverside Park in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam.

text: Tubtub sa Top 10 ang gindangatan ni Ahtisa.
english: Ahtisa made it to the Top 10.

text: Ang nadala nga Top 5 queens nga nag-abanse sa question and answer portion amo ang Indonesia, Peru, Thailand, USA, kag Vietnam.
english: The Top 5 queens who advanced in the question and answer portion were Indonesia, Peru, Thailand, USA, and Vietnam.

text: Gin-anunsyo nga winner si Ketut Permata Juliastrid sang Indonesia samtang first runner up naman si Karnruethai Tassabut sang Thailand.
english: Ketut Permata Juliastrid of Indonesia was announced as the winner while Karnruethai Tassabut of Thailand was first runner up.

text: Antes ang anunsyo sang Top 5, nakarampa pa si Ahtisa suksok ang isa ka sexy violet gown.
english: Before the announcement of the Top 5, Ahtisa was able to wear a sexy violet gown.

text: Naka-abanse siya sa Top 10 matapos nagpanguna sa Cosmo People’s Choice voting portion.
english: He advanced to the Top 10 after leading the Cosmo People’s Choice voting portion.

text: Matandaan nga pila ka adlaw antes ang preliminaries, nakaangkon sang ankle injury si Ahtisa rason nga wala nakaupod sa iban nga aktibidad apang nagpartisipar ini sa closed-door interviews kag nagpabilib man sa jury session.
english: A few days before the preliminaries, Ahtisa suffered an ankle injury that prevented her from participating in other activities but she participated in closed-door interviews and also impressed the jury session.

text: Apisar wala nadala pauli ang titulo, nadag-an man sini ang “First Station” sang People’s Choice voting kag sulod man sa Top 3 sang “National Pride” stage.
english: Although he did not take home the title, he also won the “First Station” of the People’s Choice voting and was also in the Top 3 of the “National Pride” stage.

text: Antes ang Miss Cosmo, beterana na si Ahtisa sa pageant scene kag una na nagtiglawas sa Pilipinas sa Miss International 2018 kun sa diin siya ang first runner-up.
english: Before Miss Cosmo, Ahtisa was a veteran of the pageant scene and first represented the Philippines in Miss International 2018 where she was the first runner-up.

text: Magapadalagan liwat si dismissed Bamban, Tarlac Mayor Alice Guo sa pagka-alkalde sa Bamban, Tarlac.
english: Dismissed Bamban, Tarlac Mayor Alice Guo will run again for mayor of Bamban, Tarlac.

text: Suno sa iya legal counsel nga si Atty. Stephen David, nagaplano si Guo nga mag-file sang iya nga certificate of candidacy (COC) para sa 2025 elections kag ginapreparar na subong sang legal team ang iya nga mga dokumento.
english: According to his legal counsel, Atty. Stephen David, Guo plans to file his certificate of candidacy (COC) for the 2025 elections and the legal team is now preparing his documents.

text: Suno kay David, dapat nga pabay-an nga ang mga botante mismo sa Bamban ang magadesisyon kun gusto nila nga mag-pungko liwat si Guo.
english: David said it should be left to the voters in Bamban themselves to decide if they want Guo to sit again.

text: “She will run,” suno sa legal counsel.
english: “She will run,” according to legal counsel.

text:
“Why don’t we let the people decide kung gusto siya ng tao?”

Base sa pagsulundan sang Commission on Elections (Comelec), mahimo maka-file si Guo sang COC paagi sa representative bangud nakahunong ini subong sa presuhan sa Pasig City.
english:
“Why don’t we let the people decide if people like him?”

According to the rules of the Commission on Elections (Comelec), Guo can file his COC through a representative as he is currently detained in the Pasig City jail.

text: Matandaan nga ginsipa sang Ombudsman sa pwesto si Guo sang Agusto bangud sa ginaalegar nga grave abuse of discretion bangud sa operasyon sang Philippine offshore gaming operator ukon POGO hub sa ila banwa sa Tarlac.
english: It can be recalled that the Ombudsman kicked Guo out of office in August for alleged grave abuse of discretion over the operation of the Philippine offshore gaming operator or POGO hub in his hometown of Tarlac.

text: Apisar nga ang amo nga order sa Ombudsman ang may penalidad nga perpetual disqualification from public office, mahimo pa ini maapelar, buot silingon, indi pa ini final and executory.
english: Although the order to the Ombudsman carries the penalty of perpetual disqualification from public office, it can still be appealed, meaning it is not yet final and executory.

text: Kahapon, ang National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) sa pagpanguna ni Director Jaime Santiago ang nag-file sa Department of Justice (DOJ) sang complaints batok kay Guo.
english: Yesterday, the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) led by Director Jaime Santiago filed with the Department of Justice (DOJ) complaints against Guo.

text: Bag-o ini nga mga reklamo nga amo ang falsification by a notary public, use of falsified documents, perjury, kag obstruction of justice.
english: These are new complaints which are falsification by a notary public, use of falsified documents, perjury, and obstruction of justice.

text: Ang mga gina-reklamo amo si Guo kag abogado nga si Elmer Galicia nga amo ang nag-notaryo sa iya counter affidavit apisar nga wala man ini sa Pilipinas sang Hulyo bangud nagpalagyo na ini sa luwas sang pungsod.
english: The complainants are Guo and lawyer Elmer Galicia who notarized his counter affidavit despite not being in the Philippines in July because he had fled abroad.

text: NATINGALA kita kon ngaa ang Telecommuting Law ginapatuman – bisan boluntaryo lang – sa pribado nga sektor kag indi lakip ang mga empleyado sa gobyerno.
english: WE wonder why the Telecommuting Law is being imposed – albeit voluntarily – on the private sector and excluding government employees.

text: “Unfair” ini sa mga empleyado sa gobyerno nga may kasubong nga sitwasyon sa empleyado sa pribado nga sector.
english: This is “unfair” to government employees who have the same situation as private sector employees.

text: On second thought, ugaling ,indi ayhan tungod ginatugutan na ining telecommuting, ukon ang pag-ubra sa gwa sang regular nga worksite, sang gobyerno bisan sa praktis lang?
english: On second thought, however, isn't it because the government allows telecommuting, or working outside the regular worksite, even in practice?

text: Kon matuod, wala na kita sing reklamo parti sini on behalf sang mga empleyado sa gobyerno.
english: If it is true, we have no complaints about it on behalf of government employees.

text: Ini nga praktis nahibal-an naton sa pila ka kaso sang mga empleyado sang gobyerno nga gintugutan sa pag-claim sang ila regular nga sueldo kag mga benepisyo samtang ginahimo nila ang ila usual nga trabaho sa gwa lang sang ila upisina.
english: This practice we know in several cases of government employees who were allowed to claim their regular salary and benefits while they were doing their usual work just outside their office.

text: Natandaan ko pa ang isa judge nga nag-file sang daily time record samtang wala naga-report sa iya upisina.
english: I remember one judge who filed a daily time record while not reporting to his office.

text: Gin-paylan siya gani sang kaso angot diri.
english: He was even filed a case in this regard.

text: Pero nagdaug siya sa kaso sa claim nga nagatrabaho siya bisan yara siya sa gwa sang iya upisina.
english: But he won the case on the claim that he was working even when he was out of his office.

text: May isa man ka kaso sang isa ka city legal officer nga na-ospital nga samtang nagatener siya sa ospital nag-claim gihapon sing iya regular nga sueldo sa mga adlaw nga yara siya sa ospital.
english: There is also a case of a city legal officer who was hospitalized who while he was in the hospital still claimed his regular salary for the days he was in the hospital.

text: Na-absuelto man siya tungod sa rason nga naga-pamirma siya sang papeles samtang confined siya sa ospital.
english: He was also acquitted on the grounds that he was signing papers while he was confined to the hospital.

text: Ugaling, bisan gina-praktis na gid man ini sang gobyerno lain gid ya kon may kasuguan nga formal nga nagapatuman sini.
english: However, even if the government practices it, it is different if there is a law that formally implements it.

text: Importante nga maathag ang pagpatuman sini sa tanan nga wala pinilian.
english: It is important that its implementation is clear to all without discrimination.

text: Indi bala?
english: Isn't it?

text:
***

Ang House Justice Committee sang sini lang nagtulod sa pag-amendar sang Juvenile Justice and Welfare Act, RA 9344, agud ipanubo ang edad sang criminal liability sang kabataan – nga ma-aresto, manabat sang ila kasal-anan kag ma-priso – halin sa 15 anyos pa-ibabaw  sa 17 anyos pakadto sa 9 ka tuig paibabaw sa edad nga 17 anyos.
english:
***

The House Justice Committee recently pushed for an amendment to the Juvenile Justice and Welfare Act, RA 9344, to lower the age of criminal liability for children – to be arrested, held accountable and imprisoned – from 15 years old and above to 17 years old to 19 years old and above.

text: Sa edad nga 15 ka tuig paubos, sa idalom sang RA 9344, ang bata INDI MA-PRISO sa iya kasal-anan kag MA-DETAIN lang sa mga rehabilitation center, partikular sa isa ka ginatawag nga Bahay Pag-Asa.
english: At the age of 15 years and below, under RA 9344, a child can NOT be imprisoned for his crime and can only be DETAINED in rehabilitation centers, particularly in a so-called Bahay Pag-Asa.

text: Ugaling sang botohan na sa plenary, ukon kabug-usan sang Kamara, ang na-aprubahan amo ang edad nga 12 anyos, ang edad man nga ginahingyo sang kalabanan sa Senado.
english: However, when it was voted on in plenary, or the entire House of Representatives, the age of 12 was approved, the same age requested by the majority in the Senate.

text: Sa gina-propose nga amendment ginadugang  ang pagpahamtang sining mga kabataan sa mga agricultural kag training centers, sa diin sila makapanibag-o sang ila pamatasan kag direksyon sa pangabuhi.
english: The proposed amendment adds the placement of these children in agricultural and training centers, where they can change their behavior and direction in life.

text:
***

Ang pagpaubos sang edad halin sa 15 pakadto sa 9 kag sang ulihi sa 12 anyos, sandig sa mga datos nga nagapakita nga madamo na sang mga kabataan nga naga-edad siyam ka tuig tubtub 13 nga na-involver sa mga krimen nga nagalakip gani sang murder, rape, parricide, pagka-involve sa ilegal nga droga, kag iban pa.
english:
***

The lowering of the age from 15 to 9 and later to 12 years, is based on data that shows that many children aged nine to 13 have been involved in crimes that include murder, rape, parricide, involvement in illegal drugs, and others.

text: Notwithstanding, mas importante ang mahibal-an naton kon bala nahibal-an sining kabataan kon ano gid ang maayo kag malain (right and wrong) agud mahusgaran kon ano gid ang dapat isilot sa ila.
english: Notwithstanding, it is more important that we know whether these children know what is right and wrong in order to judge what they should be punished for.

text: Angot diri, halos tanan, kon indi gid man tanan, nga mga pungsod nagakilala sa edad nga pitu (7) anyos bilang Age of Reason, ukon edad sa diin ang bata may capacidad na sa pag-akto with responsibility.
english: In this regard, almost all, if not all, countries recognize the age of seven (7) years as the Age of Reason, or the age at which the child has the capacity to act with responsibility.

text: Nonetheless, ang “act of responsibility” may grado (grade or stages) sang paghibalo kag paghimo halin sa pinakakubos nga pag-intiendi tubtub sa edad sang full responsibility.
english: Nonetheless, the “act of responsibility” has grades (grades or stages) of knowing and doing from the lowest understanding to the age of full responsibility.

text: Sa halos tanan nga mga pungsod, ginakilala ang full responsibility sang kabataan sa pag-abot sang lubos nga katumanan sang Age of Puberty (11-12 anyos) sa diin lubos na ang pisikal kag emosyonal nga pag-uswag sang ila pagkatawo, nga masami ginakilala sang mga otoridad sa siyensya sa edad nga 15-17.
english: In almost all countries, the full responsibility of children is recognized upon reaching the full fulfillment of the Age of Puberty (11-12 years) where the physical and emotional development of their personality is complete, usually recognized by scientific authorities at the age of 15-17.

text:
***

Wala sing bata nga natawo nga kriminal, sa pagpamatuod mismo sang mga mangin-alamon.
english:
***

No child is born a criminal, as the wise men themselves testify.

text: Bunga siya sang sala nga pagpadaku (upbringing) sang iya panimalay kag sang mga tawo kag palibot nga naka-impluwensya sa iya.
english: He is the product of the wrong upbringing of his family and the people and environment that influenced him.

text: Gani, bisan pa sa ebidensya sang ila capacidad sa paghimo sing krimen, luyag ko gihapon tagaan sila sang paghangop.
english: So, despite the evidence of their capacity to commit crime, I still want to give them insight.

text: Gina-shestyon naton ang edad nga 11-12 panubo nga wala sila criminal liability, sa diin nagasugod ang Age of Puberty nga nagatapos sa edad nga 15-17 ka tuig.
english: We shestion the age of 11-12 below that they have no criminal liability, where the Age of Puberty begins and ends at the age of 15-17 years.

text: Imagine kun kabuot man sa imo nga klase sang tawo kag wala ka man nagapanghilabot sa kabuhi iban apang gindakop ka gihapon bangud katukayo mo ang isa ka kriminal!?
english: Imagine if you are a kind person and you don't interfere in the lives of others but you are still arrested because you are a criminal!?

text: Natabo ini sa isa ka lalaki nga si Rene Martinez Guttierez, isa ka 46-anyos nga residente sang Colombia, indi lang isa ka bes kundi tatlo gid ka beses!
english: This happened to a man named Rene Martinez Guttierez, a 46-year-old resident of Colombia, not just once but three times!

text: Sa masobra isa ka dekada, tatlo ka beses gid siya nga gindala sa presuhan bangud nagsala ang mga pulis sa rason nga pareho sila sang pangalan sang isa ka drug dealer sa Peru nga wanted indi lamang sa iya pungsod kundi bisan diin nga bahin sang kalibutan.
english: In more than a decade, he was taken to jail three times because the police mistook him for the same name as a drug dealer in Peru who was wanted not only in his country but anywhere in the world.

text: Ginpahayag nga ang pinakaulihi nga pagdakop kay Guttierez ang natabo subong gid lamang nga bulan sang nagbalik ini sa Colombia agud kuntani nga bisitahon ang iya nga amay.
english: Guttierez's latest arrest occurred this month when he returned to Colombia to visit his father.

text: Ginpalapitan siya sang Interpol officials sang nag-abot siya sa airport kag gilayon nga gindagdagan sang warrant of arrest.
english: He was approached by Interpol officials when he arrived at the airport and immediately issued a warrant of arrest.

text: Sang 2010 suno sa rekord, walo man siya ka adlaw nga nanimuron sa presuhan sang naghapit lang kuntani siya sa police station agud magkuha sang judicial record para sa iya gintukod nga negosyo.
english: In 2010, according to records, he also spent eight days in jail when he stopped by the police station to get a judicial record for his business.

text: May yara man sang tion nga duha ka bulan siya sa presuhan kadungan sang report nga may kinawatay sa iya ulubrahan.
english: There was also a time when he spent two months in jail in conjunction with a report of theft at his workplace.

text: Suno sa asawa ni Rene, pareho ang pangalan kag ang date of birth sang iya bana sa tawo nga wanted bangud kakuntyaba ini sang isa ka lalaki nga nag-ship sang 20 ka kilo sang cocaine sa Peru sang 2006.
english: According to Rene's wife, her husband's name and date of birth are the same as those of the wanted man because he was a friend of a man who shipped 20 kilos of cocaine to Peru in 2006.

text: Sa subong, sa masubo nga palad, yara gihapon si Rene sa Los Martires police station kag nagahulat nga patihan sang mga pulis ang mga dokumento nga gin-presentar nga indi siya ang matuod nga kriminal.
english: In the meantime, unfortunately, Rene is still at the Los Martires police station and waiting for the police to believe the documents presented that he is not the real criminal.

text:
Patuloy ang nararanasang matinding init sa malaking bahagi ng Estados Unidos, kung saan milyon-milyong residente ang nakararanas ng feels-like temperature na umaabot sa 90°F hanggang 115°F.

Sa St.
english:
Extreme heat continues to be experienced in much of the United States, with millions of residents experiencing feel-like temperatures ranging from 90°F to 115°F.

In St.

text: Louis, Missouri, nananatiling naka-extreme heat warning matapos ang sunod-sunod na araw ng matinding init.
english: Louis, Missouri, remains under an extreme heat warning after consecutive days of extreme heat.

text:
Naka-alerto rin ang mga lugar sa South Carolina at North Carolina gaya ng Myrtle Beach, Wilmington, at Raleigh, na posibleng makaranas ng init na hanggang 115°F.

May mga umiiral ding heat advisories mula Florida hanggang Virginia at mula Texas hanggang West Virginia, kabilang ang Dallas, Memphis, at Cincinnati, pati na ang ilang bahagi ng Upper Midwest gaya ng Duluth at Bismarck.
english:
Areas in South Carolina and North Carolina such as Myrtle Beach, Wilmington, and Raleigh are also on alert, with the possibility of experiencing heat up to 115°F.

Heat advisories are in effect from Florida to Virginia and from Texas to West Virginia, including Dallas, Memphis, and Cincinnati, as well as parts of the Upper Midwest such as Duluth and Bismarck.

text: Bahagyang gumaan naman ang lagay ng panahon sa Northeast dahil sa cold front na nagdulot ng ulan nitong Biyernes.
english: The weather in the Northeast will be slightly easier due to the cold front that brought rain on Friday.

text: Nagpaalala ang mga awtoridad na umiwas sa direktang init at uminom ng maraming tubig.
english: Authorities remind people to avoid direct heat and drink plenty of water.

text: USA– Nakahibalo ka bala nga ang paggamit sang underwear sa tion sang pagtulog ang may negatibo nga epekto?
english: USA– Did you know that using underwear during sleep can have negative effects?

text: Suno kay Dr. Nancy Herta, isa ka Obstetrician Gynecologist, ang pagsuksok sang underwear sa tion nga magtulog ang mahimo makatugasang nga isa man sa mga rason sang yeast infection kag bacterial viginosis.
english: According to Dr. Nancy Herta, an Obstetrician Gynecologist, said wearing underwear during sleep can be irritating which is also one of the causes of yeast infection and bacterial viginosis.

text: Ang paggamit sang underwear nga may indi maayo ang kalidad ang mahimo man nga magtuga sang pagpalangatol.
english: Using underwear with poor quality can also cause itching.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Dr. Vanessa Mackay, spokeswoman sang Royal College of Obstetricians and Gynaecologists, nga ang paggamit sang undergarment kaangay sang underwear ang makatuga sang pagpalangatol ilabi na sa mga naga menopause.
english: He also said that Dr. Vanessa Mackay, spokeswoman of the Royal College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists, said the use of undergarments such as underwear can cause itching especially in menopausal women.

text: Ginaduso sang Gynecologist nga indi maggamit sang underwear sa pagtulog agud malikawan ang moisture nga nagadala sang bacteria nga mahimo makatuga sang impeksyon.
english: The Gynecologist recommends not using underwear to sleep to avoid moisture carrying bacteria that can cause infection.

text: Para naman sa indi makasaho, mas maayo nga maggamit sang mahumok, cotton ukon halog nga underwear sa pagtulog.
english: For those who cannot breathe, it is better to use soft, cotton or soft underwear for sleeping.

text: Ginsingganan ni Senate President Pro Tempore Panfilo “Ping” Lacson nga nagsumiter sang sala nga coordinates si anay Public Works Secretary Manuel Bonoan sa mga flood control projects sa Malacañang.
english: Senate President Pro Tempore Panfilo “Ping” Lacson said former Public Works Secretary Manuel Bonoan submitted wrong coordinates for flood control projects in Malacañang.

text: Suno pa kay Sen.
english: According to Sen.

text: Lacson nga ini agud pasalahon ang mga naga-imbestigar sa nasambit nga imbestigasyon.
english: Lacson said this is to mislead the investigators in the said investigation.

text: Ginpahayag man sang Blue Ribbon Committee Chair nga resulta ini sang indi insakto nga datos nahanungod sa 421 ka mga ghost flood control projects.
english: The Blue Ribbon Committee Chair also said that this is the result of inaccurate data regarding 421 ghost flood control projects.

text: Dugang pa ni Lacson magapaguwa sang subpoena ang Blue Ribbon Committee sa lunes agud piliton si Bonoan nga magtambong sa hearing.
english: Lacson said the Blue Ribbon Committee will issue a subpoena on Monday to force Bonoan to attend the hearing.

text: Kun indi magtambong si Bonoan pwede ini nga ma-cite in contempt kag magapahimo sila sang arrest warrant sa Senado.
english: If Bonoan does not attend, he can be cited in contempt and they will issue an arrest warrant in the Senate.

text: Upod man sa agenda sang komite ang pagbusisi sang pila ka mga dokumento sang DPWH, kabahin na ang Cabral files kag ang alegasyon nga gingamit ni anay House Speaker Martin Romualdez ang Dioscayas bilang front sa pagbakal sang balay sa isa ka mahal nga subdivision sa Makati
english: The committee's agenda also includes the examination of several DPWH documents, including the Cabral files and the allegation that former House Speaker Martin Romualdez used Dioscayas as a front to buy a house in an expensive subdivision in Makati.

english: Colonel Lorenez Losaria, deputy city director for operation and Sub-Site Task Group Peace and Order commander, said the city requested assistance from the Regional Mobile Force Battalion to help guard these areas.

text: Suno kay Losaria, lakip sa i-implementar amo ang gun ban nga nag-umpisa sang nagligad pa nga Enero 15.
english: According to Losaria, among the measures to be implemented is the gun ban that began on January 15.

english: Temporarily suspended Permit to Carry Firearms Outside of Residence for 10 days of implementation of this rule.

english: In addition, the ban on backpacks will be strictly enforced.

text: Sandig sa anunsyo sang Iloilo City Government, 2,167 ka mga uniformed personnel kag masobra sa 2,000 force multipliers ang igalapta para nga mabantayan ang mga aktibidad sa Dinagyang subong nga tuig.
english: According to the announcement of the Iloilo City Government, 2,167 uniformed personnel and more than 2,000 force multipliers will be deployed to monitor the activities of this year's Dinagyang.

text: Ahtisa Manalo nga dal-on ang korona sa Pilipinas sa pagsabak sini sa finals sang Miss Cosmo 2024 subong nga adlaw, Oktubre 5.
english: Ahtisa Manalo to bring the crown to the Philippines when she competes in the finals of Miss Cosmo 2024 today, October 5.

text: Pila ka mga aktibidad sa pageant ang wala natambungan ni Ahtisa sa sulod sang pila ka adlaw bangud sa injury sa iya nga tiil.
english: Ahtisa missed several pageant activities for several days due to a leg injury.

text: Ginbawi niya ini paagi sa matahum nga performance sa jury session kun sa diin gindayaw ini sa iya yellow bikini kag blue cape sa iya signature pasarela.
english: She made up for it with a beautiful performance in the jury session where she was praised for her yellow bikini and blue cape in her signature catwalk.

text: Sa evening gown portion, nagsuksok naman si Ahtisa sang blue gown nga may gold details.
english: In the evening gown portion, Ahtisa wore a blue gown with gold details.

english:

text: Pilason ang anom ka mga sakay sang caterpillar ride matapos nagtabog ang mga ini.
english: Six passengers of the caterpillar ride were injured after they fled.

text: Natabo ang insidente sa Jose Panganiban, Camarines Norte.
english: The incident occurred in Jose Panganiban, Camarines Norte.

text: Suno sa otoridad, nagtabog ang mga biktima matapos mahukas ang safety steel handrail sa ila nga ginapungkuan.
english: According to authorities, the victims fled after the safety steel handrail on their seat was loosened.

text: Ginsabat naman sang tag-iya sang peryahan ang gasto sang mga biktima sa ospital.
english: The owner of the fair covered the victims' hospital expenses.

english: Video courtesy:Princess Galleta

text: Nasawi sa isang artillery strike si Major General Duong Somneang, kumander ng Cambodia’s 7th Division, sa nagpapatuloy na sagupaan laban sa mga pwersa ng Thailand sa pinagtatalunang teritoryo malapit sa Chong Ta Thao–Phu Ma Kua, nitong Sabado, Hulyo 26.
english: Major General Duong Somneang, commander of Cambodia’s 7th Division, was killed in an artillery strike during the ongoing clashes with Thai forces in disputed territory near Chong Ta Thao–Phu Ma Kua, on Saturday, July 26.

text: Batay sa mga ulat, maagang nagsimula ang sagupaan kung saan matagumpay na naitaboy ng Thai forces ang tropa ng Cambodia mula sa Phu Ma Kua.
english: According to reports, the fighting started early in the morning where Thai forces successfully drove Cambodian troops from Phu Ma Kua.

text: Sinubukan ng Cambodia na magsagawa ng counterattack, subalit nauwi ito sa matinding kaswalidad sa kanilang hanay , kabilang ang pagkamatay ni Major General Somneang.
english: Cambodia tried to launch a counterattack, but was repulsed by heavy casualties in their ranks, including the death of Major General Somneang.

text: Ang sagupaan ay bahagi ng tumitinding tensyon sa pagitan ng dalawang bansa na parehong umaangkin sa naturang lugar.
english: The conflict is part of escalating tensions between two countries that both claim the area.

text: Kasunod ng insidente, nagsampa ng pormal na reklamo ang pamahalaan ng Cambodia sa United Nations Security Council (UNSC), na inakusahan ang Thailand bilang pasimuno ng kaguluhan.
english: Following the incident, the Cambodian government filed a formal complaint with the United Nations Security Council (UNSC), accusing Thailand of inciting the unrest.

text: Ngunit tinanggihan ng UNSC ang petisyon at nanawagan sa magkabilang panig na ayusin ang hidwaan sa pamamagitan ng direktang dayalogo o bilateral negotiations.
english: However, the UNSC rejected the petition and called on both sides to resolve the dispute through direct dialogue or bilateral negotiations.

text: Sa depensa ng Thailand, iprinisinta nila ang ebidensya na ang Cambodia umano ang unang umatake.
english: In Thailand's defense, they presented evidence that Cambodia allegedly attacked first.

text: Bukod dito, sinisi rin ng Thai government ang Cambodia sa posibleng mga paglabag sa international humanitarian law, kabilang ang umano’y pag-atake sa mga sibilyan at ospital.
english: In addition, the Thai government also accused Cambodia of possible violations of international humanitarian law, including alleged attacks on civilians and hospitals.

text: Ayon sa UNSC, hindi pa maituturing na banta sa pandaigdigang kapayapaan ang tensyon sa border ng dalawang bansa, kaya’t mas mainam na maresolba ito sa lebel ng diplomatikong pag-uusa
english: According to the UNSC, the tension on the border between the two countries cannot be considered a threat to global peace, so it is better to resolve it at the level of diplomatic unity

text: NEW ZEALAND- Disiplina kag batasan sang mga pumuluyo ang rason kun ngaa nalab-ot na sang New Zealand ang Coronavirus disease 2019 ukon Covid-19 free status.
english: NEW ZEALAND- Discipline and behavior of the people is the reason why New Zealand has achieved Coronavirus disease 2019 or Covid-19 free status.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Bombo International Correspondent Tess Trivilegio Cedro Peeters direkta sa Oakland, New Zealand, iya ginpahayag nga halos tanan nga tawo ang disiplinado kag nagasunod sa protocol nga ginapatuman sang gobyerno kag ilisipon gid lang ang nagalapas.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Bombo International Correspondent Tess Trivilegio Cedro Peeters said that almost everyone is disciplined and follows the protocol implemented by the government and only those who violate it will be counted.

text: Suno kay Peeters, bangud nga covid-free na ang New Zealand, balik na sa normal ang pangabuhi sang mga tawo sa diin wala na sang restrictions magluwas lang sa pag-obserbar sang social distancing nga ginapatuman.
english: According to Peeters, since New Zealand is covid-free, people's lives are back to normal where there are no restrictions except for the observance of social distancing.

text: Mahimo naman nga makapatigayon sang mga parties kag pagtililipon kag mahimo man nga makapadulong sa simbahan para magtambong sa misa.
english: You can also hold parties and gatherings and you can also go to church to attend mass.

text: Sa pihak sini, magapabilin sa gihapon ang pagpatuman sang border restrictions sa diin dumilian ang pagsulod sang mga dumuluong apang mahimo naman nga makasulod sa pungsod ang mga citizens ukon residente sa kondisyon nga magapaidalom ang mga ini sa 14-day quarantine.
english: Meanwhile, border restrictions will remain in place where foreigners are prohibited from entering the country but citizens or residents can enter the country on condition that they undergo 14-day quarantine.

text: Ginpahayag naman ni Peeters nga apisar nagbalik na sa normal ang sitwasyon, may yara naman sang ginapangatubang nga problema sa suplay sang tubig rason nga may water restrictions nga ginapatuman.
english: Peeters said that although the situation has returned to normal, there are still problems with water supply which is why water restrictions are being implemented.

text: Sigurado ka man bala kun sin-o nga mga tawo ang nagaulikid sa imo –patay ka man ukon buhi?
english: Are you sure which people care about you – dead or alive?

text: Amo man ini ang pamangkot sang isa ka 60-anyos nga lalaki sa Brazil nga sa tuman niya ka curious kun sanday sin-o ayhan ang magakadto kun mapatay siya, nahimo niya nga peke-on ang iya kamatayon!
english: This is the question of a 60-year-old man in Brazil who was so curious about who would come when he died that he managed to fake his death!

text: Ginpahayag nga isa ka ceremonialist ang lalaki nga si Baltazar Lemos.
english: The man, Baltazar Lemos, was said to be a ceremonialist.

text: Isa siya ka master of ceremonies sa lain-lain nga mga event; gani sa tion nga may mga haya, nakakita na siya nga kun kaisa duha lang ang nagakadto, kag kun kaisa naman nagaginutok ang mga tawo.
english: He was a master of ceremonies at different events; so when there were feasts, he saw that sometimes only two people went, and sometimes people were crowded.

text: Amo ini ang nagpukaw sa iya kuryosidad nga mahibaluan kun pila ayhan ang makadto sa haya kun siya na ang yara sa lungon.
english: This aroused his curiosity to know how many would go to the funeral when he was in the coffin.

text: Ang natabo… nag-post ini nga nagapahibalo sa iya pamilya kag mga abyan nga napatay na siya, kag may picture pa sang Albert Einstein Hospital sa Sao Paolo.
english: What happened… he posted informing his family and friends that he had died, and there was a picture of the Albert Einstein Hospital in Sao Paolo.

text: Bangud gin-anunsyo man kun diin nga chapel ihaya ang bangkay, nagkadto man didto ang iya nga mga kapartidusan kag mga abyan.
english: Since the chapel where the body will be buried was also announced, his party members and friends also went there.

text: Sang didto na, gin-play ang isa ka voice record kun sa diin mismo tingog ni Baltazar ang nagapanugid sang iya nga mga inagyan sa kabuhi.
english: Once there, a voice record was played where Baltazar's own voice told his life experiences.

text: Nagtodo pa gid ang mga hibi sang mga tawo bangud abi nila, gin-preparar na ini sang lalaki antes pa man siya ginbawian sang kabuhi.
english: People cried even louder because they thought the man had prepared it before he died.

text: Apang sa kakibot sang tanan, gulpi lang nga nagbukas ang altar doors kag nagsulod si Baltazar!
english: But to everyone's surprise, the altar doors suddenly opened and Baltazar walked in!

text: May iban nga nagwawaw, samtang may iban naman nga daw nakakita sang ghost, kag may yara man nga indi makahulag.
english: Some gawked, while others seemed to have seen a ghost, and some could not move.

text: Sunod nga ginpaathag sang lalaki nga curious lang siya kun sanday sin-o ang magakadto sa haya rason nga nahimo niya ini.
english: The man then explained that he was just curious about who was going to the field so he did it.

text: Nanginit naman ang mga tawo sa iya rason kag sa attempt sini nga kuhaon ang atensyon sang tanan.
english: People were angry at his reason and his attempt to get everyone's attention.

text: Mas nagdugang pa gid ang bash sa iya sang nahibaluan sang publiko nga may yara siya sang 80-anyos nga iloy nga naka-wheelchair nga amo gid posible ang pinaka-naapektuhan kun nabatian sini ang balita.
english: The bash on him increased even more when the public learned that he had an 80-year-old mother in a wheelchair who would most likely have been affected the most if she had heard the news.

text: Nag-sorry man si Baltazar apang daw kaangay nga mga bungol ang mga tawo sa iya palibot umpisa sang amo nga adlaw.
english: Baltazar also apologized but the people around him seemed deaf since that day.

text: NANGIN kasuguan na sadtong Disyembre 20, 2018 ang Republic Act 11165, nga gahingyo sa pribado nga mga kompaniya nga ipatuman – sing boluntaryo lang ( indi compulsory) – ang telecommuting, ukon telework, sa mga kwalipikado nga mga empleyado.
english: Republic Act 11165 became law on December 20, 2018, requiring private companies to implement – ​​voluntarily (not compulsory) – telecommuting, or telework, for qualified employees.

text: Ining kasuguan sa telecommuting nagapahanugot sa isa ka empleyado sa pribado nga sektor nga maka-ubra sa gwa sang iya upisina ukon regular nga worksite.
english: This telecommuting law allows a private sector employee to work outside of his or her office or regular worksite.

text: Diri puede magtrabaho ang isa ka empleyado sa iya puluy-an ukon diin man nga conveniente sa iya, samtang ga-enjoy sang tanan nga benepisyo nga gina-enjoy man sang mga empleyado nga naga-ubra full-time sa upisina ukon regular nila nga worksite.
english: Here an employee can work from his home or wherever is convenient for him, while enjoying all the benefits that employees who work full-time in the office or their regular worksite also enjoy.

text: Pero, ngaa bala puede ini?
english: Why, though, is this possible?

text: Puedeng-puede!
english: Possibly!

text: Ina tungod yara na kita  sa Age of Telecomunication and  Computer Technology.
english: That's because we're in the Age of Telecommunication and Computer Technology.

text: Sa karon, puede kita makapadala sang aton luyag ipaabot sa bisan kon sin-o man, sa bisan diin nga bahin sang kalibutan, paagi sa internet sa bulig sang computer technology.
english: Today, we can send our message to anyone, anywhere in the world, through the internet with the help of computer technology.

text: Lakip na gani ang pagbaton sing may bayad nga ubra paagi sa online (via internet) communication.
english: This includes accepting paid work through online (via internet) communication.

text: In fact, madamo na sa aton ang nakakita sing palangabuhian paagi sa internet nga indi kinahanglan magkadto gid sa upisina sang aton gina-ubrahan.
english: In fact, many of us have earned a living through the internet without having to go to our employer's office.

text: Uso na gani sa karon ang tutoring sa internet sa mga foreigner nga luyag magtuon sing English kag iban pa nga lenggwahe.
english: Online tutoring is now even popular among foreigners who want to learn English and other languages.

text: Sadtong nagpahuway na ako sa pagka-editor sang pamantalaan, naka-trabaho ako sa isa ka monthly magazine sa Uropa sa diin nagapadala ako sang akon mga artikulo via internet kag ginabayran ako paagi lang sa money transfer.
english: When I took a break from being a newspaper editor, I got a job with a monthly magazine in Europe where I sent my articles via the internet and was paid only by money transfer.

text: Isa ka gatos ka US dollar ($100) ang ginabayad sa akon sa kada artikulo nga magwa.
english: I get paid a hundred US dollars ($100) for every article that comes out.

text: Nag-untat ugaling ako sang gin-assign ako sa malayo nga lugar, katulad sang Antique kag Boracay, tungod indi pa ako sadto lubos maayo sa akon ginabatyag.
english: However, I stopped when I was assigned to faraway places, such as Antique and Boracay, because I was not yet feeling well.

text: Naka-trabaho man ako bilang editor sang isa ka daily sa Negros, sa diin ang mga artikulo ginapadala lang sa akon sang publisher, sang sadto nag-resign ang iya editor, nga gina-edit ko sa akon computer kag gina-email pabalik sa internet.
english: I also worked as an editor of a daily in Negros, where articles were just sent to me by the publisher, when his editor resigned, which I edited on my computer and emailed back to the internet.

text: Nagtrabaho ako diri sing mga duha ka bulan.
english: I worked here for about two months.

text: Nag-untat lang ako sang nagmasakit ako.
english: I only stopped when I got sick.

text: Sa karon, naga-edit ako online sang duha ka local weekly kag gasulat sang kolum – duha ka beses sa isa ka semana – sa Panay News.
english: Currently, I edit online for two local weeklies and write a column – twice a week – for Panay News.

text:
***

Gina-welcome ta gid ang ining kasuguan – ang Telecommuting Act – tungod sa daku sini nga bentaha sa empleyado kag bisan sa employer.
english:
***

We welcome this law – the Telecommuting Act – because of its great advantages to the employee and even the employer.

text: Sa idalom sang ining kasuguan indi ka kinahanglan magtrabaho part-time, ukon pang-talent fee, kag mag-earn santu sa part-time ukon talent fee lang, samtang puede ka man maka-trabaho kag maka-earn sing lubos katulad sa mga full-time nga empleyado sa upisina ukon diin ang regular nga worksite.
english: Under this law you do not have to work part-time, or talent fee, and earn based on part-time or talent fee only, while you can also work and earn fully like full-time employees in the office or where the regular worksite.

text: Bentaha man sa employer ini kay makapa-uswag ini sang morale (enthusiasmo) kag productivity sang empleyado tungod sa sining pribilehiyo.
english: This is also an advantage for the employer because it can improve the morale (enthusiasm) and productivity of the employee because of this privilege.

text: In fact, ining kasuguan nagahatag sing parehas nga oportunidad sa pag-ubra sa mga may kasablagan (PWDs) nga puede lang maka-ubra sa ila puluy-an.
english: In fact, this law provides equal employment opportunities to persons with disabilities (PWDs) who can only work from home.

text: Sa pagpatuman sining kasuguan, syempre dapat may piho nga polisa ang kompaniya parti sini.
english: In implementing this law, of course the company must have a specific policy in this regard.

text: Dayon kilalahon sini kon sin-o gid sa ila mga empleyado ang puede maka-telework ukon maka-ubra sa gwa sang regular nga worksite.
english: It will then identify which of their employees can telework or work outside the regular worksite.

text: Kon mahibal-an na sang empleyado nga kwalipikado siya sa sini nga pribelihiyo kinahanglan lang niya magpahibalo sa iya employer sang iya interes sa pag-telework.
english: Once the employee knows that he or she is eligible for this privilege he or she only needs to inform his or her employer of his or her interest in teleworking.

text: Ang mga kwalipikado mag-telework amo seguro yadtong mga empleyado nga makahimo sang ila trabaho online sa internet, kag mga hilimuon nga ma-ubra sa puluy-an kag i-report lang sa employer ang ila nahimo nga trabaho.
english: Those who are eligible to telework are probably those employees who can do their work online on the internet, and tasks that can be done at home and report to the employer.

text: Tungod boluntaryo lang ang pagpatuman sining kasuguan, indi man ini seguro madali-dali ipatuman sang kompaniya.
english: Since the implementation of this law is voluntary, the company will not be able to implement it easily.

text: Yara man ang problema nga gamiton sang empleyado ang iya panahon sa pag-ligoy ukon ang pag-gamit sang company computers sa indi bagay nga buluhaton katulad sa pag-chat sa kon sin-o lang, download sang kon ano lang, ukon ang paggamit sini sa mga ilegal nga mga hilimuon katulad sang pag-download sang porn kag i-share sa iban, kag bisan ang paggamit sini sa trafficking kag child pornography kasubong sang ginahimo sang pila ka sindikato.
english: There is also the problem of employees using their time to swim or using company computers for inappropriate activities such as chatting with anyone, downloading something, or using them for illegal activities such as downloading porn and sharing it with others, and even using it for trafficking and child pornography as done by some syndicates.

text: Kon maseguro na sang kompaniya nga indi masaskuhan ang ila trabaho,  amo na seguro ang pag-authorize sining telework sa mga kwalipikado nga empleyado.
english: Once the company is sure that their work will not be disrupted, it will probably authorize this telework to qualified employees.
