text: Nagpanaog na sa pwesto bilang head sang Chinese Basketball Association (CBA) ang NBA legend nga si Yao Ming bangud napigawan gid ini sa performance sang national team.
english: NBA legend Yao Ming has stepped down as head of the Chinese Basketball Association (CBA) after being disappointed with the performance of the national team.

text: Pito ka tuig nga gin-uyatan sang former Rockets star ang amo nga posisyon apisar nga nag-retiro na siya sa paghampang sang basketball sang 2011.
english: The former Rockets star held the position for seven years despite retiring from playing basketball in 2011.

text: Base sa interview kay Yao sa state news agency nga Xinhua, nag-resign siya bangud wala gid nakalab-ot sa “expectations” ang performances kag mga resulta sang hampang sang national team.
english: According to Yao's interview with state news agency Xinhua, he resigned because the national team's performances and results did not meet expectations.

text: Antes sini, pila ka beses na nga kritikal ang 44-anyos sa men’s national team kag gintawag pa sini anay ang ila players nga “slackers” kag nagpahayag man nga malayo sila katama sa pinakamaayo nga teams sa kalibutan.
english: The 44-year-old has previously been critical of the men’s national team several times and even called their players “slackers” and said they are far from the best teams in the world.

text: Sang wala sila nakasulod sa 2024 Paris Olympics, una man nga ginpahayag ni Yao sang nagligad nga tuig nga akuon niya ang bug-os nga responsibilidad.
english: When they missed out on the 2024 Paris Olympics, Yao also initially said last year that he would take full responsibility.

text:
Sunod man nga ginkumpirma sang CBA ang paghalin sini sa pwesto kag nagpaathag nga ginhimo ang desisyon matapos ang “careful consideration and based on considerations for the development of China’s basketball and personal planning.”

Antes ini nga development, duha ka magkasunod nga interesante nga hampang nga nagkitaay ang China kag ang Gilas Pilipinas nga ginsundan gid sang Pinoy basketball fans.
english:
The CBA later confirmed his resignation and explained that the decision was made after “careful consideration and based on considerations for the development of China’s basketball and personal planning.”

Before this development, two consecutive interesting matches between China and Gilas Pilipinas were closely followed by Filipino basketball fans.

text: Sang FIBA World Cup 2023, ginlutos sang Gilas ang China, 96-75, nga amo lamang ang isahanon nga kadalag-an sang Pilipinas sa tournament.
english: In the FIBA ​​World Cup 2023, the Gilas defeated China, 96-75, which was the Philippines’ only victory in the tournament.

text: Nanguna ang Utah Jazz kag Filipino-American star nga si Jordan Clarkson nga may 34 points sa amo nga kadalag-an nga una man nga daog sang Pilipinas batok sa China sa senior level sa FIBA-sanctioned tournament halin sang 2014 FIBA Asia Cup.
english: Utah Jazz and Filipino-American star Jordan Clarkson led the way with 34 points in the victory, which was also the Philippines' first victory over China at the senior level in a FIBA-sanctioned tournament since the 2014 FIBA ​​Asia Cup.

text: Pagkasunod nga bulan, liwat nga nahuy-an ang China sa atubang mismo sang Chinese fans sang ginlutos sila liwat sang Gilas Pilipinas sa semifinals sang men’s basketball sa Asian Games.
english: The following month, China was again embarrassed in front of Chinese fans when they were again defeated by Gilas Pilipinas in the semifinals of men's basketball at the Asian Games.

text: Nagbangon ang Gilas halin sa 20-puntos nga abanse, kag ginpasulod ni Justin Brownlee ang tres 24 segundos ang nabilin sa hampang nga amo ang nagpabor sa Pilipinas, 77-76, tubtub nga nakasulod ini sa finals kag dalayon nga nakuha ang gold medal sa Asiad.#
english: The Gilas recovered from a 20-point lead, and Justin Brownlee scored a three with 24 seconds left in the game that favored the Philippines, 77-76, until it reached the finals and immediately won the gold medal at the Asiad.

text: Nagretiro na sa Philippine Basketball Association (PBA) ang isa sa pinakamaayo nga imports nga si Allen Durham matapos ang isa ka dekada man nga pagpakita sang abilidad sa basketball sa Pilipinas.
english: One of the best imports, Allen Durham, has retired from the Philippine Basketball Association (PBA) after a decade of showing his basketball skills in the Philippines.

text: Kilala si Durham nga three-time Best Import awardee sa idalom sang Meralco Bolts nga patas sa awards nga nakuha sang Ginebra star nga si Justin Brownlee nga kilala man nga iya pinakadaku nga rival sa court.
english: Durham is known as a three-time Best Import awardee under the Meralco Bolts equal to the awards won by Ginebra star Justin Brownlee who is also known as his biggest rival on the court.

text: Pahayag ni Durham, nagbiya na siya sa PBA bilang pagpanghanda sa dalayon gid sini nga pagretiro sa basketball sa masunod nga tuig.
english: Durham said he is leaving the PBA in preparation for his immediate retirement from basketball next year.

text: Si Durham ang nanguna sa Bolts sa ila nauna nga tatlo ka PBA finals appearances apang ginakabos gid pirme batok kay Brownlee kag sa Ginebra.
english: Durham has led the Bolts in their previous three PBA finals appearances but has always been underwhelming against Brownlee and Ginebra.

text: Siya ang best reinforcement sa sulod sang tatlo ka tuig partikular sang 2016, 2017, kag 2020 editions sang Governor’s Cup.
english: He has been the best reinforcement for the past three years particularly during the 2016, 2017, and 2020 editions of the Governor’s Cup.

text: Sini lang nga tuig, may deja vu nga natabo sang gintapos ni Durham ang iya PBA career sa kamot gihapon ni Brownlee kag sang Gin Kings paagi sa 3-0 sweep sa quarterfinals sang PBA Governor’s Cup conference.
english: Just this year, some deja vu struck when Durham ended his PBA career still in the hands of Brownlee and the Gin Kings with a 3-0 sweep in the quarterfinals of the PBA Governor’s Cup conference.

text: Ulihi nga nakahampang si Durham para sa Bolts sa East Asia Super League (EASL) sang nagligad nga October 16 nga naka-skor sang 14 points sa 77-74 nga kalutusan batok sa iya former team nga Ryukyu sa Okinawa, Japan.
english: Durham last played for the Bolts in the East Asia Super League (EASL) last October 16, scoring 14 points in a 77-74 loss to his former team Ryukyu in Okinawa, Japan.

text: Antes magbalik si Durham sa Michigan sa United States subong nga adlaw, nagpatigayon ang franchise sang thanksgiving party para sa iya sa company headquarters sa Pasig sabg Martes.
english: Before Durham returned to Michigan in the United States today, the franchise held a thanksgiving party for him at the company headquarters in Pasig on Tuesday.

text: Indi lamang sa PBA nakasentro ang karera sang 36-anyos nga basketball star.
english: The 36-year-old basketball star's career is not only centered on the PBA.

text: Ginkilala man siya anay nga Japan B.League Finals Most Valuable Player sang 2023 matapos ginpangunahan ang Ryukyu Golden Kings sa championship.
english: He was also previously named the Japan B.League Finals Most Valuable Player in 2023 after leading the Ryukyu Golden Kings to the championship.

text: Sa France, siya ang Defensive Player of the Year, isa ka All-First Team member, kag All-Import team member sang duha ka beses sa second-tier French LNB Pro B League.
english: In France, he was Defensive Player of the Year, an All-First Team member, and All-Import team member twice in the second-tier French LNB Pro B League.

text: Nakahampang man siya sa Romania, Finland, Israel, Uruguay, Korea, kag sa NBA G League.
english: He has also played in Romania, Finland, Israel, Uruguay, Korea, and the NBA G League.

text: Ginkawatan na kag gintiro pa ang isa ka manuglibod sang isda sa Lambayong, Sultan Kudarat.
english: A fishmonger was robbed and shot in Lambayong, Sultan Kudarat.

text: Ang biktima amo si Bapa Masla, residente sang Sultan sa Barongis, Maguindanao del Sur.
english: The victim was identified as Bapa Masla, resident of Sultan in Barongis, Maguindanao del Sur.

text: Base sa impormasyon, nagadalagan ang motorsiklo sini sang gintiro sang wala pa nakilal-an nga mga indibidwal.
english: According to reports, he was running his motorcycle when he was shot by unidentified individuals.

text: Gilayon naman nga gindala sa ospital ang biktima.
english: The victim was rushed to the hospital.

text: Ginapatihan nga pagpangawat ang motibo sa krimen bangud nadula ang kwarta sini.
english: The motive of the crime is believed to be robbery because he lost his money.

text: Padayon pa ang imbestigasyon sa insidente.
english: The investigation into the incident is ongoing.

text: Naka-experiensya sang pagkadelay ang mga kapulisan sang pagserbe sang warrant of arrest batok sa negosyante nga si Charlie ”Atong” Ang sa iya balay sa Pasig City.
english: Police experienced delays in serving a warrant of arrest against businessman Charlie ”Atong” Ang at his house in Pasig City.

text: Nagtaas naman ang tensyon sang mga personnel sang Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) matapos wala gilayon ginpahanugutan nga makasulod sa balay sini apisar napresentar na ang warrant of arrest.
english: Tensions rose among the personnel of the Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) after they were not immediately allowed to enter his house despite the presentation of a warrant of arrest.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagpaguwa sang warrant of arrest ang regional trial court sa Sta.
english: The regional trial court in Sta.

text: Cruz, Laguna batok kay Ang kag sa 17 pa ka iban nga naangot sa kaso nga kidnapping with homicide kahapon nga adlaw, Enero 13.
english: Cruz, Laguna against Ang and 17 others in connection with the kidnapping with homicide case yesterday, January 13.

text: Ang kaso nga ini indi pwede nga mapyansahan sa idalom sang layi sang Pilipinas.
english: This case is not bailable under Philippine law.

text: Samtang, nagbutang naman sang hagdan ang mga awtoridad sa atubangan sang gate sang balay ni Ang apang nagapabilin ini sa gihapon nga nakasara ang gate sini.
english: Meanwhile, the authorities installed a ladder in front of the gate of Ang's house but the gate remains closed.

text: Nag-abot naman ang abogado ni Ang kag nagpangabay sa mga awtoridad nga siya anay ang magasulod sa balay sini antes sila magsulod.
english: Ang's lawyer arrived and asked the authorities to let him enter his house before they entered.

text: Ginpangayo naman sang abogado ang mga pangalan sang mga awtoridad nga nagsulod lakip na diri ang apat ka mga pulis kag isa ka opisyal sang barangay.
english: The lawyer asked for the names of the authorities who entered the house, including four policemen and a barangay official.

text: Matapos ang malapit isa ka oras nga hulat kag pagbantay wala nila makit-an si Ang.
english: After nearly an hour of waiting and watching they could not find Ang.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin ginbaton naman sang abogado ni Ang ang warrant of arrest batok sa negosyante.
english: Meanwhile, Ang's lawyer accepted the warrant of arrest against the businessman.

text: Suno pa sa mga awtoridad nga kun indi man nila makit-an si Ang ila man tingwaan nga lantawon kun nagwa ini sa pungsod.
english: According to the authorities, if they cannot find Ang, they will try to see if he left the country.

text: INI NA seguro ang pinakamasakit nga pahayag ni Presidente Duterte batok sa mga Obispo, lakip na seguro ang ordinaryo nga mga pari, nga posible may ginapakita nga mahulas nga pagsinalayo sunu sa pagtan-aw ni Presidente.
english: THIS is perhaps the most painful statement of President Duterte against the Bishops, including perhaps the ordinary priests, who may be showing a loose distance in the President's view.

text:
Sa iya pamulong-pulong sang sini lang sa tion sang pagselebrar sang kaadlawan ni Masbate Governor Antonio Kho, ginsiling ni Presidente ang masunod (sunu sa balita sa isa ka pahayagan nasyonal):

“Hoy, kayong mga tambay diyan, pag dumaan yang Obispo ninyo holdapan ‘yan, maraming pera ‘yan p***** i** niya… Patayin n’yo…”

Tungod sa sining pamahog sang Presidente, daw nakugmat man  gani kita nga mga pumuluyo nga nagatahod sa mga Obispo kag kaparian katoliko, sa kabug-usan, nga ang sumulunod nagadamo sing mga 80 ka porsyento sang aton populasyon.
english:
Speaking recently during Masbate Governor Antonio Kho’s birthday celebration, the President said the following (as reported in a national newspaper):

“Hey, you guys hanging out there, when the Bishop passes by, you rob him, he's got a lot of money... Kill him...”

Because of this threat of the President, it seems that we citizens who respect the Bishops and Catholic priests, in general, are shocked that the followers are increasing to about 80 percent of our population.

text: Ano na lang abe kon sundon sining mga tambay, kag iban pa nga wala nagatahod sa ila, ang panugyan ni Presidente?
english: What if these hangouts, and others who do not respect them, follow the President's advice?

text: Popular pa kaayo si Presidente kag posible may ara da sing fanatiko sa iya mga sumulunod nga basi magtuman sang iya panugyan batok sa sining mga Obispo nga ang pangabuhi, para sa iya pagpati, taliwas sa ila ginatudlo sa mga tumuluo.
english: The President is still very popular and there may be fanatics among his followers who might follow his advice against these Bishops whose lives, for his beliefs, are contrary to what they teach the faithful.

text: In fact, indi man naton madula nga basi may mga fanatiko man nga mga tumuluo nga maghimo sing indi maayo sa Presidente tungod sa sining pamahog niya sa kaparian.
english: In fact, we cannot rule out the possibility that there may be fanatical believers who will do bad things to the President because of his threat to the priests.

text: Nadumduman ko pa ang natabo sa isa ka prime minister sang isa ka daku nga pungsod.
english: I remember what happened to a prime minister of a large country.

text: Ginpa-raid niya ang isa ka simbahan.
english: He had a church raided.

text: Wala ini maluyagan sang pila ka tumuluo, nga kalakip gali sa security mismo sining prime minister.
english: This did not please some believers, who were actually part of the prime minister's own security.

text: Sus, ginpatay gid sang duha sa ila ining ila prime minister tungod sa sining pang-insulto sini sa ila simbahan!
english: Sus, two of them killed their prime minister because of this insult to their church!

text: Tani indi ini matabo sa mga Obispo kag mga kaparian kag subong man kay Presidente kay indi kita luyag matabo nga magpinatyanay na lang kita sa aton kalain sing buot sa isa kag isa.
english: I hope this does not happen to the Bishops and priests and also to the President because we do not want to happen that we just kill each other in our hatred for each other.

text: Samtang, wala sing kabalaka ang kaparian sa sining panugyan ni Presidente nga pamatyon sila sang posible mga fanatiko niya.
english: Meanwhile, the priests are not concerned about the President's suggestion that they be killed by his possible fanatics.

text: Ini ang ginpabatyag ni Novaliches Bishop-Emeritus Teodoro Bacani Jr.
english: This was expressed by Novaliches Bishop-Emeritus Teodoro Bacani Jr.

text: sa isa ka interbyu sa radyo.
english: in a radio interview.

text: Siling niya nga wala sila nahadlok sa sining pamahog ni Presidente sa ila kabuhi kag gin-“dare” pa niya ang Presidente.
english: He said they were not afraid of the President's threat to their lives and he even dared the President.

text: “Meron lang akong friendly challenge kay Presidente Duterte,” siling niya, “Simple lang na ganito.
english: “I just have a friendly challenge to President Duterte,” he said, “It's as simple as that.

text: Alam niyo kaming mga Obispo naglalakad, wala kaming bodyguard, wala kaming bullet-proof vests, wala kaming mga security aides na nakapaligid na marami, wala kaming dalang baril, gano’n kami,” siling niya sa sining interbyu.
english: You know we Bishops walk, we don't have bodyguards, we don't have bullet-proof vests, we don't have security aides who are around a lot, we don't carry guns, that's all we are,” he said in this interview.

text:
“Ang challenge ko kay Presidente Duterte na kung talagang matapang siya, simple lang, gawin niya yung ginagawa namin (na naglalakad na walang security escorts).”

Ginsabat ini sang spokesperson ni Presidente.
english:
“My challenge to President Duterte is that if he is really brave, he will simply do what we are doing (walking without security escorts).”

The President's spokesperson responded.

text: Ginsiling sini nga ginatumod lang sang Presidente ang mga Obispo nga nagapatambok sang ila bulsa kag nagapangabuhi labag sa ila “teachings”.
english: He said the President is only referring to the Bishops who are fattening their pockets and living against their teachings.

text: Ang buot niya silingon seguro sa “teachings” amo nga ang mga pari dapat mangabuhi sing mas ispiritual kag kulang sa materyal nga pangabuhi.
english: He probably meant by “teachings” that priests should live a more spiritual and less material life.

text: Of course, wala nagakahulugan nga kon manggaran ka indi ka na makapangabuhi ispiritwal.
english: Of course, being rich doesn't mean you can't live a spiritual life.

text: Pwede man ang isa ka tawo nga sakay sa kotse samtang ispiritwal ang ugali kag nagahimo sing ispiritwal nga bagay katulad sang pagbulig ukon pagpatigayon sang kaayuhan sang mga kubos.
english: It is also possible for a person to ride in a car while being spiritual and doing something spiritual such as helping or doing good for the poor.

text: Aba, madamo nga manggaran ang nagahimo sina!
english: Why, many rich people do that!

text: Lakip na si Presidente Duterte, no doubt.
english: Including President Duterte, no doubt.

text:
***

Ang matuod amo nga indi makapagusto ang mga pari sa ila hulag sa pangabuhi, bisan pa nga madamo sa ila ang natawo nga manggaran kag tugot sa pagpanag-iya sang propyedad, katulad sang mga Dominicans kag Augustinians.
english:
***

The truth is that priests cannot enjoy their way of life, even though many of them were born wealthy and allowed to own property, like the Dominicans and Augustinians.

text:
Ang mga Hesuwita, katulad ni Pope Francis, indi gani tugot manag-iya sang propyedad tungod sang ila vow nga “Poverty, chastity and obedience.”

Ang mga pari sa parokya sa Iloilo, sa nahibal-an ta, may sweldo, kon sweldo man ang tawag sini, nga mga P15,000 lang sa kada bulan nga pwede nila magamit sa ila personal nga kinahanglanon, manggaran man sila ukon kubos sing ginhalinan.
english:
Jesuits, like Pope Francis, are not even allowed to own property because of their vow of “Poverty, chastity and obedience.”

The priests in the parish in Iloilo, as far as we know, have a salary, if it is called a salary, of only about P15,000 per month that they can use for their personal needs, whether they are rich or poor.

text: Pareho lang ini sa sweldo sang mamumugon sa tag-P500 kada adlaw.
english: This is the same as the wage of a worker at P500 per day.

text: So, indi naton masiling nga masulhay man ang ila pangabuhi.
english: So, we can't say that their lives are comfortable either.

text: Ang mga manggaran sa ila, segurado ko nga limitado man ang ila pagpangabuhi tungod sa ila misyon ispiritwal bilang pari.
english: The richest of them, I am sure, also have a limited life because of their spiritual mission as a priest.

text: (w_mateojr@yahoo.com/PN)
english: (w_mateojr@yahoo.com/PN)

text: Mapadalagan sanday “Star for All Seasons” Vilma Santos Recto kag anak sini nga si Luis Manzano bilang governor kag vice governor sa Batangas.
english: “Star for All Seasons” Vilma Santos Recto and her son Luis Manzano will run for governor and vice governor of Batangas.

text: Samtang ang anak pa gid ni Vilma nga si Ryan Christian Recto ang mapadalagan man bilang kongresista sa 6th District sang Batangas.
english: Meanwhile, Vilma's son, Ryan Christian Recto, is also running for congressman in the 6th District of Batangas.

text: Subong nga adlaw, nag-file si Vilma kag mga anak sini sang ila Certificate of Candidacy (COC) sa Batangas Provincial Capitol.
english: Today, Vilma and her children filed their Certificate of Candidacy (COC) at the Batangas Provincial Capitol.

text: Gin-updan si Vilma sang iya bana nga si Department of Finance (DOF) Secretary Ralph Recto samtang si Luis ang gin-updan man sang iya misis nga actress nga si Jessy Mendiola.
english: Vilma was accompanied by her husband, Department of Finance (DOF) Secretary Ralph Recto while Luis was accompanied by his wife, actress Jessy Mendiola.

text: Kapin sa 467,000 ka mga salakyan ang nadugang sa mga dalan sang Pilipinas sang 2024 nga ang sales growth ginalauman nga mapadayon subong nga tuig.
english: More than 467,000 vehicles will be added to Philippine roads by 2024 with sales growth expected to continue this year.

text: Suno sa Chamber of Automotive Manufacturers of the Philippines Inc.
english: According to the Chamber of Automotive Manufacturers of the Philippines Inc.

text: (CAMPI) kag sang Truck Manufacturers Association (TMA), may 467,252 ka mga units nga nabaligya sang 2024 nga nagapakita sang 8.7% nga pagtaas gikan sa 429,807 ka mga units nga nabaligya sang 2023.
english: (CAMPI) and the Truck Manufacturers Association (TMA), there were 467,252 units sold in 2024 showing an 8.7% increase from 429,807 units sold in 2023.

text: Samtang ang commercial vehicles ang nagbug-os sang 74.15% sang merkado nga may 346,482 ka units, samtang ang mga depampasahero nga salakyan nagbug-os sang 25.85% nga may 120,770 ka units.
english: Meanwhile, commercial vehicles accounted for 74.15% of the market with 346,482 units, while passenger vehicles accounted for 25.85% with 120,770 units.

text: Ini bangud may 42,044 ka mga units nga nabaligya sang Disyembre nga nagamarka sang 2.8% nga growth gikan sa 40,898 ka mga units nga nabaligya sang Nobyembre, kag 7.4% nga mas mataas kon ipaanggid sa 39,153 ka mga units nga nabaligya sang Disyembre 2023.
english: This is because there were 42,044 units sold in December marking a 2.8% growth from the 40,898 units sold in November, and 7.4% higher compared to the 39,153 units sold in December 2023.

text: Ginmando sang Professional Regulatory Board of Civil Engineering ang pag-revoke sang professional license ni former Department of Public Works and Highways district engineer Henry Alcantara.
english: The Professional Regulatory Board of Civil Engineering has ordered the revocation of the professional license of former Department of Public Works and Highways district engineer Henry Alcantara.

text: Suno sa PRC, napamatud-an si Alcantara nga guilty sa gross unprofessional kag unethical conduct bangud sa iya self-confessed involvement sa mga ghost kag substandard flood control projects sa Bulacan.
english: According to the PRC, Alcantara was found guilty of gross unprofessional and unethical conduct due to his self-confessed involvement in ghost and substandard flood control projects in Bulacan.

text: Ginmando sang Office of the Basic Education Commission (Obec) ang temporaryo nga pagpasirado sang 751 ka mga eskwelahan nga nahamtang sa high-risk areas kag malapit sa border sang Thailand kag Cambodia.
english: The Office of the Basic Education Commission (Obec) ordered the temporary closure of 751 schools located in high-risk areas and near the border of Thailand and Cambodia.

text: Ginhimo sang ahensya ang desisyon kasunod sang nagasaka nga tensyon sa tunga sang duha ka pungsod nga nag-resulta sa paglinukpanay kun sa diin may na-record na nga casualties kag libu-libo na nga mga residente ang nagbiya sa ila mga puluy-an.
english: The agency made the decision following rising tensions between the two countries that resulted in clashes where casualties have been recorded and thousands of residents have fled their homes.

text: Suno kay John Mark Lopez, isa ka teacher sa probinsya sang Lopburi kag Bombo International Correspondent sa Thailand, ginsugo ang mga eskwelahan nga istrikto nga magsunod sa emergency response protocols kag i-monitor gid ang safety sang mga estudyante.
english: According to John Mark Lopez, a teacher in Lopburi province and Bombo International Correspondent in Thailand, schools have been instructed to strictly follow emergency response protocols and closely monitor the safety of students.

text: Nagpahayag man ang Education Minister sang gilayon nga pagpatuman sang psychological and welfare support para sa apektado nga mga estudyante kag ila mga pamilya.
english: The Education Minister also announced the immediate implementation of psychological and welfare support for the affected students and their families.

text: Nagbalay man ang ahensya sang short-term kag long-term recovery measures para malikawan nga mag-untat ang mga kabataan sa pag-eskwela, makahatag sang mental health support kadungan sang displacement, kag mabalik ang educational access sa border communities.
english: The agency also outlined short-term and long-term recovery measures to prevent children from dropping out of school, provide mental health support during displacement, and restore educational access to border communities.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa natabo nga border violence partikular na ang artillery shelling sang Cambodian forces nga nag-igo sa convenience store sa sulod sang petrol station sa Kantharalak district sang Si Sa Ket province, lakip sa napatay amo ang isa ka Grade 9 female student.
english: It is known that in the border violence particularly the artillery shelling of Cambodian forces that hit a convenience store inside a petrol station in Kantharalak district of Si Sa Ket province, among the dead was a Grade 9 female student.

text: Subong nga gab-i, gin-anunsyo man nga nagpatuman na ang Thailand sang martial law sa walo ka mga distrito sa border sini sa Cambodia.#
english: Tonight, it was also announced that Thailand has imposed martial law in eight districts on its border with Cambodia.

text: ANG isa naton ka abyan galibug gid ang iya ulo kon ano gid sa karon ang relihiyon ni Presidente Duterte.
english: ONE of our friends is very confused about what religion President Duterte is now.

text: Ang nahibal-an naton amo nga ginbunyagan siya nga isa ka katoliko.
english: What we do know is that he was baptized a catholic.

text: In fact, sa isa ka okasyon samtang presidente na siya ginpabutyag niya nga katoliko siya.
english: In fact, on one occasion while he was president he expressed that he was a Catholic.

text: Kag ina bisan sige ang iya atake sa mga pari, lakip na si Pope Francis, bisan pa gani sang naga-kampanya pa lang siya sa pagka-presidente.
english: And that's despite his constant attacks on priests, including Pope Francis, even during his presidential campaign.

text: Sang ulihi ugaling, sang sige na init sang relasyon niya sa Simbahan Catolica, ginsiling niya nga ang iya relihiyon amo ang “Relihiyon ni Duterte”.
english: Later, however, as his relationship with the Catholic Church continued to heat up, he said that his religion was “Duterte's Religion”.

text: Ambot lang kon nagalahog lang siya.
english: I don't know if he's just joking.

text: In fact, kon basehan naton ang iya pabutyag parti sa iya pagpati, nagagwa nga indi na siya katoliko.
english: In fact, if we base his statement on his beliefs, it turns out that he is no longer a Catholic.

text: Ina sang ginsikway na niya ang pagpati sa pinaka-importante nga pagtuo sang mga katoliko sa Holy Trinity – ang isa ka Diyos nga may tatlo ka persona: Amay, Anak kag Espiritu Santo.
english: That was when he rejected the belief in the most important Catholic faith in the Holy Trinity – one God in three persons: Father, Son and Holy Spirit.

text: Sa pahayag niya sang sining ulihi lang ang Amay lang ang Diyos kag wala sing Diyos Anak (Hesukristo) kag Diyos Espiritu Santo.
english: In his recent statement, only the Father is God and there is no God the Son (Jesus Christ) and God the Holy Spirit.

text: Of course, kon ano man ang relihiyon ni Duterte wala na ya paki ang mga pumuluyo, labi na gid diri sa Pilipinas kag iban pa nga pungsod nga wala sing State Religion, katulad sa nahibal-an ta nga mga nasyon Muslim, kag nagapati sa Separation of Church and State.
english: Of course, whatever Duterte's religion, the people don't care, especially here in the Philippines and other countries that don't have a State Religion, like the Muslim countries we know, and believe in the Separation of Church and State.

text: Sa ila ang isyu pang-relihiyon lain man sa isyu sang kahimtangan sa pangabuhi, relasyon sang mga tawo sa isigkatawo sa sosyedad, kag iban pa nga isyu sa panghimanwa nga gatutok lang sa tawohanon (indi ispiritual) nga problema.
english: For them, the religious issue is also different from the issue of living conditions, people's relationships with others in society, and other civic issues that focus only on human (not spiritual) problems.

text: In fact, tungod sa tindug sa Separation of Church and State, nagdaug si Duterte bisan pa sa mga masakit niya nga pagtrato kay Pope Francis, nga pinuno sang 80 ka porsyento ka katoliko diri, sadtong magduaw ini sa Pilipinas.
english: In fact, because of his stand on the Separation of Church and State, Duterte won despite his harsh treatment of Pope Francis, who is the head of the 80 percent Catholic population here, during his visit to the Philippines.

text: Ginbasol niya ang problema sa trapiko sadtong pagduaw ni Pope Francis, samtang sang magduaw ang president sang Tsina sa Pilipinas wala man siya gani mag-angal sa kasubong nga problema sa trapiko.
english: He blamed the traffic problem during Pope Francis' visit, while when the Chinese president visited the Philippines he did not even complain about such a traffic problem.

text: Sa Estados Unidos, nagdaug man bilang Presidente si John F. Kennedy samtang katapo siya sang Simbahan Catolica nga ang kadamuon mga 25 porsyento lang sang populasyon.
english: In the United States, John F. Kennedy also won the presidency while belonging to the Catholic Church, which makes up only about 25 percent of the population.

text: Nagdaug man si Barack Obama bilang Presidente samtang yara siya sa black minority sang populasyon.
english: Barack Obama also won the presidency while being in the black minority of the population.

text: Sa Pilipinas mismo, madamo na kita nga mga utod nga Muslim nga yara sa pwesto, lakip ang na-elejer bilang senador, kongresista kag meyor.
english: In the Philippines itself, we have many Muslim brothers and sisters in office, including those elected as senators, congressmen and mayors.

text: Samtang, padayon nga mataas ang rating sa survey ni Duterte, nga ang latest amo ang 74 satisfaction rating bisan sa sige niya atake sa Simbahan.
english: Meanwhile, Duterte's survey rating continues to be high, with the latest being a 74 satisfaction rating despite his continued attacks on the Church.

text: Sang sini lang ugaling gin-atake na ni Duterte ang mayor nga doktrina sang pagtuo Katoliko – ang isa ka Diyos sa tatlo ka persona sang Amay, Anak kag Espiritu Santo.
english: Recently, however, Duterte has attacked the main doctrine of the Catholic faith – the one God in three persons of Father, Son and Holy Spirit.

text: Isa gid lang kuno ang Diyos.
english: There is only one God.

text: Tungod sini, strictly indi na katoliko si Duterte bisan ginbunyagan siya sa Simbahan Katolika.
english: Because of this, Duterte is no longer strictly a Catholic even though he was baptized in the Catholic Church.

text: Gani, kon magbalik gid man siya sa Simbahan Catolica, kinahanglan na gid niya seguro nga magpa-kumpirma liwat.
english: So, if he ever returns to the Catholic Church, he will probably have to be confirmed again.

text: Natandaan ko ang natabo sa akon sang ako nagpangasawa sa Simbahan Catolica.
english: I remember what happened to me when I got married in the Catholic Church.

text: Gaduha-duha na sadto ang Simbahan kon katoliko pa ako sa nahibal-an nila seguro nga ginsikway ko ang ano man nga ginapatihan nga diyos agud pangitaon gid kon sin-o ang matuod nga Diyos.
english: The Church was already doubting if I was still a Catholic because they probably knew that I had rejected any god I believed in in order to find the true God.

text: Gin-require gid ako nga ma-kumpirmahan liwat.
english: I was absolutely required to be reconfirmed.

text: Si Panay News photojournalist Felix pa gani ang akon maninoy.
english: Panay News photojournalist Felix is ​​even my brother-in-law.

text: Ang confirmation ginahiwat sang obispo sa binunyagan sa pagsugod sang edad nga 12 anyos.
english: Confirmation is administered by the bishop to the baptized at the beginning of the age of 12 years.

text: Sang ginkumpirma ako liwat 52 anyos na ako.
english: When I was reconfirmed I was 52 years old.

text: Amo man ini seguro ang gin-require kay anay Senador Roding Ganon sang pangasaw-on niya si Rona sa madamo man nga okasyon nga nagka-conflicto siya sa Simbahan Catolica.
english: This is probably what was required of former Senator Roding Ganon when he married Rona on many occasions when he had conflicts with the Catholic Church.

text: Ti, ano gid ayhan nga relihiyon ang sudlan ni Duterte?
english: Well, what religion will Duterte join?

text: Basi ang Iglesia ni Kristo, nga identified man sa iya.
english: Maybe the Church of Christ, which is also identified with him.

text: Ang INC gatudlo nga ang Diyos Amay amo lang ang matuod nga Diyos kag ginasikway sini ang Trinidad sini sa Anak Diyos (Hesukristo) kag Diyos Espiritu Santo.
english: The INC teaches that God the Father is the only true God and rejects the Trinity of God the Son (Jesus Christ) and God the Holy Spirit.

text: Basi man ang Jewish Faith nga nagasikway man sang Holy Trinity.
english: Maybe the Jewish Faith that also rejects the Holy Trinity.

text: Ukon basi ang iya kuno “Relihiyon ni Duterte” nga nagatudlo nga wala sing Impiyerno.
english: Or maybe his supposed “Duterte Religion” which teaches that there is no Hell.

text: Ti, ano ayhan ini sa inyo pagpati?/PN
english: Well, what do you think it is?/PN

text: Natukiban nga ang babaye nga nag-alegar nga nakakita sang bag-o bun-ag nga lapsag sa sulod sang tangkal kahapon nga adlaw sa Brgy.
english: It was discovered that the woman who allegedly saw a newborn baby inside the barn yesterday in Brgy.

text: Anonang, Leon, Iloilo amo man gali ang matuod nga iloy sang bata.
english: Anonang, Leon, Iloilo is the real mother of the child.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Lieutenant Mark Cortez, deputy chief of police sang Leon Municipal Police Station, iya ginkumpirma nga base sa ila imbestigasyon, ginhimu-himu lang sang babaye ang istorya nga iya nakita-an ang lapsag sa tangkal.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Lieutenant Mark Cortez, deputy chief of police of the Leon Municipal Police Station, confirmed that based on their investigation, the woman made up the story that she saw the baby in the barn.

text: Ginkilala ang babaye kay alyas “Anna Mae”, 20-anyos kag ginapahayag nga may yara ini sang partner nga amo ang amay sang iya subang nga bata nga naga-edad 2-anyos.
english: The woman was identified as alias “Anna Mae”, 20-years-old and allegedly has a partner who is the father of her 2-year-old youngest child.

text: Nahibaluan nga bulagay na sila sang iya nga partner nga taga-Passi City.
english: It was learned that he and his partner from Passi City are separated.

text: Wala pa nakumpirmar kun amo man ini ang amay sang iya bag-o nga ginbun-ag nga bata.
english: It has not been confirmed if he is also the father of her newborn child.

text: Suno sa pulis, gin-usisa sang Women and Children’s Protection Desk sang Leon si Anna Mae bangud nga ila ini nakita-an nga nagapanglapsi kag nakita-an man nga may yara sang mantsa sang dugo ang iya bayo kag likod sang iya paa.
english: According to the police, the Women and Children's Protection Desk of Leon examined Anna Mae because they found her lying on the floor and also found blood stains on her clothes and the back of her leg.

text: Gin-ako man niya sa mga otoridad nga siya ang iloy sang bata kag iya lang ginhimu-himu ang iya ginpahayag kahapon nga iya nakit-an ang lapsag sa tangkal.
english: She also admitted to the authorities that she was the mother of the child and that she was making up her statement yesterday that she found the baby in the barn.

text: Gilayon ini gin-examine sang attending physician sa Aleosan District Hospital kag nakumpirmar nga bag-o lang ini nagbata bangud man sa nakita-an nga laceration sa iya kinatawo kun sa diin gintahi pa sang doctor.
english: She was immediately examined by the attending physician at the Aleosan District Hospital and confirmed that she had just given birth due to the laceration on her genitals where the doctor stitched her.

text: Nahibalaun man nga siya mismo ang nagpabata sa iya kaugalingon sa sulod mismo sang ila balay.
english: It was also learned that she gave birth to herself inside their house.

text: Sandig sa imbestisgasyon sang mga otoridad, wala nakabalo ang pamilya sini nga nagbusong siya bangud nga gintago ni Anna Mae sa rason nga nahuya ini ipahibalo ang iya sitwasyon sa iya pamilya.
english: According to the investigation of the authorities, her family did not know that she was pregnant because Anna Mae hid it because she was ashamed to inform her family about her situation.

text: Sa karon, yara na ini sa kustodiya sang Women and Children’s Protection Desk agud mabuligan sa sitwasyon nga iya gina-atubang sa subong.
english: She is now in the custody of the Women and Children's Protection Desk for assistance in the situation she is currently facing.

text: Gin-alegar ni Batangas Rep.
english: Batangas Rep.

text: Leandro Leviste nga ang gina-uyatan sini nga “Cabral files” ang gamay pa gid lamang nga parte kaangot sa mga anomaliya sa Department of Public Works and Highways.
english: Leandro Leviste said the “Cabral files” he holds are only a small part of the anomalies in the Department of Public Works and Highways.

text: Suno sa kongresista, may ara pa ini sang may gina-uyatan nga iban pa nga ebidensya nga mas mabug-at ipaanggid sa mga file nga iya na nga ginpagwa.
english: The congressman said he still has other evidence that is heavier than the files he has already released.

text: Nagapati siya nga amo ini ang rason kun ngaa gina-target siya sang nagkakain-lain nga pagpamahog sa iya kabuhi.
english: He believes that this is the reason why he is targeted by various threats to his life.

text: Nahibaluan nga nakasulod sa Cabral files ang mga datos kag dokumento nahanungod sa budget sang mga proyekto nga pang-imprastruktura sa nagkalain-lain nga distrito sa pungsod.
english: It was learned that the Cabral files contained data and documents regarding the budget of infrastructure projects in various districts in the country.

text: Nagpaandam man si Leviste nga kun ipa-patay siya, maga-gwa ang kabug-usan nga kamatuoran kaangot sa mga iregularidad sa DPWH.
english: Leviste also warned that if he is killed, the whole truth about the irregularities in the DPWH will come out.

text: Wala na sang mas espesyal nga adlaw sa duha ka tawo nga nagahigugmaanay kundi ang ila nga kasal.
english: There is no more special day for two people who love each other than their wedding.

text: Diri sila magapanumpa nga indi magbayaay, kag diri nila isugid sa atubang sang mga tawo kun daw ano nila kapalangga ang isa kag isa.
english: Here they will swear not to leave each other, and here they will tell in front of the people how much they love each other.

text: Apang sa isa ka kasal sa Dipaculao, Aurora, tumalagsahon ang natabo bangud sa mismo adlaw sang ila kasal amo man ang pagbata sang misis!
english: But at a wedding in Dipaculao, Aurora, something unusual happened because on the very day of their wedding, the wife gave birth!

text: Makit-an nga kumpleto na ang entourage, nahimos na ang venue sang kasal kag bongga ang mga handa.
english: The entourage is complete, the wedding venue is ready and the guests are ready.

text: Apang bangud sa emergency, indi na makatambong ang babayi bangud nga yara ini sa ospital.
english: However, due to the emergency, the woman could not attend because she was in the hospital.

text: Suno sa groom nga si Jericho Sabado, indi man niya gusto nga ikanselar ang kasal bangud daku na ang ila naggasto.
english: According to groom Jericho Sabado, he does not want to cancel the wedding because they have already spent a lot of money.

text: Gani suhestyon sang pastor, tawgan na lang si misis sa ospital ukon indi gani, i-video call na lang samtang padayon ang seremonya.
english: So the pastor suggested, just call the wife at the hospital or even, just video call while the ceremony continues.

text: Ang natabo, mannequin anay ang nagbulos kay misis sa kasal nga syempre, nagasuksok man sang puti nga gown nga tipikal nga ginagamit sa kasal.
english: What happened was that a former mannequin replaced the wife at the wedding who of course, was also wearing the white gown typically used at weddings.

text: Apisar medyo masubo ang groom, okay na ini para sa iya bangud nakabun-ag na si Misis sang isa ka healthy baby.
english: Although the groom was a little sad, it was okay for him because his wife had given birth to a healthy baby.

text: Ginkumpirma ni Golden State Warriors head coach Steve Kerr nga nakaangkon sang injury ang superstar nga si Stephen Curry sa 112-104 nga kapaslawan sang team batok sa LA Clippers.
english: Golden State Warriors head coach Steve Kerr confirmed that superstar Stephen Curry suffered an injury in the team’s 112-104 loss to the LA Clippers.

text: Nakit-an ang 36-anyos nga two-time MVP kag four-time NBA champion nga nagakiang-kiang na sang nagguwa ini sa third quarter.
english: The 36-year-old two-time MVP and four-time NBA champion was found limping when he came out of the third quarter.

text: Pagkatapos sang kuwatro minutos sa fourth quarter, nagbalik ini sa hampang apang naglala ang sakit kag ginbuligan sang team-mate nga si Gary Payton sa locker room.
english: After four minutes in the fourth quarter, he returned to the game but the pain worsened and team-mate Gary Payton helped him into the locker room.

text: Indi ini tuman ka lala nga injury suno kay Kerr apang ginakahangaw-an gihapon nila ang kaangay sini nga ankle injuries.
english: Kerr said it was not a serious injury but they are still concerned about similar ankle injuries.

text: Si Curry nga may malawig man nga history sang ankle injuries ang naka-skor sang 18 points sa una nga kapaslawan sang Warriors subong nga NBA season.
english: Curry, who also has a long history of ankle injuries, scored 18 points in the Warriors’ first loss this NBA season.

text: Suno sa team, nagpaidalom ini sa Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scan pagkatapos sang hampang kag wala sang structural damage apang may left peroneal strain.
english: According to the team, he underwent a magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scan after the game and there was no structural damage but a left peroneal strain.

text: Natalana nga iga-evaluate liwat ang iya kondisyon sa Biyernes.
english: His condition is scheduled to be re-evaluated Friday.

text: “Golden State Warriors guard Stephen Curry, who exited last night’s game against the Los Angeles Clippers with 7:55 remaining in the fourth quarter, underwent an MRI late last night.
english: “Golden State Warriors guard Stephen Curry, who exited last night’s game against the Los Angeles Clippers with 7:55 remaining in the fourth quarter, underwent an MRI late last night.

text: The MRI showed no structural damage and confirmed the injury as a left peroneal strain.
english: The MRI showed no structural damage and confirmed the injury as a left peroneal strain.

text: He will be re-evaluated on Friday,” suno sa X post sang GSW.#
english: He will be re-evaluated on Friday,” according to GSW’s X post.#

text: Isumpa sang isa ka kandidato sa pagka-senador ang mga tawo nga sa likod sang Commission on Elections (COMELEC) kun ideklara siya nga nuisance ukon nagapagamo lang sa piniliay.
english: A senatorial candidate will curse the people behind the Commission on Elections (COMELEC) if he is declared a nuisance or just causing trouble in the election.

text: Ini amo si Betsaida Lopez.
english: This is Bethsaida Lopez.

text: Si Lopez ang gindeklara nga nuisance candidate sang nagligad nga eleksyon bangud sa kakulang sang iya pamatuod sa iya intensyon sa pagpadalagan.
english: Lopez was declared a nuisance candidate in the last election due to lack of proof of his intention to run.

text: Apang sa ikaduha nga adlaw sang filing sang certificate of candidacy (COC) para sa May 2025 elections, liwat ini nga nagpakita.
english: But on the second day of the filing of the certificate of candidacy (COC) for the May 2025 elections, it reappeared.

text: “Kapag hindi ako pinatakbong senador ng COMELEC, lahat ng mga taong involve na ako ay i-disqualify sa pagiging mahirap, ay isinusumpa ko ang mga taong yun at idedeklara ko na pinakawala kayong kwentang ahensya ng gobyerno.”
english: “If the COMELEC does not nominate me as a senator, all the people involved with me will be disqualified for being poor, I will curse those people and declare you the most worthless government agency.”

text: Dalayawon ang duha ka pulis nga wala gid nag-alang-alang sa pagbulig sa isa ka babayi nga naalangan kag nagbata sa JM Basa St., Iloilo City kadungan sang highlight sang Dinagyang Festival.
english: Two policemen who did not hesitate to help a woman who was stranded and gave birth in JM Basa St., Iloilo City during the highlight of the Dinagyang Festival are commendable.

text: Ang mga nagbulig nga mga pulis amo sanday PSSg Resurrecion Aliponso, Jr.
english: The policemen who assisted were PSSg Resurrecion Aliponso, Jr.

text: sang San Lorenzo Municipal Police Station kag ang iya kaupod nga si PCpl.
english: of the San Lorenzo Municipal Police Station and his partner, PCpl.

text: Joe Ben Moleño sang Sibunag Municipal Police Station, lunsay augmentation personnel nagikan sa Guimaras Police Provincial Office nga gin-deploy para sa security coverage sa Iloilo City.
english: Joe Ben Moleño of Sibunag Municipal Police Station, both augmentation personnel from the Guimaras Police Provincial Office who were deployed for security coverage in Iloilo City.

text: Gilayon nga nagbulig ang duha sang nakita ang sitwasyon sang 27-anyos nga iloy nga si Charlane Lobaton, 27, residente sang Zone 3 Brgy.
english: The two immediately helped the 27-year-old mother, Charlane Lobaton, 27, resident of Zone 3 Brgy.

text: San Juan Molo, Iloilo City.
english: San Juan Molo, Iloilo City.

text: Natigayon nga nabun-ag ni Charlane ang iya baby girl nga ginpangalanan kay “Dianne Jane”.
english: Charlane managed to give birth to her baby girl who was named “Dianne Jane”.

text: Nangibabaw ang mga Ilonggo nga players nga nagabug-os sang J3 Barotac Nuevo nga nagpasakop sa Octoberfest Sports League nga ginpatigayon sa Boracay.
english: The Ilonggo players of J3 Barotac Nuevo who participated in the Octoberfest Sports League held in Boracay dominated.

text: Gindala nila pauli ang titulo sa Beach Football.
english: They took home the Beach Football title.

text: Ang team ginabug-usan nanday Joshua Jerome Estares, Nathaniel Boblo, Arlo Salvacion, Karlo Lustan, Jefferson Descarial, June Louie Biclar, James Tuazon, Allan John Biñas, kag Jarlson Derutas.
english: The team consists of Joshua Jerome Estares, Nathaniel Boblo, Arlo Salvacion, Karlo Lustan, Jefferson Descarial, June Louie Biclar, James Tuazon, Allan John Biñas, and Jarlson Derutas.

text: Ang ila manager amo si Neil Jeffrey Reyes.
english: Their manager is Neil Jeffrey Reyes.

text: Matandaan nga sa Love Boracay Beach Sports Activity sa Boracay sang April 27- 28, 2024, sila man ang gindeklarar nga kampeon sa Beach Football.
english: It can be recalled that at the Love Boracay Beach Sports Activity in Boracay on April 27-28, 2024, they were also declared champions in Beach Football.

text: ILOILO CITY – Neither confirm nor deny ang kampo ni Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas sa impormasyon nga gin-admit ini sa isa ka ospital sa Metro Manila.
english: ILOILO CITY – Neither confirm nor deny the camp of Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas on the information that he was admitted to a hospital in Metro Manila.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Joy Fantilaga, spokesperson ni Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga ang pagpadulong sang alkalde sa Metro Manila ang kabahin sang iya general check-up.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Joy Fantilaga, Treñas' spokesperson, said the mayor's visit to Metro Manila was part of his general check-up.

text: Suno kay Fantilaga, samtang nagahulat sa resulta sang iya laboratory tests, ginaprepahan man sang alkalde ang pag-file sang Team Uswag sang Certificate of Candidacy (COC) nga natalana sa masunod nga semana.
english: According to Fantilaga, while waiting for the results of his laboratory tests, the mayor is also preparing for the filing of Team Uswag's Certificate of Candidacy (COC) which is scheduled for next week.

text: Gintugyan naman sang alkalde kay Vice Jeffrey Ganzon ang pagdumala sa Iloilo City bilang acting Mayor.
english: The mayor handed over the management of Iloilo City to Vice Jeffrey Ganzon as acting Mayor.

text: Nahibaluan nga maga-file sang COC ang Team Uswag sa Oktubre 8.
english: Team Uswag will file its COC on October 8.

text: Nasawi ang isa lalaki matapos aksidenteng malamon ng isang makinaryang pang-ani o harvester sa Barangay Janipaan Oeste, Cabatuan, Iloilo.
english: A man was injured after being accidentally swallowed by a harvester in Barangay Janipaan Oeste, Cabatuan, Iloilo.

text: Kinilala ang biktima sa alyas na “Jose”, 57-anyos, may asawa, at residente ng Barangay Janipaan Olo sa parehong bayan.
english: The victim was identified as “Jose”, 57 years old, married, and resident of Barangay Janipaan Olo in the same town.

text: Sa panayam ng Bombo Radyo kay Police Lieutenant Veto Bastiero Jr., Deputy Chief of Police ng Cabatuan, sinabi nito na habang nililinis umano ng biktima ang harvester, aksidente itong tinamaan ng bahagi ng makina na tinatawag na reaper.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Police Lieutenant Veto Bastiero Jr., Deputy Chief of Police of Cabatuan, said that while the victim was cleaning the harvester, he was accidentally hit by a part of the machine called a reaper.

text: Tinamaan ang kanang bahagi ng kanyang katawan, kabilang ang ulo, kamay, at paa.
english: The right side of his body was hit, including the head, hands, and feet.

text: Ang harvester ay pagmamay-ari ni Ma.
english: The harvester is owned by Ma.

text: Elvera Zanoria, na tiyahin rin ng biktima.
english: Elvera Zanoria, who is also the victim's aunt.

text: Ngunit ayon sa anak ng biktima na si Jerson Tirados, may dahilan upang pagdudahan ang sinasabing aksidente.
english: However, according to the victim's son, Jerson Tirados, there is reason to doubt the alleged accident.

text: Kwento niya, bago ang insidente, inutusan umano ng driver ang kanyang ama na linisin ang bahagi ng harvester, partikular ang threshing drum.
english: He said that before the incident, the driver allegedly ordered his father to clean the part of the harvester, particularly the threshing drum.

text: Aniya, tatlo sila sa lugar nang mangyari ang insidente, at nakita niyang habang naglilinis ang kanyang ama, biglang pinaandar ng driver ang makina, dahilan para umikot ang threshing drum at tuluyang lamunin ang biktima.
english: He said there were three of them at the scene when the incident occurred, and he saw while his father was cleaning, the driver suddenly started the engine, causing the threshing drum to rotate and completely swallow the victim.

text: Dahil sa matinding pinsala, agad na isinugod ang biktima sa Ramon Tabiana Memorial District Hospital ngunit idineklara rin siyang dead-on-arrival ng mga doktor.
english: The victim was rushed to the Ramon Tabiana Memorial District Hospital but was declared dead on arrival by doctors.

text: Gayunpaman, duda ang pamilya ng biktima sa tunay na nangyari at pinaniniwalaang posibleng may masamang intensyon ang driver ng makina laban kay Jose.
english: However, the victim's family doubts the truth of the incident and believes that the driver of the car may have had bad intentions against Jose.

text: Dahil dito, nananawagan sila ng hustisya para sa pagkamatay ng kanilang mahal sa buhay.
english: Because of this, they are calling for justice for the death of their loved one.

text: Sa ngayon, patuloy na nangangalap ng ebidensya ang mga awtoridad upang matukoy kung mayroong pagkukulang o pananagutan ang driver sa insidente.
english: Authorities are still gathering evidence to determine whether the driver was negligent or responsible for the incident.

text: GRABE ang ginahimo sa mga tarpulen ni Congressman Arthur “Toto” Defensor Jr.
english: Congressman Arthur “Toto” Defensor Jr.

text: sang kon sin-o man, sumugod lang sadtong naggwa ang survey nga nagapanguna siya sing daku sa iya mga kontra.
english: of anyone, it's only since the survey came out that he's leading his opponents by far.

text: Gapadalagan sa karon si Toto Defensor sa pagka-gobernador sang Iloilo bilang sal-i sa iya amay nga manugtapos sang iya termino bilang gobernador.
english: Toto Defensor is currently running for governor of Iloilo to succeed his father who is ending his term as governor.

text: Si Gob, sa wala pa kahibalo, wala kaagi pierde sa ano man nga eleksyon diri sa Iloilo tungod sa iya maayo nga binuhatan nga iya luyag ipa-erederar sa iya anak nga si Toto Defensor sa iya handom nga mag-gobernador man sang Iloilo.
english: Gob, for those who do not know, has never lost any election here in Iloilo because of his good deeds that he wants to inherit from his son Toto Defensor in his desire to become governor of Iloilo.

text: Ginapanggisi kuno ang mga tarpulen ni Toto Defensor sa kon diin nahamtang ang mga ini sa madamo nga bahin sang bug-os nga lima ka distrito sang Iloilo.
english: Toto Defensor's tarpaulins are allegedly being torn where they are located in many parts of the five districts of Iloilo.

text: Ang iban ginpunggulan gid sang iya ulo nga gapakita sang kapintas sang kon sin-o man nga naghimo sini.
english: Some were beheaded, showing the cruelty of whoever did it.

text: Mahigko na ini iya nga pamulitika sang wala luyag kay Toto Defensor.
english: This is his dirty politics of those who do not like Toto Defensor.

text: May lamod pa gani ini sing terorismo kay nagahatag ini sa iban nga bumoloto sing kahadlok.
english: It even contains terrorism because it instills fear in some voters.

text:

text: GINPAHANGOP sa pumuluyo sangSangguniang Panlalawigan sang Iloilo nga may 90 ka adlaw sila halin sa pagsulod sang 2019 agud padayunon ang pagtuon nila sang executive budget ni Gov.
english: THE residents of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan of Iloilo have been reminded that they have 90 days from the beginning of 2019 to continue their study of the executive budget of Gov.

text: Arthur Defensor Sr.
english: Arthur Defensor Sr.

text: Ina tungod nagkulang kuno ang panahon sa pagtuon sini, nga dapat tani naaprubahan na bag-o pa ang katapusan sang Disyembre 2018.
english: That's because there was a lack of time to study it, which should have been approved before the end of December 2018.

text: Gintudlo ang problema sa pag-reorganisar sang SP sang sini lang sa diin ang gahum sa pagtuon sa badyet nasaylo sa mayoriya, nga unfortunately kontra pulitika sa kay Gob.
english: He pointed out the problem with the recent reorganization of the SP where the power to study the budget was transferred to the majority, which is unfortunately anti-political to Gob.

text: Sunu sa kasuguan, ang executive budget sang isa ka ehekutibo puede panubuan apang indi mapataasan sang sanggunian.
english: According to the law, the executive budget of an executive can be reduced but not increased by the sanggunian.

text: Dugang pa gid ang siling sang Korte Suprema nga dapat i-specify gid ang tanan nga items sa budget, luas sa pila ka exceptions nga ginatugot sang kasuguan.
english: The Supreme Court further held that all items in the budget must be specified, except for certain exceptions allowed by law.

text: Katulad sang 10 percent lumpsum para sa SK kag 20 percent development fund sang barangay halin sa share sa Internnal Revenue Allotment (IRA) sang siyudad.
english: Such as 10 percent lumpsum for the SK and 20 percent development fund of the barangay from the share in the Internal Revenue Allotment (IRA) of the city.

text:
Sunu  sa Article X. Section 6  “Local government units shall have a

just share, as determined by law, in the national taxes which shall be automatically released to them.”

Bati ta nga luyag pahilabtan sang mayoriya ining paggamit sang IRA kay luyag nila nga sila ang maggahum sini kag indi si Gob.
english:
According to Article X. Section 6  “Local government units shall have a

just share, as determined by law, in the national taxes which shall be automatically released to them.”

We hear that the majority wants to interfere with the use of the IRA because they want them to rule it and not Gob.

text: Ang aton pagpati, sa idalom sang Separation of Powers sa aton Constitution, ang poder sang gobernador isa ka poder ehekutibo, kag siya ang maga-determinar kon paano ini gamiton sunu sa iya programa de gobierno.
english: Our belief is that under the Separation of Powers in our Constitution, the power of the governor is an executive power, and he will determine how to use it according to his program of government.

text: Posible luyag lang seguro sang SP mahibal-an ini sa paggamit sang ila veto sa pag-override sang veto sang gobernador just in case.
english: Maybe the SP just wants to know this by using their veto to override the governor's veto just in case.

text: Ang pag-amendar sang executive budget sang SP puede i-veto man ni gobernador sa rason nga illegal (ultra vires) ini ukon oppressive ukon kontra sa welfare sang pumuluyo.
english: The amendment to the executive budget of the SP can also be vetoed by the governor on the grounds that it is illegal (ultra vires) or oppressive or against the welfare of the people.

text:
***

Apang ano ang matabo sa executive budget 2019 ni Gob samtang padayon nga ginatun-an sang SP lampas sa pagsulod sang 2019 nga dapat naaprubahan na tani sa pagsugod na sang sini nga tuig?
english:
***

But what will happen to Gob's executive budget 2019 while the SP continues to study it beyond the entry of 2019 which should have been approved at the beginning of this year?

text: Ma-reenact, ukon magapabilin, ang 2018 nga budget tubtub nga maaksyunan sang SP sa ila bahin tubtub 90 ka adlaw despues.
english: The 2018 budget will be reenacted, or remain, until the SP takes action on their part until 90 days later.

text: Gakahangawa sini si Gob especially sa kaso sang mga contract workers – mga doktor, mga narses, kag staff sa mga district hospitals, kag pati ang security personnel kag janitorial services nga ang mga contract kinahanglan ipasige sa 2019.
english: Gob is concerned about this especially in the case of contract workers – doctors, nurses, and staff in district hospitals, as well as security personnel and janitorial services whose contracts must be extended in 2019.

text: Kag tungod indi pa ma-aprubahan ang 2019 provincial budget, matanga sila sa hangin kay wala pa sing pondo ang ila serbisyo.
english: And since the 2019 provincial budget has not yet been approved, they will be left with no funds for their services.

text: Ma-furlough, ukon mag-leave of absence kag wala sueldo tubtub mapabalik sila sa trabaho kon may pondo na, ukon pasigehon sa trabaho nga indi anay maka-sueldo sang tatlo ka bulan (90 ka adlaw) kag nagapagutom anay tubtub ma-aprubahan ang badyet?
english: To be furloughed, or leave of absence without pay until they are returned to work when funds are available, or to continue working without pay for three months (90 days) and starving until the budget is approved?

text: Nagpasalig ugaling si Vice Governor Christine Garin, nga nagapanguna sa mga kasumpong pulitika ni Gob, nga indi maapektuhan ang mga “essential services”.
english: However, Vice Governor Christine Garin, who leads Gob's political opponents, assured that essential services will not be affected.

text: Kinahanglan lang kuno ni Gob mag-certify nga ang ini mga “essential services”.
english: Gob just needs to certify that these are “essential services”.

text: Apang diin kuhaon ang pondo para sa sining “essential services”?
english: But where will the funding for these “essential services” come from?

text: Laban-laban seguro sa mga “surplus” nga nabilin pa sa general fund.
english: Probably most of the surpluses left in the general fund.

text: Kag puede bala mangin kabahin sang proposed 2019 budget ining “surplus” agud magamit meantime sa mga ining “essential services”?
english: And can this surplus be part of the proposed 2019 budget to be used meantime for these essential services?

text: Ano ang procedure agud magamit ining “surplus”?
english: What is the procedure to use this surplus?

text: Basi puede na ang isa ka resolution nga naga-deklarar sang “emergency funding”.
english: Maybe a resolution declaring “emergency funding” is enough.

text: Meantime, sa sulod sang 90 ka adlaw nga pagtuon sa executive budget ni Gob, puede ma-amendar ini sang SP sunu sa ila gahum sa pagpanubo sang proposed 2019 budget nga sa ila pensar nagakaangay sa “proper and necessary use” sang badyet.
english: Meantime, within 90 days of studying the executive budget of Gob, the SP can amend it according to their power to reduce the proposed 2019 budget which they think is in line with the “proper and necessary use” of the budget.

text: Kon indi kumporme si Gob, i-veto niya ang gin-amendar nga proposed 2019 budget sa kabug-usan ukon ang pila lang ka mga items nga indi niya luyag nga sa iya pensar ilegal (ultra vires) ukon kontra sa public welfare.
english: If Gob does not agree, he will veto the amended proposed 2019 budget as a whole or only some items that he does not want that he thinks are illegal (ultra vires) or against public welfare.

text: Puede man i-override sng SP ang veto ni Gob sa mga items nga indi niya naluyagan sa boto nga two-thirds (2/3) sang SP sunu sa Local Government Code, samtang nagapabilin ang mga bahin sang 2019 executive budget nga wala niya na-veto, nga kon tawgon line-veto.
english: The SP can also override the veto of the Gob on items that he does not like with a vote of two-thirds (2/3) of the SP according to the Local Government Code, while the parts of the 2019 executive budget that he did not veto remain, which is called line-veto.

text: Naubos gid patay ang mga sakay sang isa ka passenger plane sa Russia matapos ini nagtibusok samtang nagahinampot na sa destinasyon.

text: Pahayag pa sang mga imbestigador, nagbukas na sila sang criminal case sa suspected violation sang air traffic kag air transport rules.
english: Investigators said they have opened a criminal case for suspected violation of air traffic and air transport rules.

text: Apang ginsiling ni Remulla nga indi pa makahimo sang tikang ang DILG bangud wala pa ini sang nabaton nga pormal nga kopya sang arrest order.
english: However, Remulla said the DILG cannot take action because it has not yet received a formal copy of the arrest order.

text: Nag-report si Palace Press Officer Undersecretary Claire Castro sa National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) kaangot sa ginaalegar sini nga pamahog sa iya kabuhi.

text: Gintumod ni Castro ang post sang Facebook page nga “Luminous by Trixie Cruz-Angeles and Amet Paglinawan” sadtong Enero 2.

english: The portion of the post says that if Castro is added to his allies, only his appendix and coccyx will be unharmed.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga paminsaran niya anay kun mapasaka siya sang kaso.

text: Gin-ako niya nga nakulbaan siya, bangud wala siya naanad nga makabaton sang kaangay sini nga pamahog.
english: She admitted she was nervous, as she was not used to receiving such a threat.

text: “Hindi kinakailangan na kung ikaw man ay nag-ooppose sa sinabi ng isang tao, ikaw ay magbabanta na sa buhay niya.
english: “It is not necessary that if you are opposing what someone says, you are threatening his life.

text: Hindi po nadadaan ang anumang diskurso sa pagbabanta sa buhay, ‘yung pagiging bayolente.

text: ‘Wag nilang gayahin ang mga idolo nila,” pahayag pa sini.

english: Cruz-Angeles and Paglinawan immediately replied that Castro's reporting to the NBI only shows his intention to silence people who are just exercising their freedom of speech.

text: Suno sa duha ka abogado, kadamo man sang iban nga posts kaangot kay Castro, apang wala man ini sang bisan isa nga may gin-report sang una sa NBI.

text: “By making this report and publicizing it to the full extent that the resources of PCO can, she intends an unmistakable chilling effect on others who post their opinions and criticism of public officials in the exercise of their official functions on social media,” kabahin sang statement sang duha ka abogado.

text: Si Cruz-Angeles ang kabahin anay sang Presidential Communications Operations Office sang Duterte administration, kag nangin Press Secretary man sang Marcos administration apang nag-resign matapos ang halos apat ka bulan nga serbisyo.#
english: Cruz-Angeles was formerly part of the Presidential Communications Operations Office of the Duterte administration, and also served as Press Secretary of the Marcos administration but resigned after nearly four months of service.#

text: MAISUG nga aktibista ang sadto dalaga pa ang nagtaliwan nga si Quezon City Judge Rita Bascos-Sarabia, nga sadto nangin konsehal man sang siyudad sang Iloilo.
english: THE late Quezon City Judge Rita Bascos-Sarabia, who was also a councilor of Iloilo City, was a brave activist when she was young.

text: Bata pa siya, mga 61 lang, kag ginkanugunan siya sang kapareho niya nga mga hwes, katulad ni retirado nga Judge Rudy Castrojas sang San Jose, Antique nga nakadungan ko sa haya sini sadtong Disyembre 30 sa isa ka funeral parlor sa Iloilo Coastal Road.
english: He was young, only about 61, and he was admired by his fellow judges, such as retired Judge Rudy Castrojas of San Jose, Antique whom I met at his funeral on December 30 at a funeral parlor on Iloilo Coastal Road.

text: Si Rita, ukon Ritz, kon tawgon sang mga abyan, isa sang mga militante nga mga estudyante sadtong pagsugod mismo sang Marcos martial law.
english: Rita, or Ritz, as friends call her, was one of the militant students at the very beginning of the Marcos martial law.

text: In fact, masami siya makita sa mga rally, katulad sang rally nga ila ginhiwat sa Mobil Gasoline Station sa atubangan sang amon puluy-an sa Lapuz Sur sadto.
english: In fact, he is often seen in rallies, such as the rally they held at the Mobil Gasoline Station in front of our house in Lapuz Sur.

text: Bag-o lang ako sadto nag-abot halin sa amon diutay nga uma sa Jordan, Guimaras sa diin “gintapok” ako sang akon masakiton nga iloy tungod indi siya luyag nga padayon ma-involve ako sa mga paghimakas batok sa Marcos martial law.
english: I had just arrived from our small farm in Jordan, Guimaras where my sick mother had “thrown” me away because she did not want me to continue to be involved in the struggles against Marcos martial law.

text: Isa ka matahum kag medyo brusko sing tingog nga dalaga ang nanawag sa amon gate nga ako mismo ang nakasabat.
english: A beautiful and somewhat brusque voiced young lady called at our gate which I answered myself.

text: Gapangabay sa paggamit sang telepono.
english: Asking to use the phone.

text: Ginpasugtan ko kag gintudlo ko siya sa telepono sa salas.
english: I agreed and pointed him to the phone in the living room.

text: Samtang, sige ang siniyagit sang iya mga kaupdanan sa atubangan sang Mobil Gasoline Station.
english: Meanwhile, his companions kept shouting in front of the Mobil Gasoline Station.

text: Wala lang ko makadumdum kon ano ang isyu, although, ginhaum-haum ko nga may kahilabtan ini sa padayon nga pagtaas sang bili sang langis kag sa isyu nga US-Marcos Imperialism.
english: I just don't remember what the issue was, although, I guessed it had something to do with the continuous rise in oil prices and the issue of US-Marcos Imperialism.

text: Nagpasalamat si Rita pagkatapos kag nagbalik na sa iya hanay nga naga-rally.
english: Rita thanked him afterwards and was back in her rallying ranks.

text: Ang ining Mobil Gasoline Station nagtakop na kag ginbuslan sang isa ka bodega sa karon.
english: This Mobil Gasoline Station has closed and been replaced by a warehouse for now.

text: Wala naman ako naga-istar diri sa amon puluy-an sa Lapuz Sur kay yara na ako upod sang akon pamilya sa amon kaugalingon nga puluy-an sa Mandurriao.
english: I am not living here in our home in Lapuz Sur because I am with my family in our own home in Mandurriao.

text: Nagkit-anay kami ni Rita liwat sang pagdaug sang Edsa Revolution batok sa rehimeng Marcos nga nagbutang sa pwesto sa kay Presidente Cory Aquino.
english: Rita and I met again during the victory of the Edsa Revolution against the Marcos regime that installed President Cory Aquino.

text: Nagdaug siya sang ulihi bilang konsehal sa siyudad sang Iloilo, nga ang matahum nga hinimunan masami unod sang akon mga report kag panugdaon (column writing) sa padayon nga pagsulat ko sa Panay News.
english: He later won as a councilor in Iloilo City, whose beautiful achievement often contained my reports and column writing in my continued writing in the Panay News.

text: Isa siya sang ginahangad ko nga public servant tungod sa madamo kag mapuslanon nga mga ordinansa nga iya nahimo, labi na gid ang angot sa pag-amlig sang palibut (environment), kag tungod man sa iya maisug nga mga panindugan sa mga isyu pabor sa mga lupig kag pobre.
english: He is one of my favorite public servants because of the many and useful ordinances he has made, especially those related to the protection of the environment, and also because of his bold positions on issues in favor of the oppressed and the poor.

text: In fact, ang akon paghangad sa iya nagpadayon bisan hwes na siya.
english: In fact, my admiration for him continued even after he was a judge.

text: Nangin Facebook friend ko siya.
english: He became my Facebook friend.

text: Sa isa niya ka post, nakita ko gani ang iya maisug nga pagpangapin sa Simbahan sa pila ka isyu batok sini.
english: In one of his posts, I even saw his courageous defense of the Church on some issue against it.

text: Gani, ginkasubo ko gid ang balita nga nagtaliwan siya sa isa ka masakit nga hitabo – ang mapatay sa paglupok sang may gas-leak nga LPG sa kusina sang ila puluy-an sadtong Disyembre 26.
english: Therefore, I was deeply saddened by the news that he passed away from a painful incident – ​​to die in the explosion of gas-leaked LPG in the kitchen of their home on 26 December.

text: Nagtaliwan siya nga dala ang kaisug sa iya nadangatan.
english: He passed away with the courage of his fate.

text: Nag-sufrir siya sang third-degree burn, nga nagbutang sang iya kabuhi sa daku nga peligro.
english: He suffered a third-degree burn, putting his life in grave danger.

text: Tungod seguro nahangpan niya nga indi na siya makaluas pa sa iya nadangtan, nagpamilin-bilin na siya.
english: Perhaps because he understood that he could not escape what had happened to him, he stayed.

text: Wala man nadula ang iya daku nga kabalaka sa iya panimalay – upod sa iya bana nga si Atty. Rene Sarabia kag duha ka hamtong nga mga kabataan, nga ang isa sini bag-o lang makakuha sang bar, ukon board para sa mga abogado.
english: She is also very concerned about her household – with her husband, Atty. Rene Sarabia and two adult children, one of whom recently earned the bar, or board for lawyers.

text: Ginsugid sa aton ni Atty. Sarabia sa iya haya sadtong Disyembre 30 nga sang nagaantos na siya sang mga lima ka adlaw sa ospital sa Metro Manila nagpabutyag gid siya sang iya daku nga pagkabalaka sa ila.
english: We were told by Atty. Sarabia said in a statement on December 30 that when he was suffering for about five days in a hospital in Metro Manila, he expressed his deep concern for them.

text: Ginpabutyag niya sa iya bana nga tungod sa daku na nga kagastuhanan sa iya pagpabulong, tani kuhaon na lang siya sang Diyos sing dayon.
english: She expressed to her husband that because of the high cost of her medical treatment, she wished God would take her away forever.

text: Natuman ini sunu mismo sa iya pangayo sa Ginoo bag-o ginahanda na siya sang mga doktor nga operahan.
english: This was fulfilled according to his own request to the Lord before the doctors prepared him for surgery.

text: Ritz, may you find peace with our ever loving God!
english: Ritz, may you find peace with our ever loving God!

text: Ibutang sang Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) sa crowded areas ang mobile jails nga ginpahulam sang Bureau of Jail Management and Penology (BJMP) 6 para sa Dinagyang Festival 2026.
english: The Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) will install mobile jails loaned by the Bureau of Jail Management and Penology (BJMP) 6 for the Dinagyang Festival 2026 in crowded areas.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay PCol.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, PCol.

text: Wilbert Parilla, officer in charge sang ICPO, iya ginpahayag nga sa magutok ukon madamo nga mga tawo posible magluntad ang mga gamo.
english: Wilbert Parilla, officer in charge of the ICPO, said that in crowded or large crowds, riots are likely to occur.

text: Gintumod sini ang City Proper kun sa diin madamo sang mga aktibidad ang ginahiwat kag amo man sa distrito sang Mandurriao ilabi na sa area sang mga balay ilimnan.
english: He pointed to the City Proper where many activities are held and also in the Mandurriao district especially in the area of ​​bars.

text: Pahayag pa niya, may yara sang personnel ang BJMP nga magabantay ukon maga-drive sang mga mobile jails apang ang mga kapulisan gid sang ICPO ang magabantay sa publiko kag magadakop sa mga nagasinabad.
english: He said the BJMP has personnel who will guard or drive the mobile jails but the ICPO police will guard the public and arrest those who disturb.

text: Ginapahanumdom man sa publiko nga likawan nga maghimo sang ano man nga gamo agud indi mapreso sa mobile jails kag indi makatuga sang huol ukon halit sa iban.
english: The public is also reminded to avoid causing any trouble so as not to be imprisoned in the mobile jails and not to cause inconvenience or harm to others.

text: Madumduman nga ginpahulam sang BJMP 6 sa ICPO ang apat ka mga mobile jails agud mangin temporaryo nga presuhan sang sin-o man nga magtuga sang gamo sa tunga sang mga aktibidad.
english: It can be recalled that BJMP 6 lent the four mobile jails to the ICPO to serve as temporary jails for anyone who causes trouble during the activities.
