english: —with reports from Bombo Krylle Melliza

text: Managtag sang libre nga pares, unlimited rice kag soft drinks sa Kamara si Deo Balbuena ukon mas kilala nga Diwata kun magdaog ini sa 2025 midterm elections.
english: Deo Balbuena or better known as Diwata will distribute free pairs, unlimited rice and soft drinks in the House of Representatives if he wins the 2025 midterm elections.

text: “Ay bakit hindi kung gusto nila.
english: “Why not if they want to.

text:
Mag-a-unli rice tayo doon, with free softdrinks pa.”

Si Diwata ang 4th nominee sang Vendors Party-list.
english:
We'll have unli rice there, with free softdrinks.”

Diwata is the 4th nominee of the Vendors Party-list.

text: Kilala ini bangud sa pagpanag-iya sang Diwata Pares Overload.
english: It is known for owning Diwata Pares Overload.

text: Luyag isulong sang grupo ang kinamatarong sang mga manugbaligya sa pungsod.
english: The group wants to advance the rights of vendors in the country.

text: ILOILO– Atensyon sa mga mahilig sa turmeric bangud ini ang may benepisyo nga mahatag sa lawas sang isa ka persona.
english: ILOILO – Attention to those who love turmeric because it has benefits to give to the body of a person.

text: Suno kay Anupama Kizhakkeveettil,  board member sang  National Ayurvedic Medical Association, iya ginpahayag nga ang turmeric ang makabulig agud indi magtaas ang cholesterol sang isa ka tawo.
english: According to Anupama Kizhakkeveettil, board member of the National Ayurvedic Medical Association, she said that turmeric can help prevent a person's cholesterol from rising.

text: Makabulig man ini sa hay fever, depresyon, gingivitis, pre menstrual syndrome kag hangover.
english: It can also help with hay fever, depression, gingivitis, pre menstrual syndrome and hangovers.

text: Ang iban sa mga benepisyo sini ang  ginalakipan sang  anti-viral kag anti fungal, nagamit agud magbulong sang rheuma, ortheoarthritis, kag exzema.
english: Some of its benefits include anti-viral and anti fungal, used to treat rheuma, orthoarthritis, and eczema.

text: Makapila gid kita ka beses nga ginahambalan nga kontrolon ang aton kaugalingon kun kita ang maakig bangud posible nga indi man naton maluyagan ang resulta sang aton sarang nga mahimo kun magtahaw na ang aton nga nabatyagan.
english: We are told many times to control ourselves when we get angry because we may not like the results of what we can do when we get angry.

text: Importante ini nga leksyon nga aton tun-an samtang bata pa kita.
english: This is an important lesson to learn while we are young.

text: Isa ka halimbawa diri amo ang isa ka 28-anyos nga lalaki sa China nga nag-tinir sa isa 4-star hotel sa amo nga pungsod.
english: An example of this is a 28-year-old man in China who stayed in a 4-star hotel in that country.

text: Suno sa mga pulis, naka-bais sang amo nga lalaki nga si Chen ang isa ka hotel staff bangud samtang yara siya sa amo nga hotel, nadula ang iya laptop.
english: According to police, Chen had an argument with a hotel staff because while he was at the hotel, he lost his laptop.

text: Wala gid naghaum ang staff sang sunod nga ginhimo ni Chen.
english: The staff couldn't believe what Chen did next.

text: Ginpasulod sini sa lobby sang hotel ang iya puti nga car kag ginpangbungguan ang kutob sang iya nga malabayan — dala dira ang glass doors, lamesa, kag tanan nga yara sa lobby bangud hungod sini nga ginpakadto-pabalik ang salakyan.
english: He drove his white car into the hotel lobby and hit as many as he could — including glass doors, tables, and everything in the lobby because he deliberately drove the car back and forth.

text: Naglibog naman ang ulo sang iban nga guests kun ano ang natabo kun ngaa nag-wild ang lalaki.
english: The other guests were confused about what happened and why the man went wild.

text: Ginbungguan pa sini ang iban pa gid nga glass doors sang buot na gid man nga maguwa sa hotel, apang nakabunggo sa door frame rason nga nag-flash na ang hazard lights kag nagpundo.
english: He hit other glass doors when he tried to leave the hotel, but hit the door frame causing the hazard lights to flash and stop.

text: Nakit-an man ang iban nga lalaki nga akig kag ginpanglampusan ang salakyan ni Chen.
english: Other men were also seen angrily hitting Chen's car.

text: Suno sa pulis, wala man sang napilasan sa amo nga insidente, apang syempre, bilang premyo, gin-detain si Chen samtang pending ang imbestigasyon.
english: According to the police, no one was injured in that incident, but of course, as a reward, Chen was detained pending the investigation.

text: Sang ulihi, natukiban nga ginkawat gali ang iya nga laptop kag nakit-an nga yara na sa guwa sang hotel.
english: Later, it was discovered that his laptop had been stolen and was found outside the hotel.

text: Antes sini nga insidente, suno sa isa ka booking website, nakaangkon ang amo nga 4-star hotel sang “very good” reviews halin sa mga guests nga nagtinir didto.
english: Before this incident, according to a booking website, the 4-star hotel had received “very good” reviews from guests who stayed there.

text: Lauman na naman ang panibag-o nga hugnat sang oil price hike sa bwas, Enero 14.
english: A new round of oil price hike is expected tomorrow, January 14.

text:
Suno sa oil industry sources, yari ang pagsaka sa presyo sang gatong:

Gasoline – magasaka sang P0.80 per liter
Diesel – magasaka sang P0.90 per liter
Kerosene – magasaka sang P0.80 per liter
english:
According to oil industry sources, here is the rise in fuel prices:

Gasoline – to rise by P0.80 per liter
Diesel – to rise by P0.90 per liter
Kerosene – to rise by P0.80 per liter

text: Nagdangat sa 17 ka mga indibidwal ang napatay matapos magbunggoanay ang isa ka truck kag minibus sa Seke Road malapit sa Chitungwiza, Zimbabwe.
english: At least 17 people were killed after a truck and a minibus collided on Seke Road near Chitungwiza, Zimbabwe.

text: Sa nasambit nga numero, 15 diri ang gindeklarar nga dead on the spot kag duha ang ginbawian sang kabuhi samtang ginabulong sa ospital.
english: Of these, 15 were declared dead on the spot and two died while being treated at the hospital.

text: Sandig sa imbestigasyon sang mga otoridad, nadulaan sang kontrol ang driver sang truck rason nga naglapaw ini sa pihak nga linya kag bumunggo sa nakasugata nga mini bus.
english: According to the investigation of the authorities, the driver of the truck lost control and crossed the other lane and collided with the oncoming mini bus.

text: Bagud sini, ginhingyo ni Chitungwiza Mayor Rosaria Mangoma ang gobyerno nga ideklarar ang natabo bilang national disaster kag gintumod nga isa ini sa pinakamalala nga aksidente sa dalanon nga na-record sa ila nga lugar.
english: Chitungwiza Mayor Rosaria Mangoma urged the government to declare the incident as a national disaster and pointed out that it is one of the worst road accidents recorded in their area.

text: Dalayawon ang imbukada nga performance sang four-time National Basketball Association (NBA) champion nga si Klay Thompson sa regular season kaupod ang bag-o sini nga team nga Dallas Mavericks.
english: Four-time National Basketball Association (NBA) champion Klay Thompson's opening performance in the regular season with his new team, the Dallas Mavericks, was commendable.

text: Naka-22 points si Thompson sa iya Dallas debut kag nangin daku nga bulig kay Mavericks superstar Luka Doncic sa 120-109 NBA victory batok sa San Antonio Spurs.
english: Thompson scored 22 points in his Dallas debut and was a big help to Mavericks superstar Luka Doncic in a 120-109 NBA victory over the San Antonio Spurs.

text: May 28 puntos naman ang Slovenian star kag may 10 rebounds para sa Mavs.
english: The Slovenian star had 28 points and 10 rebounds for the Mavs.

text: Ang Mavericks nga pangaduha sa Boston Celtics sang nagligad nga season ang nagkuha kay Thompson sa free agent deal sa off-season sa tuyo nga makabawi kag makuha ang kampyonato subong nga season.
english: The Mavericks, who were second to the Boston Celtics last season, acquired Thompson on a free agent deal in the off-season with the goal of rebounding and capturing the championship this season.

text: Si Thompson — nga may apat ka titulo sa iya 13 ka seasons kaupod kay Stephen Curry kag Golden State Warriors — ang nalipay man sa iya performance.
english: Thompson — who has four titles in his 13 seasons with Stephen Curry and the Golden State Warriors — was also pleased with his performance.

text: Ang iya anum ka tres amo ang pinakadamo nga three-pointers nga nahimo sang bisan sin-o nga player sa iya Mavericks debut.
english: His six threes were the most three-pointers by any player in his Mavericks debut.

text: “Blue is my favorite color,” pahayag sini pagkatapos sang hampang.
english: “Blue is my favorite color,” he said after the game.

text:
“And Mavs blue looks good on me.”

Nakabulig man sa Dallas ang 15 puntos ni Kyrie Irving.
english:
“And Mavs blue looks good on me.”

Kyrie Irving’s 15 points also helped Dallas.

text: Nagpanguna naman sa Spurs si Victor Wembanyama nga may 17 points samtang binudlayan naman sa shots ang 11-time All-Star point guard nga si Chris Paul.
english: Victor Wembanyama led the Spurs with 17 points while 11-time All-Star point guard Chris Paul struggled with shots.

text: Three points, seven rebounds, eight assists kag one steal ang nahimo sini sa iya debut sa Spurs.
english: He had three points, seven rebounds, eight assists and one steal in his Spurs debut.

text: OSLO, NORWAY- Naglab-ot na sa 25 ang kumpirmado nga kaso sang coronavirus disease 2019 ukon covid-19 sa pungsod Norway.
english: OSLO, NORWAY- There are 25 confirmed cases of coronavirus disease 2019 or covid-19 in Norway.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Jean Larrosa Arsenal sang Lambunao, Iloilo kag 12 ka tuig na nga nagatrabaho sa Oslo, Norway, iya ginpahayag nga ang pinakaulihi nga nag positibo sa covid-19 ang duha ka trabahador sa ospital nga nagbakasyon sa Italy.
english: Jean Larrosa Arsenal of Lambunao, Iloilo, who has been working in Oslo, Norway for 12 years, said the latest confirmed cases were two hospital workers who were on vacation in Italy.

text: Suno kay Arsenal, sang nagbalik ang duha kag nag-duty sa ospital, didto na kag nagdamo ang ila  nalatnan.
english: According to Arsenal, when the two returned and went on duty at the hospital, they were infected.

text: Sa subong suno kay Arsenal, may yara pa sang 28 nga ginpaidalom sa test.
english: So far, according to Arsenal, there are still 28 who have been tested.

text: Magluwas diri, may 300 naman ka mga pumuluyo ang ginpaidalom nalang sa home quarantine bangud kulang sa pasilidad ang mga ospital sa lugar.
english: In addition, 300 residents were placed under home quarantine due to lack of facilities in the area.

text: Wala naman sang kanselasyon sang mga klase kag opisina.
english: There were no cancellations of classes and offices.

text: Na-obserbahan naman ni Arsenal nga kaangay nga wala nakulbaan ang mga tawo sa covid-19 bangud sa ila pagpati nga flu lamang ini kag indi man delikado kun mabaskog ang immune system.
english: Arsenal observed that people do not seem to be afraid of covid-19 because they believe that it is just the flu and not dangerous if the immune system is strong.

text: “GOOD intentions are not enough…”, ang masiling ta gani sa iningles sa nahimo sang mga Garin sa isa ka ultimo nga pulis sang sini lang.
english: “GOOD intentions are not enough…”, we can even say in English about what the Garin family did to a last policeman recently.

text: Ang maayo nga tinutuyo dapat updan man sing paghangop kag pagkilala sa kinamatarong sang iban, labi na gid ang may kubos nga kahimtangan, agud makapabilin kita nga makatawo.
english: Good intentions must also be accompanied by understanding and recognition of the rights of others, especially the less fortunate, in order for us to remain humane.

text: Indi man kita malipat nga “The road to hell is paved with good intentions,” agud mangin maamligon kita sa aton himuon sa aton isigkatawo.
english: Let us not forget that “The road to hell is paved with good intentions,” so that we can be careful in what we do to our neighbors.

text: Ina tungod sa aton pagpati nga husto kita, basi sa matuod gali sala kita kag malupigon pa.
english: That's because we believe we're right, but we're actually wrong and oppressed.

text:
***

Wala naluyagi ni Presidente Rodrigo Duterte ang natabo sa isa ka pulis sang Guimbal sa iya alegasyon, nga gin-ugyunan man sang resulta sang pag-imbestigar sang PRO-6, nga ginkastigo siya sang mga Garin sing wala karason-rason.
english:
***

President Rodrigo Duterte did not like what happened to a Guimbal policeman in his allegation, which was also confirmed by the results of the PRO-6 investigation, that he was beaten by the Garins without reason.

text: Gani gin-orderan ni Presidente si DILG Secretary Eduardo Año sa pagpasaka sang kaso sa kay Iloilo First District Congressman Richard Garin kag sa iya amay Guimbal Mayor Oscar Garin bisan pa nga kaalyado niya ini sa pulitika.
english: The President therefore ordered DILG Secretary Eduardo Año to file a case against Iloilo First District Congressman Richard Garin and his father Guimbal Mayor Oscar Garin even though he is his political ally.

text: Natabo ining pangkastigo sang pulis sang kaagahon sang Miyerkoles, Disyembre 26, samtang gahingapos ang kahiwatan sang Disyembre sa Guimbal sa plaza sang mga a las 3 sang sinang kaagahon.
english: The police beating occurred on Wednesday morning, December 26, as the December event in Guimbal ended at the plaza at around 3 am that morning.

text: Angot ini sa pagkinagamo sang plaza sadtong Disyembre 22, sa diin ang isa ka SK kagawad nalamposan sang botelya sang anak sang isa ka SB sang Guimbal.
english: This is in connection with the plaza riots on December 22, where an SK kagawad was hit with a bottle by the son of an SB of Guimbal.

text: Akig gid ang duha ka Garin nga luyag gid pasakaan sing kaso ang ining anak sang SB agud “matagaan sing husto nga disiplina”.
english: The two Garins are very angry that they want to file a case against this son of the SB in order to “give him proper discipline”.

text: Ugaling naareglo ang ining hitabo sang nagpirma na gid lang sang affidavit of non-interest ang SK kagawad kay, sunu sa iya, indi niya luyag mag-problema pa ang iya iloy nga OFW.
english: However, the incident was resolved when the SK kagawad signed an affidavit of non-interest because, according to him, he did not want his mother who is an OFW to have any more problems.

text: Sang maghilibalo dugang, nagagwa sa sugilanon nga si PO3 Federico Macaya Jr., 41, gid kuno ang nag-kumbinse sa biktima nga indi na lang ipasaka ang inquest agud ma-paylan sang kaso ang anak sang SB.
english: When we learned more, it turned out that PO3 Federico Macaya Jr., 41, convinced the victim not to file an inquest so that the SB's son could be charged.

text: Naakig ang mga Garin sini.
english: The Garins were angry about this.

text: Kag ginpatawag gid ni Congressman Garin ang hepe sang pulis sa Guimbal nga si PSInsp.
english: And Congressman Garin summoned the Guimbal police chief, PSInsp.

text: Antonio Monreal agud dalhon sa iya atubangan si PO3 Macaya.
english: Antonio Monreal to bring before him PO3 Macaya.

text: Gin-orderan ni congressman si Monreal agud i-disarm (kuhaan pusil) kag ginkuha ang sakbit sini nga posas kag ginposasan si Macaya.
english: The congressman ordered Monreal to disarm and removed his handcuffs and handcuffed Macaya.

text: Ginpasikto ni congressman si Macaya kon siya gid ang nagkumbinse sa biktima nga iatras na lang ang kaso.
english: The congressman asked Macaya if he was the one who convinced the victim to withdraw the case.

text: Ginpanginwala ini ni Macaya.
english: Macaya denied this.

text: Boluntaryo kuno yadtong pagpirma sang biktima sang affidavit of desistance (non-interest).
english: The victim signed the affidavit of desistance (non-interest) voluntarily.

text: Indi magpati si congressman.
english: The congressman doesn't believe it.

text: Pagkatapos sadto, ginsipa kuno ni congressman si Macaya sing pila ka beses, ginsiko, gintampa pila man ka beses, kag ginduplahan pa sing duha ka beses sa nawong samtang ginatayaan ni Mayor Garin sing armas si Macaya nga nagpakitluoy.
english: After that, the congressman allegedly kicked Macaya several times, elbowed him, slapped him several times, and spit twice in the face while Mayor Garin threw a gun at Macaya who pleaded.

text: Ang siste kay wala man lang sing ginhimo ang hepe sang pulis, nga daw tando-tando nga nagtulok lang kag wala bisan man lang  nagpatunga agud indi matam-an si Macaya.
english: The joke is that the police chief did nothing, as if he just looked and did not even intervene to prevent Macaya from being hurt.

text: Nangayo sing pasaylo si congressman sa natabo, apang sa PNP organization gid lang kag wala kay Macaya.
english: The congressman apologized for the incident, but only to the PNP organization and not to Macaya.

text: Nagpakita sing paghangop si PNP Regional Director Bulalacao kay ang sugid sa iya ginsumbag lang ang iya pulis, apang naakig na siya sang mahibal-an sang ulihi ang matuod-tuod gid nga natabo sa iya pulis.
english: PNP Regional Director Bulalacao showed understanding because he was told that his policeman was just beaten, but he was angry when he later learned the truth about what happened to his policeman.

text: “Wala ako sing kaakig sa pagkatawo ni congressman, apang akig ako sa iya ginbuhat,” sining ni Bulalacao sang mahibal-an nga gintampa pa ini kag, labaw kag labi sa tanan, sang ginduplahan pa sing duha ka beses sa nawong si Macaya.
english: “I am not angry with the congressman's personality, but I am angry with what he did,” Bulalacao said when he learned that he was slapped and, above all, when Macaya was slapped twice in the face.

text: Apat ka kaso ang gina-isip sang Campo Delgado: grave threat, physical injury, direct assault on person in authority, kag alarm and scandal.
english: Campo Delgado is counting four cases: grave threat, physical injury, direct assault on person in authority, and alarm and scandal.

text: Nag-order man si Bulalacao nga kuhaan ang mga Garin sang police escort.
english: Bulalacao also ordered that the Garin family be provided with a police escort.

text: Gin-orderan man niya sila nga i-surrender ang ila wala lisensya nga mga armas.
english: He also ordered them to surrender their unlicensed weapons.

text: Ang tanan nga mga pulis sang Guimbal ginpang-relieve man kag ginbuslan anay sing special unit.
english: All Guimbal policemen were also relieved and replaced by a special unit.

text: Gin-islan man si Monreal bilang hepe sang pulis sang Guimbal, nga basi mapasakaan pa sing administratibo nga kaso.
english: Monreal was also replaced as Guimbal police chief, who may face administrative charges.

text:
***

Ining natabo sa kay Macaya may leksyon man sa mga pulis.
english:
***

Macaya's incident also has a lesson for the police.

text: Tungod indi man ta gali maluyag matabo ini sa mga pulis, tani panumdumon man sang mga pulis nga tagaan man nila sing husto nga hustisya ang mga suspetsado nga madakpan nila./PN
english: Because we don't want this to happen to the police, I hope the police will remember to give justice to the suspects they catch./PN

text: Masami kita gina-remind nga indi gid maglagaw-lagaw ukon mag-drive sang salakyan samtang kita ang hubog.
english: We are often reminded to never go for a walk or drive a car while we are drunk.

text: Ini agud malikawan naton nga maaksidente, makapangdalahig sang iban nga tawo, ukon mapahuy-an ang aton nga kaugalingon samtang yara sa dalan.
english: This is to avoid having an accident, involving other people, or embarrassing ourselves while on the road.

text: Kaangay halimbawa sa sining isa ka Indian executive sa isa ka daku nga American multinational financial services company nga ginpahayag nagpangihi sa isa ka pasahero sa eroplano bangud sa iya tuman nga kahulugbon.
english: Like for example this one Indian executive in a large American multinational financial services company who allegedly urinated on a passenger on a plane because he was so drunk.

text: Ginpahayag nga Nobyembre 26, 2022 pa sang natabo ang insidente sang halin ang Indian executive sa New York kag pauli na sa New Delhi.
english: The incident reportedly occurred on November 26, 2022 when the Indian executive was on his way home from New York in New York.

text: Ginkilala ang lalaki kay Shankar Mishra, ang former vice president sang Indian operations sang daku nga bangko sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: The man was identified as Shankar Mishra, the former vice president of Indian operations of the big bank in the United States of America.

text: Gin-alegar nga ginbuksan sini ang zipper sang iya nga pants kag nag-ililihi kag sa kadimalason sang isa ka 72 anyos nga pasahero, siya gid ang natup-an.
english: He allegedly opened the zipper of his pants and peed and unfortunately for a 72-year-old passenger, he was hit.

text: Nag-reklamo ang tigulang nga babayi, apang wala man maayo nga na-handle sang airline ang reklamo amo man ang polisa sini sa pag-serbe sang alcoholic drinks.
english: The elderly woman complained, but the airline did not handle the complaint well as well as its policy on serving alcoholic drinks.

text: Sa bahin naman sang lalaki, gilayon man ini nga ginpahalin sa trabaho sang nahibaluan sang management ang amo nga insidente.
english: The man was immediately fired when the management learned of the incident.

text: Nag-lie low pa si Mishra kag nagpalagyo kag gin-switch off pa sini ang iya nga cellphone halin sang amo nga bulan.
english: Mishra lied low and ran away and switched off his cellphone since that month.

text: Ginpahayag nga nagpabilin ang kontak sini sa iban niya nga abyan, kag sang damlag lang, may credit transaction ini sa Bangalore sa India rason nga na-trace ang iya nga lokasyon kag gilayon nga nadakpan sang mga pulis.
english: He reportedly remained in contact with other friends, and recently, he had a credit transaction in Bangalore, India, which led to his location being traced and immediately arrested by the police.

text: Indi anay makapatigayon sang referrals ang Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) kaangot sa imbestigasyon sini sa flood control corruption bangud nga kulang sila sa mga komisyoner.
english: The Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) is currently unable to conduct referrals in connection with its investigation into flood control corruption due to a shortage of commissioners.

text: Suno kay ICI special adviser Rodolfo Azurin Jr., himuon lang anay nila ang ila nga trabaho subong, agud nga kun may mag-abot nga bag-o nga komisyoner, handa na sila para maka-refer sang bag-o nga mga impormasyon sa Ombudsman.
english: According to ICI special adviser Rodolfo Azurin Jr., they will do their job now, so that if there is a new commissioner, they are ready to refer new information to the Ombudsman.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang nabilin na lamang nga commissioner amo si ICI chairperson Andres Reyes Jr.
english: The only remaining commissioner is ICI chairperson Andres Reyes Jr.

text: kasunod sang resignation nanday Rogelio Babes Singson kag Rossana Fajardo.
english: following the resignation of Rogelio Babes Singson and Rossana Fajardo.

text: Disyembre 2025 sang nagpanaog si Singson bangud sa iya ikaayong lawas kag seguridad, samtang nagdepensa naman si Fajardo nga natapos na niya ang trabaho santo sa iya mandato.
english: Singson stepped down in December 2025 for health and security reasons, while Fajardo defended that he had finished his work according to his mandate.

text: Una naman nga nagpahayag ang Malacañang nga luyag ni President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.
english: Earlier, Malacañang said President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.

text: nga padayunon sang ICI ang ila nga imbestigasyon kag trabaho apisar sang sunod-sunod nga resignations.
english: that the ICI will continue its investigation and work despite the successive resignations.

text: Nag-file sang certificate of candidacy (COC) bilang Mayor sang Albuera, Leyte ang self-confessed drug lord nga si Rolan “Kerwin” Espinosa.
english: Self-confessed drug lord Rolan “Kerwin” Espinosa filed his certificate of candidacy (COC) as Mayor of Albuera, Leyte.

text: Gin-updan si Espinosa sang iya mga kaangay nga kandidato sa idalom sang Bando Espinosa-Pundok Kausaban (BE-PK) party.
english: Espinosa was accompanied by his fellow candidates under the Bando Espinosa-Pundok Kausaban (BE-PK) party.

text: Matandaan nga si Espinosa ang nangin kontrobersyal matapos gin-angot ni former president Rodrigo Duterte sa illegal drug trade sa Eastern Visayas, sa diin nag-testify man ini sa Senate hearing sa narcotics operations sa pungsod.
english: It can be recalled that Espinosa became controversial after former president Rodrigo Duterte linked him to the illegal drug trade in Eastern Visayas, where he also testified in the Senate hearing on narcotics operations in the country.

text: Sang Hunyo, ginbasura sang Leyte Regional Trial Court (RTC) ang kaso batok kay Espinosa bangud sa kakulang sa ebidensya.
english: In June, the Leyte Regional Trial Court (RTC) dismissed the case against Espinosa for lack of evidence.

text: Gintumod man si Espinosa sadto bilang top drug personality sa Eastern Visayas.
english: Espinosa was also referred to as the top drug personality in Eastern Visayas.

text: Gin-angot man ini sadto sa paghatag sang drug money kay former Senator Leila de Lima pinaagi sa iya anay aide nga si Ronnie Dayan.
english: It was also linked to the giving of drug money to former Senator Leila de Lima through her former aide Ronnie Dayan.

text: Apang sang 2022, ginbawi ni Espinosa ang iya mga akusasyon batok kay de Lima sa diin ginrason sini nga ginpwersa siya kag ginpahog agud itudlo si de Lima.
english: However, in 2022, Espinosa withdrew his accusations against de Lima arguing that he was coerced and threatened to point out de Lima.

text: Na-clear naman si de Lima sa tanan sini nga kaso nga ginpato-pato sang Duterte administration.
english: De Lima was cleared of all these cases that were fabricated by the Duterte administration.

text: Linantuyan, Guihulngan City, Negros Oriental.
english: Linantuyan, Guihulngan City, Negros Oriental.

text: Nasapwan sa katubuhan nga hublas kag may mga pilas tuga sang pagkabuno ang lawas sang biktima nga si alyas Princess.
english: The body of the victim, alias Princess, was found naked and with gunshot wounds.

text: May nakit-an man nga pilas sa kinatawo sang biktima.
english: A gunshot wound was also found on the victim's genitals.

text: Arestado naman sa follow-up operations ang suspek nga 33-anyos nga mangunguma matapos nga gintudlo ini ang isa ka testigo nga nagsiling nga nakita niya ang suspek nga kaupod ang biktima antes ang krimen.
english: The suspect, a 33-year-old farmer, was arrested in follow-up operations after a witness pointed out that he saw the suspect with the victim before the crime.

text: Narekober sa suspek ang kutsilyo nga ginapatihan gin-gamit sa pagpatay sa biktima.
english: A knife believed to have been used to kill the victim was recovered from the suspect.

text: Naglab-ot sa highest level ang Foreign direct investments (FDI) sang Pilipinas sa sulod sang walo ka bulan sang Oktubre 2024.
english: The Philippines' Foreign Direct Investments (FDI) reached its highest level in eight months in October 2024.

text: Ini bangud sa strong surge sa intercompany borrowings sa tunga sang multinational firms kag their local affiliates, nga naghatag man sang eclipse sa inflows sang fresh capital.
english: This was due to the strong surge in intercompany borrowings between multinational firms and their local affiliates, which also gave rise to an eclipse in inflows of fresh capital.

text: Ang Job-generating FDIs nakarehistro sang net inflow nga $1 billion sang October, 50.2- percent nga mas mataas kon ipanggid sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: Job-generating FDIs registered a net inflow of $1 billion in October, 50.2- percent higher compared to the previous year.

text: Suno sa Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP), ang net inflow nagakahulugan nga mas madamo sang foreign capital ang nagsulod sa pungsod batok sa mga nagguwa sa sulod sang isa ka period.
english: According to the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP), net inflow means that more foreign capital entered the country versus exited during a period.

text: Nagdala ini sang 10-ka bulan nga FDI net inflow sa $7.7 bilyon, nga nagtaas sang 8.2 porsyento kag nagapalapit sa $9-bilyon nga forecast sang BSP para sa bug-os nga 2024.
english: This brought 10-month FDI net inflow to $7.7 billion, up 8.2 percent and approaching the BSP’s $9-billion forecast for the whole of 2024.

text: Iga-donar sa mga biktima ni Bagyo Kristine ang kita sang Philippine Basketball Association (PBA) sa Game 1 sang 2024 Governors’ Cup Finals.
english: The Philippine Basketball Association (PBA) will donate proceeds from Game 1 of the 2024 Governors’ Cup Finals to the victims of Typhoon Kristine.

text: Ini ang gin-anunsyo nanday league chairman Ricky Vargas kag vice chairman Alfrancis Chua sa press conference sang championship series sa Enderun Colleges sa Taguig City, Oktubre 24.
english: This was announced by league chairman Ricky Vargas and vice chairman Alfrancis Chua during the press conference of the championship series at Enderun Colleges in Taguig City, October 24.

text: “Nag-usap kami ni commissioner [Willie Marcial], chairman [Ricky Vargas], we decided ‘yung Sunday’s game, ‘yung proceeds no’n lahat ido-donate namin.
english: “We talked with commissioner [Willie Marcial], chairman [Ricky Vargas], we decided ‘Sunday’s game, ‘the proceeds we’ll donate everything.

text: Lahat ‘yon,” suno kay Chua.
english: All of that,” Chua said.

text: “Nandito tayo, preparing for Sunday’s game.
english: “Here we are, preparing for Sunday’s game.

text: And them, they’re there preparing kung may matitirhan sila or makakain pa.
english: And them, they're there preparing if they have a place to stay or something to eat.

text: Ipagdasal natin sila.
english: Let us pray for them.

text: Kung sino pang gustong tumulong, nananawagan po ako na tulungan natin ang ating mga kapatid,” dugang sini.
english: If anyone else wants to help, I call on us to help our brothers and sisters,” he added.

text: Natalana sa Domingo sang gab-i, Oktubre 27, ang Game 1 sa Ynares Center sa Antipolo.
english: Scheduled for Sunday night, October 27, is Game 1 at the Ynares Center in Antipolo.

text: Tuyo sang defending champion nga TNT nga madepensahan ang ila trono nga target naman agawon sang Gin Kings.
english: Defending champion TNT aims to defend their throne which is targeted by the Gin Kings.

text: Rematch ini sa tunga sang duha ka teams nga pangunahan man gihapon sang reigning Best Import Rondae Hollis-Jefferson sang Tropang Giga kag Justin Brownlee sang Ginebra.
english: This is a rematch between the two teams that will still be led by reigning Best Import Rondae Hollis-Jefferson of Tropang Giga and Justin Brownlee of Ginebra.

text: Nahibaluan nga antes ang kampyonato sang Tropang Giga sang nagligad nga conference, sanday Brownlee ang nagauyat sang korona sang 2016, 2017, 2019, kag 2021.
english: Prior to the Tropang Giga championship last conference, Brownlee held the crown in 2016, 2017, 2019, and 2021.

text: MAY NAKA-schedule na kita nga kolum para sa Miyerkoles (Disyembre 19), gani wala naton napasulod sa amo sina nga petsa ang pagpanginbulahan naton sa aton Miss Philippines Catriona Gray sa iya pagdaug bilang Miss Universe 2018 sadtong Lunes, Disyembre 17.
english: We have already scheduled a column for Wednesday (December 19), so we did not include our congratulations to our Miss Philippines Catriona Gray on her victory as Miss Universe 2018 on Monday, December 17.

text: Wala man makagwa ang kolum ta sang Biyernes (Disyembre 21) kay na “lost in transit” sa email.
english: Our column on Friday (December 21) did not come out because it was “lost in transit” in the email.

text: Subong, Sabado, Disyembre 22 na ini naka-schedule.
english: Today, Saturday, December 22nd it is scheduled.

text: Ulihi man mainit gihapon ugaling ang aton pagpangibulahan sa kay Miss Gray sa ining aton kolum subong nga Sabado.
english: It's still hot but our congratulations to Miss Gray in our column this Saturday.

text:
***

Gabuylog kita sa bug-os nga pungsod sa paghatag sang aton mainit nga pagpangibulahan sa kay Miss Gray sa pagdaug niya bilang Miss Universe 2018 nga ginhiwat sa Bangkok, Thailand sadtong Lunes.
english:
***

We join the entire country in extending our warmest congratulations to Miss Gray on her victory as Miss Universe 2018 held in Bangkok, Thailand on Monday.

text: Sa iya pagdaug, daku siya matuod nga bugal sang pungsod.
english: With his victory, he is truly the pride of the country.

text: Nalipay man kita nga siya mismo nagpabugal gid nga siya Filipino bisan pa katunga sang iya pagkatawo isa ka Australyano sa bahin sang iya amay.
english: We are also happy that he himself was very proud to be Filipino even though half of his birth is Australian on his father's side.

text: Sang pamangkuton siya kon ano ang tig-ulo sang kanta ang luyag niya pamatian sa isa ka preliminary nga hugnat, siling niya “Raise your flag!” nga nagatumod sa iya pagka-Filipino.
english: When asked what the title of the song would like to hear in a preliminary round, he said “Raise your flag!” referring to his Filipino identity.

text: Ika-apat na si Miss Gray nga Miss Universe naton halin sa kay Gloria Diaz, Margie Moran kag Pia Wurtsbach.
english: Miss Gray is our fourth Miss Universe after Gloria Diaz, Margie Moran and Pia Wurtsbach.

text: Naga-panginbulahan man kita kay Miss Gray partikular sa aton pagkahibalo nga isa siya ka Bicolana nga pareho sa nagtaliwan kag palangga ko nga iloy.
english: We also congratulate Miss Gray particularly in our knowledge that she is a Bicolana like my late and beloved mother.

text: Makabulusog sa balatyagon ang iya sabat sang makasulod na siya sa Top 3, nga amo gid seguro ang nagpadaug sa iya.
english: His response was emotional when he made it to the Top 3, which probably won him over.

text: Sa sining iya sabat ginpabatyag niya sa bug-os nga pungsod kag sang kalibutan ang iya kabalaka sa mga kabataan – indi tungod sang kaimolon kundi tungod sang kakulang sang suporta sa unay nga dalamguhanon sang kabataan agud mangin madinalag-on man sa ulihi.
english: In his response, he expressed his concern for the children – not because of poverty but because of the lack of support for the children's dreams of becoming successful in the future.

text: “Working in some of the poorest areas of my country, I found that it was a lack of child support, not poverty, that killed their dreams,” siling gani niya sa Question & Answer sa Final 3.
english: “Working in some of the poorest areas of my country, I found that it was a lack of child support, not poverty, that killed their dreams,” he even said in the Question & Answer in Final 3.

text: Matuod, indi handom sang tanan nga mag-manggaran.
english: Of course, not everyone wants to be rich.

text: Kundi ang malab-ot lang sang ila nalipayan nga huyog kag handom – mag-doktor man, abogado, CPA man, ukon bisan lang bilang mga kubos nga social worker, nga amo sa karon ang aton adlaw-adlaw nga mga baganihan sa ila wala pahuway nga pagtatap sa kinahanglanon sang mga labing kubos naton nga mga utod.
english: But only the achievement of their happy passion and desire – whether doctors, lawyers, CPAs, or even as humble social workers, who are today our daily heroes in their tireless care for the needs of our poorest brothers and sisters.

text: Diri seguro, sa sini nga panahon sang kapintas sang pangabuhi, dapat magbatyag ang mga ginikanan, labi na gid yadtong nagagamit sang ila kabataan sa pagduso sang droga ukon agud ma-kwartahan sa cyber sex kag bastuson sang mga manyakis nga mga pedophile kag kasubong nga mga sira ulo.
english: Perhaps, in this time of cruelty, parents should feel, especially those who use their children to push drugs or to make money in cyber sex and be abused by pedophiles and the like.

text: Wala kita nagpaabot sang sabat ni Miss Gray sang yara siya sa Top 5 sa kon ano ang iya panghuna-huna angot sa paggamit sang marijuana, ukon cannabis.
english: We didn't expect Miss Gray's answer when she was in the Top 5 on what she thought about the use of marijuana, or cannabis.

text: Maisug yadto nga tindug pabor sa paggamit sang medicinal, ukon medical, marijuana tungod isa pa ini ka ilegal nga droga sa pungsod upod sa mas mind-altering, ukon nagapa-“high” nga recreational marijuana.
english: It was a bold stand in favor of the use of medical marijuana because it is another illegal drug in the country along with the more mind-altering, or “high” recreational marijuana.

text: Mangin-alamon man ang sabat niya sa iya pag-kumpara sini sa bisyo sang alcohol (makahulubog nga ilimnon) kag panigarilyo nga makahalalit man apang malikawan ang kahalitan sa husto (in moderation) kag nagakaigu nga paggamit.
english: His answer is also wise in comparing it to the addiction of alcohol and smoking which are also harmful but can be avoided in moderation and proper use.

text: In fact, matudlo niya seguro sa iya ihibalo ang paggamit sang marijuana sa madamo nga pungsod.
english: In fact, he can probably point to his knowledge of the use of marijuana in many countries.

text: Mga 25 sang 50 ka estado sa Estados Unidos ang nag-legalize na sang marijuana, medicinal kag recreational man.
english: About 25 of the 50 states in the United States have legalized marijuana, both medicinal and recreational.

text: Sa Nicaragua kag Canada tugot na gani ang paggamit sang recreational marijuana sang publiko.
english: In Nicaragua and Canada, the use of recreational marijuana is even legal.

text: Legalized man ang paggamit sini sa iban nga pungsod, although sa kalabanan regulated ini.
english: Its use is also legal in other countries, although it is largely regulated.

text: Apang masiling bala naton ini sa kaso sang Pilipinas?
english: But can we say the same in the case of the Philippines?

text: Ang paggamit sang marijuana, kon bala mapuslanon kag “safe” depende seguro sa eksperensya sang kada pungsod.
english: The use of marijuana, whether it is useful and safe depends on the experience of each country.

text: Amo gani nga indi pareho ang ila pagtan-aw sa kon bala itugot ini ukon indi, ukon tubtub diin bala pwede ini mapahanugutan.
english: That's why they don't have the same view on whether it's allowed or not, or to what extent it can be allowed.

text: Sa Pilipinas ugaling may negatibo kita nga experyensya.
english: In the Philippines however we have a negative experience.

text: Sunu sa Department of Health, sadtong 1980s kalabanan nga pasyente nga gina-treat kag gina-rehab sa addiction mga marijuana users tubtub nga nagsaylo na ang bisyo sa shabu.
english: According to the Department of Health, in the 1980s most patients treated and rehabbed for addiction were marijuana users until the addiction switched to shabu.

text: Gani indi pa kita seguro makasugbo sa sina nga bisyo sang basta-basta lang.
english: So we probably can't break that habit just yet.

text: (w_mateojr@yahoo.com/PN)
english: (w_mateojr@yahoo.com/PN)

text: Nakatipon ang Pilipinas sang masobra P760 billion nga kita sa turismo sa tuig 2024.
english: The Philippines will generate more than P760 billion in tourism revenue by 2024.

text: Suno kay Tourism Secretary Christina Frasco, ang turismo sa Pilipinas nakatipon sang all-time high in visitor revenues gikan sa aton mga internasyonal nga turista.
english: According to Tourism Secretary Christina Frasco, tourism in the Philippines has generated all-time high in visitor revenues from our international tourists.

text: Nagarepresentar ini sang kapin sa 9% nga pagtaas gikan sa 2023 nga kita sang mga visitors kag 126% nga recovery gikan sa 600 billion visitor receipts sang 2019.
english: This represents more than a 9% increase from 2023 visitor revenue and a 126% recovery from 2019’s 600 billion visitor receipts.

text: Suno kay Frasco, ang numero nagapakita nga ang ekonomiya, nagbangon sa performance sang turismo sa Pilipinas.
english: According to Frasco, the figure shows that the economy, has recovered from the performance of tourism in the Philippines.

text: Nagpasalig man ini nga ang Department of Tourism nangin malig-on sa ila pangako nga masiguro ang pagdamo sang mga naga-abot nga turista sa pungsod.
english: He also assured that the Department of Tourism has been steadfast in its commitment to ensure an increase in tourist arrivals in the country.

text: Nagpaathag si Senadora Imee Marcos kun ngaa nag-atras ini sa alyansa nga gin-endorso sang iya nga utod nga si Presidente Ferdinand Marcos Jr sa pagka-senador para sa 2025 elections.
english: Senator Imee Marcos explained why she withdrew from the alliance endorsed by her brother President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. for the 2025 elections.

text: Matandaan nga ginpakilala sang Presidente sa Alyansa Para Sa Bagong Pilipinas convention ang senatorial slate sang administrasyon kun sa diin nalakip si Senadora Imee apang wala ini sa event.
english: It can be recalled that the President introduced the senatorial slate of the administration at the Alliance for the New Philippines convention which included Senator Imee but she was not present at the event.

text: Kilala man si Senadora Imee bilang malapit nga abyan ni Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: Senator Imee is also known as a close friend of Vice President Sara Duterte.

text: Suno kay Imee, indi niya luyag nga mabutang sa tunga-tunga sang duha ka kampo.
english: Imee says she doesn’t want to be caught between two camps.

text: Apisar nag-withdraw si Marcos sa Senatorial slate sang administrasyon, gin-athga niya nga bukas siya sa tion nga imbitaron siya sang presidente nga magsaka sa entablado sang Alyansa Para Sa Bagong Pilipinas.
english: Although Marcos withdrew from the administration's Senatorial slate, he made it clear that he is open if the president invites him to take the stage of the Alliance for a New Philippines.

text: Nagpasalamat man siya sa iya nga utod bangud nahangpan sang presidente ang iya nga sitwasyon.
english: He also thanked his brother because the president understood his situation.

text: Ginsiling pa ni Marcos, nakaistorya na niya ang iya iloy tuhoy sa iya nga pag-withdraw sa alyansa.
english: Marcos said he has already spoken to his mother about his withdrawal from the alliance.

text: Suno sa iya, ginkasubo ni anay First Lady Imelda Marcos ang iya nga nangin desisyon.
english: He said former First Lady Imelda Marcos regretted his decision.

text: Sa subong, ginakumpleto pa niya ang iya nga mga dokumento para sa pag-file niya sang iya nga kandidatura sa pagkasenador sa 2025 elections.
english: He is currently completing his documents for filing his candidacy for senator in the 2025 elections.

text: Ginahulat na ang niya ang desisyon sang Nacionalista party sa pag-file sang COC bangud wala man siya nag-resign sa partido.
english: He is waiting for the decision of the Nacionalista party to file his COC because he did not resign from the party.

text: Kun kapid gani, typically, pareho gid ang birthday.
english: If it's twins, typically, they have the same birthday.

text: Apang sa Texas, may yara sang kapid nga baby girls nga sa separado nga tuig nabun-ag!
english: But in Texas, there are twin baby girls who were born in separate years!

text: Una nga ginpaguwa sang iloy nga si Kali Jo Scott ang una nga twin girl nga si Annie Jo sang Disyembre 31,2022 sang 11:55 pm.
english: Mom Kali Jo Scott first released first twin girl Annie Jo on December 31,2022 at 11:55 pm.

text:
Naguwa naman ang second twin nga si Effie Rose sang January 1, 2023, sang 12:01 a.m.

Si Kali Jo ang last baby nga nabun-ag sa Texas Health Presbyterian Hospital Denton sang 2022 samtang si Effie Rose naman ang first baby nga nabun-ag sa amo nga ospital sang 2023.
english:
The second twin, Effie Rose, was born on January 1, 2023, at 12:01 a.m.

Kali Jo was the last baby born at Texas Health Presbyterian Hospital Denton in 2022 while Effie Rose was the first baby born at the same hospital in 2023.

text: Happy naman nga ginpakigbahin sang mommy nga pareho nga healthy ang baby girls kag lunsay nagabug-at sang 5.5 pounds.
english: The mommy happily shared that both baby girls are healthy and both weigh 5.5 pounds.

text: Excited man ang parents bangud dungan sa NewYear’s eve kag New Year’s day ang birthday sang kapid, rason nga extra special ang ila nga holidays sa masunod nga tuig.
english: The parents are also excited because the twins' birthdays fall on New Year's Eve and New Year's Day, making their holidays extra special next year.

text: GINADUMDUM naton sa karon (Disyembre 18) ang kapanganakan ni Graciano Lopez Jaena, ang nagapanguna nga propagandista sang reforma sa Pilipinas bilang editor sang pamantalaan nga La Solidaridad kag tagpamababa sang mga Filipino sadto sa iloy nga Espanya.
english: WE commemorate today (December 18) the birthday of Graciano Lopez Jaena, the leading propagandist of reform in the Philippines as editor of the newspaper La Solidaridad and spokesman for the Filipinos in Spain.

text: Natawo siya sa Jaro, siyudad sang Iloilo sadtong Disyembre 18, 1856 sa mga ginikanan nga sanday Placido Lopez kag Maria Jacoba Jaena.
english: He was born in Jaro, Iloilo City on December 18, 1856 to Placido Lopez and Maria Jacoba Jaena.

text: Ginbawian siya sang kabuhi sa balatian nga tuberculosis sadtong Enero 20, 1896 sa Barcelona, Espanya.
english: He died of tuberculosis on January 20, 1896 in Barcelona, ​​Spain.

text: Gusto sang iya iloy nga magpari siya, apang luyag gid niya nga mag-doktor, gani ginpasugtan siya nga magtuon sa Universidad de Santo Tomas.
english: His mother wanted him to become a priest, but he really wanted to be a doctor, so he was allowed to study at the University of Santo Tomas.

text: Apang wala siya mabaton diri tungod wala sing Bachelor of Arts ang seminaryo sang Jaro.
english: But he was not accepted here because the Jaro seminary did not have a Bachelor of Arts.

text: Ginbaton siya sa San Juan de Dios Hospital bilang apprentice.
english: He was accepted at San Juan de Dios Hospital as an apprentice.

text: Tungod ugaling sa problema pinansyal wala siya nagpasige diri kag nag-practice na gid lang sing medisina.
english: However, due to financial problems, he did not continue here and practiced medicine.

text: Nagka-problema siya sang mamalibad siya nga mag-testigo nga ang isa ka priso napatay sa natural nga kabangdanan samtang sa matuod napatay ini sa kapintas sang isa ka opisyal.
english: He got into trouble when he refused to testify that an inmate died of natural causes when in fact he died of officer brutality.

text: Nagpadayon siya sa iya kawsa kontra sa inhustisya, apang sang may pamahog na sa iya kabuhi, nagpadulong na siya sa Espanya sadtong 1880, sa diin nanguna siya sa pagsulat kag paghambal para sa reforma sa Pilipinas.
english: He continued his cause against injustice, but when his life was threatened, he went to Spain in 1880, where he led the writing and speaking for reform in the Philippines.

text:
***

Una siya sa mga aktibista nga mga Filipino nga nagpukaw sang kalainan sang mga prayle (friars) sa pungsod sa iya nobela nga Fray Botod sa edad pa lang nga 18 anyos.
english:
***

He was one of the first Filipino activists to awaken the evil of the friars in the country in his novel Fray Botod at the age of 18 years.

text: Sa Fray Botod ginlarawan niya ang isa ka prayle nga matambok (fat) kag maasab sa sex (lecherous) kag abusado.
english: In Fray Botod he portrayed a friar who was fat and lecherous and abusive.

text: Wala ini nga libro mabalhag, apang pila ka kopya ang nakatupa sa kamot sang pila ka kakilala lakip na sang mga prayle.
english: This book was not published, but several copies fell into the hands of some acquaintances including friars.

text: Naakig gid ang mga prayle sa pagkabasa sini, apang wala gid nila mapamatud-an nga siya ang nagsulat sini.
english: The friars were furious to read it, but they could never prove that he had written it.

text: Sa Fray Botod ginpatpat niya ang kalainan sang pila ka prayle nga nagagahum sadto sa pungsod bag-o pa ginbuyagyag ni Dr. Jose Rizal ang ining kalainan sang nagagahom nga mga Espanyol sadto sa pungsod sa iya duha ka nobela nga Noli Me Tangere kag El Filibusterismo.
english: In Fray Botod he explained the evil of some friars who were ruling the country before Dr. Jose Rizal described this evil of the Spanish rulers in the country in his two novels Noli Me Tangere and El Filibusterismo.

text: Didto sa Espanya, sang nalagyo siya diri sa paglagas sang mga otoridad, ginsuguran man niya ang Propaganda Movement sa pagbag-o sang sitwasyon sang mga Filipino sa iya pungsod paagi sang La Solidaridad sa diin siya ang una nga editor.
english: In Spain, when he fled the authorities, he also started the Propaganda Movement to change the situation of Filipinos in his country through La Solidaridad where he was the first editor.

text: Ulihi na lang mag-abot sa Espanya si Marcelo H. del Pilar kag Dr. Jose P. Rizal nga sang ulihi nag-upod kay Lopez Jaena sa papanguna sang Propaganda Movement sa Espanya.
english: Marcelo H. del Pilar and Dr. Jose P. Rizal who later joined Lopez Jaena in leading the Propaganda Movement in Spain.

text: Ginakasubo naton ugaling nga sa ila nga tatlo, si Rizal lang ang ginapadunggan sa mga selebrasyon nasyonal kag sa madamo nga mga rebulto sa pungsod.
english: We regret, however, that of the three, only Rizal is honored in national celebrations and in many statues in the country.

text: In fact, tungod sang ka-importante sang rolyo sang Freedom of the Press sadto pa sa Uropa (lakip ang Espanya) kag sa Amerika, kag bisan sa karon pa, dapat ginkilala naton tani si Lopez Jaena nga Amay sang Press Freedom sa pungsod (Father of Philippine Press Freedom), kag indi lang sa Siyudad sang Iloilo sa diin siya natawo.
english: In fact, because of the importance of the role of Freedom of the Press in Europe (including Spain) and America, and even today, we should have recognized Lopez Jaena as the Father of Philippine Press Freedom, and not just in Iloilo City where he was born.

text: Tani makilala gid man si Lopez Jaena bilang Father of Philippine Press Freedom sa ulihi, as he deserves it.
english: I hope Lopez Jaena will be recognized as the Father of Philippine Press Freedom in the future, as he deserves it.

english: (w_mateojr@yahoo.com/PN)

text: Nagsugod na sa training sa Japan ang duha ka mga manghod ni two-time Olympic gold medalist Carlos Yulo nga sanday Eldrew kag Elaiza.
english: Two-time Olympic gold medalist Carlos Yulo's two younger brothers, Eldrew and Elaiza, have already started training in Japan.

text: Suno sa ila iloy nga si Angelica Yulo, nagahanas ang duha sa idalom sang training camp ni Japanese coach Munehiro Kugimiya nga amo man ang nangin long-time coach ni Caloy antes sini nakuha ang duha ka bulawan nga mga medalya sa Olympiada.
english: According to their mother, Angelica Yulo, the two were training under the training camp of Japanese coach Munehiro Kugimiya, who was also Caloy's long-time coach before winning two Olympic gold medals.

text: Nagpares si Coach Mune sa iban nga Japanese company sponsors para sa training nga ginalantaw nga preparasyon na sa Los Angeles Olympics 2028.
english: Coach Mune paired with other Japanese company sponsors for the training that is expected to be in preparation for the Los Angeles Olympics 2028.

text: Una na nga ginsapubliko ni Gymnastics Association of the Philippines (GAP) president Cynthia Carrion ang plano nga ilakip si Eldrew sa lineup sa Los Angeles 2028 nga posible maga-compete kaupod sa iya magulang nga si Caloy nga nagatuyo naman nga depensahan ang iya gold medals sa Summer Games.
english: Gymnastics Association of the Philippines (GAP) president Cynthia Carrion earlier announced plans to include Eldrew in the lineup at Los Angeles 2028, which is likely to compete alongside her brother Caloy, who is also aiming to defend his gold medals at the Summer Games.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagahimo naman sang pangalan si Eldrew paagi sa pagdaog sang mga medalya sa national multi-sport events samtang si Elaiza naman ang nakabulsa sang lima ka gold medals sang ginpatigayon ang Palarong Pambansa sini nga tuig.
english: Eldrew is making a name for herself by winning medals in national multi-sport events while Elaiza pocketed five gold medals during the Palarong Pambansa this year.

text: Si Caloy nga kampyon sa floor exercise kag vault events sa Paris Games amo ang una nga Filipino gymnast nga nakadaog sang Olympic gold medal kag una man nga Pinoy nga nakabulsa sang duha gid ka gold medals sa isa lang ka edisyon sang Olympiada.#
english: Caloy, who won the floor exercise and vault events at the Paris Games, is the first Filipino gymnast to win an Olympic gold medal and the first Filipino to bag two gold medals in a single edition of the Olympiad.

text: ILOILO CITY– Ikaw bala ang tuman na ka stress sa trabaho, nadulaan na sang gana sa kabuhi kag nagakinahanglan sang inspirasyon?
english: ILOILO CITY – Are you stressed at work, lost interest in life and in need of inspiration?

text: mahimo nga ang pagkadto sa beach ang solusyon sa imo problema.
english: maybe going to the beach is the solution to your problem.

text: Suno kay  J. Aaron Hipp, Ph.D., environmental health expert, ang paglakat sa beach nga nagatiniil lang ang  makapanubo sang chronic pain, fatigue kag iban  pa nga sakit.
english: According to J. Aaron Hipp, Ph.D., environmental health expert, walking barefoot on the beach can reduce chronic pain, fatigue and other ailments.

text:
Ang paglangoy sa baybayun ang makabulig agud pakigbatu-an ang mga impeksyon sa lawas,bangud ang tubig dagat ang may mataas nga lebel sang mga  mineral kaangay sang magnesium, iodine, kag potassium

Makabulig man ini agud makuha ang mga negatibo nga elemento nga nagapagamo sa imo kaisipan kag nagapadugang sang stress.
english:
Swimming at the beach can help fight infections in the body, as seawater contains high levels of minerals such as magnesium, iodine, and potassium

It can also help to remove negative elements that clutter your mind and increase stress.

text: Ang pagpadulong sa beach ang isa man sa makabulig agud mas mangin produktibo ka sa imo pagbalik sa trabaho kag mas mapagwa mo ang imo creativity.
english: Going to the beach is also one of the best ways to be more productive when you return to work and to unleash your creativity.

text: Ginklaro ni former Senator Panfilo “Ping” Lacson nga magapadalagan siya bilang independent candidate sa eleksyon sa masunod nga tuig apisar nalakip man siya sa senatorial slate nga gin-anunsyo ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: Former Senator Panfilo “Ping” Lacson clarified that he will run as an independent candidate in next year's elections despite being included in the senatorial slate announced by President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: sang nagligad nga semana.
english: last week.

text: “I am running as an independent candidate, not being a member of a political party,” kabahin sang statement sa iya official social media page.
english: “I am running as an independent candidate, not being a member of a political party,” part of the statement on his official social media page.

text: Pahayag sini, isa siya ka guest candidate sang Nationalist People’s Coalition (NPC) nga kabahin sang alyansa sang lima ka major political parties sa idalom ni Marcos.
english: He said he is a guest candidate of the Nationalist People's Coalition (NPC) which is part of the alliance of five major political parties under Marcos.

text: “I am a guest candidate of the Nationalist People’s Coalition (NPC), which is part of an alliance of five major political parties that includes the administration’s Partido Federal ng Pilipinas,” suno sa former senator.
english: “I am a guest candidate of the Nationalist People’s Coalition (NPC), which is part of an alliance of five major political parties that includes the administration’s Partido Federal ng Pilipinas,” the former senator said.

text: Matandaan nga ang gintingob sang administrasyon nga partido sa idalom sang Alyansa Para Sa Bagong Pilipinas senatorial slate amo ang Partido Federal ng Pilipinas (PFP), National Unity Party, Lakas-CMD, Nacionalista Party, kag Nationalist People’s Coalition.
english: It can be recalled that the administration's merged parties under the Alliance for the New Philippines senatorial slate are Partido Federal ng Pilipinas (PFP), National Unity Party, Lakas-CMD, Nacionalista Party, and Nationalist People's Coalition.

text: Paathag sini, bugal niya nga mangin kabahin sang grand alliance, kag wala sang duda sa iya pinsar nga pananglitan magdaog siya sa masunod nga tuig, sigurado siya nga may salig sa iya si Marcos.
english: He explained that he is proud to be part of the grand alliance, and there is no doubt in his mind that if he wins next year, he is sure that Marcos will trust him.

text: “Make no mistake – I am proud to be part of a grand alliance of our country’s five major political parties.
english: “Make no mistake – I am proud to be part of a grand alliance of our country’s five major political parties.

text: I have no doubt in my mind that should I win next year, President Marcos fully recognizes my consistent role as a fiscalizer guided only by our shared motto: ‘Ang tama ay ipaglaban; ang mali ay labanan’,” kabahin sang statement.
english: I have no doubt in my mind that should I win next year, President Marcos fully recognizes my consistent role as a fiscalizer guided only by our shared motto: ‘What is right is to be fought for; wrong is fought’,” part of the statement.

text: Matandaan nga nagpadalagan si Lacson bilang independent presidential candidate sang 2022 kaupod si former Senate President Tito Sotto nga subong nagapadalagan man sa pagka-senador kag gina-endorso man ni Marcos.#
english: Lacson ran as an independent presidential candidate in 2022 alongside former Senate President Tito Sotto who is also running for senator and is also endorsed by Marcos.

text: Nagpaandam si Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla nga mahimo i-suspend ukon mapasakaan sang kaso-administratibo ang mga pulitiko nga padayon nga magagamit sang programa sang gobyerno para sa ila nga personal nga interes.
english: Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla warned that politicians who continue to use government programs for their personal interests could be suspended or charged with administrative charges.

text: Suno sa tiglikom, kabahin ini sang implementasyon sang “anti-epal” provision sa General Appropriations Act (GAA).
english: According to the secretary, this is part of the implementation of the “anti-epal” provision in the General Appropriations Act (GAA).

text: “We have administrative cases that we can file against them — anything from suspension to preventive suspension… we have many, all of them are administrative cases that can be filed against them, not criminal,” suno sa opisyal sa ginpatigayon nga Palace briefing.
english: “We have administrative cases that we can file against them — anything from suspension to preventive suspension… we have many, all of them are administrative cases that can be filed against them, not criminal,” the official said at a Palace briefing.

text: Nagapati man si Remulla nga tion na nga magbalay sang layi nga makahatag sang ngipon sa “anti-epal” campaign.
english: Remulla also believes that it is time to frame a law that will give teeth to the “anti-epal” campaign.

text: “Yes, I believe so.
english: “Yes, I believe so.

text: They should do it because right now your anti-epal campaign was only born out of the frustration of the people in the last 15 years.
english: They should do it because right now your anti-epal campaign was only born out of the frustration of the people in the last 15 years.

text: So, we don’t have a codified conduct for that anti-epal campaign.
english: So, we don’t have a codified conduct for that anti-epal campaign.

text: And it will be a great help if the national legislature made steps to really ban that,” suno sa tiglikom.
english: And it will be a great help if the national legislature makes steps to really ban that,” the secretary said.

text: Nagpanawagan man ang DILG nga magkuha sang picture ukon videos, kag mag-report gilayon kun may mga pulitiko nga nagapa-epal.
english: The DILG also called on the public to take pictures or videos, and report immediately if there are politicians who are epal.

text: Ginalantaw man subong sang ahensya ang pagtukod sang portal nga kaangay sa Sumbong sa Pangulo website agud mas madasig nga makapanugid ang publiko.
english: The agency is also looking at setting up a portal similar to the Sumbong sa Pangulo website to speed up the public's reporting.

text: Sa bahin sang Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD), una naman nagpasalig ang ahensya nga mangin istrikto sila sa pagdumili sa mga pulitiko sa pagpartisipar sa pagpanagtag sang ayuda nga iya sang gobyerno.
english: On the part of the Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD), the agency earlier assured that they will be strict in prohibiting politicians from participating in the distribution of government aid.

text: Indi man pagpakadtuon ang DSWD social workers sa distribution sites kun didto ang mga pulitiko.#
english: DSWD social workers will not be allowed to visit distribution sites if politicians are present.

text: Nagdangat sa 18 ka mga tawo ang napatay kag masobra 160 ang nasamaran sang nagtibusok ang training aircraft sang Bangladesh Air Force sa isa ka eskwelahan sa Dhaka nga amo ang kapital sang pungsod.
english: At least 18 people were killed and more than 160 injured when a Bangladesh Air Force training plane crashed into a school in the capital Dhaka.

text: Suno sa militar, nag-crash ang Air Force F-7 BGI aircraft sa campus sang Milestone School and College sa Uttara sa Dhaka sang Lunes sang hapon (local time).
english: The military said an Air Force F-7 BGI aircraft crashed into the campus of Milestone School and College at Uttara in Dhaka on Monday afternoon (local time).

text: Sang amo nga tion suno sa awtoridad, nagakuha sang test kag naga-attend sang regular classes ang mga estudyante.
english: At the time, authorities said, the students were taking tests and attending regular classes.

text: Indi pa klaro kun ano gid ang rason sang insidente, apang sa inisyal nga pahayag, 1:06 sang hapon ang take-off apang gilayon nga nagkalayo bangud sang mechanical fault.
english: The cause of the incident is still unclear, but initial reports said the vehicle took off at 1:06 pm but immediately caught fire due to a mechanical fault.

text: Base sa inisyal nga pahayag sang armed forces, lakip sa napatay amo mismo ang piloto nga si Flight Lieutenant Md.
english: According to the initial statement of the armed forces, among the dead was the pilot himself, Flight Lieutenant Md.

text: Taukir Islam.Ginpahayag man sang armadong-kusog sang Bangladesh nga gintinguhaan pa kuntani sang piloto nga mapalikaw ang aircarft sa less populated area matapos natabo ang mechanical fault.
english: Taukir Islam.The Bangladesh armed forces also said the pilot tried to divert the aircraft to a less populated area after the mechanical fault occurred.

text: Sandig naman sa National Institute of Burn and Plastic Surgery, masobra 50 ka mga pasyente ang gindala sa ila nga pasilidad lakip ang mga kabataan.
english: According to the National Institute of Burn and Plastic Surgery, more than 50 patients were brought to their facility including children.

text: Nagapadayon pa ang rescue operations.#
english: Rescue operations are still ongoing.

text:
Gina-istoryahan subong ang bag-o nga video ni Senator Imee Marcos nga parody sang game show nga “Who Wants to Be a Millionaire?”

Sa Question No.
english:
Senator Imee Marcos’ new video parody of the game show “Who Wants to Be a Millionaire?” is now being discussed.

In Question No.

text: 3, ginpamangkot sang “host” si Imee kun ano ang tawag sa pulitiko nga masami nagalain-lain sang duag kag political stance.
english: 3, the host asked Imee what to call a politician who often has different colors and political stance.

text: Una nga nagsabat ang senadora sang “political butterfly”, apang sala ini suno sa “host.” Sa iya script, nagpakuno-kuno naman ang senadora nga wala nakabati kag ginmensyonar ang “Ping”, apang ginklaro man sang “host” nga “Pink” ang sabat.
english: The senator first responded with a “political butterfly”, but it was wrong, according to the “host.” In her script, the senator pretended not to hear and mentioned “Ping”, but the host also clarified that “Pink” was the answer.

text: Wala sang ginhambal nga pangalan, pero antes sini nga parody, may tension sa tunga ni Imee kag Senate President Pro Tempore Panfilo “Ping” Lacson kaangot sa 2026 national budget.
english: No names were mentioned, but before this parody, there was tension between Imee and Senate President Pro Tempore Panfilo “Ping” Lacson over the 2026 national budget.

text: Ginsabat ni Lacson si Imee sang damlag lang nga nagahimo ini sang mga wala-basehan nga istorya kaangot sa 2026 budget kag sa Senate blue ribbon committee.
english: Lacson responded to Imee recently that she was making baseless stories regarding the 2026 budget and the Senate blue ribbon committee.

text:
Ginbulgar man ni Lacson nga may “pork barrel” si Imee

“She makes a lot of noise criticizing the 2026 budget for having ‘pork’ but she had ‘pork’ in the budget,” kabahin sang statement ni Lacson.
english:
Lacson also revealed that Imee has a “pork barrel”

“She makes a lot of noise criticizing the 2026 budget for having ‘pork’ but she had ‘pork’ in the budget,” Lacson said in a statement.

text: Nag-react man anay si Lacson sa mga tirada ni Imee sa Senate Blue Ribbon Committee.
english: Lacson also reacted to Imee's tirades in the Senate Blue Ribbon Committee.

text: Para sa iya, indi na ini kritisismo kundi insulto.
english: To him, it was no longer a criticism but an insult.

text: “Perhaps she wants to apply as the ‘meow meow of the Senate’?
english: “Perhaps she wants to apply as the ‘meow meow of the Senate’?

text: We don’t want a meow meow in the Senate, but someone seems interested to apply,” suno kay Lacson.
english: We don’t want a meow meow in the Senate, but someone seems interested to apply,” according to Lacson.

text: Ang “Meow Meow” sa Kamara amo si suspended Cavite Rep.
english: The “Meow Meow” in the House is suspended Cavite Rep.

text: Kiko Barzaga nga kilala sa iya “meow meow” antics sa House sessions.
english: Kiko Barzaga known for his “meow meow” antics in House sessions.

text: ILOILO CITY- Suportado sang Office of the Presidential Assistant for Visayas ang lihok sang mga Local Government Unit sa Visayas nga pag-ban sang pagsulod sang live pigs, pork kag pork products gikan sa Luzon kag Mindanao bilang proteksyon gikan sa African Swine Fever.
english: ILOILO CITY – The Office of the Presidential Assistant for Visayas supports the move of Local Government Units in the Visayas to ban the entry of live pigs, pork and pork products from Luzon and Mindanao as a protection against African Swine Fever.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Assistant Secretary Jonji Gonzales sang Office of the Presidential Assistant for the Visayas, iya ginpahayag nga apisar may pressure sa swine industry gikan sa Luzon kag Mindanao nga nagahingyo nga tugutan ang pagsulod sang baboy sa Visayas, nagapanindugan ini nga dapat istriktuhan gid ang pagpatuman sang nasambit nga ban.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Assistant Secretary Jonji Gonzales of the Office of the Presidential Assistant for the Visayas said that despite pressure on the swine industry from Luzon and Mindanao to allow the entry of pigs into the Visayas, he insists that the ban should be strictly enforced.

text: Suno kay Gonzales, wala man sang dapat kabalak-an ang mga pumuluyo sang bilog nga Visayas  bangud stable gihapon ang presyo sang baboy nga nagapatimaan sang bastante nga suplay.
english: According to Gonzales, the people of the entire Visayas have nothing to worry about because the price of pork is still stable which indicates sufficient supply.

text: Sa Iloilo,suno kay Gonzales,8 billion pesos ang balor sang swine population nga may katumbas nga 16 tubtob 20 billion pesos nga industriya.
english: In Iloilo, according to Gonzales, the value of the swine population is 8 billion pesos with an equivalent 16 to 20 billion pesos industry.

text: Samtang,mahimo naman nga hingalitan sang hograisers sa Visayas ang estado sini nga African Swine Fever free agud magsuplay  sang baboy sa Luzon ukon sa Mindanao.
english: Meanwhile, hograisers in the Visayas may take advantage of its African Swine Fever free status to supply pigs to Luzon or Mindanao.

text: Nagpamalibad si Senator Imee Marcos nga mag-upod sa senatorial slate nga gin-endorso sang iya utod nga si President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.
english: Senator Imee Marcos refused to join the senatorial slate endorsed by her brother, President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.

text: para sa 2025 elections.
english: for the 2025 elections.

text: Base sa video message ni Imee, magapa-reelect ini bilang isa ka independent candidate.
english: Based on Imee's video message, she will seek reelection as an independent candidate.

text: Sa statement sang senadora, ginpahayag sini nga mabudlay mag-isahanon sa pulitika kag sa kampanya, apang amo ini suno sa iya ang legasiya nga ginbilin sang iya amay nga si anay Presidente Ferdinand Marcos, Sr.
english: In a statement, the senator said it is difficult to be alone in politics and campaigning, but this is the legacy left by her father, former President Ferdinand Marcos, Sr.

text: “It is never easy to stand alone, in campaigns and in politics… But that is the legacy my father left me, that is the legacy of Apo Lakay whom we remember today,” suno kay Imee samtang gina-mensyonar ang 35th death anniversary sang iya amay.
english: “It is never easy to stand alone, in campaigns and in politics… But that is the legacy my father left me, that is the legacy of Apo Lakay whom we remember today,” said Imee while mentioning the 35th death anniversary of her father.

text: Pahayag pa ni Imee nga subong affiliated sa Nacionalista Party, ginpili niya nga mangin independent na lamang para indi na mabudlayan ang iya “ading” (Bongbong Marcos), kag amo man ang iya mga abyan.
english: Imee said that now that she is affiliated with the Nacionalista Party, she chose to be independent so that her “ading” (Bongbong Marcos) will not suffer, as well as her friends.

text: “I chose to stand alone so that my ading (younger brother) will no longer be put in a difficult position, and my true friends won’t have to hesitate,” pahayag sini.
english: “I chose to stand alone so that my ading (younger brother) will no longer be put in a difficult position, and my true friends won’t have to hesitate,” it said.

text: “I choose to remain free and loyal — not to any group, but to every Filipino,” iya gindugang.
english: “I choose to remain free and loyal — not to any group, but to every Filipino,” he added.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang kaupod sini sa Nacionalista nga si House Deputy Speaker Camille Villar ang kabahin man sang senatorial ticket sang electoral alliance sang administrasyon nga amo ang Alyansa para sa Bagong Pilipinas.
english: His Nacionalista colleague, House Deputy Speaker Camille Villar, is also part of the senatorial ticket of the administration's electoral alliance, the Alliance for the New Philippines.

text: Nagpasalamat man si Imee sa Nacionalista kag sa iya utod nga si Bongbong nga gin-upod siya sa ginpakilala nga senatorial slate.
english: Imee also thanked the Nacionalista and her brother Bongbong for including her in the introduced senatorial slate.

text: “I offer my heartfelt gratitude to President Bongbong, who, despite the anger and extreme cruelty of some, came to my defense and included me in the alliance,” pahayag sini.
english: “I offer my heartfelt gratitude to President Bongbong, who, despite the anger and extreme cruelty of some, came to my defense and included me in the alliance,” it said.

text:
“Many thanks also to NP and to all my allies who continue to support me, may your trust remain with me.”

Matandaan nga sang ginpakilala ni Marcos ang 12 nga yara sa ila line-up sang nagligad nga semana, si Imee lamang ang absent apang ginrason nga masako na ini sa pagpangampanya.#
english:
“Many thanks also to NP and to all my allies who continue to support me, may your trust remain with me.”

When Marcos introduced the 12 in their line-up last week, only Imee was absent but argued that she was busy campaigning.

text: Gintuad sang singer nga si Martin Nievera nga nadiskubre sang isa ka wrestling coach ang iya talent sa pagkanta samtang nagapaligo ini sa shower room.
english: Singer Martin Nievera confessed that a wrestling coach discovered his singing talent while he was taking a shower in the shower room.

text: Suno kay Martin, naligo siya sa shower sang locker room matapos ang isa ka basketball game kag samtang naga-shower, naga-enjoy ini sa reverb echo.
english: Martin said he was taking a shower in the locker room shower after a basketball game and while showering, he was enjoying the reverb echo.

text: Pahayag niya, ang ambahanon nga “Feelings” ni Morris Albert ang iya ginakanta sang nabatian siya sang wrestling coach nga naglabay lang sa lugar.
english: He said he was singing the song “Feelings” by Morris Albert when he was heard by a wrestling coach who was passing by.

text:
Didto ini ginhambalan sang coach nga, ‘Hey, I want you to audition tomorrow for the choir.'”

Nangin miyembro gid man ini sang choir.
english:
That’s when the coach told him, ‘Hey, I want you to audition tomorrow for the choir.'”

He eventually became a member of the choir.

text: Sang 1981, nag-intra si Martin sa isa ka California-wide talent search nga may 4,000 contestants kag siya ang nagdaug.
english: In 1981, Martin entered a California-wide talent search with 4,000 contestants and came out on top.

text: Didto na narealisar ni Martin nga luyag niya nga mangin isa ka singer kag sa Pilipinas niya gusto mag-umpisa sang career.
english: Martin realized that he wanted to be a singer and that he wanted to start his career in the Philippines.

text: Sa subong, 42 ka tuig na sa industriya si Nievera nga amo ang ginhatagan sang bansag nga Concert King sang Pilipinas.
english: Today, Nievera has been in the industry for 42 years and has been given the title of Concert King of the Philippines.

text: Maga-atubangay liwat ang Barangay Ginebra kag ang defending champions nga TNT Tropang Giga sa finals sang PBA Governors’ Cup!
english: Barangay Ginebra and defending champions TNT Tropang Giga will face each other again in the finals of the PBA Governors' Cup!

text: Ini matapos ginlutos sang Ginebra ang San Miguel Beermen, 102-99, sa Game 6 sang semifinals sa Smart Araneta Coliseum subong nga gab-i, Oktubre 20.
english: Ginebra defeated the San Miguel Beermen, 102-99, in Game 6 of the semifinals at the Smart Araneta Coliseum tonight, October 20.

text: Nagpanguna na ang Gin Kings, 86-78, sa temprano nga bahin sang fourth quarter antes nakalagas ang Beermen, 99-98, matapos ang back-to-back baskets nanday June Mar Fajardo kag import nga si EJ Anosike sang dos minutos na lamang ang nabilin sa hampang.
english: The Gin Kings led, 86-78, early in the fourth quarter before the Beermen pulled away, 99-98, after back-to-back baskets by June Mar Fajardo and import EJ Anosike with just two minutes left in the game.

text: 1:49 minutes naman ang nabilin sa fourth frame sang naka-tres si Justin Brownlee nga amo ang naghatag-ligwa sa Ginebra kag amo na ang katapusan nga puntos sa hampang.
english: 1:49 minutes left in the fourth frame when Justin Brownlee hit a three that gave Ginebra the break and that was the last point of the game.

text: Nagpanguna sa Ginebra si Maverick Ahanmisi nga may 25 points, two rebounds, isa ka assist, kag isa ka steal samtang si Brownlee naman ang may 21 points, seven boards, seven assists, three steals, kag two blocks.
english: Maverick Ahanmisi led Ginebra with 25 points, two rebounds, one assist, and one steal while Brownlee had 21 points, seven boards, seven assists, three steals, and two blocks.

text: Naka-20 puntos si Japeth Aguilar samtang ang scoring-leader sa fourth quarter nga si RJ Abarrientos ang may 16 points.
english: Japeth Aguilar had 20 points while fourth quarter scoring-leader RJ Abarrientos had 16 points.

text: Sa Beermen naman, nanguna si Anosike nga may 30 points samtang may 22 points naman kag 15 rebounds kag reigning Most Valuable Player nga si Fajardo.
english: For the Beermen, Anosike led the way with 30 points while Fajardo had 22 points and 15 rebounds and reigning Most Valuable Player.

text: Balantayan ang Game 1 sa finals series 7:30 sang gab-i sa Domingo sa Ynares Center sa Antipolo.
english: Watch Game 1 of the finals series at 7:30 pm on Sunday at the Ynares Center in Antipolo.
