text: INDI TA MAN seguro mabasol gid si President Rodrigo Duterte sa iya kalain buot sa Simbahan Katolika – kag sa iban pa nga kritiko – sa sige sini nga pag-kritikar sa Presidente sa padayon nga pinatyanay sa pungsod angot sa Gyera Kontra Droga.
english: WE CAN'T blame President Rodrigo Duterte for his anger towards the Catholic Church – and other critics – for his constant criticism of the President for the ongoing killings in the country in connection with the War on Drugs.

text: In fact, halin sang pagpungko sa pwesto ni Presidente sadtong 2016 sobra 4,000 na ang napatay, sunu sa kapulisan, sa ila “police operations”.
english: In fact, since the President took office in 2016, more than 4,000 people have been killed, according to the police, in their police operations.

text: Nagbato kuno ini sila sang dakpon na sang mga pulis.
english: They allegedly threw stones when the police arrested them.

text: Malapit man ugaling sa amo nga kadamuon ang napatay tungod sa extrajudicial killings (EJK), sunu sa human rights groups, nga  tani gindakop lang kag pasakaan kaso.
english: However, human rights groups say the number of extrajudicial killings (EJK) deaths is close to the same number.

text: Ang Gyera Kontra Droga ginpangako ini ni Presidente sa kampanya sa eleksyon sang 2016, kag isa ini sa ka daku nga rason kon ngaa nagdaug siya sa eleksyon.
english: The War on Drugs was promised by the President during the 2016 election campaign, and it is one of the biggest reasons why he won the election.

text: Gani, natural lang nga ipatuman niya ini sa iya masarangan.
english: Naturally, then, he would enforce it to the best of his ability.

text: Pareho may interes ang Estado kag Simbahan sa sining problema sa droga.
english: Both the State and the Church have an interest in this drug problem.

text: Kon may problema sa ila tunga, ina yara lang sa punto de vista sa pagpatuman.
english: If there is a problem between them, that is only from an enforcement point of view.

text: Sa nahibal-an ta na, ginapabalik ni Presidente ang death penalty, ukon ang silot nga kamatayon, sa mabug-at gid kaayo nga mga kaso, lakip ang dalagku nga mga kaso angot sa ilegal nga droga, samtang sige man ang pinatyanay.
english: As we already know, the President is restoring the death penalty, or the death penalty, in very serious cases, including major cases involving illegal drugs, while killings continue.

text: On the other hand, kontra ini sang Simbahan Katolika, nga ginatuohan sang sobra 80 ka porsyento sang aton populasyon,  sa idalom sang ika-5 nga Sugo sang Diyos: Indi ka magpatay (sang kapareho mo).
english: On the other hand, it is against the Catholic Church, which is believed by more than 80 percent of our population, under the 5th Commandment of God: Thou shalt not kill.

text: Sugot lang ang Simbahan sa self-defense, ukon sa pag-defensa sa kaugalingon, kag kaangay nga defensa lakip ang “just war”, ukon ang matarong nga pagsulod sa gyera nga indi na malikawan.
english: The Church only agrees with self-defense, or self-defense, and similar defenses including “just war”, or the just entry into war that can no longer be avoided.

text: Kumpormi man sini si Presidente, sa iya mismo siling.
english: The President agrees with this, he said.

text: Ang problema ugaling, sunu sa mga tagpangapin sang Simbahan kag human rights groups, kay lain ang sugid sa hulid.
english: The problem, however, according to Church advocates and human rights groups, is that the story is different.

text: Sa iya mga deklarasyon, siling nila, ginapaisug pa ni Presidente  ang mga pulis sa paghimo sang kalakasan paagi sa pagpasalig sa ila sang iya pag-apin sa ila sa kon ano man nga salabton.
english: In his declarations, they say, the President even encourages the police to commit violence by assuring them of his protection against any responsibility.

text: “Ako ang mapa-priso kon matabo!” nasiling gani niya.
english: “I’ll go to jail if it happens!” he even said.

text: Tungod sini, indi man katingalahan nga ang iban nga pulis gatirada na gid lang sang ila personal nga ginakaakigan.
english: Because of this, it is not surprising that some police officers just shoot their personal grudges.

text: Well, may ara nga mapatihan, may ara nga indi mapatihan sa sining mga “police operations” kag akusasyon sing EJK.
english: Well, there are believable, there are unbelievable in these “police operations” and accusations of EJK.

text: Tubtub subong ugaling, wala pa gid sing may nadutlan sing kaso, luas lang sa tatlo ka pulis nga ginbangdan sang kamatayon sang isa ka menor de edad sa Metro Manila.
english: So far, however, no one has been charged, except for three policemen who caused the death of a minor in Metro Manila.

text: Kon kis-a, kon ano-ano man ang ginahambal sang Presidente nga makasalaklaw, ukon indi maayo pamatian sang mga kabataan sa ila dapat ginataha tani nga pangulo sang pungsod.
english: Sometimes, whatever the President says that is offensive, or not good for the children to hear, they should respect the head of the country.

text: Maabtik man ugaling magpangapin ang mga tagpamababa sang Presidente.
english: However, the President's spokesmen are quick to defend themselves.

text:
Masiling ina sila nga “indi ina ang buot silingon sang Presidente.”

Kon kis-a, masiling pa ina sila nga “joke” (lahog) ukon “hyberbole” (lapaw nga sugid) lang ang mga ini.
english:
They will say, “That is not what the President meant.”

Sometimes, they can even say that they are just a “joke” or “hyberbole”.

text: Apang masakit ini sa mga natungdan, katulad sang lahog parti sa ginlugos nga Australyano nga madre.
english: But it hurts those concerned, like the joke about the raped Australian nun.

text: Kon kis-a gani makahaladlok.
english: Sometimes even scary.

text: Sa kaakig sang Presidente nabungat gani niya nga patyon niya ang mga Obispo kay wala man sila sing nahimo kundi ang mag-kritikar sa Presidente.
english: In anger, the President even said that he would kill the Bishops because they had done nothing but criticize the President.

text: Indi ugaling kuno ina ang luyag ipahangop sang Presidente kay indi siya kuno makapatay sang obispo, siling sang iya mga tagpamababa.
english: However, that is not what the President means because he cannot kill a bishop, his spokesmen said.

text: Tungod sini, madamo gani sang mga tumuluo ang hayag nga nagpabatyag sang ila kalain buot sa sining pang-atake ni Presidente sa mga pari.
english: Because of this, many believers have openly expressed their displeasure with the President's attack on priests.

text: In fact, nagpakita sing suporta ang mga tumuluo sa ila mga obispo sa misa sa pagdedicar sa altar sang Manila Cathedral sadtong ika-60 nga postwar restoration rite sini sadtong Disyembre 10, nga gintambungan sang mga 20 ka obispo.
english: In fact, the faithful showed their support to their bishops at the dedication mass of the altar of the Manila Cathedral during its 60th postwar restoration rite on December 10, which was attended by about 20 bishops.

text: Sa ini nga okasyon, gintagaan sang 30 minutos nga palakpak (applause) sang mga tumuluo ang mga obispo sa pagpakita sang ila suporta sa ila sa sining pamahog ni Presidente nga dapat sila patyon.
english: On this occasion, the bishops were given a 30-minute applause by the faithful to show their support for the President's threat to kill them.

text: Nanawagan man gani ang Presidente nga maayo pa nga indi na gid lang magtambong sa misa ang mga pumuluyo kag mangadi na gid lang sa ila mga puluy-an.
english: The President even called on the people not to attend mass and pray at home.

text: Apang wala ini ginsunod sang mga tumuluo.
english: But the believers did not follow it.

text: Sa Mandurriao Parish Church, nagdamo pa gani ang nagsimba diri sadtong Domingo sang aga.
english: At Mandurriao Parish Church, the number of worshipers increased on Sunday morning.

text: Siyam ka mga indibidwal ang napatay matapos ginpangluthang sang mga armado nga suspek sa sulod sang isa ka bar sa General Villamil Playas, Guayas Province, sa Ecuador.
english: Nine individuals were killed after being shot by armed suspects inside a bar in General Villamil Playas, Guayas Province, Ecuador.

text: Suno sa mga otoridad, hinali nga nagsulod sa establisemento ang mga armado samtang ang mga biktima nagahampang sang pool.
english: According to authorities, the gunmen suddenly entered the establishment while the victims were playing pool.

text: Wala sang klaro nga motibo ang insidente, apang ginakabig ini nga isa sa mga pinakamaduguo nga krimen sa nasambit nga lugar subong nga tuig.
english: There is no clear motive for the incident, but it is considered one of the bloodiest crimes in the area this year.

text: Ginpahayag ni Police Colonel Jhanon Varela nga may yara pa sang duha ka biktima nga pilason kag gilayon gindala sa pinakamalapit nga hospistal para sa nagakaigo nga pagbulong.
english: Police Colonel Jhanon Varela said there were two other victims who were injured and were immediately taken to the nearest hospital for proper treatment.

text: Base sa record sang otoridad, sa una pa lang nga lima ka bulan sang 2025, naglab-ot na sa 4,051 ang kaso sang pinatyanay sa Ecuador, isa ka alarming nga indikasyon sang padayon kahangawa sang seguridad sa pungsod.
english: According to authority records, in the first five months of 2025 alone, there will be 4,051 cases of homicide in Ecuador, an alarming indication of the continuing security concerns in the country.

text: Ginausisa pa subong sang mga otoridad ang motibo sang krimen kag ang posible nga pagkilala sang mga responsable.
english: Authorities are still investigating the motive of the crime and the possible identification of those responsible.

text: Nagapadayon man ang police operations sa lugar agud madakpang ang mga suspek.
english: Police operations are also ongoing in the area to arrest the suspects.

text: Ginsabat sang Filipino singer nga si Arnel Pineda nga frontman sang American rock band nga The Journey ang mga kritisismo batok sa iya may kaangtanan sa performance sini sa Rock in Rio sa Brazil sang weekend.
english: Filipino singer Arnel Pineda frontman of American rock band The Journey has responded to the criticism against him in connection with its performance at Rock in Rio in Brazil over the weekend.

text: Sa iya social media accounts, ginpasalamatan niya ang mga fans nga naglantaw sang show.
english: Taking to her social media accounts, she thanked fans for watching the show.

text: Apang gin-ako man sini nga dismayado siya sa iya pagperform sang kanta nga “Don’t Stop Believin'” bangud nga madamo nga beses ini naglibag kag halos indi niya malab-ot ang mataas nga tono.
english: But he also admitted that he was disappointed in his performance of the song "Don't Stop Believin'" because it was confused many times and he almost did not reach the high tone.

text: Suno sa, ginaagwanta niya subong ang mental kag emosyonal nga epekto sa iya sang madamo nga kritisismo.
english: That said, she is currently coping with the mental and emotional toll of so much criticism on her.

text: May nagsiling pa nga mag-resign na lang ini sa banda.
english: Some even said he should resign from the band.

text: Sa pihak sini, madamo naman ang todo-suporta gihapon sa iya kag nagpahayag nga indi nalang pagsapakon ang iya bashers.
english: Meanwhile, many are still supporting him and said they should ignore his bashers.

text: Si Pineda ang nangin kabahin sang Journey sa sulod na sang 17 ka tuig matapos ginbuslan ang original vocalist nga si Steve Perry.
english: Pineda has been part of Journey for 17 years after replacing original vocalist Steve Perry.

text: Ini nga banda ang sa likod sang hits nga “Open Arms,” Faithfully,” kag “Don’t Stop Believin.'”
english: This band is behind the hits “Open Arms,” Faithfully,” and “Don’t Stop Believin.'”

text: Ginalauman ni Mayor Raisa Treñas nga ang bago nga pamunuan sang Iloilo City District Engineers Office (ICDEO) mangin bukas sa kooperasyon kag may klaro nga koordinasyon upod sa Iloilo City Government.
english: Mayor Raisa Treñas expects the new leadership of the Iloilo City District Engineers Office (ICDEO) to be open to cooperation and have clear coordination with the Iloilo City Government.

text: Ini matapos ang pag-relieve kay Eng.
english: This follows the relief of Eng.

text: Roy Pacanan kahapon nga adlaw matapos ang order nga wala sini nalab-ot ang qualifications sang Civil Service Commission (CSC).
english: Roy Pacanan yesterday after the order that he did not meet the qualifications of the Civil Service Commission (CSC).

text:
Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Joy Fantilaga Gorzal, spokesperson ni Mayor Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga dapat mangin committed sa transparency ang bag-o nga pamunuan sang ICDEO

Ini agud nga may ara sang direksyon kag epektibo nga koordinasyon ang syudad sa pagtukod sang mga bag- o nga mga proyekto.
english:
In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Joy Fantilaga Gorzal, spokesperson of Mayor Treñas, said the new ICDEO leadership should be committed to transparency.

This is to ensure that the city has direction and effective coordination in the construction of new projects.

text: Importante gid, suno pa sa iya, nga ang mga proyekto sa palaabuton ilabi na ang mga flood control projects mapuslan gid sang pumuluyo sang syudad.
english: It is very important, he said, that future projects especially flood control projects will benefit the people of the city.

text: Dugang pa sang alcalde nga pinaagi sa bukas nga koordinasyon kag klaro nga komunikasyon, mas mangin mahapos ang pagpatuman sang mga proyekto para kaayuhan sang mga Ilonggo.
english: The mayor added that through open coordination and clear communication, it will be easier to implement projects for the benefit of Ilonggos.

text: Nagnubo sang Nobyembre 2024 ang numero sang mga unemployed nga mga Pilipino sa tunga sang seasonal nga pagtaas sang demand para sa labor sa tion sang “ber” moths nga nagadul-ong sa mga holidays.
english: Decreased in November 2024 the number of unemployed Filipinos amid the seasonal increase in demand for labor during the “ber” moths leading up to the holidays.

text: Suno kay Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) chief and National Statistician nga si Claire Dennis Mapa, ang mga indibidwal nga wala sang trabaho, naga-edad 15 pataas, naglab-ot sa 1.66 million, mas manubo sa 1.97 million nga wala sang trabaho sang Oktubre 2024.
english: According to Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) chief and National Statistician Claire Dennis Mapa, unemployed individuals, aged 15 and above, reached 1.66 million, down from the 1.97 million unemployed in October 2024.

text: Tuig-tuig, ang numero sang unemployed sang Nobyembre 2024 mas manubo man sa 1.83 million nga wala sang trabaho sang Nobyembre 2023.
english: Year-on-year, the number of unemployed in November 2024 is also lower than the 1.83 million who were out of work in November 2023.

text: Bilang porsyento sang 51.20 million ka mga Pilipino sa pwersa sang trabaho, nga aktibo nga nagapangita sang trabaho kag palangabuhian sa sulod sang panahon, ang kadamuon sang unemployed nga mga tawo nag-translate sa isa ka unemployment rate nga 3.2%, nagnubo gikan sa 3.9% sang Oktubre 2024.
english: As a percentage of the 51.20 million Filipinos in the labor force, who were actively looking for jobs and livelihoods during the period, the number of unemployed people translated into an unemployment rate of 3.2%, down from 3.9% in October 2024.

text: Isahanon lamang ang Golden State Warriors nga wala sang naangkon nga kalutusan antes nagtakop ang preseason sa National Basketball Association (NBA) subong nga tuig.
english: The Golden State Warriors are the only ones without a loss before the end of the preseason in the National Basketball Association (NBA) this year.

text: Katapusan nga gin-atubang sang Warriors ang Los Angeles Lakers kun sa diin ginkamasaan gid sini ang team sa score nga 132-74 sa hampang sa Chase Center sa San Francisco, California, USA.
english: The Warriors last faced the Los Angeles Lakers where they defeated the team 132-74 at the Chase Center in San Francisco, California, USA.

text: 6-0 ang record nanday Stephen Curry sa sini nga preseason matapos ginlutos ang Los Angeles Clippers, Sacramento Kings (duha ka beses), Detroit Pistons kag Los Angeles Lakers (duha ka beses).
english: Stephen Curry has a 6-0 record this preseason after beating the Los Angeles Clippers, Sacramento Kings (twice), Detroit Pistons and Los Angeles Lakers (twice).

text: Sang 2022 nga katapusan nila nahimo ang amo sini nga record, nadag-an nila ang championship title sa sa regular season.
english: In 2022 when they last made such a record, they won the championship title in the regular season.

text: Apang santo sa inisyal nga reports, may tatlo ka players nga i-waive ang Golden State.
english: But according to initial reports, Golden State has three players to waive.

text: Nagaguwa ang mga pangalan nanday Kevin Knox, Blake Hinson, kag Jackson Rowe.
english: The names of Kevin Knox, Blake Hinson, and Jackson Rowe come up.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa kada pagtakop sang NBA preseason, ginahimo na sang teams ang ila desisyon sa pinal nila nga roster para sa pagbukas sang regular season sa masunod nga semana.
english: It is known that at the end of each NBA preseason, teams are already making their decisions on their final roster for the opening of the regular season next week.

text: Lakip diri ang pag-waive sa players sa training camp deals nga wala nakalab-ot sa standard roster.#
english: This includes waiving players on training camp deals that did not reach the standard roster.#

text: Arestado ang apat ka mga pulis bangud sa pagpinalupok sang pusil sa isa ka birthday party sa Barangay San Benito, Lipa City, Batangas.
english: Four policemen were arrested for firing guns at a birthday party in Barangay San Benito, Lipa City, Batangas.

text: Ang mga pulis amo sanday “Staff Sergeant Calleja” sang Lobo Police Station, Staff Sergeant Lopez sang Mataas na Kahoy Police Station, Senior Master Sergeant Caguicla sang Taysan Police Station, kag ang birthday celebrator nga si Staff Sergent Titular, 36, sang Taysan Police Station.
english: The policemen were identified as “Staff Sergeant Calleja” of Lobo Police Station, Staff Sergeant Lopez of Matahan na Kahoy Police Station, Senior Master Sergeant Caguicla of Taysan Police Station, and birthday celebrant Staff Sergeant Titular, 36, of Taysan Police Station.

text: Una nga nakabaton ang police station sang report sang pagpinalupok sang pusil kag sang ginrespondehan sa lugar, didto nakit-an ang 71 ka basiyo sang bala.
english: The police station first received a report of gunfire and when they responded to the scene, they found 71 rounds of ammunition.

text: May isa man ka residente nga nag-post sang live video sa facebook sang amo nga pagpinalupok sang pusil.
english: A resident also posted a live video on Facebook of the gunfire.

text: Gilayon naman nga ginpang-aresto ang mga pulis kag gin-disarmahan.
english: The police were immediately arrested and disarmed.

text: Ginkakas na bilang myembro sang lima ka mga gamhanan nga komitiba sa Kamara si SAGIP Partylist Representative Rodante Marcoleta.
english: SAGIP Partylist Representative Rodante Marcoleta has been removed as a member of five powerful committees in the House.

text: Ginpahayag ini sang Kamara de Representantes antes mag-break ang sesyon humalin kahapon.
english: This was announced by the House of Representatives before the break of the session from yesterday.

text: Ginduso ni House Deputy Majority Leader kag Iloilo City Lone District Rep.
english: House Deputy Majority Leader and Iloilo City Lone District Rep.

text: Julienne ‘JamJam’ Baronda ang pagkakas kay Marcoleta sa Commission on Appointments (CA) kag sa mga komite sang energy, justice, public accounts, kag constitutional amendments.
english: Julienne ‘JamJam’ Baronda announced Marcoleta’s removal from the Commission on Appointments (CA) and the energy, justice, public accounts, and constitutional amendments committees.

text: Una naman nga ginkakas si Marcoleta bilang vice chairman sang Committee on Good Governance and Public Accountability.
english: Marcoleta was earlier removed as vice chairman of the Committee on Good Governance and Public Accountability.

text: Gin-elect naman sang Kamara si Manila Teachers Party list Rep.
english: The House elected Manila Teachers Party list Rep.

text: Virgilio Lacson bulos kay Marcoleta.
english: Virgilio Lacson replaces Marcoleta.

text: “Mr. Speaker, on the part of the majority, I move to nominate and elect to the Commission on Appointments, to the Committee on Energy, to the Committee on Justice, to the Committee on Public Accounts and (the Committee on) Consti Amendments Representative Virgilio Lacson vice Rep.
english: “Mr. Speaker, on the part of the majority, I move to nominate and elect to the Commission on Appointments, to the Committee on Energy, to the Committee on Justice, to the Committee on Public Accounts and (the Committee on) Consti Amendments Representative Virgilio Lacson vice Rep.

text:
Rodante Marcoleta, so move.”

Nag-usisa naman si House Deputy Speaker kag Cebu 5th District Representative Duke Frasco nga amo ang nagapamuno sa session kun may mamalabag sa ginduso ni Baronda.
english:
Rodante Marcoleta, its bad.”

House Deputy Speaker and Cebu 5th District Representative Duke Frasco, who is chairing the session, asked if anyone would object to Baronda's proposal.

text: “Is there any objection?
english: “Is there any objection?

text:
The chair hears none, the motion is approved.”

Matandaan nga isa si Marcoleta sa mga nagdepensa kay Vice President Sara Duterte kaangot sa kuwestiyunable nga paggasto sang pondo sini sa Department of Education (DepEd) sang 2022 kag sa Office of the Vice President (OVP).
english:
The chair hears none, the motion is approved.”

It can be recalled that Marcoleta was one of those who defended Vice President Sara Duterte regarding the questionable spending of its funds in the Department of Education (DepEd) in 2022 and the Office of the Vice President (OVP).

text: Ka-sweet panumdumon kag daw extra-special gid kun may couple ka nga makilala nga pareho ang birthday.
english: It's so sweet to remember and it's extra-special when you meet a couple who share the same birthday.

text: Apang ano abi kun ang ila nga anak pareho pa gid sa ila ang birthday?
english: But what if their child has the same birthday as them?

text: Yes, triple celebration!
english: Yes, triple celebration!

text: Posible ini bangud natabo ini sa married couple didto sa Alabama, USA.
english: This is possible because it happened to a married couple in Alabama, USA.

text: Excited ang Huntsville Hospital for Women and Children sa Alabama sa pag-share nga sa amo nga pasilidad, nagbun-ag ang isa ka iloy sang baby girl sa petsa nga birthday man niya kag sang iya nga bana.
english: Huntsville Hospital for Women and Children in Alabama is excited to share that at the facility, a mother gave birth to a baby girl on the same date as her and her husband's birthday.

text: Ang mag-asawa amo sanday Cassidy kag Dylan Scott.
english: The couple is Cassidy and Dylan Scott.

text: Disyembre 18 sang ginbun-ag ni Cassidy ang ila beautiful baby girl nga ginpangalanan kay Lennon.
english: On December 18, Cassidy gave birth to their beautiful baby girl, who was named Lennon.

text: Naguwa si Lennon las 12:30 sa kaagahon, just in time for the celebration!
english: Lennon came out at 12:30 in the morning, just in time for the celebration!

text: Suno sa ospital, ini nga phenomenon ang makabig nga ‘one in 133,000 chances!’ gani espesyal gid ang case sang amo nga mag-asawa.
english: According to the hospital, this phenomenon is considered 'one in 133,000 chances!' so the case of the couple is very special.

text: Sigurado nga merry gid ang Disyembre sang tatlo bangud magluwas nga palareho ang ila nga birthday, Christmas season ini nga bulan kag ini ang most wonderful time of the year!
english: The three of them must have had a merry December because besides having the same birthday, it's Christmas season and it's the most wonderful time of the year!

text: Kay Dylan, Cassidy, kag kay Baby Lennon, happy awesome birthday!!!
english: To Dylan, Cassidy, and Baby Lennon, happy awesome birthday!!!

text: PADAYON pa ang pagnubo sang oil (langis) prices sa Pilipinas .
english: Oil prices in the Philippines continue to fall.

text: In fact, sang ulihi lang nga ini, sunod-sunod nga tatlo ka semana gid ang pag-roll back sang bili sang langis.
english: In fact, recently, the price of oil rolled back three weeks in a row.

text: Kag may ginapaabot pa ang publiko!
english: And the public has more to look forward to!

text: Nalipay gid sini ang aton pumuluyo kay makabawi na kita pagkatapos sang sunod-sunod nga pagsaka man sang bili sang langis kag pagluntad sang padayon man nga inflation, ukon pagsaka sang bili sang tanan nga balaklon.
english: This makes our people very happy because we can recover after a series of oil price increases and continuous inflation, or increases in the price of all commodities.

text: Sa nahibal-an ta na, apektado sang bili sang langis ang aton pangabuhi sa halos tanan naton nga pagginawi .
english: As we know, the price of oil affects our lives in almost all our behaviors.

text: Pataason mo ang bili sini kag magataas man ang galastuhon naton sa pagkaon, kuryente, plete, balon sang mga kabataan sa eskwelahan, kag kon ano pa.
english: You increase the price of it and our expenses for food, electricity, fares, school supplies, and so on will also increase.

text: Ugaling, sa siling gani, lain ang sugid sa hulid.
english: However, as the saying goes, the story is different behind the scenes.

text: Ang plete amo man gihapon.
english: The fare is the same.

text: Ang halos tanan nga balaklon amo man gyud.
english: Almost every commodity is the same.

text: Bisan ang bili sang bugas indi man mapilit agud mag-ariya kay sa gihapon ang komprahanay sang iban sa ginhalinan amo man gihapon.
english: Even the price of rice cannot be forced to rise because the price of others at the source is still the same.

text: Matuod, halos  wala man gareklamo ang may ikasarang, samtang gapamurug-ot ang mga pigado na nga daan nga gapalibug kon ano na lang ang himuon nila agud mabuhi.
english: True, the rich hardly complain, while the already poor struggle to survive.

text: Ang iban basi mangawat na gid lang kag magdugang sing problema sa aton kapulisan kag iban pa nga may otoridad.
english: Others may steal and add to the problems of our police and other authorities.

text: Sa sina nga sitwasyon, matakos ta ang kabakud sang pag-unonongay sang pamilya agud makabulig sa mga ginakulang.
english: In that situation, we can measure the strength of family unity to help those in need.

text: Apang, ano na lang kon pigado man ang tanan?
english: But, what if everyone is poor too?

text: Mamui-musi lang sang aton mata kag maghulat sang ayuda sang gobyerno?
english: Just close our eyes and wait for government aid?

text: Ina kon may mabulig man ang gobyerno.
english: That's if the government can help.

text: Kabay pa nga may mabulig gid ang aton gobyerno sa sining mapiut nga panahon sa aton pangabuhi.
english: May our government help us in this difficult time in our lives.

text:
***

Samtang, ang gobyerno nagapabugal pa nga sigehon gid ang  pagpatong sang ikaduha ka round sang excise tax sa langis nga P2 kada litro sa sunod nga tuig.
english:
***

Meanwhile, the government is still boasting that it will continue to impose the second round of excise tax on oil of P2 per liter next year.

text: Man, ang ila pakot amo nga magasige-sige na gid lang ang pagnubo, ukon ang pagpabilin, sang bili sang langis sa karon.
english: Man, their net is that the price of oil will continue to fall, or stay, for now.

text: Pero, indi na gid bala magsaka pa ang bili sang langis, at least sa sulod sang masunod nga tuig, 2019?
english: But, won’t oil prices rise further, at least during the next year, 2019?

text: Gaduha-duha kita sini.
english: We doubt it.

text: Ang balita naton nga naga-worry man gani ang 15 ka dalagku nga myembro sang Organization of Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC) sa sining sige pagnubo sang bili sang langis sa world market kay daku ang  epekto sini sa ila negosyo.
english: Our news is that even the 15 major members of the Organization of Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC) are worried about the continuous decline in oil prices in the world market because it has a huge impact on their businesses.

text: Angot diri, ma-meeting gani ang OPEC sa Disyembre 6 agud tan-awon ang ila kahimtangan tungod sa sining pagnubo sang bili sang langis.
english: In this regard, OPEC will meet on December 6 to see their situation due to the drop in oil prices.

text: Ina tungod ginadabukan pa sang Estados Unidos ini sa pagpataas sang ila produksyon sang krudo nga nagapanubo sang bili sang langis.
english: That's because the United States is still burning it to increase its crude oil production which lowers the price of oil.

text: Ang Estados Unidos sa karon ang No.
english: The United States is currently the No.

text: 1 producir sang oil, bisan pa nga ang Saudi gapabilin ang may pinakamataas nga reserba sang oil.
english: 1 producer of oil, although Saudi remains the largest oil reserves.

text: Daw wala ugaling seguro ining pagpataas sang produksyon sang Estados Unidos sang oil – sa duso ni President Trump – kay madamo na sang mga producir sini ang nagareklamo sa pag-amat-amat huyang sang ila negosyo sa oil.
english: However, this increase in US oil production – at the urging of President Trump – seems unlikely, as many of its producers are already complaining about the gradual weakening of their oil business.

text: In fact, ang pagnubo mismo sang quota sa kon ano lang kadamo sang langis ang ma-producir sang 200 ka pungsod nga katapo sang Paris Summit makapataas na sang bili sang langis sa idalom sang Law of Supply and Demand.
english: In fact, the very reduction of the quota on how much oil can be produced by the 200 countries that are members of the Paris Summit can already raise the price of oil under the Law of Supply and Demand.

text: Ang Paris Summit katapuan ini sang mga pungsod nga nagapakigbato sa global warming ukon Climate Change, partikular sa pagpugong nga indi magdangat sa 2 degrees Celsius ang init sang kalibutan.
english: The Paris Summit is a meeting of countries fighting global warming or Climate Change, particularly to prevent global warming from reaching 2 degrees Celsius.

text: Sa pagnubo sang produksyon (supply) sang mga myembro sang Paris Summit, magataas man ang bili sang langis tungod sa pagtaas man sang pagka-kinahanglan (demand).
english: With the decline in production (supply) of the members of the Paris Summit, the price of oil will also rise due to the increase in demand.

text: Tungod sini, gapati kita nga liwat magasaka ang bili sng langis sa world market sa pagsugod sang tuig 2019, ukon sa sini na mismo nga Disyembre./PN
english: Because of this, we believe that the price of oil in the world market will rise again at the beginning of 2019, or this December.

text: Indi lamang sa imported rice ipatuman ang maximum suggested retail price (MSRP) kundi sa iban pa gid nga mga produkto.
english: The maximum suggested retail price (MSRP) will be implemented not only on imported rice but also on other products.

text: Suno sa Department of Agriculture (DA), mahimo man ini iimplementar sa iban nga imported food commodities kaangay sang vegetables kag karne.
english: According to the Department of Agriculture (DA), it can also be implemented in other imported food commodities such as vegetables and meat.

text: Suno pa kay Agriculture Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel, Jr., nagapakig-angot na sila sa Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) agud padayon nga magpangita sang mga paagi nga mabuhinan ang palas-anon sa pinansyal sang mga Pilipino.
english: Agriculture Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel, Jr. said they are already working with the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) to continue looking for ways to reduce the financial burden of Filipinos.

text: Ginpahayag naman ni Trade Secretary Ma.
english: Trade Secretary Ma.

text: Cristina A. Roque nga iga-convene sini ang National Price Coordinating Council agud marepaso ang mga estratehiya sa pagpa-estable sang presyo.
english: Cristina A. Roque said it will convene the National Price Coordinating Council to review price stabilization strategies.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag sang DA nga posible sa katapusan sang bulan nila ma-finalize ang MSRP para sa imported rice para nga malikawan ang manipulasyon sa presyo.
english: Earlier, the DA said it is possible by the end of the month to finalize the MSRP for imported rice to avoid price manipulation.

text: Balik na sa court National Basketball Association (NBA) ang Chicago Bulls guard nga si Lonzo Ball matapos ang tatlo ka operasyon sa iya tuhod kag masobra duha ka tuig man nga pagpahuway.
english: Chicago Bulls guard Lonzo Ball is back on the court after three knee surgeries and more than two years of rest.

text: Ang pagbalik sang 26-anyos nga guard ang ginhimo kadungan sang hampang sang Bulls batok sa Minnesota Timberwolves sa preseason.
english: The 26-year-old guard’s return was timed to coincide with the Bulls’ preseason game against the Minnesota Timberwolves.

text: “Checking in for the Chicago Bulls!
english: “Checking in for the Chicago Bulls!

text: No.
english: No.

text: Lonzo Ball!,” ang anunsyo sa arena nga madugay man nga ginkalangkagan sang fans.
english: Lonzo Ball!,” was the announcement in the arena that fans had also been looking forward to for a long time.

text: Ini ang iya una nga hampang halin sang Enero 14, 2022 kag ginhatagan sang standing ovation sang mga tumalan-aw sa United Center sang naka-tres ini gilayon.
english: It was his first game since Jan. 14, 2022 and was given a standing ovation by the crowd at the United Center when he immediately hit a three.

text: Nagtakop ang hampang nga may 10 points, 1 assist, kag 1 rebound si Ball sa 15 minutos nga pag-upod sini sa Bulls.
english: Ball finished the game with 10 points, 1 assist, and 1 rebound in 15 minutes with the Bulls.

text: 125-123 ang score pabor sa Chicago.
english: The score was 125-123 in favor of Chicago.

text: “It felt a lot better playing than watching, I’ll say that much,” suno sa 26-anyos nga basketball star.
english: “It felt a lot better playing than watching, I’ll say that much,” the 26-year-old basketball star said.

text:
“I can’t even really put into words how I felt out there.”

“Just blessed, man,” dugang ni Ball.
english:
“I can’t even really put into words how I felt out there.”

“Just blessed, man,” Ball added.

text: “There were a lot of people that helped me get here, not just myself.
english: “There were a lot of people that helped me get here, not just myself.

text: Just to see the crowd and all the love I get from the city, man, you cannot replicate that in any type of way.
english: Just to see the crowd and all the love I get from the city, man, you cannot replicate that in any type of way.

text:
And it’s real.”

Nahibaluan nga nagpaidalom si Ball sa meniscus operation sang Enero 2022, ginsundan sang arthroscopic surgery, kag nagpaidalom pa gid sa cartilage transplant surgery.
english:
And it’s real.”

Ball underwent meniscus surgery in January 2022, followed by arthroscopic surgery, and further underwent cartilage transplant surgery.

text: Apisar madamo na ang naagyan, daku ang paglaum sang former No.
english: Despite having been through a lot, the former No. 1 has high hopes.

text: 2 overall draft pick nga mabuligan niya ang Bulls subong nga season.
english: 2 overall draft pick that he can help the Bulls this season.

text: May isa pa ka preseason game ang Bulls batok sa Clevecland Cavaliers 8:00 buwas sa aga (PH TIME) antes ang pagbukas sang regular season para sa team sa New Orleans sa Oktubre 23.#
english: The Bulls have one more preseason game against the Clevecland Cavaliers at 8:00 tomorrow morning (PH TIME) before the regular season opener for the team in New Orleans on October 23.#

text: ILOILO CITY-Hugot nga ginakampanya ni Iloilo 3rd District Representative Lorenz Defensor  ang pagpatukod sang Children’s Medical Center sa Visayas kag Mindanao.
english: ILOILO CITY-Iloilo 3rd District Representative Lorenz Defensor is strongly campaigning for the establishment of Children's Medical Centers in the Visayas and Mindanao.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Cong.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Cong.

text: Lorenz Defensor, iya ginpahayag nga katuyuan sang iya gin-file nga House bill 6140 ang makapatukod sang ospital nga nagadedikar sa kabataan ilabi na ang mga pigado nga indi makasarang nga gastuhan ang ila pagbulong.
english: Lorenz Defensor, he said the purpose of his filed House bill 6140 is to establish a hospital dedicated to children especially the poor who cannot afford to pay for their treatment.

text: Suno kay Defensor, ang nasambit nga mga ospital ang plano nga tukuron sa banwa sang Pavia ukon sa Sta.
english: According to Defensor, the hospitals are planned to be built in Pavia or Sta.

text: Barbara diri sa Visayas samtang sa bahin sang Mindanao ini ang plano nga patindugon sa Davao City.
english: Barbara here in the Visayas while in Mindanao it is planned to be built in Davao City.

text: Sa subong, yara na sa Committee on Health ang nasambit nga hagna kag sa pagpakigsugilanon ni Defensor kay Cong.
english: The bill is currently in the Committee on Health and in Defensor's talks with Cong.

text: Angelina Tan, chairman sang kumitiba, mahimo nga italana ang committee hearing para sa nasambit nga hagna sa Pebrero 24.
english: Angelina Tan, chairman of the committee, may schedule a committee hearing for the bill on February 24.

text: Dugang pa ni Defensor, imbitaron sa nasambit nga committee hearing ang mga tiglawas sang Department of Health, mga myembro sang Board of Trustees sang  Children’s Medical Center sa Luzon kag iban pa nga stakeholders agud makakuha sang commitment kag maduso pa ang nasambit ng hagna.
english: Defensor said representatives of the Department of Health, members of the Board of Trustees of the Children's Medical Center in Luzon and other stakeholders will be invited to the committee hearing to obtain commitment and push the bill forward.

text: Ginabanta nga yara sa P5billion ang budget para sa nasambit nga mga ospital apang ginatugyan na lamang  sang kongresista sa Committee  on Appropiration ang budget para sa duha ka mga medical centers.
english: The budget for the said hospitals is estimated at P5billion but the congressman is leaving the budget for the two medical centers to the Committee on Appropriation.

text: Nagdaog si Miss Universe 2018 Catriona Gray sa libel case nga iya ginpasaka batok sa isa ka entertainment editor kag isa ka writer sang 2020.
english: Miss Universe 2018 Catriona Gray won the libel case she filed against an entertainment editor and a writer in 2020.

text: Ginkumpirma ini sang iya legal counsel nga si Atty. Joji Alondo nga nagpakigbahin man sang desisyon sang Regional Trial Court (RTC).
english: This was confirmed by his legal counsel, Atty. Joji Alondo who also shared the decision of the Regional Trial Court (RTC).

text: Ang respondents sa kaso amo ang editor sang Bulgar nga si Janice Navida kag reporter nga si Melba Llanera.
english: Respondents in the case are Bulgar editor Janice Navida and reporter Melba Llanera.

text: Pareho sila nga nagguwa nga “guilty beyond reasonable doubt” kag ginpamatbatan sang minimum nga anum ka bulan kag isa ka adlaw nga pagka-preso.
english: Both appeared “guilty beyond reasonable doubt” and were sentenced to a minimum of six months and one day in prison.

text: Gintawag ini sang kampo ni Gray nga “moral victory” kag ginpasalamatan man ang beauty queen sa pagsalig sa iya mga abogado apisar nga indi man mahapos ang proseso.
english: Gray’s camp called it a “moral victory” and also thanked the beauty queen for trusting her lawyers despite the process not being easy.

text: “Thank you Cat for the trust you have reposed on us.
english: “Thank you Cat for the trust you have reposed on us.

text: The journey was not an easy tread but it is all worth it… This is not just a judicial win but a moral victory!” pahayag sang legal counsel sa isa ka Instagram post.
english: The journey was not an easy tread but it is all worth it… This is not just a judicial win but a moral victory!” legal counsel said in an Instagram post.

text: Matandaan nga gin-file ni Cat ang reklamo sang Hulyo 2020 sang gin-release sang Bulgar ang iya peke ukon gin-photoshop lamang nga topless photo kag madasig ini nga naglapta online.
english: Cat filed the complaint in July 2020 when Bulgar released her fake or photoshopped topless photo and it quickly spread online.

text: Sa isa ka statement, nagdepensa si Navida nga ginproteksyunan man nila si Cat paagi sa pag-blur sang laragway kag wala man gin-release ang original picture.Natalana nga i-appeal sang duha ang desisyon sang RTC.
english: In a statement, Navida defended that they also protected Cat by blurring the picture and not releasing the original picture. The two are scheduled to appeal the RTC's decision.

text: ILOILO CITY-Ginbasol ni anay Department of Health Secretary kag subong 1st district representative Janet Garin ang  Department of Health sa sala nga balita tuhoy sa novel Coronavirus nga nangin rason sang pagpanic sang publiko.
english: ILOILO CITY-Former Department of Health Secretary and current 1st district representative Janet Garin blamed the Department of Health for the false news about the novel Coronavirus that caused panic among the public.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo Iloilo kay Congresswoman Garin, iya ginpahayag nga napaslawan ang ahensya sa pagpamuno ni Sec.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Iloilo, Congresswoman Garin said the agency under the leadership of Sec.

text: Francisco Duque III nga madul-ong  sa publiko ang mga importante nga impormasyon tuhoy sa novel coronavirus scare.
english: Francisco Duque III to bring to the public important information about the novel coronavirus scare.

text: Suno  kay Garin,isa sa nangin  kakulangan sang ahensiya amo ang indi gilayon nga pagpatigayon sang command conference agud ipahibalo sa publiko ang pinakaulihi nga  impormasyon nga ginapagwa sang World Health Organization.
english: According to Garin, one of the shortcomings of the agency is the failure to hold a command conference immediately to inform the public of the latest information released by the World Health Organization.

text: Dugang pa  ni Garin, importante man ang pag-appoint sang isa ka speakers bureau nga amo ang magapagwa  sa publiko sang mga impormasyon tuhoy  sa Novel Coronavirus.
english: Garin added that it is also important to appoint a speakers bureau that will release information about the Novel Coronavirus to the public.

text: Suno pa kay  Garin, wala man gilayo naka -activate sang task force ang Department of Health nga magatutok sa nasambit nga health scare.
english: Garin said the Department of Health did not immediately activate a task force to focus on the health scare.

text: Pahayag sang natungdan, ini ang mga rason kun ngaa nagsalangisag ang mga tawo kag nagpanic buying bangud sa pagpati sa naglapta nga mga sala nga impormasyon.
english: He said these are the reasons why people are panicking and panic buying because of believing in the spread of false information.

text: Nag-abanse na sa finals sang PBA Governors Cup ang defending champion nga TNT Tropang Giga matapos ginlutos ang Rain or Shine, 113-95, sa Game 5 sang semifinal playoff sa PBA Season 49 Governors’ Cup sa Ynares Center sa Antipolo.
english: Defending champion TNT Tropang Giga advanced to the finals of the PBA Governors Cup after beating Rain or Shine, 113-95, in Game 5 of the semifinal playoff of the PBA Season 49 Governors' Cup at the Ynares Center in Antipolo.

text: Sang nagtakop ang first quarter, 28-25, ginapasagunsunan ini sang TNT sang 12-0 sa pagbukas sang second quarter kag ginlimitahan lamang ang Elasto Painters sa 14 points sa amo nga frame.
english: When the first quarter ended, 28-25, TNT followed it up with a 12-0 run to open the second quarter and limited the Elasto Painters to 14 points in that frame.

text: Wala na nag-preno ang team halin sang nakuha sini ang 56-39 lead sa first half.
english: The team hasn’t hit the brakes since taking a 56-39 lead in the first half.

text: Nagpanguna sa team si Rondae Hollis-Jefferson nga amo man ang import nga naghakwat sa tropa para makuha ang kampyonato sa amo man nga conference sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: The team was led by Rondae Hollis-Jefferson, the same import who lifted the team to the championship in the same conference last year.

text: Ginbubo sini ang 36 points, 11 rebounds, nine assists, kag six steals sa sambuwa nga amo ang nagtapos sa best-of-seven series, 4-1.
english: He poured in 36 points, 11 rebounds, nine assists, and six steals in the game that ended the best-of-seven series, 4-1.

text: Ini man ang nagpabalik kay Coach Chot Reyes sa finals sa PBA sa labing-una nga tion halin sang nagbalik ini sa TNT bench sang nagligad nga season.
english: It also sent Coach Chot Reyes back to the finals in the PBA for the first time since returning to the TNT bench last season.

text: Hulaton na lamang sang TNT ang winner sa tunga sang semis series sang Barangay Ginebra kag San Miguel kun sa diin gina-uyatan na sang Gin Kings ang lead, 3-2, matapos ang 121-92 nga resulta sang hampang sa Game 5 subong man nga gab-i.

text: PENSAR ko anay neutral, ukon wala pinilian, ang serbisyo sang mga ospital sa pagtatap sang ila mga pasyente.
english: I ONCE thought that hospitals were neutral, or impartial, in the way they treated their patients.

text: Syempre, indi lang sa ila kinahanglanon agud matatap sa kon ano man nga sablag ukon balatian nga ila ginapadangat sa ospital, kundi pati man ang makapahalipay sa ila, katulad sang pagtan-aw sa ila paborito nga programa sa TV.
english: Of course, not only for their needs to be treated for whatever obstacle or illness they bring to the hospital, but also for what makes them happy, such as watching their favorite TV program.

text: Pero, kon matuod ang reklamo sang isa ka pasyente sa isa ka private room sa isa man ka pribado nga ospital, nga indi lang ugaling niya luyag hingadlan, makatan-aw ka lang diri sang mga programa sa TV sa isa gid lang ka channel.
english: However, if the complaint of a patient in a private room in another private hospital, who does not want to be named, is true, you can only watch TV programs on one channel.

text: Kon matuod, masubo matuod ini.
english: If true, it is sad indeed.

text: Kay sa lugar nga mabuligan ang pasyente agud maumpawan sa iya ginabatyag basi maglala pa kay magalain lang ang iya buot.
english: Because instead of helping the patient to be comforted by his feelings, he might get worse because he will become angry.

text: Ina tungod indi niya matan-aw ang paborito niya nga programa sa TV, labi na gid kon ang ginapatan-aw sa iya indi gid niya maluyagan.
english: That's because he can't watch his favorite TV program, especially if he doesn't like what he's watching.

text: Personal sa akon, nagatan-aw ako sa programa nga naluyagan ko kag indi tungod tutok lang sa isa ka TV channel.
english: Personally, I watch the program that I like and not because it is focused on one TV channel.

text: Ang paborito ko gid nga mga programa ang yara sa ugto.
english: My favorite programs are the ones at noon.

text: May masadya.
english: Something fun.

text: May komedya.
english: There is comedy.

text: May bastante nga mga premyo nga makabulig sa madamo nga pigado.
english: There are enough prizes to help many poor people.

text: May human interest.
english: There is a human interest.

text: May leksyon nga makuha, kag iban pa.
english: There’s a lesson to be learned, and so on.

text: Kon kis-a, ugaling, may wala man ako sing maluyagan dira, labi na gid kon binastos nga makapalain sa mga kabataan nga makatan-aw.
english: Sometimes, though, I don't like it, especially if it's rude and offensive to children who might see it.

text: Gilayon ako sina magsaylo channel kag magbalik lang ugaling sa channel nga naluyagan ko.
english: I immediately switch channels and go back to the channel I like.

text: Tani, ma-intiendihan ining problema sa luyag tan-awon sang mga pasyente sang sining pribado nga ospital.
english: Hopefully, this problem will be understood by the patients of this private hospital.

text:
***

To be fair sa sining ospital, naluyagan ta man ang serbisyo sini.
english:
***

To be fair to this hospital, we also like its service.

text: Matinahaon kag pirme lang maaliwalas ang mga nawong ang iya empleyado halin sa security guard tubtub sa nagatatap sa mga kwarto sang pasyente.
english: His employees, from the security guard to the patient's room attendant, are polite and always have a smile on their faces.

text: May naga-“Good Morning” kag maabtik magsabat kag bisan magtudlo personal sa gapabulig nga mga bisita.
english: There are those who say “Good Morning” and are quick to respond and even teach personally to helpful visitors.

text: Orderly kag limpyo ang tanan nga halos wala ka sing masimhutan nga indi amo sa bisan diin nga kanto.
english: Everything was so orderly and clean that you could hardly smell anything out of the ordinary in any corner.

text: Maluag ang mga alley nga makapasulhay sang paginhawa sang bisan sang nagabakho nga mga nagaduaw sa mga nalisdan nga mga pasyente.
english: The alleys are wide enough to ease the breathing of even the weeping visitors to the distressed patients.

text: Matahum ang mga talan-awon sa palibot sang ospital sang madasig nga naga-ugad nga siyudad sang Iloilo.
english: The scenery around the hospital of the rapidly growing city of Iloilo is beautiful.

text: In other words, ang ining ospital isa ka quality medical facility sa diin matatapan ka gid sing maayo, luas lang sa sining reklamo sang pagpagwa sang isa gid lang ka TV channel nga makapalain sing buot sang pasyente nga may paborito nga talan-awon sa iban nga channel.
english: In other words, this hospital is a quality medical facility where you will be well cared for, except for this complaint of broadcasting only one TV channel that can offend the patient who has a favorite view on another channel.

text: Tani indi lang pagdid-an ang mga pasyente sang ila luyag tan-awon sa TV nga makapahalipay sa ila.
english: I wish patients weren't just denied what they wanted to watch on TV that made them happy.

text: Man makabulig man ina padasig sang ila pag-ayo tungod malingaw sila sa pagtan-aw sa ila paborito nga TV program sa kon diin nga channel nga luyag nila.
english: It will also help speed up their recovery because they will enjoy watching their favorite TV program on whichever channel they want.

text: Kun kadamo gani sang ulubrahon sa opisina, wala-tuo ang reklamo nga imo mabatian.

text: Isa ka financial manager nga nagaobra sa national railway network sang Ireland ang nagreklamo bangud ginabayaran lang siya kuno sang ginabanta $130,000 ukon yara sa P7.2 million kada tuig agud lang nga magkaon sang iya panyaga kag magbasa lang sang pahayagan bilog nga adlaw!

english: He said that when he became a whistleblower of the company's accounting in 2014, he was fired from his job until the only job left was eating and reading the newspaper.

text: Apisar sini, nagaabot ang regular paycheck kada bulan kag nagaabot gid ang iya nga sweldo.

text: Kun kaisa suno kay Dermot, naga-check man sya sang emails apang wala man sang emails nga kaangot sa work, wala man sang messages, wala sang communications, kag wala man siya sang communication mangin sa iya nga mga katrabaho.

text: Sa Estados Unidos, laban sang nagabisyo sa droga mga linghod nga nagapang-edaron sang 18 tubtub 20 anyos.

text: Kag bisan man seguro sa iban nga pungsod, lakip ang sa aton.

text: Indi ini katingalahan tungod sa sini nga pang-edaron ang mga kabataan mahuyog gid sa pagpangalipay ukon recreational activities.

text: Natural nga ugali ini sang mga kabataan sa diin man nga pungsod ukon kultura tungod sa kabaskug nga ganoy sang ila naturalisa.

text: MAATHAG nga may exclusivo nga kinamatarong sa Scarborough Shoal ang Pilipinas tungod sakop ini sa 200-mile exclusive economic zone (EEZ) nga natalana sang United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS) sa kada nasyon.
english: The Philippines clearly has exclusive rights to the Scarborough Shoal as it is part of the 200-mile exclusive economic zone (EEZ) set by the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS) for each country.

text: Myembro ang China sang UNCLOS kag dapat kilalahon sini ang kinamatarong sang Pilipinas sa Scarborough Shoal.
english: China is a member of UNCLOS and should recognize the Philippines' right to the Scarborough Shoal.

text: Kon indi, katulad sang pilit nga pag-angkon sa Scarborough Shoal, ang China dapat manabat sa kasaypanan sini.
english: Otherwise, similar to the forced claim to the Scarborough Shoal, China must be held accountable for its mistake.

text: In fact, ginkaso ini sang Pilipinas sa International Tribunal on Law of the Sea (ITLOS) kag sang 2016 gani nagdaug ang Pilipinas kontra sa China sa ini nga isyu sang Scarborough Shoal.
english: In fact, the Philippines sued the International Tribunal on Law of the Sea (ITLOS) and in 2016 the Philippines won against China on the Scarborough Shoal issue.

text: Ugaling lang kay gingamitan ini sang China sang Law of the Jungle nga “Might is Right” sa pag-claim sa halos bug-os nga South China Sea.
english: However, China has used the Law of the Jungle “Might is Right” to claim almost the entire South China Sea.

text: Dapat makilala sang China nga wala sing permanente nga territorial sovereignty, ukon gahum nga makaugalingon sa isa ka teritoryo, bisan pa tungod sang “historic right”.
english: China must recognize that there is no permanent territorial sovereignty, or power independent of a territory, even by virtue of “historic right”.

text: Ang kasaysayan sang kalibutan testigo sang pagbaylo-baylo sang mga dulonan (boundaries) sang mga territoryo tungod sa pag-ilinaway kag pagsakop ukon pagyaub man sang mga territoryo tungod sini.
english: The history of the world is witness to the changing of the boundaries of territories due to conflict and conquest or subjugation of territories as a result.

text: Lakip man dira ang paghilisugot, ukon tungod sa kasuguan katulad sang UNCLOS.
english: This includes agreement, or because of laws such as UNCLOS.

text: Amo gani nga ang kinamatarong sa soberanya (sovereignty) indi masiling nga permanente nga kinamatarong.
english: That is why the right to sovereignty cannot be said to be a permanent right.

text: Dapat tindugan ukon awayon gid ini tubtub makilala kag tagaan sing respeto sang iban nga nasyon.
english: It must be fought for until it is recognized and respected by other nations.

text: Ugaling mahuyang nga nasyon ang Pilipinas kag wala sing ikasarang sa pag-pakigbato sang iya kinamatarong sa sadto gina-okupar nga Scarborough Shoal, kundi ipaagi lang ini sa diplomasya nga amo karon ang naton ginahimo.
english: But the Philippines is a weak country and does not have the ability to fight for its rights to the then occupied Scarborough Shoal, but only through diplomacy which is what we are doing now.

text: Isa pa, komitido kita sa panindugan sang United Nations agud solbaron ang aton hiligut-anon sa malinong lang nga pamaagi.
english: Furthermore, we are committed to the position of the United Nations to resolve our conflict through peaceful means.

text: Sa karon, may pag-intiendihanay (Memorandum of Understanding) ang China kag Pilipinas sa isa ka joint venture sa gas and oil exploration sa West Philippine Sea nga sa sulod sang EEZ naton.
english: Currently, China and the Philippines have a Memorandum of Understanding on a joint venture in gas and oil exploration in the West Philippine Sea within our EEZ.

text: Ini bala nagakahulugan nga gina-surrender na naton ang aton kinamatarong sa aton exclusive right sa EEZ sa West Philippine Sea?
english: Does this mean that we are surrendering our right to our exclusive right to the EEZ in the West Philippine Sea?

text: Basta ang MOU wala lang nagabungat nga ang China sakop sang iya soberanya ang ining proyekto sa sulod sang West Philippine Sea, okey lang ina kay mahulog lang ina sa isa ka international joint venture nga pwede entrahan sang bisan sin-o nga nasyon.
english: As long as the MOU does not state that China's sovereignty over this project within the West Philippine Sea, that's okay because it falls into an international joint venture that can be entered into by any country.

text: Kag tani amo lang ina ang buot silingon sang MOU sa bahin sang China.
english: And I hope that’s all the MOU means on the Chinese side.

NOT all retailers followed the Suggested Retailer Price (SRP) for rice, except for NFA Rice which is sold at P27/k, at the very beginning of its implementation on November 17 in Iloilo City.

text: Sa Mandurriao Public Market, por ejemplo, ang iban nagpatuman gid sing lubos sang SRP sa bugas.
english: In the Mandurriao Public Market, for example, some have fully implemented the SRP on rice.

text: Ang ila baligya sang commercial rice sunu gid sa gintalana nga SRP: Regular Milled Rice (local) – P39 kada kilo; Well-Milled Rice (local) – P44/k; kag Premium Rice (local) – P47.
english: They sell commercial rice according to the SRP: Regular Milled Rice (local) – P39 per kilo; Well-Milled Rice (local) – P44/k; and Premium Rice (local) – P47.

text:
May tatlo gani ka klase nga Well-Milled Rice (mas kilala naton nga White Rice) ang ginabaligya diri: P44/k, P42.00/k kag P40/k.

Base sa aton pag-reseach, ma-clasificar man ang White Rice sandig sa kalabaon (length) sang uyas – long grain, medium ukon short – nga mabasehan man sang ila lain-lain nga presyo.
english:
There are even three types of Well-Milled Rice (better known as White Rice) sold here: P44/k, P42.00/k and P40/k.

Based on our research, White Rice can also be classified according to the length of the grain – long grain, medium or short – which is also based on their different prices.

text: Ugaling may mga retailer diri sa Mandurriao Public Market nga wala man nagasunod sa SRP.
english: However, there are retailers here in Mandurriao Public Market who do not follow the SRP.

text:
Sa isa ka tindahan, ang pagbaligya sang bugas yara sa gihapon sa daan nga presyo: Regular Milled Rice (local) – P40/k; Well-Milled Rice (local) – P45/k; Well-Milled Rice (local) – P43/k; Premium Rice (local) – P52/k.; Special Rice – P53/k.

Sunu sa tindero nga wala nagsunod sa SRP sang bugas diri sa Mandurriao Public Market, ginbaton man kuno sang NFA inspector ang indi nila pagsunod sing lubos sa SRP.
english:
In one store, the sale of rice is still at the old price: Regular Milled Rice (local) – P40/k; Well-Milled Rice (local) – P45/k; Well-Milled Rice (local) – P43/k; Premium Rice (local) – P52/k.; Special Rice – P53/k.

According to the vendor who did not comply with the SRP of rice here in Mandurriao Public Market, the NFA inspector also accepted their non-compliance with the SRP.

text: Gin-explicar kuno niya sa NFA inspector nga ang ulihi nga stock nila yara pa sa mataas nga pagbakal, gani indi pa sila makasunod sa SRP.
english: He allegedly explained to the NFA inspector that their last stock was still in high purchase, so they could not yet comply with the SRP.

text: Otherwise, mapierde kuno sila.
english: Otherwise, they're supposed to lose.

text: Nagpasalig ugaling siya sa NFA nga panubuon man nila ang ila presyo sa SRP sa sunod nga mas barato nga pagbakal nila sa ginhalinan sang ila kompra.
english: He however assured the NFA that they will also reduce their price to the SRP the next time they buy cheaper from the source of their purchase.

text: Nagsugot man ang NFA.
english: The NFA agreed.

text: Sa nagapadayon nga pag-alburuto sang Bulkang Mayon sa Albay madamo sa mga evacuee ang nagamasakit na bangud sa nagapadayon nga pagdamo sang mga tawo sa evacuation centers.
english: With the ongoing eruption of Volcano Mayon in Albay, many of the evacuees are getting sick due to the continuous increase in the number of people in the evacuation centers.

text: Sa Tobaco City pa lamang, masobra 1,700 ka mga indibidwal ang nagapabilin sa mga evacuation center para sa temporary nga estaran.
english: In Tobaco City alone, more than 1,700 individuals remain in evacuation centers for temporary shelter.

text: Nakaangkon naman ang mga ini sang ubo, sp-on kag iban pa nga sakit bangud man sa ini sa sulod sang tent.
english: They suffered from cough, sp-on and other illnesses because of being inside the tent.

text: Nagapabilin ang Alert Level 3 sa Mayon bangud sa banta sang pyroclastic density currents, lava flow, kag rockfall.
english: Alert Level 3 remains in Mayon due to the threat of pyroclastic density currents, lava flow, and rockfall.

text: Hugot nman nga ginabawal ang pagsulod sa 6-kilometro nga Permanent Danger Zone.
english: Entry into the 6-kilometer Permanent Danger Zone is strictly prohibited.

text: Padayon naman nga ginamonitor sang PHIVOLCS ang pagtaas sang asktibidad sang bulkan samtang nagapadayon ang paghalin sang mga residente sa mga apektado nga lugar.
english: PHIVOLCS continues to monitor the increase in volcanic activity as residents continue to evacuate from affected areas.
