Natagpuang wala nang buhay ang isang 21-anyos na college student matapos barilin ang sarili sa loob ng isang simbahan sa Barangay Poblacion, Passi City, Iloilo.
english:
Reader discretion advised.]

A 21-year-old college student was found dead after shooting himself inside a church in Barangay Poblacion, Passi City, Iloilo.

text: Kinilala ang biktima sa alyas na Kenneth, residente ng Calinog, Iloilo at kumukuha ng kursong Bachelor of Science in Business Administration sa Passi City College.
english: The victim was identified as Kenneth, resident of Calinog, Iloilo and studying Bachelor of Science in Business Administration at Passi City College.

text: Ayon sa testigong si alyas Nato, nakita niya ang binata na bumaba mula sa isang tricycle at pumasok sa simbahan.
english: According to witness alias Nato, he saw the young man get off a tricycle and enter the church.

text: Makalipas ang ilang minuto, nakarinig siya ng malakas na putok at nang silipin ang loob, nadatnan na niyang duguan at wala nang buhay ang biktima habang hawak pa ang baril na ginamit.
english: After a few minutes, he heard a loud gunshot and when he looked inside, he found the victim bleeding and dead while still holding the gun used.

text: Batay sa imbestigasyon, sinabi ni PLT.
english: Based on the investigation, PLT said.

text: Sharina Cepeda, Deputy Chief of Police ng Passi City, na ito na ang ikalawang tangka ng biktima na kitilin ang sariling buhay.
english: Sharina Cepeda, Deputy Chief of Police of Passi City, said that this is the second attempt of the victim to commit suicide.

text: Narekober mula sa kanyang bag ang dalawang cellphone, isang papel na naglalaman ng password, at isang suicide note para sa kanyang pamilya.
english: Two cellphones, a piece of paper containing a password, and a suicide note for his family were recovered from his bag.

text: Lumabas din na nasa Maynila ang mga magulang ng biktima at mag-isa lang itong naninirahan sa kanilang bahay sa Calinog.
english: It also turned out that the victim's parents are in Manila and live alone in their house in Calinog.

text: Walang foul play na nakikita ang mga awtoridad at posibleng may kinalaman sa problema sa pamilya ang mot
english: Authorities are not seeing any foul play and the mot may have been related to family problems

text: Ginpanagtag sang Department of Agrarian Reform (DAR) ang kabug-usan nga 13,500 ka hektarya sang duta sa masobra 5,000 ka Agrarian Reform Beneficiaries (ARBs) sa Western Visayas.
english: The Department of Agrarian Reform (DAR) has distributed a total of 13,500 hectares of land to more than 5,000 Agrarian Reform Beneficiaries (ARBs) in Western Visayas.

text: Personal nga gin-turn over ni DAR Secretary Conrado Estrella III ang mga titulo sa ginhiwat nga ceremonial distribution kahapon nga adlaw Enero 12 sa Pototan Astrodome sa Pototan Iloilo.
english: DAR Secretary Conrado Estrella III personally turned over the titles at the ceremonial distribution held yesterday, January 12, at the Pototan Astrodome in Pototan, Iloilo.

text: Base sa datos sang DAR, 2,248 ka e-titles ang gin-release sa masobra 2,000 ka mga ARBs sa Capiz; masobra 1,400 ka e-titles sa 1,717 ka ARBs sa Iloilo; masobra 1,100 ka e-titles sa 1,107 ka ARBs sa Antique; 804 ka e-titles sa 496 ka ARBs sa Guimaras; kag 463 ka e-titles sa 461 ka ARBs sa Aklan.
english: Based on DAR data, 2,248 e-titles were released to more than 2,000 ARBs in Capiz; more than 1,400 e-titles in 1,717 ARBs in Iloilo; more than 1,100 e-titles in 1,107 ARBs in Antique; 804 e-titles in 496 ARBs in Guimaras; and 463 e-titles in 461 ARBs in Aklan.

text: Suno kay Estrella, ang Western Visayas amo ang pinaka-una nga rehiyon subong nga tuig nga nakabaton sang daku nga land title distribution.
english: According to Estrella, Western Visayas is the first region this year to receive a large land title distribution.

text: Ginpabutyag man sini ang iya nga kalipay nga nahatag na ang titulo sang mga mangunguma nga pila na ka dekada ang naghulat agud mapanag-iyahan ang ila ginapanguma nga duta.
english: He also expressed his satisfaction that the title has been given to the farmers who have been waiting for decades to own their land.

text: Ginpahanumduman man ni Estrella ang mga beneficiaries nga tipigan ang ila lupa kag indi pag-ibaligya, bangud libre ini nga gintugyan sang gobyerno sa ila.
english: Estrella also reminded the beneficiaries to keep their land and not sell it, as it was given to them free of charge by the government.

text: Gindugang pa ni Estrella nga madamo pa gihapon nga mga mangunguma sa rehiyon ang wala pa sang titulo, gani lauman nga magapadayon ang DAR sa pagpanagtag sang libre nga land titles.
english: Estrella added that there are still many farmers in the region who do not have titles, so it is expected that the DAR will continue to distribute free land titles.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, ginpahayag ni Jona Diaz, isa sa mga Agrarian Reform Beneficiaries sang Barangay Gemumua, Passi City, Iloilo, ang iya kalipay bangud sa ulihi may yara na sang titulo ang ila duta.
english: Meanwhile, Jona Diaz, one of the Agrarian Reform Beneficiaries of Barangay Gemumua, Passi City, Iloilo, expressed her happiness because their land finally has a title.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Diaz iya ginpahayag nga ini ang pamana niya sa iya kabataan—isa ka kasiguraduhan nga indi na matakaw ang ila manggad bangud titolado na ang ila taramnan nga mais nga may kahilwayan nga 1.2 ka ektarya.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Diaz said this is his legacy to his children—a guarantee that their wealth will not be stolen because their corn plantation with 1.2 hectares of freedom is titled.

text: Daw wala sang pagtigulang ang football superstar nga si Lionel Messi sang naka-hat trick ini sa hampang sang Argentina batok sa Bolivia sa 2026 World Cup qualifier.
english: Football superstar Lionel Messi didn’t seem to be aging when he scored a hat trick in Argentina’s game against Bolivia in the 2026 World Cup qualifier.

text: Ang tatlo ka goals ni Messi amo ang naghakwat sa team nga makuha ang 6-0 nga kadalag-an batok sa central South American team.
english: Messi's three goals lifted the team to a 6-0 victory over the central South American team.

text: Ini na ang ika-10 nga international hat-trick ni Messi nga patas na sa record sang iya long-time rival nga si Cristiano Ronaldo sang Portugal.
english: This is Messi's 10th international hat-trick, equal to the record of his long-time rival Cristiano Ronaldo of Portugal.

text: Magluwas sa hat trick, si Messi man ang naghatag sang duha ka assists kanday Lautaro Martinez kag Julian Alvarez nga pareho man niya nga kaupod sang nagkampyon sa 2022 World Cup.
english: In addition to the hat trick, Messi also provided two assists to Lautaro Martinez and Julian Alvarez, both of whom he was with when he won the 2022 World Cup.

text: Ang isa pa nga naka-skor sa team amo si Thiago Almada sa ika-69 nga minuto.
english: Another scorer for the team was Thiago Almada in the 69th minute.

text: Ini ang ikaduha nga hampang sang eight-time Balon d’Or winner para sa Argentina halin sang Hulyo sang nagsuprer ini sang ankle injury.
english: It was the eight-time Balon d’Or winner’s second game for Argentina since July when he suffered an ankle injury.

text: Ang Argentina national football team ukon La Albiceleste ang nagtapos sa draw batok sa Venezuela sang nagligad nga semana, nalutos batok sa Colombia sang Septyembre, apang nagapanguna gihapon sa CONMEBOL World Cup qualifying table nga may 22 points.
english: The Argentina national football team or La Albiceleste finished in a draw against Venezuela last week, lost against Colombia in September, but still tops the CONMEBOL World Cup qualifying table with 22 points.

text: Sunod nga atubangon sang squad ang Paraguay sa masunod nga qualifier game nga naka-schedule sa Nobyembre 14.
english: The squad will next face Paraguay in the next qualifier game scheduled for November 14.

text: Gin-donate sang beauty queen nga si Michelle Marquez Dee sa Autism Society Philippines ang tanan nga prize money nga iya nadag-an sa Voice for Change sa Miss Universe 2023.
english: Beauty queen Michelle Marquez Dee donated to Autism Society Philippines all the prize money she won in Voice for Change at Miss Universe 2023.

text: Ginkumpirma sang Miss Universe Philippines (MUPH) Organization nga mismo si Michelle ang nagkadto sa Antipolo City kaupod ang president sang organisasyon nga si Jonas Gaffud agud ihatag ang P684,000.
english: The Miss Universe Philippines (MUPH) Organization confirmed that Michelle herself went to Antipolo City with the organization's president Jonas Gaffud to hand over the P684,000.

text: “Miss Universe Philippines 2023 Michelle Marquez Dee gifted her prize for winning the Voice of Change Challenge to the Autism Society of the Philippines.
english: “Miss Universe Philippines 2023 Michelle Marquez Dee gifted her prize for winning the Voice of Change Challenge to the Autism Society of the Philippines.

text: Michelle, together with Jonas Gaffud, Miss Universe Philippines President, trooped to Altaroca Mountain Resort in Antipolo City to personally hand over a check for P684,000.
english: Michelle, together with Jonas Gaffud, Miss Universe Philippines President, trooped to Altaroca Mountain Resort in Antipolo City to personally hand over a check for P684,000.

text: MMD, as many know, has been a lifelong champion of people on the autism spectrum,” pahayag sang organisasyon.
english: MMD, as many know, has been a lifelong champion of people on the autism spectrum,” the organization said in a statement.

text: Ang Voice for Change nangin kabahin sang Miss Universe competition kun sa diin hatagan ang mga kandidata sang kahigayunan nga suportahan ang ila advocacy.
english: Voice for Change became part of the Miss Universe competition where candidates will be given the opportunity to support their advocacy.

text: Ginpili naman ni MMD ang Autism Society Philippines, bangud magluwas nga kilala siya nga “lifelong champion” sang mga tawo sa autism spectrum, duha sa iya mga utod nga sanday Mazen kag Adam ang pareho nga na-diagnose nga may amo nga kondisyon.
english: MMD chose the Autism Society Philippines, because besides being known as a “lifelong champion” of people on the autism spectrum, two of his brothers, Mazen and Adam, were both diagnosed with the condition.

text: Matandaan nga Septyembre 16 sang ginsapubliko ni MMD nga wala pa niya nabaton ang premyo halin sa Voice For Change kag ginsiling sini nga amo ini ang “most personal” award sa iya journey sa pageant bangud sa iya adbokasiya.
english: It can be recalled that on September 16, MMD announced that he has not yet received the award from Voice For Change and said that this is the “most personal” award in his journey in the pageant because of his advocacy.

text: Nag-depensa gilayon ang MUPh kag ginsiling nga may delay bangud sa communication process sa local franchise kag indi sa Miss Universe Organization.
english: MUPh immediately defended itself and said that there was a delay due to the communication process with the local franchise and not with the Miss Universe Organization.

text: Pagka-aga, gin-anunsyo na sang beauty queen nga na-release na ang iya prize money.
english: The next morning, the beauty queen announced that her prize money had been released.

text: “Michelle shows everyone that even after her stint as Miss Universe Philippines, she remains a staunch ally of her advocacy and a QUEEN in every sense of the word.
english: “Michelle shows everyone that even after her stint as Miss Universe Philippines, she remains a staunch ally of her advocacy and a QUEEN in every sense of the word.

text: Thank you, Michelle,” dugang sang MUPh.
english: Thank you, Michelle,” MUPh added.

text: Matandaan nga magluwas nga sulod sa Top 10 sa coronation night sang Miss Universe 2023 sa El Salvador, nakuha ni Michelle ang madamo nga special awards nga amo ang isa sa tatlo ka gold winners sang Voice for Change competition, Spirit of Carnival Award nga hatag sang pageant sponsor nga Carnival Cruises, Miss Universe’ fan vote, kag Best National Costume title nga tribute naman niya sa iya papel bilang Air Force Reservist.
english: It can be recalled that besides being in the Top 10 at the coronation night of Miss Universe 2023 in El Salvador, Michelle won many special awards including one of the three gold winners of the Voice for Change competition, Spirit of Carnival Award given by pageant sponsor Carnival Cruises, fan Universe's Best Costume title, and National Costume title. he paid tribute to his role as an Air Force Reservist.

text: Nagsaka na sa 38 ang numero sang mga napatay sang nagkulob ang isa ka tourist boat sa Ha Long Bay sa Vietnam.
english: The death toll has risen to 38 when a tourist boat capsized in Vietnam's Ha Long Bay.

text: Ginabulubanta nga 48 ka turista ang sakay sang amo nga sakayang pandagat lakip na ang lima ka mga crew members.
english: An estimated 48 tourists were on board the boat including five crew members.

text: Suno sa gobyerno sang Vietnam, kalabanan sa mga sakay amo ang mga Vietnamese, lakip na ang pila ka kabataan.
english: According to the Vietnamese government, most of those on board were Vietnamese, including some children.

text: Gilayon man ginpadala ang mga rescuers, lakip na ang mga border guards, navy personnel, police, kag mga professional divers para magbulig sa rescue operation apisar pa nga limitado ang visibility bangud sa malain nga panahon.
english: Rescuers, including border guards, navy personnel, police, and professional divers were immediately dispatched to assist in the rescue operation despite limited visibility due to bad weather.

text: Ginkumpirmar sang otoridad nga pulo lang ka mga indibidwal ang nakaluwas sa amo nga insidente.
english: Authorities confirmed that only ten individuals survived the incident.

text: ILOILO CITY- Yara na subong sa maayo nga kahimtangan ang tatlo ka tuig nga bata nga lalaki nga gindala sa Western Visayas Medical Center matapos makitaan sang sintomas sang Coronavirus.
english: ILOILO CITY – A three-year-old boy who was brought to the Western Visayas Medical Center after showing symptoms of Coronavirus is now in good condition.

text: Ang biktima ang naghalin sa Guangdong Province sa China kaupod ang iya ginikanan kag nagpadulong sa Iloilo agud kuntani magtambong sa selebrasyon sang Chinese New Year.
english: The victim came from Guangdong Province in China with his parents and went to Iloilo to attend the Chinese New Year celebration.

text: Sa exclusive interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Mary Jane Juanico, pinuno sang Infectious Disease Section sang Department of Health Region 6, iya ginpahayag nga ang biktima ang nahilanat rason nga ginpa check up.
english: In an exclusive interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Mary Jane Juanico, head of the Infectious Disease Section of the Department of Health Region 6, said the victim had a fever and was checked up.

text: May in house doctor naman ang hotel sa Iloilo Business Park nga ila ginatiniran sa diin ini ang una nga ginpaidalom sa check up.
english: The hotel has an in-house doctor at the Iloilo Business Park where they were staying.

text: Matapos sini, gindala ang biktima sa Qualimed kag sa ulihi, ginsaylo sa Western Visayas Medical Center.
english: The victim was then brought to Qualimed and later transferred to the Western Visayas Medical Center.

text: Suno kay Dr. Juanico, ginkuhaan na ang biktima sang nasopharyngeal kag oropharyngeal swab kag ginahulat na lang ang resulta halin sa Research Institute for Tropical Medicine.
english: According to Dr. Juanico, the victim has already been taken a nasopharyngeal and oropharyngeal swab and is awaiting the result from the Research Institute for Tropical Medicine.

text: Gin-athag man ni Dr. Juanico nga may standard protocol sa infection prevention ang kada hotel kag ospital rason nga wala sang dapat kahangaw-an ang mga guests ukon pasyente nga malatnan sang balatian.
english: He also explained that Dr. Juanico said each hotel and hospital has a standard protocol for infection prevention so guests or patients should not worry about being infected.

text: Sa subong, nagakaon na ang biktima kag wala na sang anuman nga sintomas sang Coronavirus.
english: The victim is now eating and has no symptoms of Coronavirus.

text: Gin-athag man ni Dr. Juanico nga Coronavirus free sa gihapon ang Western Visayas.
english: He also explained that Dr. Juanico said Western Visayas is still Coronavirus free.

text: SA Senado, may bill ukon hagna si Senador Vicente Sotto agud panubuon sa 13 anyos ang edad sang kabataan nga wala sing criminal liability, ukon salabton kriminal sa mahimo nila nga kasal-anan sa kasuguan.
english: In the Senate, Senator Vicente Sotto has a bill to lower the age of children without criminal liability to 13 years old.

text: In other words, pwede na sila mabilanggo sa nahimo nga krimen sa tion nga naga-edad pa lang sila sing 13 anyos paibabaw.
english: In other words, they can be imprisoned for a crime committed when they are only 13 years old or older.

text: Sa subong nga kasuguan – ang Republic Act No.
english: In the current law – Republic Act No.

text: 9344, ukon ang Juvenile Justice and Welfare Act of 2006 – ang edad nga pwede patawan sing silot sang pagkabilanggo amo lang ang may edad nga 15 anyos paibabaw.
english: 9344, or the Juvenile Justice and Welfare Act of 2006 – the only age for imprisonment is 15 years old and above.

text: Kon mahunong man sila, sunu sa sining kasuguan, indi ini agud mabilanggo sila pareho sa mga adult (18 anyos paibabaw) tungod sa “lack of discernment”, ukon kakulangan sang ila pensar sa paghimo sang husto nga paghusgar sa kon ano gid ang malain kag ang maayo.
english: If they are imprisoned, according to this law, it is not to imprison them like adults (18 years old and above) because of “lack of discernment”, or lack of their minds to make the right judgment of what is really bad and what is good.

text: Ang may edad 15 tubtub 17 pwede mapatawan diri sing mas mamag-an nga silot sangsa may edad 18 paibabaw kag mabutang lang sila sa mga facilidad nga bagay sa ila kaedad.
english: Those aged 15 to 17 may be given lighter sentences than those aged 18 and older and will only be placed in age-appropriate facilities.

text: Sa sini nga facilidad, ginatudluan sila sa pag-usoy sang tadlong nga dalan paagi sa “intervention and rehabilitation” sa idalom sing ginasiling nga “diversion program” sang gobyerno katulad sang yara sa Nueva Valencia, Guimaras para sa mga “Children in Conflict with the Law” (CICL).
english: In this facility, they are taught to find the right path through “intervention and rehabilitation” under a so-called “diversion program” of the government such as the one in Nueva Valencia, Guimaras for “Children in Conflict with the Law” (CICL).

text: Sa nahibalan naton sa pagduaw sa sining facilidad, ang mga kabataan diri ginatudluan sang disiplina katulad sang kon ano oras ang pagtulog kag pagbugtaw, ang malingaw sa sports katulad sang basketball, kag ang matudluan sang maayong pamatasan kag kasuguan sang Diyos.
english: As we learned from visiting this facility, the children here are taught discipline such as what time to go to bed and wake up, to enjoy sports such as basketball, and to be taught good manners and God's laws.

text: Ginaupdan man sila sa pagsimba kon aga sa ila malapit nga simbahan.
english: They are also accompanied to morning services at their nearby church.

text: Si Senador Chiz Escudero naman nagapanugyan sa pagpanubo sang criminal liability sa edad nga 9 ka tuig, katulad sa ginapat-ud sang daan nga kasuguan.
english: Senator Chiz Escudero proposes to lower the criminal liability to the age of 9 years, as stipulated by the old law.

text: Ining daan nga kasuguan  – ang RA 10630 –naga-detain (Section 20-A) sang kabataan nga may edad sing mga 12 anyos tungod sa mabug-at nga krimen katulad sang “rape, murder, and homicide, among others”.
english: This old law – RA 10630 – detains (Section 20-A) children aged about 12 years for serious crimes such as “rape, murder, and homicide, among others”.

text: Gina-requirer man sining kasuguan ang mga lokal nga gobyerno (LGU) agud magpatuman sang ila Bahay Pag-Asa (House of Hope) para sa sining kabataan.
english: The law also requires local government units (LGUs) to implement their House of Hope for these children.

text: Ang problema ugaling sa RA 9344, nga suportado sang United Nations sa idalom sang Universal Rights of Children, amo nga wala sing maayo nga pagpatuman sang sining mga programa sa sining mga kabataan.
english: The problem however with RA 9344, which is supported by the United Nations under the Universal Rights of Children, is that there is no proper implementation of these programs to these children.

text: Wala man sing husto nga funding kag nagakaigu nga facilidad.
english: There is also a lack of proper funding and adequate facilities.

text: Luyag lang sang pila dira sa Kongreso itudlo ang problema sa kasuguan nga nagapanubo liwat sang criminal liability sa 13 ukon 9 anyos, samtang ang kapalpakan sang ginasugo nga mga programa sang RA 9344 amo gid ang matuod nga rason sang padayon nga pagsagsag sang kabuangan sang mga kabataan.
english: Some in Congress just want to point out the problem with the law that reduces criminal liability to 13 or 9 years old, while the failure of the mandated programs of RA 9344 is the real reason for the continued spread of child abuse.

text: Upod sa tindug sang mga pro-child group, wala man kita gapasugot sa sining mga proposal nga panubuon pa gid ang criminal liability sa 13 ukon 9 ka tuig.
english: Along with the position of pro-child groups, we also do not agree with these proposals to further increase criminal liability to 13 or 9 years.

text: Dapat ipatuman lang sing maayo ang ginasaad sang RA 9344.
english: The promises of RA 9344 should be implemented properly.

text: In fact, ang dapat lagson sang aton gobyerno amo ang mga sindikato nga nagagamit sa sining wala hinalung-ong nga kabataan sa ila kademonyohan.
english: In fact, what our government should be pursuing are the syndicates that use these unsuspecting children for their demonization.

text: Kag palihog lang tuod-tuoda man ninyo ang pagpatuman sang anti-poor ta nga mga programa.
english: And please take seriously the implementation of our anti-poor programs.

text: Indi malilong nga ang kaimolon isa gid sang daku nga rason kon nga ining mga salawayon nga mga kabataan nagasagsag gihapon.
english: There is no doubt that poverty is one of the biggest reasons why these innocent children are still struggling.

text: Masami mapabay-an ining mga kabataan sang ila mga ginikanan nga lubong sa trabaho sa kon diin-diin agud mabuhi ang ila pamilya.
english: These children are often left behind by their parents who are busy working somewhere to support their families.

text: Kag kon mapabay-an, ti kamo na lang seguro mamensar kon ano ayhan ang ila mahimo kon wala sa pagtatap ukon pag-ubay sang ila mga ginikanan.
english: And if neglected, then you can probably think of what they would do without the care or support of their parents.

text: Masobra na sa one third sang 310 ka members sang House of Representatives ang kabahin na subong sang ruling party nga Lakas-CMD.
english: More than one third of the 310 members of the House of Representatives are now part of the ruling party Lakas-CMD.

text: Ini ang ginpahayag sang opisina ni Speaker Martin Romualdez.
english: This was revealed by the office of Speaker Martin Romualdez.

text: Santo sa statement, may yara na sang 109 Lakas-CMD members sa kamara matapos nag-upod sang damlag lang sa partido sanday Zamboanga del Sur Rep.
english: According to the statement, there are already 109 Lakas-CMD members in the chamber after Zamboanga del Sur Rep.

text: Victoria Yu nga sadto anay member sang PDP-Laban; ex-Nacionalista Party member Raul Tupas sang Iloilo; kag Bukidnon Rep.
english: Victoria Yu, a former PDP-Laban member; ex-Nacionalista Party member Raul Tupas of Iloilo; and Bukidnon Rep.

text: Jose Manuel Alba, nga halin sa Bukidnon Paglaum Party.
english: Jose Manuel Alba, who is from Bukidnon Paglaum Party.

text: Suno sa opisina ni Romualdez, ang dugang nga affiliation nagapasangkad sang suporta sa Congress kag ang grassroots para kay President Ferdinand ‘Bongbong’ R. Marcos Jr.
english: According to Romualdez’s office, the additional affiliation expands support in Congress and the grassroots for President Ferdinand ‘Bongbong’ R. Marcos Jr.

text: kag sa iya Agenda for Prosperity kag Bagong Pilipinas programs.
english: and in its Agenda for Prosperity and Bagong Pilipinas programs.

text: Sang nagligad nga Biyernes sang nagpatigayon ang Lakas-CMD sang national convention kun sa diin ginsiling sang Speaker nga ang partido ang mangin kabahin sang masaligan kag reform-oriented nga administration coalition para sa May 2025 polls.
english: Last Friday, Lakas-CMD held a national convention where the Speaker said the party will be part of a reliable and reform-oriented administration coalition for the May 2025 polls.

text: Nagsaka sa lima ka tawo ang napatay matapos masunog ang isa ka barko nga nagakarga sang 280 ka mga pasahero sa baybayon sang North Sulawesi, Indonesia.
english: The death toll has risen to five after a ship carrying 280 passengers caught fire off the coast of North Sulawesi, Indonesia.

text: Ang barko amo ang KM Barcelona 5 nagikan sa Talaud Islands padulong sa Manado sang ini nagkalayo malapit sa Talisei Island.
english: The ship was KM Barcelona 5 from Talaud Islands to Manado when it caught fire near Talisei Island.

text: Suno sa report, nagsugod ang kalayo las-12 sang udto sa lugar kag nagtuga sang pag-panic sang mga pasahero samtang madasig nga nagalapta ang kalayo sa bilog nga sakayan.
english: According to reports, the fire started at 12 noon in the area and caused panic among the passengers as the fire quickly spread throughout the vessel.

text: Ginpahayag ni Vice Admiral Denih Hendrata, Commander sang Indonesian Fleet Command, 284 ka mga pasahero kag crew members ang naluwas matapos ginrespondehan sang tatlo ka navy ships kag sang mga manugpangisda sa lugar.
english: Vice Admiral Denih Hendrata, Commander of the Indonesian Fleet Command, said 284 passengers and crew members were rescued after three navy ships and local fishermen responded.

text: Padayon pa ang imbestigasyon sang mga otoridad kun ano ang posible nga gintunaan sang sunog sa barko.
english: Authorities are still investigating the possible cause of the fire.

text: KON naga-ulan, bisan sa malip-ut lang nga panahon, nagatener ang tubig diri sa bal-ut sang nagaatubangay nga duha ka mayor nga building nga wala ma-sementuhan sa Mandurriao National High School.
english: WHEN it rains, even for a short time, the water stays here in the middle of the two main unpaved buildings at Mandurriao National High School.

text: Ina – sa hangop ta sa madugay nga paglabay naton diri pakadto sa Iloilo Supermart – tungod wala man sing alagyan ang tubig pagwa sa drainage sa kilid sang dalan nga sa kilid man lang sang eskwelahan.
english: That – as we understand from our long walk here to the Iloilo Supermart – is because there is no way for the water to come out of the drainage on the side of the road that is next to the school.

text: Otherwise, wala tani gadugay ang pagpondo sang tubig diri nga ginalikawan sang mga estudyante sa pag-agi, labi na gid kay nagalunangon ini sa diutay lang nga wisik sang ulan.
english: Otherwise, the water stagnation here that students avoid passing by would not last long, especially since it gets muddy with the slightest drizzle of rain.

text: Lamawan gani ang gwa sini kon sige ang ulan diri.
english: It's even muddy outside when it rains here.

text: Diri na gid lang gani naga-agi ang mga estudyante sa magamay apang sementado nga alagyan sa atubangan sang ila mga kwarto sa tabuk lang sang naga-atubangay nila nga mga building.
english: This is where the students walk through the small but paved path in front of their rooms just across the buildings facing each other.

text: Ining gamay nga alagyan (mga duha lang ka tapak ang lapad seguro) yara sa bal-ut nga espasyo sa tunga sa diin nagatener ang tubig kon mag-ulan tungod manubo ini sa magamay nga alagyan sang mga estudyante.
english: This small path (only about two feet wide probably) is in the middle of the narrow space where the water stays when it rains because it is lower than the small path of the students.

text: Mga anom ka tapak man guro ang kalapad sining espasyo.
english: This space is probably about six feet wide.

text: Ang siste pa gid amo nga kon mag-tener ang tubig diri sing madugay nagabaho ini sang baho sang kanal.
english: The problem is that if the water stays here for a long time, it smells like a sewer.

text: Kag magtahaw lang ang baho sini kon magmala ini sa init sang adlaw sing inadlaw tubtub senemana kon dugay-dugay gawa ang pagtener sang tubig.
english: And the smell will only disappear if it dries in the sun for days to weeks if the water stays for a long time.

text: Kon mag-agi gani kita diri pakadto sa Iloilo Supermart gabalingasaw gid ang baho sini tubtub sa dalan sa kilid sang eskwelahan.
english: When we pass by here to Iloilo Supermart, the smell of it reaches the road next to the school.

text: Natingala kita kon ngaa daw sa wala lang sa buot sang mga estudyante kag bisan sang mga manunudlo ang ining kahimtangan nila dira.
english: We wonder why the students and even the teachers seem to ignore their situation there.

text: Nagareklamo gid man seguro, ugaling ginaantos na gid lang nila ini kag gapangamuyo na gid lang nga aktuhan ini nga problema sang gobyerno, nga sa kadugay wala man sing ginahimo.
english: They must be complaining, but they are just suffering and praying that the government will act on this problem, which for a long time has not done anything.

text: Ining proyekto nga dalan iya seguro sang gobyerno nasyonal tungod ang bilog nga eskwelahan iya ini proyekto.
english: This road project is insured by the national government because the whole school is its project.

text: Kon iya ini nga proyekto sang gobyerno nasyonal, wala sing animo seguro ang nagtukod (contractor) ukon nagpatukod (DPWH) sining alagyan pasulod sa eskwelahan.
english: If this is a national government project, there is probably no one who built (contractor) or built (DPWH) this entrance to the school.

text: Ebidensya ini sang kapalpakan sang gobyerno.
english: This is evidence of government failure.

text: Daw aloy nga lipong nga ang makakaon malingin ang iya ulo.
english: It's like a dizzy lizard that makes anyone who eats it dizzy.

text: Sa sini lang nga gamay nga problema, indi pa ninyo makita kag matagaan ini sing solusyon?
english: With this little problem, you can't see and give it a solution?

text: Indi kamo magsiling nga na-short ang inyo budget agud indi malakip ining proyekto sa ining alagyan pasulod sa eskwelahan.
english: Don't say that your budget was short to not include this project in this school entrance.

text: Seguro may nag-cut sang budget nga madyekero.
english: Maybe some magician cut the budget.

text: Indi ayhan amo ina ang natabo?
english: Isn't that what happened?

text: Ti, pabay-an ta lang ini nga problema?
english: Well, let's leave this problem alone?

text: Samtang, nagaantos ang mga estudyante, ang mga manunudo kag ang mga nagaduaw sa eskwelahan sa kabaho sining nagatener nga tubig.
english: Meanwhile, the students, the teachers and those who visit the school are suffering from the stench of this stagnant water.

text: In fact, indi lang perhwisyo ini sa pagtuon sang mga kabataan kag ikaayong lawas sang tanan nga nagapausbong sang baho kanal sini.
english: In fact, it is not only harmful to the education of children and the health of all who promote the smell of it.

text: ILOILO-Nagpangabay ang Iloilo Provincial Health office sa publiko nga indi magpanic tuhoy sa novel coronavirus.
english: ILOILO-The Iloilo Provincial Health Office has urged the public not to panic about the novel coronavirus.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Patricia Grace Trabado, chief sang Provincial Health Office, iya ginpahayag nga sa baylo nga magsala, kinahanglan nga mangin vigilante ang publiko.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Patricia Grace Trabado, chief of the Provincial Health Office, said that instead of making mistakes, the public should be vigilant.

text: Suno kay Trabado,ang dapat bantayan sang pumuluyo amo ang mga myembro sang pamilya nga naggikan sa mga pungsod sa diin may yara sang kumpirmado nga kaso sang coronavirus.
english: According to Trabado, the people should watch out for family members who come from countries where there are confirmed cases of coronavirus.

text: Sa tion nga sila ang magpakita sang sintomas sang coronavirus kaangay sang hilanat, pag-ubo,sip-on kag panghatsi, gilayon sila nga dal-on sa health center para matalupangod sang doktor.
english: If they show symptoms of coronavirus such as fever, cough, runny nose and sneezing, they will be immediately taken to the health center for medical attention.

text: May kaangtanan diri, nagpasar naman sang resolusyon si Iloilo Vice Governor Christine Garin nga magamando sa mga ahensya sang gobyerno nga magpatigayon sang information drive batok sa coronavirus.
english: In this regard, Iloilo Vice Governor Christine Garin passed a resolution directing government agencies to conduct information drives against the coronavirus.

text: Ini nga mga ahensya ukon talatapan ang nagalakip sang Provincial health Office, municipal health office kag Department of Education.
english: These agencies include the Provincial health office, municipal health office and Department of Education.

text: Suno kay Garin, ang information drive magatutok sa pagtudlo sa mga tawo sang dapat himuon agud makalikaw sa virus kag sa tion nga matapikan naman, makahibalo sang dapat himuon.
english: According to Garin, the information drive will focus on teaching people what to do to avoid the virus and in case of infection, know what to do.

text: Samtang, gindula sang Department of Health Region 6 ang kahangawa  sang publiko tuhoy sa paglapta sang coronavirus sa Region 6.
english: Meanwhile, the Department of Health Region 6 dispelled public concerns about the spread of coronavirus in Region 6.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Mary Jane Juanico, head sang Department of health Region 6 – Infectious Disease Section, iya ginpahayag nga lunsay nagnegatibo ang tatlo ka mga tawo gikan sa China nga nag-abot sa kalibo Interrnational Airport sa aklan nga gin-quarantine matapos nakitaan sang sintomas sang virus.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Mary Jane Juanico, head of the Department of Health Region 6 – Infectious Disease Section, said that all three people from China who arrived at Kalibo International Airport in Aklan who were quarantined after showing symptoms of the virus tested negative.

text: Suno kay Juanico, magluwas sa tatlo ka mga kaso nga nagnegatibo , wala na sang iban pa nga suspected nga kaso  sang novel coronavirus sa rehiyon.
english: According to Juanico, apart from the three cases that tested negative, there are no other suspected cases of novel coronavirus in the region.

text: Nahibaluan nga may naglapta nga text message tuhoy sa isa ka guest sa isa ka hotel sa syudad sang Iloilo kag ginpahayag gindala sa isa ka ospital sa syudad apang ini ang ginpanginwala sang nasambit nga hotel kag sang ospital.
english: It was learned that there was a text message about a guest in a hotel in Iloilo City and was reportedly taken to a hospital in the city but this was denied by the said hotel and the hospital.

text: Patuloy ang ginagawang search and rescue operations sa Vietnam ngayong Linggo para sa lima pang nawawala matapos tumaob ang isang bangka sa Ha Long Bay noong Sabado, kung saan 37 katao ang naiulat na nasawi.
english: Search and rescue operations continue in Vietnam on Sunday for five more missing after a boat capsized in Ha Long Bay on Saturday, with 37 people reported missing.

text: Ang bangkang tinatawag na “Wonder Sea” ay may sakay na 48 pasahero at limang tripulante nang ito’y tumaob dahil sa biglaang buhos ng ulan at masamang panahon, ayon sa VNExpress.
english: The boat called “Wonder Sea” was carrying 48 passengers and five crew members when it capsized due to heavy rains and bad weather, according to VNExpress.

text: Karamihan sa mga pasaherong nasawi ay magpa-pamilya mula sa Hanoi, kabilang ang mahigit 20 bata.
english: Most of the passengers were traveling from Hanoi with their families, including more than 20 children.

text: Ayon sa mga awtoridad, 11 katao ang nailigtas, habang 34 na bangkay ang narekober hanggang noong Sabado ng gabi.
english: According to authorities, 11 people were rescued, while 34 bodies were recovered as of Saturday night.

text: Tatlong tripulante rin ang nahanap patay sa loob ng cabin kinagabihan, habang nagpapatuloy ang paghahanap sa natitirang limang nawawala ngayong Linggo.
english: Three crew members were also found dead inside the cabin last night, while the search for the remaining five missing continues on Sunday.

text: Nagpaabot na ng pakikiramay si Vietnamese Prime Minister Pham Minh Chinh sa mga naulila at inatasan ang mga kaukulang ahensya na magsagawa ng masusing imbestigasyon at panagutin ang sinumang mapatunayang nagpabaya sa insidente.
english: Vietnamese Prime Minister Pham Minh Chinh has expressed his condolences to the victims and instructed the relevant agencies to conduct a thorough investigation and hold accountable anyone found negligent in the incident.

text: ANG Suggested Retail Price (SRP) sang produkto masami naton makita nga nakapaskel sa mga sari-sari store nga nagabaligya sang softdrinks, katulad sang Coca-Cola, Pepsi Cola, kag iban pa.
english: THE Suggested Retail Price (SRP) of a product is often posted in grocery stores that sell softdrinks, such as Coca-Cola, Pepsi Cola, and others.

text: Ginahimo ini sang ila kompaniya agud mangin competitive ang ila presyo sa karibal nga mga produkto dira mismo sa sining mga retail outlet.
english: Their company does this to make their prices competitive with rival products right here in these retail outlets.

text: Ining bukas kag gina-anunsyo sa publiko nga SRP sang ila produkto nangin popular na gani nga gimik sa negosyo sang sining mga kompaniya.
english: This open and publicly advertised SRP of their product has even become a popular business gimmick of these companies.

text: Nangin daku man ini nga bulig sa mga bumalakal kay ang kompaniya mismo ang nagadikta sa pagpanubo sang presyo dira mismo sa retail outlet nga indi na sila mangita kon diin makabakal sang mas barato nga softdrink.
english: This is also a big help to consumers because the company itself dictates to reduce the price right at the retail outlet so that they do not have to look for cheaper softdrink.

text: Of course, tungod “suggested” lang ang ining presyo, mahimo man magpataas presyo ang retail outlet kon ang iya pagkuha sang produkto nagakinahanglan sing dugang nga gasto sa iya bahin.
english: Of course, since this price is only “suggested”, the retail outlet can also raise prices if its acquisition of the product requires additional costs on its part.

text: Maathag ugaling ang epekto sini kon indi magkapreho ang presyuhanay sang pareho nga produkto bisan man sa kaso nga wala sing may nakapaskel nga SRP nga notisya.
english: However, the effect is obvious if the price of the same product is not the same even in the case of no SRP notice posted.

text: Katulad lang sa duha ka mgkalapit nga retail outlet sa diin nagabakal ako sang isa sining softdrink.
english: Just like the two nearby retail outlets where I buy one of these softdrink.

text: Tungod mas mahal ang kuha sang retail outlet sang iya stock, nagabaligya siya sing P16 kada 12-ounce sang produkto.
english: Because the retail outlet charges more for his stock, he sells at P16 per 12-ounce of the product.

text: Sa pihak P15 lang.
english: On the other hand, it's only P15.

text: Natural didto ako nagabakal sa mas barato.
english: Naturally there I buy cheaper.

text:
***

Sa kaso sang SRP sa bugas, nga ginapatuman sa karon (sa Nobyembre 17 pa sa Iloilo, sunu kay DTI-Iloilo Director Diosdado Cadena), matabo man ina kon lain-lain ang presyo sang kapareho nga klase sang bugas.
english:
***

In the case of the SRP on rice, which is currently being implemented (on November 17 in Iloilo, according to DTI-Iloilo Director Diosdado Cadena), that will also happen if the prices of the same type of rice are different.

text: By the way, sa Memorandum of Agreement sa tunga sang Dept.
english: By the way, in the Memorandum of Agreement between the Dept.

text: of Agriculture, NFA kag Dept.
english: of Agriculture, NFA and Dept.

text: of Trade & Industry (DTI) sa sining karon, indi lang ga-monitor sang presyo sang bugas ang DTI, luas sa na-assign sa ila sang Price Act, kundi pwede man ini mangdakop sang mga naga-violar nga retail outlet.
english: of Trade & Industry (DTI) at present, the DTI not only monitors the price of rice, in addition to those assigned to them by the Price Act, but it can also arrest violating retail outlets.

text: Pareho sa ginapatuman sang mga negosyante sa softdrink, ang SRP sa bugas indi man ginapilit ini nga presyo sa retail outlet kon indi gid pwede tungod sa mas daku nga gasto.
english: Like the softdrink traders impose, the SRP on rice is not forced on the retail outlet if it is not possible due to higher costs.

text: In fact, na-istoryahan man sang mga otoridad ang kon ano gid ang dapat nga SRP sa bugas para sa mga supermarket kag mall tungod sang ila lain nga kahimtangan ikumparar sa mga public market.
english: In fact, the authorities also discussed what the SRP for rice should be for supermarkets and malls because of their different status compared to public markets.

text: Sunu kay Cadena sa aton exclusive nga interview naton sa iya, wala dayon ginapadakop ang naga-violar nga retail outlet.
english: According to Cadena in our exclusive interview with him, the violating retail outlet is not immediately arrested.

text: Ginapatawag anay ini “to show cause” kon ngaa indi sila dapat dakpon kag patawan sang penalidad.
english: It used to be called “to show cause” why they should not be arrested and punished.

text: Ang penalidad nagalab-ut sa P2,000 tubtub sa isa ka milyon ka pesos kag ang pagkansela sang lisensya sang retail outlet.
english: The penalty ranges from P2,000 to one million pesos and the cancellation of the retail outlet's license.

text: Dapat mapamatud-an sang retail outlet nga justified ang pagpataas sini sang iya presyo sa idalom sang “rule on overpricing” sa idalom sang Price Act agud mapasensya, siling ni Cadena.
english: The retail outlet must prove that it is justified in raising its prices under the “rule on overpricing” under the Price Act to be excused, Cadena said.

text: Gintumba sang former three-division world champion nga si John Riel “Quadro Alas” Casimero ang kasumpong sini nga Americano nga si Saul Sanchez sa imbukada pa lamang nga round sang super bantamweight bout sa Yokohama Budokan sa Yokohama, Japan.
english: Former three-division world champion John Riel “Quadro Alas” Casimero knocked out his American opponent Saul Sanchez in the opening round of the super bantamweight bout at Yokohama Budokan in Yokohama, Japan.

text: 10 ka rounds ang amo nga sambuwa apang sa umpisa pa lang sang ila pag-atubangay, maathag na sa hulag sang Pinoy boxer nga wala ini sang gana nga palawigon ang hampang.
english: The fight lasted 10 rounds but from the very beginning of their fight, it was clear from the movement of the Filipino boxer that he had no desire to extend the fight.

text: Nag-igu ang right hook ni Casimero kay Sanchez rason nga nagpanukod na ini sa canvas kag gin-isipan na sang referee 30 segundos pa lang sa first round.
english: Casimero's right hook hit Sanchez causing him to stand on the canvas and the referee counted him 30 seconds into the first round.

text: Nakalampuwas pa ang 25-anyos nga Amerikano kag nagbuya sang mga sumbag, apang napasulod sang Pinoy ang solid left hook nga nagtumba liwat kay Sanchez.
english: The 25-year-old American survived and threw punches, but the Filipino landed a solid left hook that knocked Sanchez down again.

text: Nagbangon liwat ang kasumpong apang asud-asud na ang atake ni Casimero rason nga gin-untat na sang referee ang sambuwa kag gindeklarar nga daog ang Pinoy via technical knockout sa marka nga 2-minutes kag 41-seconds.
english: The opponent got up again but Casimero's attack was so strong that the referee stopped the fight and declared the Filipino the winner via technical knockout at the 2-minute and 41-second mark.

text: Nagsaka na subong sa 34-4-1 ang record sang 35-anyos nga si Quadro Alas nga may 23 knockouts, samtang nagnubo naman si Sanchez sa 21-4 record nga may 12 knockouts.
english: The 35-year-old Quadro Alas now has a record of 34-4-1 with 23 knockouts, while Sanchez has dropped to a 21-4 record with 12 knockouts.

text: Antes nadayon ang hampang, may drama pa nga natabo sa weigh-in sang Oktubre 12 bangud nagbug-at si Casimero sang 56.3 kilos nga mas sobra sang isa ka kilo sa limit.
english: Before the match, there was another drama at the weigh-in on October 12 as Casimero weighed 56.3 kilos, one kilo more than the limit.

text: Sa ikaduha nga attempt duha ka oras ang nagligad, overweight man gihapon ini sa 55.9 kilos.
english: On the second attempt two hours later, he was still overweight at 55.9 kilos.

text: Base sa Japan Boxing Commission rules nga naugyunan man sang duha ka kampo, ginhatagan liwat sang tyansa si Casimero sa isa pa ka weigh-in sang aga sang adlaw na mismo sang hampang, kun sa diin na-clear na gid man sini ang bug-at nga 128 pounds rason nga nagpadayon ang non-title bout.
english: Based on the Japan Boxing Commission rules agreed upon by both sides, Casimero was given another chance at another weigh-in in the morning of the day of the match, where he cleared the weight of 128 pounds and continued the non-title bout.

text: Indi ini ang una nga bes nga may mga problema si Quadro Alas sa iya bug-at.
english: This is not the first time Quadro Alas has had problems with his weight.

text: May isyu man ini sa bug-at sa scheduled fight sini sang 2021 batok kay Paul Butler para sa iya anay WBO bantamweight world title.
english: He also had a weight issue with his scheduled fight in 2021 against Paul Butler for his former WBO bantamweight world title.

text: Na-postpone ang original bout bangud nag-withdraw si Casimero sa weigh-in bangud sa iya ginpahayag nga gastritis.
english: The original bout was postponed because Casimero withdrew from the weigh-in due to what he said was gastritis.

text: Sang ulihi, dalayon na nga nakakasan ang WBO world title ang Pinoy fighter bangud sa paggamit sini sang sauna agud nga makasulod sa ginkasugtan nga bug-at sang gin-reschedule ang iya away batok kay Butler.
english: Later, the Filipino fighter was immediately stripped of his WBO world title for using a sauna to get to the agreed weight when his fight against Butler was rescheduled.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang paggamit sang sauna ang ginadumilian gid sa idalom sang medical guidelines sang British Boxing Board of Control.#
english: It is known that the use of saunas is strictly prohibited under the medical guidelines of the British Boxing Board of Control.

text: AKLAN – Yara sa red alert status ang Aklan Provincial Health Office matapos gin-quarantine ang tatlo ka Chinese nationals nga ginadudahan nga may yara sang Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SARS)-like pneumonia virus.
english: AKLAN – The Aklan Provincial Health Office is on red alert status after three Chinese nationals suspected of having the Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SARS)-like pneumonia virus were quarantined.

text: Ginpahayag sa Bombo Radyo ni Dr. Cornelio Cuachon sang Aklan Provincial Health Office, nga ang 29 anyos nga Chinese national ang labing una nga ginpaidalom sa hospital quarantine, ginsundan sang tatlo ka tuig nga bata kag ang pinaka-ulihi amo ang 65 nga tigulang.
english: He told Bombo Radyo that Dr. Cornelio Cuachon of the Aklan Provincial Health Office, said the 29-year-old Chinese national was the first to be placed under hospital quarantine, followed by a three-year-old child and the last was a 65-year-old man.

text: Suno kay Dr. Cuachon, ang tatlo ka mga turista ang gindala sa Dr. Rafael S. Tumbukon Memorial Hospital para sa medical examination kun sa diin outpatient na ang 29 anyos nga pasyente samtang nagapabilin naman sa hospital ang 65 anyos nga tigulang.
english: According to Dr. Cuachon, the three tourists were taken to Dr. Rafael S. Tumbukon Memorial Hospital for medical examination where the 29-year-old patient is outpatient while the 65-year-old man remains in the hospital.

text: Ginpahayag ni Dr. Cuachon nga ginkuhaan sang blood samples kag specimens ang tatlo kag ini ang ginpadala sa Research Institute for Tropical Medicine sa Manila para sa testing.
english: Dr. Cuachon said blood samples and specimens were taken from the three and they were sent to the Research Institute for Tropical Medicine in Manila for testing.

text: Sa pihak sini, nagpanugyan si Dr. Cuachon sa mga pumuluyo nga likawan ang pagsalangisag kag mas makapaayo nga mag-inom sang madamu nga tubig kag multi-vitamins.
english: Meanwhile, Dr. Cuachon urged residents to avoid exercise and drink plenty of water and multi-vitamins.

text: Samtang, sa bahin naman sang Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines-Aklan, ginpahayag sang manager nga si Engr.
english: Meanwhile, on the part of the Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines-Aklan, manager Engr.

text: Eusebio Monserrate Jr., nga ang ginhimu sa tatlo ka turista ang protocol sa Kalibo International Airport agud nga indi maglapta ang balati-an.
english: Eusebio Monserrate Jr., that the three tourists were treated according to the protocol at Kalibo International Airport to prevent the spread of the disease.

text: Suno kay Engr.
english: According to Engr.

text: Monserrate, ang tatlo ka Chinese nationals ang nakitaan sang sintomas sang hilanat apang indi sila tumandok sang Wuhan, China kun sa diin naghalin ang misteryoso nga balati-an.
english: Monserrate said the three Chinese nationals showed symptoms of fever but were not natives of Wuhan, China where the mysterious disease originated.

text: Ginpahayag ni Engr.
english: He said Engr.

text: Monserrate nga antes pa man makapanaog sa eroplano ang mga pasahero, ginapaidalom sila sa inspection paagi sa Thermal scanner agud madali nga mahibalu-an kun positibo sila sa balatian.
english: Monserrate said that before passengers get off the plane, they are subjected to inspection through a thermal scanner to quickly determine if they are positive for the disease.

text: Nauna na nga ginpahayag sang World Health organization nga ang virus nga nagatuga sang misteryoso nga balati-an ang ang nalakip sa coronaviruses kasubong sang Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome nga nagpatay sang ginabanta 800 ka tawo kadungan sang outbreak sang 2002 nga nag-umpisa sa China.
english: The World Health Organization has previously said that the virus that causes the mysterious disease is among the coronaviruses such as Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome that killed an estimated 800 people during the 2002 outbreak that began in China.

text: Gagawing prayoridad ng Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) ngayong taon ang paglilinis sa Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) na itinuturing bilang isa sa mga pinakatiwaling ahensya ng pamahalaan sa bansa.
english: The Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) will make it a priority this year to clean up the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) which is considered one of the most trusted government agencies in the country.

text: Ayon kay Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla, gagawin nila ang lahat ng pagsisikap upang tuldukan ang korapsyon sa nasabing ahensya.
english: According to Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla, they will make every effort to stop corruption in the agency.

text: Binanggit ni Remulla na sa BFP, ang pagbebenta ng mga fire extinguisher, ang procurement ng mga sprinkler, ang pagproseso ng building permit, at marami pang iba ay puno ng mga anomalya.
english: Remulla mentioned that in the BFP, the sale of fire extinguishers, the procurement of sprinklers, the processing of building permits, and many others are full of anomalies.

text: Ayon sa kalihim, paiigtingin ng interior department ang pagmamanman sa mga tauhan ng bureau ngayong taon.
english: According to the secretary, the interior department will intensify its monitoring of bureau personnel this year.

text: Nag-produce sila ng 15,000 body camera para sa mga inspector.
english: They produced 15,000 body cameras for inspectors.

text: Ito ay gagamitin sa loob ng 24 oras at hindi maaaring patayin upang maitala maging ang kanilang mga pag-uusap.
english: It will be used for 24 hours and cannot be turned off to record even their conversations.

text: Nauna nang sinabi ng kalihim noong 2025 na malawakan ang korapsyon sa BFP na nagsisimula mula sa mga firemen hanggang sa pinakamataas na opisyal.
english: The secretary earlier said that by 2025, corruption in the BFP will be widespread from the firemen to the highest officials.

text: Nauna na ring isiniwalat ang anomalya sa recruitment ng mga tauhan ng BFP kung saan naniningil umano ang mga tiwaling indibidwal ng P500,000 sa bawat aplikante kapalit ng pagpasok sa ahensya.
english: Earlier, anomalies in the recruitment of BFP personnel were also exposed where corrupt individuals allegedly charged P500,000 to each applicant in exchange for admission to the agency.

text: Indi lang si Vice President Sara Duterte ang nagbisita sa balay ni former Vice President Leni Robredo sa Naga City, Camarines Sur kundi mangin sanday Interior Secretary Benhur Abalos kag Sen.
english: Not only Vice President Sara Duterte visited the house of former Vice President Leni Robredo in Naga City, Camarines Sur but also Interior Secretary Benhur Abalos and Sen.

text: Ramon Revilla Jr.
english: Ramon Revilla Jr.

text: Pareho kay Sara, sanday Abalos kag Revilla ang nagkadto man para sa selebrasyon sang Feast of Our Lady of Peñafrancia.
english: Like Sara, Abalos and Revilla also went for the celebration of the Feast of Our Lady of Peñafrancia.

text: Si Revilla ang kumpirmado na nga magapadalagan liwat bilang senador sa 2025 midterm elections, samtang matunog man nga ginabati-bati nga magasulod naman sa pulitika si Abalos.
english: Revilla is confirmed to run again as senator in the 2025 midterm elections, while Abalos is also rumored to enter politics.

text: Pahayag sang interior secretary, nagkadto siya sa Naga City para sa festival bangud deboto ang iya pamilya sang Our Lady of Peñafrancia, kag sang amo nga tion, napinsaran sini nga mayo man nga mag-courtesy call siya kay Robredo.
english: The interior secretary said he went to Naga City for the festival because his family is a devotee of Our Lady of Peñafrancia, and at that time, he thought it would be good to make a courtesy call to Robredo.

text: Nag-post naman sang pictures si Revilla kag nagsiling nga suod gid nga abyan sang ila pamilya si anay Sec.
english: Revilla posted pictures and said that former Sec.

text: Jesse Robredo nga amo ang nagtaliwan nga bana ni Leni.
english: Jesse Robredo who is Leni's late husband.

text: Sunod man nga gin-athag sang former vice president nga sa kada Peñafrancia, welcome gid ang tanan sa ila balay sa Naga City halin sang una bisan ano pa man ang duag sa politika.
english: The former vice president further explained that in every Peñafrancia, everyone is welcome in their house in Naga City since the beginning regardless of political affiliation.

text: “During Peñafrancia, we do not look at political colors.
english: “During Peñafrancia, we do not look at political colors.

text: There’s no party affiliation, everything here is politically neutral.
english: There’s no party affiliation, everything here is politically neutral.

text: Everyone who comes for the Lady is welcome here,” pahayag ni Robredo.
english: Everyone who comes for the Lady is welcome here,” Robredo said.

text:
“Since my husband became mayor in 1988, everyone who visits Naga for the Lady is very much welcome.”

Sang Byernes, matandaan nga sa isa ka makakilibot nga development, si Sara mismo ang una nga nagkadto sa balay ni Robredo kag nagtinir sang isa ka oras.
english:
“Since my husband became mayor in 1988, everyone who visits Naga for the Lady is very much welcome.”

On Friday, it can be recalled that in a surprising development, Sara herself was the first to go to Robredo's house and stayed for an hour.

text: Nagdepensa ang Office of the Vice President nga indi desperada si Sara, samtang ginklaro naman ni Leni nga personal kag indi political ang iya gin-istoryahan.
english: The Office of the Vice President defended that Sara was not desperate, while Leni clarified that her conversation was personal and not political.

text: Nanglabo ang isa ka lalaki matapos ginsunlog ini kag gintawag nga ‘kabayo’ sa Doña Remedios Trinidad (DRT), Malolos, Bulacan.
english: A man was stabbed after being stabbed and called a 'horse' in Doña Remedios Trinidad (DRT), Malolos, Bulacan.

text: Suno sa imbestigasyon, ginlabo sang suspek nga si alyas “Boy Itak” sa nawong ang isa ka motorcycle rider nga ginpasibangdan niya nga nagsunlog sa iya.
english: According to the investigation, the suspect alias “Boy Itak” stabbed a motorcycle rider in the face whom he accused of stabbing him.

text: Sa maayo nga palad, gamay lang nga pilas ang naangkon sang biktima.
english: Fortunately, the victim sustained minor injuries.

text: Antes ang insidente, nagpondo lang sa lugar ang biktima sang nakit-an ang iya mga abyan.
english: Before the incident, the victim had stopped at the scene when his friends saw him.

text: Sa wala ginlauman nga kahigayunan, nag-ulhot ang suspek kag nagsinggit kun sin-o ang nagtawag sa iya nga “kabayo” kag nanglabo na ini kag naigo ang biktima.
english: At an unexpected opportunity, the suspect appeared and shouted who called him “horse” and he stabbed and hit the victim.

text: Gilayon naman nga naaresto ang suspek.
english: The suspect was immediately arrested.

text: Magasandig ang gobyerno sang Pilipinas sa foreign lenders subong nga tuig para malab-ot ang mga tinutuyo sini sa development sang nasyon.
english: The Philippine government will rely on foreign lenders this year to achieve its development goals.

text: Ginapahayag nga magahulam ang Marcos administration sang kabug-usan nga $6.35 billion (ginabanta nga P369.66 billion) halin sa Asian Development Bank (ADB) kag World Bank agud nga may pondo ang mga proyekto.
english: The Marcos administration will reportedly borrow a total of $6.35 billion (estimated at P369.66 billion) from the Asian Development Bank (ADB) and the World Bank to fund the projects.

text: Ini nga mga inisyatibo magatutok sa pagpaumwad sa urban transit, pag-promote sang climate-resilient agriculture, pagpasangkad pa sang malimpyo nga enerhiya, pagpaayo pa sang sanitation, pagpabaskog sang health and education services, kag pag-upgrade sang rural infrastructure.
english: These initiatives will focus on improving urban transit, promoting climate-resilient agriculture, expanding clean energy, improving sanitation, strengthening health and education services, and upgrading rural infrastructure.

text: Ginaalegar nga pito ka concessional financing packages ang magahalin sa ADB kag siyam naman ang mangin loan sa World Bank apang naka-schedule pa ini nga aprubahan subong nga tuig.
english: It is alleged that seven concessional financing packages will come from the ADB and nine will be loans from the World Bank but they are still scheduled to be approved this year.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag ni Department of Finance Secretary Ralph Recto nga nagaplano ang national government nga buhinan ang foreign borrowings sa 10 percent sa medium term nga amo ang magahimo sang domestic borrowings sa 90 percent.
english: Earlier, Department of Finance Secretary Ralph Recto said the national government plans to reduce foreign borrowings to 10 percent in the medium term which will bring domestic borrowings to 90 percent.

text: Ini nga proposal suno kay Recto ang naga-target sang gradual shift sa 90 percent domestic borrowing agud nga mabuhinan ang mga risgo kaangot sa foreign exchange sa paglapaw sang 2028.
english: This proposal, according to Recto, targets a gradual shift to 90 percent domestic borrowing in order to reduce the risks associated with foreign exchange by 2028.

text: Sang nagligad nga tuig, naka-secure ang DOF sang 12 financing deals kag nakahulam sang kabug-usan nga $5.67 billion (P333.42 billion) agud mapondohan ang mga proyekto sa infrastructure, transport, defense, digital technology, health, kag agriculture.
english: Last year, the DOF secured 12 financing deals and borrowed a total of $5.67 billion (P333.42 billion) to fund projects in infrastructure, transport, defense, digital technology, health, and agriculture.

text: SANG sini lang (Nobyembre 9, 2018, sunu sa balita), ang Sandiganbayan nagpagwa sang iya desisyon nga naga-convict, ukon nagahusgar sing guilty, kay anay First Lady Imelda Marcos sa pitu ka kaso sang graft and corruption.
english: RECENTLY (November 9, 2018, according to the news), the Sandiganbayan issued its decision convicting, or judging guilty, former First Lady Imelda Marcos in seven cases of graft and corruption.

text: Ining mga akusasyon naga-involver sang paggamit niya kag sang iya bana, ang anay nagtaliwan na nga diktador nga si  Ferdinand Marcos, sang ila mga foundations sa Switzerland sa negosyo, sa balor nga mga $200, nga gina-prohibir sang Konstitusyon.
english: These charges involve her and her husband, the late former dictator Ferdinand Marcos, using their Swiss foundations in business, worth about $200, which is prohibited by the Constitution.

text: Beneficiario man sining ila negosyo ang ila kabataan nga sanday Imee, Irene kag Bong-Bong.
english: Their children, Imee, Irene and Bong-Bong, are also beneficiaries of their business.

text: Ang ining akusasyon ginpasaka sang Presidential Commission on Good Government (PCGG) sadtong 1991 sa Ombudsman, nga nag-aprobar kag nagpasaka man sini sa Sandiganbayan.
english: The charge was filed by the Presidential Commission on Good Government (PCGG) in 1991 with the Ombudsman, who approved it and filed it with the Sandiganbayan.

text: Ang Sandiganbayan (People’s Advocate) isa ka special appellate collegial court nga may hurisdiksyon sa mga kaso kriminal kag civil nga naga-involver sang graft and corrupt practices, kag kasubong nga mga kaso nga ma-komiter sang mga opisyal kag empleyado sang gobyerno, lakip ang mga government-owned ukon government-controlled corporations (GOGCC).
english: The Sandiganbayan (People's Advocate) is a special appellate collegial court with jurisdiction over criminal and civil cases involving graft and corrupt practices, and similar cases committed by government officials and employees, including government-owned or government-controlled corporations (GOGCC).

text: Sa sini nga desisyon sang Sandiganbayan, ang 89 anyos ang anay First Lady ginpatawan sang pagkabilanggo sa sulod sang anom ka tuig kag isa ka bulan sa minimum tubtub sa 11 ka tuig sa maximum sa kada isa sang pitu ka akusasyon kontra sa iya.
english: In this decision of the Sandiganbayan, the 89-year-old former First Lady was sentenced to six years and one month in prison at a minimum to 11 years at a maximum for each of the seven charges against her.

text: Sa kabug-usan, ang ining pagkabilanggo ni Imelda magalab-ut sa kabilugan nga 40 anyos sa minimum ukon 70 anyos sa maximum.
english: In total, Imelda's imprisonment will amount to a total of 40 years at a minimum or 70 years at a maximum.

text: Ang Sandiganbayan nagapreparar sa karon sa pagpagwa sang warrant of arrest kay Imelda.
english: The Sandiganbayan is currently preparing to issue a warrant of arrest for Imelda.

text: Pwede man siya, ugaling, makapasaka sang iya kaso sa Korte Suprema, sunu mismo sa PCGG nga nagalaum nga indi na ini siya makaluas pa bisan sa Korte Suprema.
english: He can, however, file his case in the Supreme Court, according to the PCGG itself, which hopes that he will not escape even the Supreme Court.

text: Samtang, nagpahayag man ang Palasyo nga kon mangin-final na gid man ang desisyon sang Korte Suprema basi mahulugan si Imelda sang pardon ni Presidente Duterte – tungod seguro kay kaalyado niya ini sa pulitika kag tungod man sa iya edad kag kahimtangan sang ikaayong lawas.
english: Meanwhile, the Palace said that if the Supreme Court's decision becomes final, Imelda may be eligible for President Duterte's pardon – probably because she is his political ally and also because of her age and health condition.

text:
***

Ginkalipay ining pag-convict kay Imelda sang mga biktima sang martial law ni Marcos, kag sang madamo pa nga mga pumuluyo nga indi makauyon sang diniktador nga pagginahum kag sang kalainan nga dala sini.
english:
***

Imelda's conviction was welcomed by the victims of Marcos' martial law, and by many other citizens who could not tolerate dictatorial rule and the evil it brought.

text: May naghinugyaw pa gani.
english: Some even cheered.

text: Ang matuod, in the long run, ang mga yara man lang sa poder ang maka-benepisyo sa martial law, indi bala?
english: The truth is, in the long run, only those in power will benefit from martial law, right?

text: Saksi dira mismo ang martial law ni Marcos.
english: Marcos' martial law is a witness.

text: Sa akon bahin, wala ugaling ako nalipay sa sining pag-convict kay Imelda tungod sa kadugay nga pagkinasuhay.
english: For my part, however, I was not happy with this conviction of Imelda because of the long-standing dispute.

text: Paano ka abe malipay kay, samtang ang mandato sa aton korte amo ang “speedy trial”, ang kaso ni Imelda naglab-ut sang halos tatlo ka dekada (30 anyos) bag-o na-desisyunan.
english: How can you be happy that, while the mandate of our court is “speedy trial”, Imelda's case took almost three decades (30 years) before it was decided.

text: “Speedy trial” bala ina ang 30 anyos?
english: Is that a “speedy trial” 30 years old?

text: Daw palumba ini sang koneho kag bao sa diin nagdaug pa ang lumpayod nga bao.
english: It was like a race between a rabbit and a fox where the lame fox won.

text: Daw nagpabaya ang koneho, kag nagtulog pa anay, agud tagaan sing pribelihiyo ang bao nga magdaug sa palumba.
english: The rabbit seemed to give up, and even went to sleep, to give the fox the privilege of winning the race.

text: Fuera los buenos sa husgado, pero ngaa ayhan nagdugay ang kaso sang amo sina ka dugay?
english: Fuera los buenos in court, but why did the case take so long?

text: Kamo na lang seguro maghangop-hangop da, kay basi mag-malisyoso pa ako.
english: I guess you just understand, because I might be more malicious.

text: Isa pa, indi ta pa masiling nga mahunong gid sa bilangguan si Imelda.
english: Also, we can't say that Imelda will ever stay in prison.

text: Man, maka-piyansya pa man siya.
english: Man, he can still get bail.

text: Pwede man siya seguro maka-Petition for Reconsideration kag, kon mapaslawan siya, pwede pa niya ipasaka ang iya kaso sa Korte Suprema.
english: He can probably file a Petition for Reconsideration and, if he fails, he can still appeal to the Supreme Court.

text: Gaduha-duha ugaling ang iban kon yara na ini sa Korte Suprema.
english: Some, however, are skeptical that it will be in the Supreme Court.

text: Man, ang subong nga Korte Suprema amo man ang naghatag sing kadungganan sa nagtaliwan nga diktador agud ilubong sa Libingan ng mga Bayani, sa diin wala man gani malubong dira ang iban, katulad ni Gat Jose Rizal kag Gat Andres Bonifacio, nga bagay gid malubong dira.
english: Also, the current Supreme Court also honored the late dictator to be buried in the Libingan ng mga Bayani, where others, such as Gat Jose Rizal and Gat Andres Bonifacio, who deserve to be buried there, were not even buried there.

text: Well, kon wala kita nalipay sa sining sitwasyon, at least gapasalamat kita sa kaisug sang Ombudsman kag Sandiganbayan, bisan ulihi na, nga nagtindug sing may kaisug agud tagaan sing kahulugan ang nagakabagay nga hustisya sa sini nga kaso ni Imelda.
english: Well, if we are not happy with this situation, at least we are grateful for the courage of the Ombudsman and the Sandiganbayan, even though it was too late, who stood up with courage to define the right justice in this case of Imelda.

text: Dalayawon matuod ang kaisug sang Ombudsman kag Sandiganbayan!
english: The courage of the Ombudsman and the Sandiganbayan is commendable!

text: Tani pabor man ang Korte Suprema sa sining desisyon sang Sandiganbayan.
english: I hope the Supreme Court will also be in favor of this decision of the Sandiganbayan.

text: Magasugod subong nga Enero 2025 ang 15% nga pagtaas sang contribution sang mga myembro kag employers sang Social Security System (SSS).
english: The 15% increase in the contribution of members and employers of the Social Security System (SSS) will start this January 2025.

text: Ini ang nagasunod man sa order sa idalom sang Republic Act No.
english: This is also in compliance with the order under Republic Act No.

text: 11199, or Social Security Act of 2018.
english: 11199, or Social Security Act of 2018.

text: Sa idalom sang layi, ang 1% nga pagtaas sang kontribusyon ang ipatuman sa mga katapo sang SSS kada duha ka tuig nga nagasugod sa 12% sang 2019 tubtob nga maglab-ot ini sa 15% sang 2025.
english: Under the law, a 1% contribution hike will be imposed on SSS members every two years starting from 12% in 2019 until it reaches 15% by 2025.

text: Sugod sini nga bulan, ang employer’s share mangin 10%, samtang ang kontribusyon sang empleyado ginatalana sa 5%.
english: From this month, the employer’s share will be 10%, while the employee contribution is set at 5%.

text: Hindi magnubo sa 34 ka bangkay ang nakuha, samtang 11 naman ang naluwas matapos magkulob ang isa ka tourist boat sa Halong Bay, Vietnam, sang Sabado.
english: At least 34 bodies have been recovered, while 11 were rescued after a tourist boat capsized in Halong Bay, Vietnam, on Saturday.

text: Base sa VN Express, may 53 ka tawo sa barko nga Wonder Sea, 48 ka turista kag lima ka crew.
english: According to VN Express, there were 53 people on board the Wonder Sea, 48 tourists and five crew members.

text: Naabtan ini sang mabaskog nga bagyo mga alas-1:30 sang hapon, lokal nga oras.
english: It was hit by a strong typhoon around 1:30 pm local time.

text: Antes magkulob, nadulaan sang GPS signal ang barko malapit sa Dau Go Cave.
english: Before sinking, the ship lost its GPS signal near Dau Go Cave.

text: Padayon subong ang malapad nga search and rescue operations sang navy, border guards, kag mga otoridad.
english: Extensive search and rescue operations by the navy, border guards, and authorities are ongoing.

text: Ang Halong Bay isa ka UNESCO World Heritage Site kag popular nga lugar para sa mga turista.
english: Halong Bay is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and popular tourist spot.

text: Gin-nominate sang Partido Demokratiko Pilipino (PDP) sanday Senador Christopher “Bong” Go kag Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa kag ang aktor nga si Philip Salvador agud mangin kabahin sang ila senatorial lineup para sa 2025 midterm elections.
english: The Democratic Party of the Philippines (PDP) has nominated Senators Christopher “Bong” Go and Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa and actor Philip Salvador to be part of its senatorial lineup for the 2025 midterm elections.

text: Kadungan ini sang national assembly sang amo nga partido kagab-i, Septyembre 20, sa Davao City kun sa diin yara man ang chairman nga si anay Presidente Rodrigo Duterte.
english: This coincides with the national assembly of the party last night, September 20, in Davao City where the chairman, former President Rodrigo Duterte, was also present.

text: Gintumod man sang partido si Senator Robin Padilla bilang national campaign manager.
english: The party also named Senator Robin Padilla as its national campaign manager.

text: Nahibaluan nga madugay na nga kaalyado ni Duterte sanday Go kag Bato samtang abyan nila kag masami naga-upod sa mga event sang pulitiko si Salvador.
english: Go and Bato are long-time allies of Duterte while Salvador is their friend and often attends political events.

text:
