text: Ginareklamo subong ang Jalandoni Flyover sa bangud sa madanlog sini nga estruktura.
english: The Jalandoni Flyover is now being complained about due to its slippery structure.

text: Gin-aktuhan naman ini gilayon sang Iloilo City Government ang reklamo nga madanlog nga aspalto sa nasambit nga Flyover.
english: The Iloilo City Government immediately took action on the complaint of slippery asphalt on the said flyover.

text: Ini matapos maglapta sa social media ang isa ka post nga nagapahayag nga delikado ini sa mga tawo nga naglabay sa dalan.
english: This was after a post circulated on social media that it was dangerous for people passing by.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Joy Fantillaga Gorzal, Spokesperson ni Mayor Raisa Treñas iya ginpahayag nga madanlog gid man ang aspalto nga ginbutang ilabi na kun naga-ulan kag mahimo ini magresulta sang disgrasya.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Joy Fantillaga Gorzal, spokesperson of Mayor Raisa Treñas, said the asphalt is very slippery especially when it rains and this can result in accidents.

text: Gilayon nga nag-coordinate ang City Government sa Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) nga nagpatigayon sang nasambit nga proyekto.
english: The City Government immediately coordinated with the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) which implemented the said project.

text: Nagapanawagan man ang City Government sa publiko, ilabi na sa mga motorista, nga maghinay-hinay kag mangin alisto sa pag-agi sa Jalandoni Flyover samtang ginaproseso pa ang mga kinahanglanon nga buhaton agud indi na makatuga sang disgrasya.
english: The City Government also appealed to the public, especially motorists, to slow down and be alert when passing through the Jalandoni Flyover while the necessary steps are being processed to avoid accidents.

text: Padayon naman sa karon ang ila pag-monitor sa kahimtangan sang dalan agud masiguro ang safety sang tanan nga naga-agi sa lugar.
english: They are still monitoring the road conditions to ensure the safety of all those passing through the area.

text: Suspendido nga wala sang sweldo ang silot sang Philippine Basketball Association (PBA) batok kay John Amores matapos ang insidente nga may gintiro ini sa Lumban, Laguna sang Septyembre.
english: The Philippine Basketball Association (PBA) has suspended without pay the penalty against John Amores after the incident in which he shot someone in Lumban, Laguna in September.

text: May ginplastar man nga kondisyon para tugutan siya nga maghampang liwat sa liga.
english: Conditions were also put in place for him to be allowed to play in the league again.

text: Gin-anunsiyo ini nanday Atty. Ogie Narvasa, legal counsel sang PBA, kag commissioner Willie Marcial.
english: This was announced by Atty. Ogie Narvasa, PBA legal counsel, and commissioner Willie Marcial.

text: Suno kay Narvasa, dapat nga makakuha sang clearance gikan sa iya nga counselors si Amores bag-o siya tugutan nga maghampang liwat.
english: According to Narvasa, Amores should get clearance from his counselors before he is allowed to play again.

text: Apang tugutan naman si Amores nga magtambong sa practice sang team samtang suspendido ini.
english: However, Amores will be allowed to attend team practice while he is suspended.

text: Mabaton man ni Amores ang iban pa niya nga sweldo kag benepisyo magluwas sa sweldo niya nga natalana sa mga hampang nga suspendido siya.
english: Amores will also receive his other salary and benefits in addition to his salary scheduled for the games for which he is suspended.

text: Ginpahayag ni Marcial nga nakig-angot man ang liga sa Games and Amusements Board (GAB) nahanungod sa desisyon.
english: Marcial said the league also contacted the Games and Amusements Board (GAB) regarding the decision.

text: Una diri, ginpahayag sang GAB nga posibleng indi na pagpasugtan si Amores nga makahampang sa professional leagues.
english: Earlier, the GAB said Amores may not be allowed to play in professional leagues.

text: Paathag ni Narvasa nga ang ila nga desisyon ang base sa mga pagsulundan sang PBA nga ginlapas ni Amores, kag indi direkta nga naangot sa ginkaulamiran niya nga kaso.
english: Narvasa explained that their decision was based on the PBA rules that Amores violated, and not directly related to the case he was aware of.

text: Kaupod ni Amores ang iya nga utod nga ginkasuhan sang attempted homicide bangud sa insidente.
english: Amores was accompanied by his brother who was charged with attempted homicide over the incident.

text: Nahilway sila matapos magbayad sang piyansa.
english: They were released after paying bail.

text: NALIPAY gid kita nga makita ang anay bantogon nga broadcaster nga si Soc Abonado sa isa ka supermart diri sa Mandurriao sadtong Hwebes.
english: WE were delighted to see former famous broadcaster Soc Abonado at a supermart here in Mandurriao on Thursday.

text: Indi lang tungod suod ta nga abyan kag upod sa propesyon sa tri-media si Soc nga madugay wala ta makita sang nagsaylo ini sang interes sa pangabuhi, kundi tungod man kay isa siya sang mga komentarista sa radyo nga kahidlawan mo.
english: Not only because Soc is a close friend and colleague of ours in the tri-media profession whom we haven't seen for a long time since he changed his interests in life, but also because he is one of the radio commentators you will miss.

text: Kilala siya sa iya matandus kag maisug nga pagpangapin sa mga ginapigos kag sa pagpakamalaut sa mga salbahe sa gobyerno sa iya mga komentaryo.
english: He is known for his fierce and courageous defense of the oppressed and for condemning the savages in the government in his commentaries.

text: Nangin matonog iya ngalan sa madamo nga mga eksposey (expose) nga galakip sang anomaliya sa bulong nga substandard nga ginpanagtag sa Iloilo, kag bisan sa anomaliya sa pagpalusot sang sinako nga kalamay nga nakalab-ut pa gani sa Senado.
english: His name became famous in many exposes that included the anomaly in the substandard medicine distributed in Iloilo, and even the anomaly in the smuggling of sacks of sugar that even reached the Senate.

text: Sa karon, isa siya ka kandidato sa pagka-konsehal sa banwa sang Janiuay, Iloilo upod sa linyada ni Congressman Toto Defensor sa pagka-gobernador sang Iloilo sa Mayo 2019 nga eleksyon.
english: He is currently a candidate for councilor in Janiuay, Iloilo along with Congressman Toto Defensor's lineup for governor of Iloilo in the May 2019 elections.

text: Wala siya nagsiling kon ano ang pagdala niya sang mga isyu kag sang iya grupo sa kampanya, apang naseguro naton nga dalhon niya ang mga isyu parti sa mga kamalamalahan nga maangot sa ila kasumpong, lakip na seguro ang isyu sa substandard nga bulong nga kuno nagpatambok sang iban dira.
english: He did not say what issues he and his team will bring to the campaign, but we are sure that he will bring issues about the disasters associated with their opponent, including perhaps the issue of substandard medicine that allegedly made some of them fat.

text: Namuno niya ang parti sang pagpamakal sang raw materials sang bulong sa bili nga isa ka milyon ka pesos (P1 million) nga sang ginluad sang makina nabaligya sing P50 ka milyon!
english: He led the purchase of raw materials for the drug at a cost of one million pesos (P1 million) which when loaded by the machine sold for P50 million!

text: Hamak mo ran, banwa?
english: Your blood, people?

text: Ang masakit dira kay madamo sini mga substandard nga bulong, nga gintunaan sang paglala sang masakit kag kamatayon gani sang madamo nga pasyente.
english: The problem is that many of these drugs are substandard, which has caused worsening of the disease and even death of many patients.

text: Segurado maubo gid sina ang kasumpong mo sa pulitika sa palaabuton nga eleksyon sa Mayo 2019 kon ma-expose mo ining mga anomaliya.
english: Your political opponent in the upcoming May 2019 elections will surely cough if you expose these anomalies.

text: Good luck sa imo masaligan nga pagdaug, Soc!
english: Good luck with your reliable win, Soc!

text:

SAMTANG wala pa matapos ang final counting sang United States midterm elections, maathag na ang pagkapierde sang Republican Party ni President Donald Trump sa House of Representatives, nga gin-dominar niya sadto upod sa Senado.
english:
***

WHILE the final counting of the United States midterm elections is yet to be completed, the loss of President Donald Trump’s Republican Party in the House of Representatives, which he once dominated with the Senate, is clear.

text: Sang Nobyembre 7, isa ka adlaw pagkatapos sang US midterm elections, 219 na ka pulungkuan (seats) sa House ang nadaug sang Democratic Party ni sadto Presidente Barack Obama.
english: On November 7, a day after the US midterm elections, 219 seats in the House were won by former President Barack Obama's Democratic Party.

text: Sobra na ini sa katunga sang 435 ka seats sa kabug-usan sang House.
english: That’s more than half of the 435 seats in the House total.

text: Nagdaug liwat ugaling ang Republican Party, ang  tradisyonal nga kasumpong sang Democratic Party sa two-party system sang Estados Unidos, sa Senado.
english: However, the Republican Party, the traditional opponent of the Democratic Party in the two-party system of the United States, won again in the Senate.

text: Sa amo man nga pag-inisipay sadtong Nobyembre 7, may yara na nga 51 ka seats nga nadaug ang Republican Party sa 100 ka seats nga yara sa Senado, samtang nagapaabot pa sang dugang nga manugdaug.
english: In the same count on November 7, the Republican Party had already won 51 of the 100 seats in the Senate, while more winners are still expected.

text: Ano bala ang buot silingon sini sa pagpalakat sang administrasyon  ni Trump?
english: What does this mean for the Trump administration?

text: Mga observer nagapati nga daku gid ang epekto sini sa karon nga mga programa kag polisa sang Trump administrasyon.
english: Observers believe it will have a profound impact on the Trump administration’s current programs and policies.

text: Labi na gid sa iya ginapatuman nga US-Mexico border sa tunga sang duha ka pungsod batok sa mga illegal immigrants pasulod sa US, sa tax cuts nga iya ginadihon, kag ang programa sa health care.
english: Especially in his enforcement of the US-Mexico border between the two countries against illegal immigrants entering the US, the tax cuts he is proposing, and the health care program.

text: Ang House may eksklusibo nga poder sa mga revenue bills kag pagpalakat sang buhis.Tungo sini laban-laban maapektuhan gid ang plano sa pamuhis ni Trump kag ang kon diin patup-on ang funding sa mga program kag proyekto, lakip na ang pondo sa pagtukod sang US-Mexico border batok sa mga illegal immigrants.
english: The House has exclusive power over revenue bills and tax administration. This will likely affect Trump's tax plan and where funding for programs and projects, including funding for the construction of the US-Mexico border against illegal immigrants, will be severely affected.

text: Tungod sini, ga-expect kita nga mangin mahumok na gawa ang relasyon ni Trump sa mga Democrats kag untaton na niya ang sige bombardiyo sa mga Democrats nga sa karon yara sa mayoriya sa House.
english: Because of this, we expect Trump's relationship with the Democrats to soften and he will stop bombarding the Democrats who are now in the majority in the House.

text: Ukon dungol gid siya iya, nga labi gani magabaris sa paggamit sang gahum sang Presidente upod sa mayoriya sa Senado sang mga kaupod niya sa Republican Party.
english: Or he is so stupid, that he will even challenge the use of the President's power with the majority in the Senate of his colleagues in the Republican Party.

text: Nagtaliwan ang tabloid photojournalist nga si Itoh Son samtang naga-cover sa Traslacion subong nga Byernes, Enero 9.
english: Tabloid photojournalist Itoh Son passed away while covering Traslacion this Friday, January 9.

text: Sa inisyal nga reports, nagsuprer ini sang heart attack kaina sang aga Quirino Grandstand.
english: According to initial reports, he suffered a heart attack this morning at Quirino Grandstand.

text: Ginapahayag nga antes ang iya kamatayon, pila ka adlaw na nga na-trangkaso si Son kadungan sang pre-Traslacion events lakip na sa tradisyunal nga Pahalik.
english: Before his death, Son reportedly had the flu for several days during the pre-Traslacion events including the traditional Pahalik.

text: Suno pa sa Manila Police District (MPD), nagbisita ang photojournalist sa MPD Station 5 sang 3 a.m. para kuhaan kuntani sang laragway ang sitwasyon sa Quirino Grandstand, apang gulpi lang ini nga natumba.
english: According to the Manila Police District (MPD), the photojournalist visited MPD Station 5 at 3 a.m. to take pictures of the situation at the Quirino Grandstand, but suddenly fell.

text: Nagpalab-ot naman ang Presidential Task Force on Media Security sang pagpakig-unong sa pamilya kag mga abyan sang photojournalist.
english: The Presidential Task Force on Media Security extended its condolences to the family and friends of the photojournalist.

text: Suno sa iya, indi Traslacion ang rason sang pagtaliwan sang nasambit nga indibidwal bangud may ginabatyag na ini antes pa man magpartisipar ukon mag-cover sang religious event.
english: He said Traslacion was not the cause of the death of the individual because he was already feeling ill before participating or covering the religious event.

text: Dal-on nanday Sharon Cuneta kag Gabby Concepcion ang ila “Dear Heart” reunion show sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika kag Canada subong nga tuig.
english: Sharon Cuneta and Gabby Concepcion will bring their “Dear Heart” reunion show to the United States of America and Canada this year.

text: Sa separado nga announcement sang anay mag-asawa, ginpahayag nga matabo ang ila collaboration sa shows sa Oktubre kag sa Nobyembre.
english: In a separate announcement, the former couple said their collaboration will take place on shows in October and November.

text: “I know a lot of you have been waiting for us to confirm the rumors.

text: I would like to every one of you to North America — in the USA and Canada — on October and November 2024 for the ‘Dear Heart’ concert tour,” pahayag sang Megastar.
english: I would like to every one of you to North America — in the USA and Canada — on October and November 2024 for the ‘Dear Heart’ concert tour,” the Megastar said.

english: The two first held reunion concerts in Cebu and Pasay City in October and November 2023.

text: Ini nga show ang gin-base sa pelikula sang 1981 nga may amo man nga tig-ulo.

text: Una na gin-ako sang singer-actress nga siya kag si Gabby ang maga-updanay kuntani sila sa show nga “P.S. I Love You” apang wala nadayon ang mga negosasyon.
english: Earlier, the singer-actress admitted that she and Gabby were supposed to be together on the show “P.S. I Love You” but the negotiations did not go through.

text: Kasado sila nga duha sang 1984, may isa ka anak nga amo ang actress-singer nga si KC Concepcion, apang gin-annul ang ila kasal sang 1987.
english: The two were married in 1984, have one child with the actress-singer KC Concepcion, but annulled their marriage in 1987.

text: Malipayon subong ang ex-couple sa ila bag-o nga partners — si Sharon kay former senator Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan, samtang si Gabby naman sa non-showbiz wife nga si Genevieve Yatco Gonzales.

text: Duwa ang patay kag tatlo ang pilason matapos ginbungguan sang bus ang nasugata nga traysikol sa diversion road sang Brgy.
english: Two people were killed and three others injured after a bus hit a tricycle on the diversion road of Brgy.

text: San Vicente, Bato, Camarines Sur.
english: San Vicente, Bato, Camarines Sur.

text: Ang napatay amo ang tricycle driver nga si alyas “Noli”, 45-anyos, residente sang Brgy.
english: The deceased was identified as tricycle driver alias “Noli”, 45, resident of Brgy.

text: Santicon, Polangui, Albay kag isa ka pasahero sini nga si alyas Gab.
english: Santicon, Polangui, Albay and a passenger alias Gab.

text: Ang mga pilason naman amo sanday “Aida”, 64-anyos; “Ann”, 21-anyos; kag duwa ka tuig nga bata nga babaye.
english: The injured were identified as “Aida”, 64; “Ann”, 21-years-old; and a two-year-old daughter.

text: Nagsungka naman sa otoridad ang driver sang bus nga ginamaneho ni Ed, 50-anyos, sang Brgy.
english: The driver of the bus, Ed, 50, of Brgy.

text: Tagbong, Pili, Camarines Sur.
english: Tagbong, Pili, Camarines Sur.

text: Base sa imbestigasyon, nagtuyo nga mag-overtake ang bus sa ginasundan nga wing van truck kag naagaw sini ang linya sang nasugata nga tricycle rason sang bungguanay.
english: According to the investigation, the bus tried to overtake the following wing van truck and took the lane of the oncoming tricycle causing the collision.

text: Nagapangatubang sang kaso nga reckless imprudence resulting in multiple homicide kag multiple physical injuries ang bus driver.
english: The bus driver is facing charges of reckless imprudence resulting in multiple homicide and multiple physical injuries.

text: INUG-implementar na sa bug-os nga pungsod sang Department of Agriculture kag Dept.
english: INUG-implemented nationwide by the Department of Agriculture and Dept.

text: of Trade and Industry, sa bulig sang NFA kag PNP, ang Suggested Retail Price (SRP) sang bugas sunu sa nagakalain-lain sini nga kategoriya ukon klase sa merkado.
english: of Trade and Industry, with the help of NFA and PNP, the Suggested Retail Price (SRP) of rice according to its different categories or classes in the market.

text: Sunu kay DA Secretary Manuel Piñol, ang SRP guideline gin-publikar na sadtong Biyernes, Oktubre 26, pa.
english: According to DA Secretary Manuel Piñol, the SRP guideline was published on Friday, October 26, yesterday.

text: Ang kasuguan naga-requirer ugaling nga ma-implementar lang ang kasuguan pagkatapos pa sang 15 ka adlaw, ukon sa Nobyembre 10 (Sabado), kon ang isip ta halin sa masunod nga adlaw, Oktubre 27.
english: The law requires, however, that the law be implemented only after 15 days, or on November 10 (Saturday), if we think of the next day, October 27.

text: Tungod sini, sa siling man ni Sekretaryo Piñol, manglagas lang sila sang mga erring traders sugod sa sini man nga tion.
english: Therefore, according to Secretary Piñol, they will only pursue erring traders from this time.

text: Ina man tungod ma-implementar lang ang penalties kag sanctions pagkatapos mismo sa sining 15 ka adlaw sang pag-publikar sang SRP guideline.
english: That's because the penalties and sanctions will only be implemented 15 days after the publication of the SRP guideline.

text: Samtang, napat-ud na sang DA kag sang DTI, ang suhestyon sini sa bili (SRP) sang bugas sa merkado nga ginatugutan ibaligya sang mga retailer sa bug-os nga pungsod.
english: Meanwhile, the DA and the DTI have already determined the suggested price (SRP) of rice in the market that is allowed to be sold by retailers nationwide.

text:
Sa na-anunsyar na sang DA kag DTI, ang masunod amo ang SRP nga ipaluntad sa tanan nga merkado sa pungsod, luas sa NFA rice sa tag-P27 kada kilo:

Imported well milled rice, P39 kada kilo; local well milled rice, P44/k; imported premium grade 2, P40/k; imported premium grade 1, P43/k; local premium grade rice, P47/k; Special Rice, wala SRP.
english:
As announced by the DA and DTI, the following are the SRPs to be implemented in all markets in the country, except for NFA rice at P27 per kilo:

Imported well milled rice, P39 per kilo; local well milled rice, P44/k; imported premium grade 2, P40/k; imported premium grade 1, P43/k; local premium grade rice, P47/k; Special Rice, or SRP.

text: Ini nga mga Special Rice nagalakip seguro sang Sandomen, Jasmine, kag iban pa nga bugas nga masami ginabakal sang mga pumuluyo nga may ikasarang sa ila man pagpati nga tungod mahal ini, maayo man ini para sa ila pagkinahanglan.
english: These Special Rice probably include Sandomen, Jasmine, and other rice that are often bought by the people who can afford it in their belief that because it is expensive, it is also good for their needs.

text: Ini nga mga bugas (Special Rice) luyag kan-on nila tungod mas mahamot kag mahumok kon maluto, ukon tungod kinahanglan sang ikaayong lawas sang iban, katulad sang medyo mahal man gawa nga brown rice para sa mga may diabetes.
english: These rices (Special Rice) are preferred because they are more fragrant and soft when cooked, or because they are necessary for the health of others, such as brown rice, which is also relatively expensive for diabetics.

text:
***

Apang, dapat bala pareho ang balor sining SRP kon i-implementar na ini sa nagakalain-lain nga lugar?
english:
***

However, should this SRP have the same value once implemented in different areas?

text: Una nga paghangop naton sini amo nga tungod ang SRP suhestyon (suggested) lang nga presyo indi ini mangin pareho kon ipatuman na sa nagakalain-lain nga lugar.
english: Our first understanding of this is that since the SRP is only a suggested price, it will not be the same when implemented in different areas.

text: Pwede ini nga sunu gid sa natalana nga SRP, ukon basi magnubo pa ukon magtaas man kon amo gid ang bagay.
english: It may be in accordance with the SRP, or it may be lower or higher if necessary.

text: Ina tungod lain-lain man ang circumstancia sa lain-lain man nga lugar ang pagpa-presyo sang bugas sa ginakuhaan, sa pagdala sini sa merkado, kag kon diin ang pwesto sang pagbaligya sang bugas.
english: This is because the pricing of rice at the source, in bringing it to the market, and where the rice is sold is different in different places.

text:
In fact, ginaathag ini sa Implementing Rules and Regulations (IRR) sang Price Act, ukon ang RA 7581, sa idalom sang Rule 1 – Definition of Terms nga “It is the policy of the State to ensure the availability of basic and prime commodities at reasonable prices at all times without denying legitimate business a fair return of investment.”

Sa nahibal-an ta, ang isa ka electric company katulad sang PECO matugutan lang sang ganansya (profit) nga indi magsobra sa 12 ka porsyento tungod sa daku nga kahilabtanan sini sa pagpangabuhi sang publiko, ukon sang kadam-an sang mga pumuluyo.
english:
In fact, it is clarified in the Implementing Rules and Regulations (IRR) of the Price Act, or RA 7581, under Rule 1 – Definition of Terms that “It is the policy of the State to ensure the availability of basic and prime commodities at reasonable prices at all times without denying legitimate business return of fair investment.”

As far as we know, an electric company like PECO is only allowed a profit of not more than 12 percent because of its great involvement in the lives of the public, or the majority of the people.

text: Kaangid man seguro ining pagpatuman sang limitado nga pag-ganansya sa PECO kag iban nga public utilities sa ginapatuman sa IRR sang Price Act sa idalom sang Mandated Price Ceiling nga ma-imponer sang Presidente sa panahon sang “unreasonable increases in prices of (any basic or prime commodity)”.
english: This implementation of limited profitability in PECO and other public utilities is probably similar to the implementation of the IRR of the Price Act under the Mandated Price Ceiling that the President will impose during “unreasonable increases in prices of (any basic or prime commodity)”.

text: Wala kita ugaling makahibalo kon pila gid ining Mandated Price Ceiling para sa SRP nga gintugot sang Presidente agud punggan ang subong nga pagsinaka sang presyo sang bugas.
english: However, we do not know how much is the Mandated Price Ceiling for the SRP that the President approved to curb the current rise in rice prices.

text: Basi 10 ka porsyento ukon pila man nga nahibal-an na sang DTI upod sa Prevailing Price sa subong nga amo na ang ginbasehan sang SRP sa nagakalain-lain nga lugar.
english: Maybe 10 percent or something that the DTI already knows along with the Prevailing Price at the moment that is the basis of the SRP in different areas.

text: Sir Dado Cadena, ano gid bala ang tugot nga presyo sang bugas bisan diri lang sa siyudad sang Iloilo agud maka-preparar kita sang nagakabagay nga badyet sa pag-implementar na sang SRP?
english: Sir Dado Cadena, what is the allowable price of rice even here in Iloilo City so that we can prepare an appropriate budget for the implementation of the SRP?

text: Ginapanan-aw ta ugaling nga madamo gid ang magareklamo, labi na gid sa sige man taas sang balaklon (inflation) nga dalahig man ang mga negosyante sang bugas.
english: However, we expect that many will complain, especially in the face of rising inflation, including rice traders.

text: Ano abe sa imo, Sir Dado?
english: What do you think, Sir Dado?

text: Nagbukas ang mga Philippine financial markets para sa tuig 2025 nga may mixed note nga resulta.
english: Philippine financial markets opened for 2025 with mixed note results.

text: Nagtaas ang mga stocks, apang naghinay ang balor sang peso sa una nga adlaw sang trading sa bag-ong tuig.
english: Stocks rose, but the peso depreciated on the first day of trading in the new year.

text: Ini kasunod sang pag-usisa sang mga economic data pagkatapos sang holiday season.
english: This follows a review of economic data after the holiday season.

text: Ang Philippine Stock Exchange Index (PSEi) nagsaka sang 21.60 points ukon 0.33% sa 6,550.39 sa closing bell, samtang ang All Shares Index nagsaka man sang 6.59 points ukon 0.18% sa 3,755.10.
english: The Philippine Stock Exchange Index (PSEi) was up 21.60 points or 0.33% at 6,550.39 at the closing bell, while the All Shares Index was also up 6.59 points or 0.18% at 3,755.10.

text: Duha ka sektor—financials kag services—ang nagpakita sang pagtaas, apang ang industrial, holding firms, property, kag mining and oil nanubo.
english: Two sectors—financials and services—showed increases, but industrial, holding firms, property, and mining and oil declined.

text: Kapin sa 1.114 bilyon ka shares nga nagabalor sang P3.240 billion ang nabaligya.
english: More than 1.114 billion shares worth P3.240 billion were traded.

text: Kon kuhaon ang extraordinary block shares, ang balor sang turnover nagapundo sa P2.802 billion.
english: Taking out the extraordinary block shares, the value of the turnover stops at P2.802 billion.

text: Mas madamo ang mga shares nga nabuhinan (97) ipaanggid sa mga nagsaka (94), samtang 47 ka shares ang wala nagbag-o.
english: More shares decreased (97) compared to increased (94), while 47 shares remained unchanged.

text: Napatas na sang San Miguel sa 1-1 ang serye sa 2024 PBA Governors’ Cup semifinals batok sa Barangay Ginebra matapos ang overtime sa Game 2 sa Araneta Coliseum sa Quezon City nga nagtakop sa skor nga 131-125.
english: San Miguel tied the series 1-1 in the 2024 PBA Governors' Cup semifinals against Barangay Ginebra after overtime in Game 2 at the Araneta Coliseum in Quezon City that ended with a score of 131-125.

text: Antes nakuha sang Beermen ang kadalag-an, naagaw pa sang Ginebra ang momentum sa fourth quarter sang napanas sini ang 11 puntos nga abanse paagi kay Justin Brownlee nga naka-15 puntos sa amo lamang nga frame.
english: Before the Beermen got the win, Ginebra was able to seize momentum in the fourth quarter when it erased an 11-point lead through Justin Brownlee, who scored 15 points in the same frame.

text: Singko minutos ang nabilin sa oras sa fourth quarter sang nagpatas sa 97 ang skor sang duha ka team paagi sa tres ni Scottie Thompson.
english: With five minutes left on the clock in the fourth quarter, the score was tied at 97 on a Scottie Thompson three.

text: Ang pinaka-interesante nga parte sang hampang amo ang nabilin nga 36 segundos sang 104-103 ang skor pabor sa San Miguel, apang naka-tres si Brownlee.
english: The most interesting part of the game came with 36 seconds left when the score was 104-103 in favor of San Miguel, but Brownlee made a three.
